text_en: N ow the generation of Christ was in this wise. When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph , before they came together, she was found with child, of the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Liber generationis Jesu Christi filii David, filii Abraham.
text_pt: Livro da geração de Jesus Cristo, filho de Davi, filho de Abraão.
text_el: Βίβλος γενέσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ υἱοῦ Δαυὶδ υἱοῦ Ἀβραάμ.

text_en: Abraham begot Isaac . And Isaac begot Jacob . And Jacob begot Judas and his brethren.
text_la: Abraham genuit Isaac. Isaac autem genuit Jacob. Jacob autem genuit Judam, et fratres ejus.
text_pt: Abraão gerou a Isaque; e Isaque gerou a Jacó; e Jacó gerou a Judá e a seus irmãos;
text_el: Ἀβραὰμ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰσαάκ, Ἰσαὰκ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰακώβ, Ἰακὼβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰούδαν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And Judas begot Phares and Zara of Thamar. And Phares begot Esron. And Esron begot Aram.
text_la: Judas autem genuit Phares, et Zaram de Thamar. Phares autem genuit Esron. Esron autem genuit Aram.
text_pt: E Judá gerou, de Tamar, a Perez e a Zerá; e Perez gerou a Esrom; e Esrom gerou a Arão;
text_el: Ἰούδας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Φάρες καὶ τὸν Ζάρα ἐκ τῆς Θαμάρ, Φάρες δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἑσρώμ, Ἑσρὼμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀράμ,

text_en: And Aram begot Aminadab. And Aminadab begot Naasson. And Naasson begot Salmon.
text_la: Aram autem genuit Aminadab. Aminadab autem genuit Naasson. Naasson autem genuit Salmon.
text_pt: E Arão gerou a Aminadabe; e Aminadabe gerou a Naassom; e Naassom gerou a Salmom;
text_el: Ἀρὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀμιναδάβ, Ἀμιναδὰβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ναασσών, Ναασσὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλμών,

text_en: And Salmon begot Booz of Rahab. And Booz begot Obed of Ruth . And Obed begot Jesse.
text_la: Salmon autem genuit Booz de Rahab. Booz autem genuit Obed ex Ruth. Obed autem genuit Jesse. Jesse autem genuit David regem.
text_pt: E Salmom gerou, de Raabe, a Boaz; e Boaz gerou de Rute a Obede; e Obede gerou a Jessé;
text_el: Σαλμὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Βόες ἐκ τῆς Ῥαχάβ, Βόες δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωβὴδ ἐκ τῆς Ῥούθ, Ἰωβὴδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰεσσαί,

text_en: And Jesse begot David the king . And David the king begot Solomon , of her that had been the wife of Urias.
text_la: David autem rex genuit Salomonem ex ea quæ fuit Uriæ.
text_pt: E Jessé gerou ao rei Davi; e o rei Davi gerou a Salomão da que foi mulher de Urias.
text_el: Ἰεσσαὶ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Δαυὶδ τὸν βασιλέα. Δαυὶδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σολομῶνα ἐκ τῆς τοῦ Οὐρίου,

text_en: And Solomon begot Roboam. And Roboam begot Abia. And Abia begot Asa.
text_la: Salomon autem genuit Roboam. Roboam autem genuit Abiam. Abias autem genuit Asa.
text_pt: E Salomão gerou a Roboão; e Roboão gerou a Abias; e Abias gerou a Asa;
text_el: Σολομὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ῥοβοάμ, Ῥοβοὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀβιά, Ἀβιὰ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀσάφ,

text_en: And Asa begot Josaphat . And Josaphat begot Joram. And Joram begot Ozias .
text_la: Asa autem genuit Josophat. Josophat autem genuit Joram. Joram autem genuit Oziam.
text_pt: E Asa gerou a Josafá; e Josafá gerou a Jorão; e Jorão gerou a Uzias;
text_el: Ἀσὰφ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσαφάτ, Ἰωσαφὰτ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωράμ, Ἰωρὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ὀζίαν,

text_en: And Ozias begot Joatham. And Joatham begot Achaz . And Achaz begot Ezechias .
text_la: Ozias autem genuit Joatham. Joatham autem genuit Achaz. Achaz autem genuit Ezechiam.
text_pt: E Uzias gerou a Jotão; e Jotão gerou a Acaz; e Acaz gerou a Ezequias;
text_el: Ὀζίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωαθάμ, Ἰωαθὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἄχας, Ἄχας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἑζεκίαν,

text_en: And Ezechias begot Manasses . And Manasses begot Amon. And Amon begot Josias .
text_la: Ezechias autem genuit Manassen. Manasses autem genuit Amon. Amon autem genuit Josiam.
text_pt: E Ezequias gerou a Manassés; e Manassés gerou a Amom; e Amom gerou a Josias;
text_el: Ἑζεκίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μανασσῆ, Μανασσῆς δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀμώς, Ἀμὼς δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσίαν,

text_en: And Josias begot Jechonias and his brethren in the transmigration of Babylon .
text_la: Josias autem genuit Jechoniam, et fratres ejus in transmigratione Babylonis.
text_pt: E Josias gerou a Jeconias e a seus irmãos na deportação para babilônia.
text_el: Ἰωσίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰεχονίαν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος.

text_en: And after the transmigration of Babylon , Jechonias begot Salathiel. And Salathiel begot Zorobabel.
text_la: Et post transmigrationem Babylonis : Jechonias genuit Salathiel. Salathiel autem genuit Zorobabel.
text_pt: E, depois da deportação para a babilônia, Jeconias gerou a Salatiel; e Salatiel gerou a Zorobabel;
text_el: μετὰ δὲ τὴν μετοικεσίαν Βαβυλῶνος Ἰεχονίας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλαθιήλ, Σαλαθιὴλ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ζοροβαβέλ,

text_en: And Zorobabel begot Abiud. And Abiud begot Eliacim. And Eliacim begot Azor.
text_la: Zorobabel autem genuit Abiud. Abiud autem genuit Eliacim. Eliacim autem genuit Azor.
text_pt: E Zorobabel gerou a Abiúde; e Abiúde gerou a Eliaquim; e Eliaquim gerou a Azor;
text_el: Ζοροβαβὲλ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀβιούδ, Ἀβιοὺδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλιακίμ, Ἐλιακὶμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀζώρ,

text_en: And Azor begot Sadoc. And Sadoc begot Achim. And Achim begot Eliud.
text_la: Azor autem genuit Sadoc. Sadoc autem genuit Achim. Achim autem genuit Eliud.
text_pt: E Azor gerou a Sadoque; e Sadoque gerou a Aquim; e Aquim gerou a Eliúde;
text_el: Ἀζὼρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαδώκ, Σαδὼκ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀχίμ, Ἀχὶμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλιούδ,

text_en: And Eliud begot Eleazar. And Eleazar begot Mathan. And Mathan begot Jacob.
text_la: Eliud autem genuit Eleazar. Eleazar autem genuit Mathan. Mathan autem genuit Jacob.
text_pt: E Eliúde gerou a Eleazar; e Eleazar gerou a Matã; e Matã gerou a Jacó;
text_el: Ἐλιοὺδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλεάζαρ, Ἐλεάζαρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ματθάν, Ματθὰν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰακώβ,

text_en: And Jacob begot Joseph the husband of Mary , of whom was born Jesus , who is called Christ .
text_la: Jacob autem genuit Joseph virum Mariæ, de qua natus est Jesus, qui vocatur Christus.
text_pt: E Jacó gerou a José, marido de Maria, da qual nasceu JESUS, que se chama o Cristo.
text_el: Ἰακὼβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσὴφ τὸν ἄνδρα Μαρίας, ἐξ ἧς ἐγεννήθη Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος Χριστός.

text_en: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations . And from David to the transmigration of Babylon are fourteen generations . And from the transmigration of Babylon to Christ are fourteen generations .
text_la: Omnes itaque generationes ab Abraham usque ad David, generationes quatuordecim : et a David usque ad transmigrationem Babylonis, generationes quatuordecim : et a transmigratione Babylonis usque ad Christum, generationes quatuordecim.
text_pt: De sorte que todas as gerações, desde Abraão até Davi, são catorze gerações; e desde Davi até a deportação para a babilônia, catorze gerações; e desde a deportação para a babilônia até Cristo, catorze gerações.
text_el: Πᾶσαι οὖν αἱ γενεαὶ ἀπὸ Ἀβραὰμ ἕως Δαυὶδ γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες, καὶ ἀπὸ Δαυὶδ ἕως τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες, καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος ἕως τοῦ Χριστοῦ γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες.

text_en: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
text_la: Christi autem generatio sic erat : cum esset desponsata mater ejus Maria Joseph, antequam convenirent inventa est in utero habens de Spiritu Sancto.
text_pt: Ora, o nascimento de Jesus Cristo foi assim: Que estando Maria, sua mãe, desposada com José, antes de se ajuntarem, achou-se ter concebido do Espírito Santo.
text_el: Τοῦ δὲ [Ἰησοῦ] Χριστοῦ ἡ γένεσις οὕτως ἦν. μνηστευθείσης τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ Μαρίας τῷ Ἰωσήφ, πρὶν ἢ συνελθεῖν αὐτοὺς εὑρέθη ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχουσα ἐκ πνεύματος ἁγίου.

text_en: Whereupon Joseph her husband , being a just man , and not willing publicly to expose her, was minded to put her away privately.
text_la: Joseph autem vir ejus cum esset justus, et nollet eam traducere, voluit occulte dimittere eam.
text_pt: Então José, seu marido, como era justo, e a não queria infamar, intentou deixá-la secretamente.
text_el: Ἰωσὴφ δὲ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς, δίκαιος ὢν καὶ μὴ θέλων αὐτὴν δειγματίσαι, ἐβουλήθη λάθρᾳ ἀπολῦσαι αὐτήν.

text_en: But while he thought on these things, behold the Angel of the Lord appeared to him in his sleep, saying: " Joseph , son of David , fear not to take unto you Mary your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Hæc autem eo cogitante, ecce angelus Domini apparuit in somnis ei, dicens : Joseph, fili David, noli timere accipere Mariam conjugem tuam : quod enim in ea natum est, de Spiritu Sancto est.
text_pt: E, projetando ele isto, eis que em sonho lhe apareceu um anjo do Senhor, dizendo: José, filho de Davi, não temas receber a Maria, tua mulher, porque o que nela está gerado é do Espírito Santo;
text_el: ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐνθυμηθέντος ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου κατ' ὄναρ ἐφάνη αὐτῷ λέγων, Ἰωσὴφ υἱὸς Δαυίδ, μὴ φοβηθῇς παραλαβεῖν Μαρίαν τὴν γυναῖκά σου, τὸ γὰρ ἐν αὐτῇ γεννηθὲν ἐκ πνεύματός ἐστιν ἁγίου:

text_en: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Jesus , for he shall save his people from their sins ."
text_la: Pariet autem filium : et vocabis nomen ejus Jesum : ipse enim salvum faciet populum suum a peccatis eorum.
text_pt: E dará à luz um filho e chamarás o seu nome JESUS; porque ele salvará o seu povo dos seus pecados.
text_el: τέξεται δὲ υἱὸν καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν, αὐτὸς γὰρ σώσει τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν.

text_en: Now all this was done that it might be fulfilled which the Lord spoke by the prophet , saying:
text_la: Hoc autem totum factum est, ut adimpleretur quod dictum est a Domino per prophetam dicentem:
text_pt: Tudo isto aconteceu para que se cumprisse o que foi dito da parte do Senhor, pelo profeta, que diz;
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ ὅλον γέγονεν ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν ὑπὸ κυρίου διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος,

text_en: "Behold a virgin shall be with child, and bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel ," which being interpreted is "God with us."
text_la: Ecce virgo in utero habebit, et pariet filium : et vocabunt nomen ejus Emmanuel, quod est interpretatum Nobiscum Deus.
text_pt: Eis que a virgem conceberá, e dará à luz um filho, E chamá-lo-ão pelo nome de EMANUEL, Que traduzido é: Deus conosco.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡ παρθένος ἐν γαστρὶ ἕξει καὶ τέξεται υἱόν, καὶ καλέσουσιν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἐμμανουήλ, ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον μεθ' ἡμῶν ὁ θεός.

text_en: And Joseph , rising up from sleep, did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him, and took unto him his wife.
text_la: Exsurgens autem Joseph a somno, fecit sicut præcepit ei angelus Domini, et accepit conjugem suam.
text_pt: E José, despertando do sono, fez como o anjo do Senhor lhe ordenara, e recebeu a sua mulher;
text_el: ἐγερθεὶς δὲ [ὁ] Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕπνου ἐποίησεν ὡς προσέταξεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου καὶ παρέλαβεν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ:

text_en: And he knew her not till she brought forth her first born son , and he called his name Jesus .
text_la: Et non cognoscebat eam donec peperit filium suum primogenitum : et vocavit nomen ejus Jesum.
text_pt: E não a conheceu até que deu à luz seu filho, o primogênito; e pôs-lhe por nome Jesus.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκεν αὐτὴν ἕως [οὗ] ἔτεκεν υἱόν: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: When Jesus therefore was born in Bethlehem of Juda , in the days of King Herod , behold, there came wise men from the East to Jerusalem ,
text_la: Cum ergo natus esset Jesus in Bethlehem Juda in diebus Herodis regis, ecce magi ab oriente venerunt Jerosolymam,
text_pt: E, tendo nascido Jesus em Belém de Judéia, no tempo do rei Herodes, eis que uns magos vieram do oriente a Jerusalém,
text_el: Τοῦ δὲ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος ἐν Βηθλέεμ τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἐν ἡμέραις Ἡρῴδου τοῦ βασιλέως, ἰδοὺ μάγοι ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν παρεγένοντο εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα

text_en: saying: "Where is he that is born king of the Jews ? For we have seen his star in the East, and have come to adore him."
text_la: dicentes : Ubi est qui natus est rex Judæorum? vidimus enim stellam ejus in oriente, et venimus adorare eum.
text_pt: Dizendo: Onde está aquele que é nascido rei dos judeus? porque vimos a sua estrela no oriente, e viemos a adorá-lo.
text_el: λέγοντες, ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ τεχθεὶς βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων; εἴδομεν γὰρ αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀστέρα ἐν τῇ ἀνατολῇ καὶ ἤλθομεν προσκυνῆσαι αὐτῷ.

text_en: And King Herod , hearing this, was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
text_la: Audiens autem Herodes rex, turbatus est, et omnis Jerosolyma cum illo.
text_pt: E o rei Herodes, ouvindo isto, perturbou-se, e toda Jerusalém com ele.
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἡρῴδης ἐταράχθη καὶ πᾶσα Ἱεροσόλυμα μετ' αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And assembling together all the chief priests and the scribes of the people, he inquired of them where Christ should be born.
text_la: Et congregans omnes principes sacerdotum, et scribas populi, sciscitabatur ab eis ubi Christus nasceretur.
text_pt: E, congregados todos os príncipes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas do povo, perguntou-lhes onde havia de nascer o Cristo.
text_el: καὶ συναγαγὼν πάντας τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ γραμματεῖς τοῦ λαοῦ ἐπυνθάνετο παρ' αὐτῶν ποῦ ὁ Χριστὸς γεννᾶται.

text_en: But they said to him: "In Bethlehem of Juda . For so it is written by the prophet :
text_la: At illi dixerunt : In Bethlehem Judæ : sic enim scriptum est per prophetam:
text_pt: E eles lhe disseram: Em Belém de Judéia; porque assim está escrito pelo profeta:
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ, ἐν Βηθλέεμ τῆς Ἰουδαίας: οὕτως γὰρ γέγραπται διὰ τοῦ προφήτου:

text_en: 'And you, Bethlehem the land of Juda , are not the least among the princes of Juda : for out of you shall come forth the captain that shall rule my people Israel .'"
text_la: Et tu Bethlehem terra Juda, nequaquam minima es in principibus Juda : ex te enim exiet dux, qui regat populum meum Israël.
text_pt: E tu, Belém, terra de Judá,De modo nenhum és a menor entre as capitais de Judá;porque de ti sairá o Guia que há de apascentar o meu povo Israel.
text_el: καὶ σύ, Βηθλέεμ γῆ Ἰούδα, οὐδαμῶς ἐλαχίστη εἶ ἐν τοῖς ἡγεμόσιν Ἰούδα: ἐκ σοῦ γὰρ ἐξελεύσεται ἡγούμενος, ὅστις ποιμανεῖ τὸν λαόν μου τὸν Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: Then Herod , privately calling the wise men , learned diligently of them the time of the star which appeared to them;
text_la: Tunc Herodes clam vocatis magis diligenter didicit ab eis tempus stellæ, quæ apparuit eis:
text_pt: Então Herodes, chamando secretamente os magos, inquiriu exatamente deles acerca do tempo em que a estrela lhes aparecera.
text_el: τότε Ἡρῴδης λάθρᾳ καλέσας τοὺς μάγους ἠκρίβωσεν παρ' αὐτῶν τὸν χρόνον τοῦ φαινομένου ἀστέρος,

text_en: and sending them into Bethlehem , said: "Go and diligently inquire after the child, and when you have found him, bring me word again, that I also may come and adore him."
text_la: et mittens illos in Bethlehem, dixit : Ite, et interrogate diligenter de puero : et cum inveneritis, renuntiate mihi, ut et ego veniens adorem eum.
text_pt: E, enviando-os a Belém, disse: Ide, e perguntai diligentemente pelo menino e, quando o achardes, participai-mo, para que também eu vá e o adore.
text_el: καὶ πέμψας αὐτοὺς εἰς Βηθλέεμ εἶπεν, πορευθέντες ἐξετάσατε ἀκριβῶς περὶ τοῦ παιδίου: ἐπὰν δὲ εὕρητε ἀπαγγείλατέ μοι, ὅπως κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν προσκυνήσω αὐτῷ.

text_en: Who having heard the king, went their way. And behold, the star which they had seen in the East went before them, until it came and stood over where the child was.
text_la: Qui cum audissent regem, abierunt, et ecce stella, quam viderant in oriente, antecedebat eos, usque dum veniens staret supra, ubi erat puer.
text_pt: E, tendo eles ouvido o rei, partiram; e eis que a estrela, que tinham visto no oriente, ia adiante deles, até que, chegando, se deteve sobre o lugar onde estava o menino.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπορεύθησαν, καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁ ἀστὴρ ὃν εἶδον ἐν τῇ ἀνατολῇ προῆγεν αὐτοὺς ἕως ἐλθὼν ἐστάθη ἐπάνω οὗ ἦν τὸ παιδίον.

text_en: And seeing the star they rejoiced with exceeding great joy .
text_la: Videntes autem stellam gavisi sunt gaudio magno valde.
text_pt: E, vendo eles a estrela, regoziram-se muito com grande alegria.
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ τὸν ἀστέρα ἐχάρησαν χαρὰν μεγάλην σφόδρα.

text_en: And entering into the house, they found the child with Mary his mother; and falling down they adored him. And opening their treasures, they offered him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
text_la: Et intrantes domum, invenerunt puerum cum Maria matre ejus, et procidentes adoraverunt eum : et apertis thesauris suis obtulerunt ei munera, aurum, thus, et myrrham.
text_pt: E, entrando na casa, acharam o menino com Maria sua mãe e, prostrando-se, o adoraram; e abrindo os seus tesouros, ofertaram-lhe dádivas: ouro, incenso e mirra.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθόντες εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν εἶδον τὸ παιδίον μετὰ Μαρίας τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ πεσόντες προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἀνοίξαντες τοὺς θησαυροὺς αὐτῶν προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δῶρα, χρυσὸν καὶ λίβανον καὶ σμύρναν.

text_en: And having received an answer in sleep that they should not return to Herod , they went back another way into their country.
text_la: Et responso accepto in somnis ne redirent ad Herodem, per aliam viam reversi sunt in regionem suam.
text_pt: E, sendo por divina revelação avisados num sonho para que não voltassem para junto de Herodes, partiram para a sua terra por outro caminho.
text_el: καὶ χρηματισθέντες κατ' ὄναρ μὴ ἀνακάμψαι πρὸς Ἡρῴδην, δι' ἄλλης ὁδοῦ ἀνεχώρησαν εἰς τὴν χώραν αὐτῶν.

text_en: And after they had departed, behold an angel of the Lord appeared in sleep to Joseph , saying: Arise, and take the child and his mother, and fly into Egypt : and be there until I shall tell you. For it will come to pass that Herod will seek the child to destroy him.
text_la: Qui cum recessissent, ecce angelus Domini apparuit in somnis Joseph, dicens : Surge, et accipe puerum, et matrem ejus, et fuge in Ægyptum, et esto ibi usque dum dicam tibi. Futurum est enim ut Herodes quærat puerum ad perdendum eum.
text_pt: E, tendo eles se retirado, eis que o anjo do Senhor apareceu a José num sonho, dizendo: Levanta-te, e toma o menino e sua mãe, e foge para o Egito, e demora-te lá até que eu te diga; porque Herodes há de procurar o menino para o matar.
text_el: Ἀναχωρησάντων δὲ αὐτῶν ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου φαίνεται κατ' ὄναρ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ λέγων, ἐγερθεὶς παράλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ φεῦγε εἰς Αἴγυπτον, καὶ ἴσθι ἐκεῖ ἕως ἂν εἴπω σοι: μέλλει γὰρ Ἡρῴδης ζητεῖν τὸ παιδίον τοῦ ἀπολέσαι αὐτό.

text_en: Who arose, and took the child and his mother by night, and retired into Egypt : and he was there until the death of Herod :
text_la: Qui consurgens accepit puerum et matrem ejus nocte, et secessit in Ægyptum:
text_pt: E, levantando-se ele, tomou o menino e sua mãe, de noite, e foi para o Egito.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἐγερθεὶς παρέλαβεν τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς καὶ ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον,

text_en: That it might be fulfilled which the Lord spoke by the prophet , saying: Out of Egypt have I called my son.
text_la: et erat ibi usque ad obitum Herodis : ut adimpleretur quod dictum est a Domino per prophetam dicentem : Ex Ægypto vocavi filium meum.
text_pt: E esteve lá, até à morte de Herodes, para que se cumprisse o que foi dito da parte do Senhor pelo profeta, que diz: Do Egito chamei o meu Filho.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ ἕως τῆς τελευτῆς Ἡρῴδου: ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν ὑπὸ κυρίου διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος, ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἐκάλεσα τὸν υἱόν μου.

text_en: Then Herod perceiving that he was deluded by the wise men , was exceeding angry : and sending killed all the menchildren that were in Bethlehem , and in all the borders thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently inquired of the wise men .
text_la: Tunc Herodes videns quoniam illusus esset a magis, iratus est valde, et mittens occidit omnes pueros, qui erant in Bethlehem, et in omnibus finibus ejus, a bimatu et infra secundum tempus, quod exquisierat a magis.
text_pt: Então Herodes, vendo que tinha sido iludido pelos magos, irritou-se muito, e mandou matar todos os meninos que havia em Belém, e em todos os seus contornos, de dois anos para baixo, segundo o tempo que diligentemente inquirira dos magos.
text_el: Τότε Ἡρῴδης ἰδὼν ὅτι ἐνεπαίχθη ὑπὸ τῶν μάγων ἐθυμώθη λίαν, καὶ ἀποστείλας ἀνεῖλεν πάντας τοὺς παῖδας τοὺς ἐν Βηθλέεμ καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῆς ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κατωτέρω, κατὰ τὸν χρόνον ὃν ἠκρίβωσεν παρὰ τῶν μάγων.

text_en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet , saying:
text_la: Tunc adimpletum est quod dictum est per Jeremiam prophetam dicentem:
text_pt: Então se cumpriu o que foi dito pelo profeta Jeremias, que diz:
text_el: τότε ἐπληρώθη τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἰερεμίου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος,

text_en: A voice in Rama was heard, lamentation and great mourning; Rachel bewailing her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
text_la: Vox in Rama audita est ploratus, et ululatus multus : Rachel plorans filios suos, et noluit consolari, quia non sunt.
text_pt: Em Ramá se ouviu uma voz, Lamentação, choro e grande pranto: Raquel chorando os seus filhos, E não quer ser consolada, porque já não existem.
text_el: φωνὴ ἐν Ῥαμὰ ἠκούσθη, κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὀδυρμὸς πολύς: Ῥαχὴλ κλαίουσα τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν παρακληθῆναι, ὅτι οὐκ εἰσίν.

text_en: But when Herod was dead, behold an angel of the Lord appeared in sleep to Joseph in Egypt ,
text_la: Defuncto autem Herode, ecce angelus Domini apparuit in somnis Joseph in Ægypto,
text_pt: Morto, porém, Herodes, eis que o anjo do Senhor apareceu num sonho a José no Egito,
text_el: Τελευτήσαντος δὲ τοῦ Ἡρῴδου ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου φαίνεται κατ' ὄναρ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: saying: Arise, and take the child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel . For they are dead that sought the life of the child.
text_la: dicens : Surge, et accipe puerum, et matrem ejus, et vade in terram Israël : defuncti sunt enim qui quærebant animam pueri.
text_pt: Dizendo: Levanta-te, e toma o menino e sua mãe, e vai para a terra de Israel; porque já estão mortos os que procuravam a morte do menino.
text_el: λέγων, ἐγερθεὶς παράλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ πορεύου εἰς γῆν Ἰσραήλ, τεθνήκασιν γὰρ οἱ ζητοῦντες τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ παιδίου.

text_en: Who arose, and took the child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel .
text_la: Qui consurgens, accepit puerum, et matrem ejus, et venit in terram Israël.
text_pt: Então ele se levantou, e tomou o menino e sua mãe, e foi para a terra de Israel.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἐγερθεὶς παρέλαβεν τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς γῆν Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: But hearing that Archelaus reigned in Judea in the room of Herod his father, he was afraid to go thither: and being warned in sleep retired into the quarters of Galilee .
text_la: Audiens autem quod Archelaus regnaret in Judæa pro Herode patre suo, timuit illo ire : et admonitus in somnis, secessit in partes Galilææ.
text_pt: E, ouvindo que Arquelau reinava na Judéia em lugar de Herodes, seu pai, receou ir para lá; mas avisado num sonho, por divina revelação, foi para as partes da Galiléia.
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ ὅτι Ἀρχέλαος βασιλεύει τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἀντὶ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ἡρῴδου ἐφοβήθη ἐκεῖ ἀπελθεῖν: χρηματισθεὶς δὲ κατ' ὄναρ ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὰ μέρη τῆς Γαλιλαίας.

text_en: And coming he dwelt in a city called Nazareth : that it might be fulfilled which was said by the prophets : That he shall be called a Nazarene .
text_la: Et veniens habitavit in civitate quæ vocatur Nazareth : ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per prophetas : Quoniam Nazaræus vocabitur.
text_pt: E chegou, e habitou numa cidade chamada Nazaré, para que se cumprisse o que fora dito pelos profetas: Ele será chamado Nazareno.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν κατῴκησεν εἰς πόλιν λεγομένην Ναζαρέτ, ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τῶν προφητῶν ὅτι Ναζωραῖος κληθήσεται.

text_en: And in those days comes John the Baptist preaching in the desert of Judea .
text_la: In diebus autem illis venit Joannes Baptista prædicans in deserto Judææ,
text_pt: E, naqueles dias, apareceu João o Batista pregando no deserto da Judéia,
text_el: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις παραγίνεται Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτιστὴς κηρύσσων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῆς Ἰουδαίας

text_en: And saying: Do penance : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
text_la: et dicens : Pœnitentiam agite : appropinquavit enim regnum cælorum.
text_pt: E dizendo: Arrependei-vos, porque é chegado o reino dos céus.
text_el: λέγων, μετανοεῖτε, ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

text_en: For this is he that was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet , saying: A voice of one crying in the desert , Prepare the way of the Lord , make straight his paths.
text_la: Hic est enim, qui dictus est per Isaiam prophetam dicentem : Vox clamantis in deserto : Parate viam Domini; rectas facite semitas ejus.
text_pt: Porque este é o anunciado pelo profeta Isaías, que disse:Voz do que clama no deserto:Preparai o caminho do Senhor,Endireitai as suas veredas.
text_el: οὗτος γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ῥηθεὶς διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος: φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the same John had his garment of camel's hair , and a leathern girdle about his loins: and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
text_la: Ipse autem Joannes habebat vestimentum de pilis camelorum, et zonam pelliceam circa lumbos suos : esca autem ejus erat locustæ, et mel silvestre.
text_pt: E este João tinha as suas vestes de pelos de camelo, e um cinto de couro em torno de seus lombos; e alimentava-se de gafanhotos e de mel silvestre.
text_el: αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Ἰωάννης εἶχεν τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τριχῶν καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ, ἡ δὲ τροφὴ ἦν αὐτοῦ ἀκρίδες καὶ μέλι ἄγριον.

text_en: Then went out to him Jerusalem and all Judea , and all the country about Jordan :
text_la: Tunc exibat ad eum Jerosolyma, et omnis Judæa, et omnis regio circa Jordanem;
text_pt: Então ia ter com ele Jerusalém, e toda a Judéia, e toda a província adjacente ao Jordão;
text_el: τότε ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία καὶ πᾶσα ἡ περίχωρος τοῦ Ἰορδάνου,

text_en: And were baptized by him in the Jordan , confessing their sins .
text_la: et baptizabantur ab eo in Jordane, confitentes peccata sua.
text_pt: E eram por ele batizados no rio Jordão, confessando os seus pecados.
text_el: καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ὑπ' αὐτοῦ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.

text_en: And seeing many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism , he said to them: You brood of vipers, who has showed you to flee from the wrath to come?
text_la: Videns autem multos pharisæorum, et sadducæorum, venientes ad baptismum suum, dixit eis : Progenies viperarum, quis demonstravit vobis fugere a ventura ira?
text_pt: E, vendo ele muitos dos fariseus e dos saduceus, que vinham ao seu batismo, dizia-lhes: Raça de víboras, quem vos ensinou a fugir da ira futura?
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ πολλοὺς τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων ἐρχομένους ἐπὶ τὸ βάπτισμα εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς;

text_en: Bring forth therefore fruit worthy of penance .
text_la: Facite ergo fructum dignum pœnitentiæ.
text_pt: Produzi, pois, frutos dignos de arrependimento;
text_el: ποιήσατε οὖν καρπὸν ἄξιον τῆς μετανοίας:

text_en: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham for our father. For I tell you that God is able of these stones to raise up children to Abraham .
text_la: Et ne velitis dicere intra vos : Patrem habemus Abraham. Dico enim vobis quoniam potens est Deus de lapidibus istis suscitare filios Abrahæ.
text_pt: E não presumais, de vós mesmos, dizendo: Temos por pai a Abraão; porque eu vos digo que, mesmo destas pedras, Deus pode suscitar filhos a Abraão.
text_el: καὶ μὴ δόξητε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς, πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ, λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ.

text_en: For now the axe is laid to the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that does not yield good fruit, shall be cut down, and cast into the fire.
text_la: Jam enim securis ad radicem arborum posita est. Omnis ergo arbor, quæ non facit fructum bonum, excidetur, et in ignem mittetur.
text_pt: E também agora está posto o machado à raiz das árvores; toda a árvore, pois, que não produz bom fruto, é cortada e lançada no fogo.
text_el: ἤδη δὲ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται: πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.

text_en: I indeed baptize you in water unto penance , but he that shall come after me, is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you in the Holy Ghost and fire.
text_la: Ego quidem baptizo vos in aqua in pœnitentiam : qui autem post me venturus est, fortior me est, cujus non sum dignus calceamenta portare : ipse vos baptizabit in Spiritu Sancto, et igni.
text_pt: E eu, em verdade, vos batizo com água, para o arrependimento; mas aquele que vem após mim é mais poderoso do que eu; cujas alparcas não sou digno de levar; ele vos batizará com o Espírito Santo, e com fogo.
text_el: ἐγὼ μὲν ὑμᾶς βαπτίζω ἐν ὕδατι εἰς μετάνοιαν: ὁ δὲ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος ἰσχυρότερός μού ἐστιν, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς τὰ ὑποδήματα βαστάσαι: αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ καὶ πυρί:

text_en: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his floor and gather his wheat into the barn; but the chaff he will burn with unquenchable fire.
text_la: Cujus ventilabrum in manu sua : et permundabit aream suam : et congregabit triticum suum in horreum, paleas autem comburet igni inextinguibili.
text_pt: Em sua mão tem a pá, e limpará a sua eira, e recolherá no celeiro o seu trigo, e queimará a palha com fogo que nunca se apagará.
text_el: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ διακαθαριεῖ τὴν ἅλωνα αὐτοῦ, καὶ συνάξει τὸν σῖτον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην, τὸ δὲ ἄχυρον κατακαύσει πυρὶ ἀσβέστῳ.

text_en: Then comes Jesus from Galilee to the Jordan , unto John , to be baptized by him.
text_la: Tunc venit Jesus a Galilæa in Jordanem ad Joannem, ut baptizaretur ab eo.
text_pt: Então veio Jesus da Galiléia ter com João, junto do Jordão, para ser batizado por ele.
text_el: Τότε παραγίνεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰορδάνην πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάννην τοῦ βαπτισθῆναι ὑπ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: But John stayed him, saying: I ought to be baptized by you, and you come to me?
text_la: Joannes autem prohibebat eum, dicens : Ego a te debeo baptizari, et tu venis ad me?
text_pt: Mas João opunha-se-lhe, dizendo: Eu careço de ser batizado por ti, e vens tu a mim?
text_el: ὁ δὲ διεκώλυεν αὐτὸν λέγων: ἐγὼ χρείαν ἔχω ὑπὸ σοῦ βαπτισθῆναι, καὶ σὺ ἔρχῃ πρός με;

text_en: And Jesus answering, said to him: Allow it to be so now. For so it becomes us to fulfil all justice . Then he allowed him.
text_la: Respondens autem Jesus, dixit ei : Sine modo : sic enim decet nos implere omnem justitiam. Tunc dimisit eum.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, respondendo, disse-lhe: Deixa por agora, porque assim nos convém cumprir toda a justiça. Então ele o permitiu.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ, ἄφες ἄρτι, οὕτως γὰρ πρέπον ἐστὶν ἡμῖν πληρῶσαι πᾶσαν δικαιοσύνην. τότε ἀφίησιν αὐτόν.

text_en: And Jesus being baptized , forthwith came out of the water: and lo, the heavens were opened to him: and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove , and coming upon him.
text_la: Baptizatus autem Jesus, confestim ascendit de aqua, et ecce aperti sunt ei cæli : et vidit Spiritum Dei descendentem sicut columbam, et venientem super se.
text_pt: E, sendo Jesus batizado, saiu logo da água, e eis que se lhe abriram os céus, e viu o Espírito de Deus descendo como pomba e vindo sobre ele.
text_el: βαπτισθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εὐθὺς ἀνέβη ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕδατος: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἠνεῴχθησαν οἱ οὐρανοί, καὶ εἶδεν πνεῦμα θεοῦ καταβαῖνον ὡσεὶ περιστερὰν ἐρχόμενον ἐπ' αὐτόν:

text_en: And behold a voice from heaven saying: This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased.
text_la: Et ecce vox de cælis dicens : Hic est Filius meus dilectus, in quo mihi complacui.
text_pt: E eis que uma voz dos céus dizia: Este é o meu Filho amado, em quem me comprazo.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ φωνὴ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν λέγουσα, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν ᾧ εὐδόκησα.

text_en: Then Jesus was led by the spirit into the desert , to be tempted by the devil .
text_la: Tunc Jesus ductus est in desertum a Spiritu, ut tentaretur a diabolo.
text_pt: Então foi conduzido Jesus pelo Espírito ao deserto, para ser tentado pelo diabo.
text_el: Τότε [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς ἀνήχθη εἰς τὴν ἔρημον ὑπὸ τοῦ πνεύματος, πειρασθῆναι ὑπὸ τοῦ διαβόλου.

text_en: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, afterwards he was hungry.
text_la: Et cum jejunasset quadraginta diebus, et quadraginta noctibus, postea esuriit.
text_pt: E, tendo jejuado quarenta dias e quarenta noites, depois teve fome;
text_el: καὶ νηστεύσας ἡμέρας τεσσεράκοντα καὶ νύκτας τεσσεράκοντα, ὕστερον ἐπείνασεν.

text_en: And the tempter coming said to him: If you be the Son of God , command that these stones be made bread.
text_la: Et accedens tentator dixit ei : Si Filius Dei es, dic ut lapides isti panes fiant.
text_pt: E, chegando-se a ele o tentador, disse: Se tu és o Filho de Deus, manda que estas pedras se tornem em pães.
text_el: καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ πειράζων εἶπεν αὐτῷ, εἰ υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ θεοῦ, εἰπὸν ἵνα οἱ λίθοι οὗτοι ἄρτοι γένωνται.

text_en: Who answered and said: It is written, Not in bread alone does man live, but in every word that proceeds from the mouth of God .
text_la: Qui respondens dixit : Scriptum est : Non in solo pane vivit homo, sed in omni verbo, quod procedit de ore Dei.
text_pt: Ele, porém, respondendo, disse: Está escrito: Nem só de pão viverá o homem, mas de toda a palavra que sai da boca de Deus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν, γέγραπται, οὐκ ἐπ' ἄρτῳ μόνῳ ζήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος, ἀλλ' ἐπὶ παντὶ ῥήματι ἐκπορευομένῳ διὰ στόματος θεοῦ.

text_en: Then the devil took him up into the holy city , and set him upon the pinnacle of the temple ,
text_la: Tunc assumpsit eum diabolus in sanctam civitatem, et statuit eum super pinnaculum templi,
text_pt: Então o diabo o transportou à cidade santa, e colocou-o sobre o pináculo do templo,
text_el: τότε παραλαμβάνει αὐτὸν ὁ διάβολος εἰς τὴν ἁγίαν πόλιν, καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ πτερύγιον τοῦ ἱεροῦ,

text_en: And said to him: If you be the Son of God , cast yourself down, for it is written: That he has given his angels charge over you, and in their hands shall they bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.
text_la: et dixit ei : Si Filius Dei es, mitte te deorsum. Scriptum est enim : Quia angelis suis mandavit de te, et in manibus tollent te, ne forte offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Se tu és o Filho de Deus, lança-te de aqui abaixo; porque está escrito: Que aos seus anjos dará ordens a teu respeito, E tomar-te-ão nas mãos, Para que nunca tropeces com o teu pé em alguma pedra.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ, εἰ υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ θεοῦ, βάλε σεαυτὸν κάτω: γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ ἐντελεῖται περὶ σοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἀροῦσίν σε, μήποτε προσκόψῃς πρὸς λίθον τὸν πόδα σου.

text_en: Jesus said to him: It is written again: You shall not tempt the Lord your God .
text_la: Ait illi Jesus : Rursum scriptum est : Non tentabis Dominum Deum tuum.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Também está escrito: Não tentarás o Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, πάλιν γέγραπται, οὐκ ἐκπειράσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου.

text_en: Again the devil took him up into a very high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them,
text_la: Iterum assumpsit eum diabolus in montem excelsum valde : et ostendit ei omnia regna mundi, et gloriam eorum,
text_pt: Novamente o transportou o diabo a um monte muito alto; e mostrou-lhe todos os reinos do mundo, e a glória deles.
text_el: πάλιν παραλαμβάνει αὐτὸν ὁ διάβολος εἰς ὄρος ὑψηλὸν λίαν, καὶ δείκνυσιν αὐτῷ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας τοῦ κόσμου καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν,

text_en: And said to him: All these will I give you, if falling down you will adore me.
text_la: et dixit ei : Hæc omnia tibi dabo, si cadens adoraveris me.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Tudo isto te darei se, prostrado, me adorares.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, ταῦτά σοι πάντα δώσω ἐὰν πεσὼν προσκυνήσῃς μοι.

text_en: Then Jesus said to him: Begone, Satan : for it is written: The Lord your God shall you adore , and him only shall you serve.
text_la: Tunc dicit ei Jesus : Vade Satana : Scriptum est enim : Dominum Deum tuum adorabis, et illi soli servies.
text_pt: Então disse-lhe Jesus: Vai-te, Satanás, porque está escrito: Ao Senhor teu Deus adorarás, e só a ele servirás.
text_el: τότε λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ὕπαγε, Σατανᾶ: γέγραπται γάρ, κύριον τὸν θεόν σου προσκυνήσεις καὶ αὐτῷ μόνῳ λατρεύσεις.

text_en: Then the devil left him; and behold angels came and ministered to him.
text_la: Tunc reliquit eum diabolus : et ecce angeli accesserunt, et ministrabant ei.
text_pt: Então o diabo o deixou; e, eis que chegaram os anjos, e o serviam.
text_el: τότε ἀφίησιν αὐτὸν ὁ διάβολος, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄγγελοι προσῆλθον καὶ διηκόνουν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And when Jesus had heard that John was delivered up, he retired into Galilee :
text_la: Cum autem audisset Jesus quod Joannes traditus esset, secessit in Galilæam:
text_pt: Jesus, porém, ouvindo que João estava preso, voltou para a Galiléia;
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ ὅτι Ἰωάννης παρεδόθη ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.

text_en: And leaving the city Nazareth , he came and dwelt in Capharnaum on the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and of Nephthalim ;
text_la: et, relicta civitate Nazareth, venit, et habitavit in Capharnaum maritima, in finibus Zabulon et Nephthalim:
text_pt: E, deixando Nazaré, foi habitar em Cafarnaum, cidade marítima, nos confins de Zebulom e Naftali;
text_el: καὶ καταλιπὼν τὴν Ναζαρὰ ἐλθὼν κατῴκησεν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ τὴν παραθαλασσίαν ἐν ὁρίοις Ζαβουλὼν καὶ Νεφθαλίμ,

text_en: that it might be fulfilled which was said by Isaiah the prophet :
text_la: ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Isaiam prophetam:
text_pt: Para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo profeta Isaías, que diz:
text_el: ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος:

text_en: Land of Zabulon and land of Nephthalim , the way of the sea beyond the Jordan , Galilee of the Gentiles :
text_la: Terra Zabulon, et terra Nephthalim, via maris trans Jordanem, Galilæa gentium :
text_pt: A terra de Zebulom, e a terra de Naftali, Junto ao caminho do mar, além do Jordão, A Galiléia das nações;
text_el: γῆ Ζαβουλὼν καὶ γῆ Νεφθαλίμ, ὁδὸν θαλάσσης, πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, Γαλιλαία τῶν ἐθνῶν,

text_en: The people that sat in darkness, has seen great light: and to them that sat in the region of the shadow of death, light has sprung up.
text_la: populus, qui sedebat in tenebris, vidit lucem magnam : et sedentibus in regione umbræ mortis, lux orta est eis.
text_pt: O povo, que estava assentado em trevas, Viu uma grande luz; aos que estavam assentados na região e sombra da morte,A luz raiou.
text_el: ὁ λαὸς ὁ καθήμενος ἐν σκοτίᾳ φῶς εἶδεν μέγα, καὶ τοῖς καθημένοις ἐν χώρᾳ καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου φῶς ἀνέτειλεν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say: Do penance , for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
text_la: Exinde cœpit Jesus prædicare, et dicere : Pœnitentiam agite : appropinquavit enim regnum cælorum.
text_pt: Desde então começou Jesus a pregar, e a dizer: Arrependei-vos, porque é chegado o reino dos céus.
text_el: Ἀπὸ τότε ἤρξατο ὁ Ἰησοῦς κηρύσσειν καὶ λέγειν, μετανοεῖτε, ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

text_en: And Jesus walking by the sea of Galilee , saw two brethren, Simon who is called Peter , and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea (for they were fishers).
text_la: Ambulans autem Jesus juxta mare Galilææ, vidit duos fratres, Simonem, qui vocatur Petrus, et Andream fratrem ejus, mittentes rete in mare (erant enim piscatores),
text_pt: E Jesus, andando junto ao mar da Galiléia, viu a dois irmãos, Simão, chamado Pedro, e André, seu irmão, os quais lançavam as redes ao mar, porque eram pescadores;
text_el: Περιπατῶν δὲ παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶδεν δύο ἀδελφούς, Σίμωνα τὸν λεγόμενον Πέτρον καὶ Ἀνδρέαν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, βάλλοντας ἀμφίβληστρον εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν: ἦσαν γὰρ ἁλιεῖς.

text_en: And he says to them: Come after me, and I will make you to be fishers of men .
text_la: et ait illis : Venite post me, et faciam vos fieri piscatores hominum.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Vinde após mim, e eu vos farei pescadores de homens.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς, δεῦτε ὀπίσω μου, καὶ ποιήσω ὑμᾶς ἁλιεῖς ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: And they immediately leaving their nets, followed him.
text_la: At illi continuo relictis retibus secuti sunt eum.
text_pt: Então eles, deixando logo as redes, seguiram-no.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εὐθέως ἀφέντες τὰ δίκτυα ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father , mending their nets: and he called them.
text_la: Et procedens inde, vidit alios duos fratres, Jacobum Zebedæi, et Joannem fratrem ejus, in navi cum Zebedæo patre eorum, reficientes retia sua : et vocavit eos.
text_pt: E, adiantando-se dali, viu outros dois irmãos, Tiago, filho de Zebedeu, e João, seu irmão, num barco com seu pai, Zebedeu, consertando as redes;
text_el: Καὶ προβὰς ἐκεῖθεν εἶδεν ἄλλους δύο ἀδελφούς, Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ μετὰ Ζεβεδαίου τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν καταρτίζοντας τὰ δίκτυα αὐτῶν: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτούς.

text_en: And they forthwith left their nets and father , and followed him.
text_la: Illi autem statim relictis retibus et patre, secuti sunt eum.
text_pt: E chamou-os; eles, deixando imediatamente o barco e seu pai, seguiram-no.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εὐθέως ἀφέντες τὸ πλοῖον καὶ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And Jesus went about all Galilee , teaching in their synagogues , and preaching the gospel of the kingdom : and healing all manner of sickness and every infirmity, among the people.
text_la: Et circuibat Jesus totam Galilæam, docens in synagogis eorum, et prædicans Evangelium regni : et sanans omnem languorem, et omnem infirmitatem in populo.
text_pt: E percorria Jesus toda a Galiléia, ensinando nas suas sinagogas e pregando o evangelho do reino, e curando todas as enfermidades e moléstias entre o povo.
text_el: καὶ περιῆγεν ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ, διδάσκων ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν καὶ κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς βασιλείας καὶ θεραπεύων πᾶσαν νόσον καὶ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν ἐν τῷ λαῷ.

text_en: And his fame went throughout all Syria , and they presented to him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and such as were possessed by devils , and lunatics , and those that had the palsy, and he cured them:
text_la: Et abiit opinio ejus in totam Syriam, et obtulerunt ei omnes male habentes, variis languoribus, et tormentis comprehensos, et qui dæmonia habebant, et lunaticos, et paralyticos, et curavit eos:
text_pt: E a sua fama correu por toda a Síria, e traziam-lhe todos os que padeciam, acometidos de várias enfermidades e tormentos, os endemoninhados, os lunáticos, e os paralíticos, e ele os curava.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἡ ἀκοὴ αὐτοῦ εἰς ὅλην τὴν Συρίαν: καὶ προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ποικίλαις νόσοις καὶ βασάνοις συνεχομένους δαιμονιζομένους καὶ σεληνιαζομένους καὶ παραλυτικούς, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτούς.

text_en: And much people followed him from Galilee , and from Decapolis , and from Jerusalem , and from Judea , and from beyond the Jordan .
text_la: et secutæ sunt eum turbæ multæ de Galilæa, et Decapoli, et de Jerosolymis, et de Judæa, et de trans Jordanem.
text_pt: E seguia-o uma grande multidão da Galiléia, de Decápolis, de Jerusalém, da Judéia, e de além do Jordão.
text_el: καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοὶ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ Δεκαπόλεως καὶ Ἱεροσολύμων καὶ Ἰουδαίας καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου.

text_en: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain , and when he was set down, his disciples came unto him.
text_la: Videns autem Jesus turbas, ascendit in montem, et cum sedisset, accesserunt ad eum discipuli ejus,
text_pt: E Jesus, vendo a multidão, subiu a um monte, e, assentando-se, aproximaram-se dele os seus discípulos;
text_el: Ἰδὼν δὲ τοὺς ὄχλους ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος: καὶ καθίσαντος αὐτοῦ προσῆλθαν [αὐτῷ] οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ:

text_en: And opening his mouth he taught them, saying:
text_la: et aperiens os suum docebat eos dicens:
text_pt: E, abrindo a sua boca, os ensinava, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἀνοίξας τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοὺς λέγων,

text_en: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .
text_la: Beati pauperes spiritu : quoniam ipsorum est regnum cælorum.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados os pobres de espírito, porque deles é o reino dos céus;
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ πτωχοὶ τῷ πνεύματι, ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

text_en: Blessed are the meek: for they shall possess the land.
text_la: Beati mites : quoniam ipsi possidebunt terram.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados os que choram, porque eles serão consolados;
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ πενθοῦντες, ὅτι αὐτοὶ παρακληθήσονται.

text_en: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
text_la: Beati qui lugent : quoniam ipsi consolabuntur.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados os mansos, porque eles herdarão a terra;
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ πραεῖς, ὅτι αὐτοὶ κληρονομήσουσιν. τὴν γῆν

text_en: Blessed are they that hunger and thirst after justice : for they shall have their fill.
text_la: Beati qui esuriunt et sitiunt justitiam : quoniam ipsi saturabuntur.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados os que têm fome e sede de justiça, porque eles serão fartos;
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ πεινῶντες καὶ διψῶντες τὴν δικαιοσύνην, ὅτι αὐτοὶ χορτασθήσονται.

text_en: Blessed are the merciful : for they shall obtain mercy.
text_la: Beati misericordes : quoniam ipsi misericordiam consequentur.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados os misericordiosos, porque eles alcançarão misericórdia;
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ ἐλεήμονες, ὅτι αὐτοὶ ἐλεηθήσονται.

text_en: Blessed are the clean of heart : they shall see God .
text_la: Beati mundo corde : quoniam ipsi Deum videbunt.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados os limpos de coração, porque eles verão a Deus;
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ καθαροὶ τῇ καρδίᾳ, ὅτι αὐτοὶ τὸν θεὸν ὄψονται.

text_en: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God .
text_la: Beati pacifici : quoniam filii Dei vocabuntur.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados os pacificadores, porque eles serão chamados filhos de Deus;
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ εἰρηνοποιοί, ὅτι [αὐτοὶ] υἱοὶ θεοῦ κληθήσονται.

text_en: Blessed are they that suffer persecution for justice' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .
text_la: Beati qui persecutionem patiuntur propter justitiam : quoniam ipsorum est regnum cælorum.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados os que sofrem perseguição por causa da justiça, porque deles é o reino dos céus;
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ δεδιωγμένοι ἕνεκεν δικαιοσύνης, ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

text_en: Blessed are you when they shall revile you, and persecute you, and speak all that is evil against you, untruly, for my sake:
text_la: Beati estis cum maledixerint vobis, et persecuti vos fuerint, et dixerint omne malum adversum vos mentientes, propter me:
text_pt: Bem-aventurados sois vós, quando vos injuriarem e perseguirem e, mentindo, disserem todo o mal contra vós por minha causa.
text_el: μακάριοί ἐστε ὅταν ὀνειδίσωσιν ὑμᾶς καὶ διώξωσιν καὶ εἴπωσιν πᾶν πονηρὸν καθ' ὑμῶν ψευδόμενοι ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ:

text_en: Be glad and rejoice for your reward is very great in heaven . For so they persecuted the prophets that were before you.
text_la: gaudete, et exsultate, quoniam merces vestra copiosa est in cælis. Sic enim persecuti sunt prophetas, qui fuerunt ante vos.
text_pt: Exultai e alegrai-vos, porque é grande o vosso galardão nos céus; porque assim perseguiram os profetas que foram antes de vós.
text_el: χαίρετε καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε, ὅτι ὁ μισθὸς ὑμῶν πολὺς ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς: οὕτως γὰρ ἐδίωξαν τοὺς προφήτας τοὺς πρὸ ὑμῶν.

text_en: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt lose its savour, wherewith shall it be salted? It is good for nothing anymore but to be cast out, and to be trodden on by men .
text_la: Vos estis sal terræ. Quod si sal evanuerit, in quo salietur? ad nihilum valet ultra, nisi ut mittatur foras, et conculcetur ab hominibus.
text_pt: Vós sois o sal da terra; e se o sal for insípido, com que se há de salgar? Para nada mais presta senão para se lançar fora, e ser pisado pelos homens.
text_el: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ ἅλας τῆς γῆς: ἐὰν δὲ τὸ ἅλας μωρανθῇ, ἐν τίνι ἁλισθήσεται; εἰς οὐδὲν ἰσχύει ἔτι εἰ μὴ βληθὲν ἔξω καταπατεῖσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: You are the light of the world. A city seated on a mountain cannot be hid.
text_la: Vos estis lux mundi. Non potest civitas abscondi supra montem posita,
text_pt: Vós sois a luz do mundo; não se pode esconder uma cidade edificada sobre um monte;
text_el: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου. οὐ δύναται πόλις κρυβῆναι ἐπάνω ὄρους κειμένη:

text_en: Neither do men light a candle and put it under a bushel, but upon a candlestick, that it may shine to all that are in the house.
text_la: neque accendunt lucernam, et ponunt eam sub modio, sed super candelabrum, ut luceat omnibus qui in domo sunt.
text_pt: Nem se acende a candeia e se coloca debaixo do alqueire, mas no velador, e dá luz a todos que estão na casa.
text_el: οὐδὲ καίουσιν λύχνον καὶ τιθέασιν αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον ἀλλ' ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν, καὶ λάμπει πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ.

text_en: So let your light shine before men , that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven .
text_la: Sic luceat lux vestra coram hominibus : ut videant opera vestra bona, et glorificent Patrem vestrum, qui in cælis est.
text_pt: Assim resplandeça a vossa luz diante dos homens, para que vejam as vossas boas obras e glorifiquem a vosso Pai, que está nos céus.
text_el: οὕτως λαμψάτω τὸ φῶς ὑμῶν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὅπως ἴδωσιν ὑμῶν τὰ καλὰ ἔργα καὶ δοξάσωσιν τὸν πατέρα ὑμῶν τὸν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

text_en: Do not think that I have come to destroy the law , or the prophets . I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
text_la: Nolite putare quoniam veni solvere legem aut prophetas : non veni solvere, sed adimplere.
text_pt: Não cuideis que vim destruir a lei ou os profetas: não vim abrogar, mas cumprir.
text_el: Μὴ νομίσητε ὅτι ἦλθον καταλῦσαι τὸν νόμον ἢ τοὺς προφήτας: οὐκ ἦλθον καταλῦσαι ἀλλὰ πληρῶσαι.

text_en: For amen I say unto you, till heaven and earth pass, one jot, or one tittle shall not pass of the law , till all be fulfilled.
text_la: Amen quippe dico vobis, donec transeat cælum et terra, jota unum aut unus apex non præteribit a lege, donec omnia fiant.
text_pt: Porque em verdade vos digo que, até que o céu e a terra passem, nem um jota ou um til jamais passará da lei, sem que tudo seja cumprido.
text_el: ἀμὴν γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν, ἕως ἂν παρέλθῃ ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ, ἰῶτα ἓν ἢ μία κεραία οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ νόμου ἕως [ἂν] πάντα γένηται.

text_en: He therefore that shall break one of these least commandments , and shall so teach men shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven . But he that shall do and teach, he shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven .
text_la: Qui ergo solverit unum de mandatis istis minimis, et docuerit sic homines, minimus vocabitur in regno cælorum : qui autem fecerit et docuerit, hic magnus vocabitur in regno cælorum.
text_pt: Qualquer, pois, que violar um destes mandamentos, por menor que seja, e assim ensinar aos homens, será chamado o menor no reino dos céus; aquele, porém, que os cumprir e ensinar será chamado grande no reino dos céus.
text_el: ὃς ἐὰν οὖν λύσῃ μίαν τῶν ἐντολῶν τούτων τῶν ἐλαχίστων καὶ διδάξῃ οὕτως τοὺς ἀνθρώπους, ἐλάχιστος κληθήσεται ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν: ὃς δ' ἂν ποιήσῃ καὶ διδάξῃ, οὗτος μέγας κληθήσεται ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν.

text_en: For I tell you, that unless your justice abound more than that of the scribes and Pharisees , you shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven .
text_la: Dico enim vobis, quia nisi abundaverit justitia vestra plus quam scribarum et pharisæorum, non intrabitis in regnum cælorum.
text_pt: Porque vos digo que, se a vossa justiça não exceder a dos escribas e fariseus, de modo nenhum entrareis no reino dos céus.
text_el: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ περισσεύσῃ ὑμῶν ἡ δικαιοσύνη πλεῖον τῶν γραμματέων καὶ Φαρισαίων, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν.

text_en: You have heard that it was said to them of old: You shall not kill . And whosoever shall kill , shall be in danger of the judgment .
text_la: Audistis quia dictum est antiquis : Non occides : qui autem occiderit, reus erit judicio.
text_pt: Ouvistes que foi dito aos antigos: Não matarás; mas qualquer que matar será réu de juízo.
text_el: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη τοῖς ἀρχαίοις, οὐ φονεύσεις: ὃς δ' ἂν φονεύσῃ, ἔνοχος ἔσται τῇ κρίσει.

text_en: But I say to you, that whosoever is angry with his brother, shall be in danger of the judgment . And whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca , shall be in danger of the council . And whosoever shall say, You fool , shall be in danger of hell fire .
text_la: Ego autem dico vobis : quia omnis qui irascitur fratri suo, reus erit judicio. Qui autem dixerit fratri suo, raca : reus erit concilio. Qui autem dixerit, fatue : reus erit gehennæ ignis.
text_pt: Eu, porém, vos digo que qualquer que, sem motivo, se encolerizar contra seu irmão, será réu de juízo; e qualquer que disser a seu irmão: Raca, será réu do sinédrio; e qualquer que lhe disser: Louco, será réu do fogo do inferno.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὀργιζόμενος τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ ἔνοχος ἔσται τῇ κρίσει: ὃς δ' ἂν εἴπῃ τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ, ῥακά, ἔνοχος ἔσται τῷ συνεδρίῳ: ὃς δ' ἂν εἴπῃ, μωρέ, ἔνοχος ἔσται εἰς τὴν γέενναν τοῦ πυρός.

text_en: If therefore you offer your gift at the altar , and there you remember that your brother has anything against you;
text_la: Si ergo offers munus tuum ad altare, et ibi recordatus fueris quia frater tuus habet aliquid adversum te:
text_pt: Portanto, se trouxeres a tua oferta ao altar, e aí te lembrares de que teu irmão tem alguma coisa contra ti,
text_el: ἐὰν οὖν προσφέρῃς τὸ δῶρόν σου ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον κἀκεῖ μνησθῇς ὅτι ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἔχει τι κατὰ σοῦ,

text_en: leave there your offering before the altar , and go first to be reconciled to your brother, and then coming you shall offer your gift.
text_la: relinque ibi munus tuum ante altare, et vade prius reconciliari fratri tuo : et tunc veniens offeres munus tuum.
text_pt: Deixa ali diante do altar a tua oferta, e vai reconciliar-te primeiro com teu irmão e, depois, vem e apresenta a tua oferta.
text_el: ἄφες ἐκεῖ τὸ δῶρόν σου ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου, καὶ ὕπαγε πρῶτον διαλλάγηθι τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου, καὶ τότε ἐλθὼν πρόσφερε τὸ δῶρόν σου.

text_en: Be at agreement with your adversary betimes, whilst you are in the way with him: lest perhaps the adversary deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison .
text_la: Esto consentiens adversario tuo cito dum es in via cum eo : ne forte tradat te adversarius judici, et judex tradat te ministro : et in carcerem mittaris.
text_pt: Concilia-te depressa com o teu adversário, enquanto estás no caminho com ele, para que não aconteça que o adversário te entregue ao juiz, e o juiz te entregue ao oficial, e te encerrem na prisão.
text_el: ἴσθι εὐνοῶν τῷ ἀντιδίκῳ σου ταχὺ ἕως ὅτου εἶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ, μήποτέ σε παραδῷ ὁ ἀντίδικος τῷ κριτῇ, καὶ ὁ κριτὴς τῷ ὑπηρέτῃ, καὶ εἰς φυλακὴν βληθήσῃ:

text_en: Amen I say to you, you shall not go out from thence till you repay the last farthing.
text_la: Amen dico tibi, non exies inde, donec reddas novissimum quadrantem.
text_pt: Em verdade te digo que de maneira nenhuma sairás dali enquanto não pagares o último ceitil.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃς ἐκεῖθεν ἕως ἂν ἀποδῷς τὸν ἔσχατον κοδράντην.

text_en: You have heard that it was said to them of old: You shall not commit adultery .
text_la: Audistis quia dictum est antiquis : Non mœchaberis.
text_pt: Ouvistes que foi dito aos antigos: Não cometerás adultério.
text_el: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη, οὐ μοιχεύσεις.

text_en: But I say to you, that whosoever shall look on a woman to lust after her, has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
text_la: Ego autem dico vobis : quia omnis qui viderit mulierem ad concupiscendum eam, jam mœchatus est eam in corde suo.
text_pt: Eu, porém, vos digo, que qualquer que atentar numa mulher para a cobiçar, já em seu coração cometeu adultério com ela.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ βλέπων γυναῖκα πρὸς τὸ ἐπιθυμῆσαι [αὐτὴν] ἤδη ἐμοίχευσεν αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And if your right eye scandalize you, pluck it out and cast it from you. For it is expedient for you that one of your members should perish, rather than your whole body be cast into hell .
text_la: Quod si oculus tuus dexter scandalizat te, erue eum, et projice abs te : expedit enim tibi ut pereat unum membrorum tuorum, quam totum corpus tuum mittatur in gehennam.
text_pt: Portanto, se o teu olho direito te escandalizar, arranca-o e atira-o para longe de ti; pois te é melhor que se perca um dos teus membros do que seja todo o teu corpo lançado no inferno.
text_el: εἰ δὲ ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ὁ δεξιὸς σκανδαλίζει σε, ἔξελε αὐτὸν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ: συμφέρει γάρ σοι ἵνα ἀπόληται ἓν τῶν μελῶν σου καὶ μὴ ὅλον τὸ σῶμά σου βληθῇ εἰς γέενναν.

text_en: And if your right hand scandalize you, cut it off, and cast it from you: for it is expedient for you that one of your members should perish, rather than that your whole body go into hell .
text_la: Et si dextra manus tua scandalizat te, abscide eam, et projice abs te : expedit enim tibi ut pereat unum membrorum tuorum, quam totum corpus tuum eat in gehennam.
text_pt: E, se a tua mão direita te escandalizar, corta-a e atira-a para longe de ti, porque te é melhor que um dos teus membros se perca do que seja todo o teu corpo lançado no inferno.
text_el: καὶ εἰ ἡ δεξιά σου χεὶρ σκανδαλίζει σε, ἔκκοψον αὐτὴν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ: συμφέρει γάρ σοι ἵνα ἀπόληται ἓν τῶν μελῶν σου καὶ μὴ ὅλον τὸ σῶμά σου εἰς γέενναν ἀπέλθῃ.

text_en: And it has been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a bill of divorce .
text_la: Dictum est autem : Quicumque dimiserit uxorem suam, det ei libellum repudii.
text_pt: Também foi dito: Qualquer que deixar sua mulher, dê-lhe carta de divórcio.
text_el: Ἐρρέθη δέ, ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ, δότω αὐτῇ ἀποστάσιον.

text_en: But I say to you, that whosoever shall put away his wife, excepting for the cause of fornication, makes her to commit adultery : and he that shall marry her that is put away , commits adultery .
text_la: Ego autem dico vobis : quia omnis qui dimiserit uxorem suam, excepta fornicationis causa, facit eam mœchari : et qui dimissam duxerit, adulterat.
text_pt: Eu, porém, vos digo que qualquer que repudiar sua mulher, a não ser por causa de fornicação, faz que ela cometa adultério, e qualquer que casar com a repudiada comete adultério.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ἀπολύων τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ παρεκτὸς λόγου πορνείας ποιεῖ αὐτὴν μοιχευθῆναι, [καὶ ὃς ἐὰν ἀπολελυμένην γαμήσῃ μοιχᾶται].

text_en: Again you have heard that it was said to them of old, you shall not forswear yourself: but you shall perform your oaths to the Lord.
text_la: Iterum audistis quia dictum est antiquis : Non perjurabis : reddes autem Domino juramenta tua.
text_pt: Outrossim, ouvistes que foi dito aos antigos: Não perjurarás, mas cumprirás os teus juramentos ao Senhor.
text_el: Πάλιν ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη τοῖς ἀρχαίοις, οὐκ ἐπιορκήσεις, ἀποδώσεις δὲ τῷ κυρίῳ τοὺς ὅρκους σου.

text_en: But I say to you not to swear at all, neither by heaven for it is the throne of God :
text_la: Ego autem dico vobis, non jurare omnino, neque per cælum, quia thronus Dei est:
text_pt: Eu, porém, vos digo que de maneira nenhuma jureis; nem pelo céu, porque é o trono de Deus;
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν μὴ ὀμόσαι ὅλως: μήτε ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, ὅτι θρόνος ἐστὶν τοῦ θεοῦ:

text_en: Nor by the earth, for it is his footstool: nor by Jerusalem , for it is the city of the great king :
text_la: neque per terram, quia scabellum est pedum ejus : neque per Jerosolymam, quia civitas est magni regis:
text_pt: Nem pela terra, porque é o escabelo de seus pés; nem por Jerusalém, porque é a cidade do grande Rei;
text_el: μήτε ἐν τῇ γῇ, ὅτι ὑποπόδιόν ἐστιν τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ: μήτε εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, ὅτι πόλις ἐστὶν τοῦ μεγάλου βασιλέως:

text_en: Neither shall you swear by your head, because you can not make one hair white or black.
text_la: neque per caput tuum juraveris, quia non potes unum capillum album facere, aut nigrum.
text_pt: Nem jurarás pela tua cabeça, porque não podes tornar um cabelo branco ou preto.
text_el: μήτε ἐν τῇ κεφαλῇ σου ὀμόσῃς, ὅτι οὐ δύνασαι μίαν τρίχα λευκὴν ποιῆσαι ἢ μέλαιναν.

text_en: But let your speech be yea, yea: no, no: and that which is over and above these, is of evil .
text_la: Sit autem sermo vester, est, est : non, non : quod autem his abundantius est, a malo est.
text_pt: Seja, porém, o vosso falar: Sim, sim; Não, não; porque o que passa disto é de procedência maligna.
text_el: ἔστω δὲ ὁ λόγος ὑμῶν ναὶ ναί, οὒ οὔ: τὸ δὲ περισσὸν τούτων ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ ἐστιν.

text_en: You have heard that it has been said: An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.
text_la: Audistis quia dictum est : Oculum pro oculo, et dentem pro dente.
text_pt: Ouvistes que foi dito: Olho por olho, e dente por dente.
text_el: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη, ὀφθαλμὸν ἀντὶ ὀφθαλμοῦ καὶ ὀδόντα ἀντὶ ὀδόντος.

text_en: But I say to you not to resist evil : but if one strike you on your right cheek, turn to him also the other:
text_la: Ego autem dico vobis, non resistere malo : sed si quis te percusserit in dexteram maxillam tuam, præbe illi et alteram:
text_pt: Eu, porém, vos digo que não resistais ao mau; mas, se qualquer te bater na face direita, oferece-lhe também a outra;
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν μὴ ἀντιστῆναι τῷ πονηρῷ: ἀλλ' ὅστις σε ῥαπίζει εἰς τὴν δεξιὰν σιαγόνα, σου στρέψον αὐτῷ καὶ τὴν ἄλλην:

text_en: And if a man will contend with you in judgment, and take away your coat, let go your cloak also unto him.
text_la: et ei, qui vult tecum judicio contendere, et tunicam tuam tollere, dimitte ei et pallium:
text_pt: E, ao que quiser pleitear contigo, e tirar-te a túnica, larga-lhe também a capa;
text_el: καὶ τῷ θέλοντί σοι κριθῆναι καὶ τὸν χιτῶνά σου λαβεῖν, ἄφες αὐτῷ καὶ τὸ ἱμάτιον:

text_en: And whosoever will force you one mile, go with him other two.
text_la: et quicumque te angariaverit mille passus, vade cum illo et alia duo.
text_pt: E, se qualquer te obrigar a caminhar uma milha, vai com ele duas.
text_el: καὶ ὅστις σε ἀγγαρεύσει μίλιον ἕν, ὕπαγε μετ' αὐτοῦ δύο.

text_en: Give to him that asks of you, and from him that would borrow of you turn not away.
text_la: Qui petit a te, da ei : et volenti mutuari a te, ne avertaris.
text_pt: Dá a quem te pedir, e não te desvies daquele que quiser que lhe emprestes.
text_el: τῷ αἰτοῦντί σε δός, καὶ τὸν θέλοντα ἀπὸ σοῦ δανίσασθαι μὴ ἀποστραφῇς.

text_en: You have heard that it has been said, You shall love your neighbour, and hate your enemy.
text_la: Audistis quia dictum est : Diliges proximum tuum, et odio habebis inimicum tuum.
text_pt: Ouvistes que foi dito: Amarás o teu próximo, e odiarás o teu inimigo.
text_el: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη, ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου καὶ μισήσεις τὸν ἐχθρόν σου.

text_en: But I say to you, Love your enemies: do good to them that hate you: and pray for them that persecute and calumniate you:
text_la: Ego autem dico vobis : diligite inimicos vestros, benefacite his qui oderunt vos, et orate pro persequentibus et calumniantibus vos:
text_pt: Eu, porém, vos digo: Amai a vossos inimigos, bendizei os que vos maldizem, fazei bem aos que vos odeiam, e orai pelos que vos maltratam e vos perseguem; para que sejais filhos do vosso Pai que está nos céus;
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀγαπᾶτε τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ὑμῶν καὶ προσεύχεσθε ὑπὲρ τῶν διωκόντων ὑμᾶς,

text_en: That you may be the children of your Father who is in heaven , who makes his sun to rise upon the good , and bad, and rains upon the just and the unjust .
text_la: ut sitis filii Patris vestri, qui in cælis est : qui solem suum oriri facit super bonos et malos : et pluit super justos et injustos.
text_pt: Porque faz que o seu sol se levante sobre maus e bons, e a chuva desça sobre justos e injustos.
text_el: ὅπως γένησθε υἱοὶ τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς, ὅτι τὸν ἥλιον αὐτοῦ ἀνατέλλει ἐπὶ πονηροὺς καὶ ἀγαθοὺς καὶ βρέχει ἐπὶ δικαίους καὶ ἀδίκους.

text_en: For if you love them that love you, what reward shall you have? Do not even the publicans this?
text_la: Si enim diligitis eos qui vos diligunt, quam mercedem habebitis? nonne et publicani hoc faciunt?
text_pt: Pois, se amardes os que vos amam, que galardão tereis? Não fazem os publicanos também o mesmo?
text_el: ἐὰν γὰρ ἀγαπήσητε τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας ὑμᾶς, τίνα μισθὸν ἔχετε; οὐχὶ καὶ οἱ τελῶναι τὸ αὐτὸ ποιοῦσιν;

text_en: And if you salute your brethren only, what do you more? Do not also the heathens this?
text_la: Et si salutaveritis fratres vestros tantum, quid amplius facitis? nonne et ethnici hoc faciunt?
text_pt: E, se saudardes unicamente os vossos irmãos, que fazeis de mais? Não fazem os publicanos também assim?
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ἀσπάσησθε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὑμῶν μόνον, τί περισσὸν ποιεῖτε; οὐχὶ καὶ οἱ ἐθνικοὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ποιοῦσιν;

text_en: Be therefore perfect , as also your heavenly Father is perfect .
text_la: Estote ergo vos perfecti, sicut et Pater vester cælestis perfectus est.
text_pt: Sede vós pois perfeitos, como é perfeito o vosso Pai que está nos céus.
text_el: ἔσεσθε οὖν ὑμεῖς τέλειοι ὡς ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ οὐράνιος τέλειός ἐστιν.

text_en: Take heed that you do not your justice before men , to be seen by them: otherwise you shall not have a reward of your Father who is in heaven .
text_la: Attendite ne justitiam vestram faciatis coram hominibus, ut videamini ab eis : alioquin mercedem non habebitis apud Patrem vestrum qui in cælis est.
text_pt: Guardai-vos de fazer a vossa esmola diante dos homens, para serdes vistos por eles; aliás, não tereis galardão junto de vosso Pai, que está nos céus.
text_el: Προσέχετε δὲ τὴν δικαιοσύνην ὑμῶν μὴ ποιεῖν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων πρὸς τὸ θεαθῆναι αὐτοῖς: εἰ δὲ μή γε, μισθὸν οὐκ ἔχετε παρὰ τῷ πατρὶ ὑμῶν τῷ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

text_en: Therefore when you do an alms-deed , sound not a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may be honoured by men . Amen I say to you, they have received their reward.
text_la: Cum ergo facis eleemosynam, noli tuba canere ante te, sicut hypocritæ faciunt in synagogis, et in vicis, ut honorificentur ab hominibus. Amen dico vobis, receperunt mercedem suam.
text_pt: Quando, pois, deres esmola, não faças tocar trombeta diante de ti, como fazem os hipócritas nas sinagogas e nas ruas, para serem glorificados pelos homens. Em verdade vos digo que já receberam o seu galardão.
text_el: ὅταν οὖν ποιῇς ἐλεημοσύνην, μὴ σαλπίσῃς ἔμπροσθέν σου, ὥσπερ οἱ ὑποκριταὶ ποιοῦσιν ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ ἐν ταῖς ῥύμαις, ὅπως δοξασθῶσιν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀπέχουσιν τὸν μισθὸν αὐτῶν.

text_en: But when you do alms , let not your left hand know what your right hand does.
text_la: Te autem faciente eleemosynam, nesciat sinistra tua quid faciat dextera tua:
text_pt: Mas, quando tu deres esmola, não saiba a tua mão esquerda o que faz a tua direita;
text_el: σοῦ δὲ ποιοῦντος ἐλεημοσύνην μὴ γνώτω ἡ ἀριστερά σου τί ποιεῖ ἡ δεξιά σου,

text_en: That your alms may be in secret, and your Father who sees in secret will repay you.
text_la: ut sit eleemosyna tua in abscondito, et Pater tuus, qui videt in abscondito, reddet tibi.
text_pt: Para que a tua esmola seja dada em secreto; e teu Pai, que vê em secreto, ele mesmo te recompensará publicamente.
text_el: ὅπως ᾖ σου ἡ ἐλεημοσύνη ἐν τῷ κρυπτῷ, καὶ ὁ πατήρ σου ὁ βλέπων ἐν τῷ κρυπτῷ ἀποδώσει σοι.

text_en: And when you pray , you shall not be as the hypocrites , that love to stand and pray in the synagogues and corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men : Amen I say to you, they have received their reward.
text_la: Et cum oratis, non eritis sicut hypocritæ qui amant in synagogis et in angulis platearum stantes orare, ut videantur ab hominibus : amen dico vobis, receperunt mercedem suam.
text_pt: E, quando orares, não sejas como os hipócritas; pois se comprazem em orar em pé nas sinagogas, e às esquinas das ruas, para serem vistos pelos homens. Em verdade vos digo que já receberam o seu galardão.
text_el: καὶ ὅταν προσεύχησθε, οὐκ ἔσεσθε ὡς οἱ ὑποκριταί: ὅτι φιλοῦσιν ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ ἐν ταῖς γωνίαις τῶν πλατειῶν ἑστῶτες προσεύχεσθαι, ὅπως φανῶσιν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀπέχουσιν τὸν μισθὸν αὐτῶν.

text_en: But you when you shall pray , enter into your chamber, and having shut the door, pray to your Father in secret, and your father who sees in secret will repay you.
text_la: Tu autem cum oraveris, intra in cubiculum tuum, et clauso ostio, ora Patrem tuum in abscondito : et Pater tuus, qui videt in abscondito, reddet tibi.
text_pt: Mas tu, quando orares, entra no teu aposento e, fechando a tua porta, ora a teu Pai que está em secreto; e teu Pai, que vê em secreto, te recompensará publicamente.
text_el: σὺ δὲ ὅταν προσεύχῃ, εἴσελθε εἰς τὸ ταμεῖόν σου καὶ κλείσας τὴν θύραν σου πρόσευξαι τῷ πατρί σου τῷ ἐν τῷ κρυπτῷ: καὶ ὁ πατήρ σου ὁ βλέπων ἐν τῷ κρυπτῷ ἀποδώσει σοι.

text_en: And when you are praying , speak not much, as the heathens . For they think that in their much speaking they may be heard.
text_la: Orantes autem, nolite multum loqui, sicut ethnici, putant enim quod in multiloquio suo exaudiantur.
text_pt: E, orando, não useis de vãs repetições, como os gentios, que pensam que por muito falarem serão ouvidos.
text_el: Προσευχόμενοι δὲ μὴ βατταλογήσητε ὥσπερ οἱ ἐθνικοί, δοκοῦσιν γὰρ ὅτι ἐν τῇ πολυλογίᾳ αὐτῶν εἰσακουσθήσονται.

text_en: Be not therefore like them for your Father knows what is needful for you, before you ask him.
text_la: Nolite ergo assimilari eis : scit enim Pater vester, quid opus sit vobis, antequam petatis eum.
text_pt: Não vos assemelheis, pois, a eles; porque vosso Pai sabe o que vos é necessário, antes de vós lho pedirdes.
text_el: μὴ οὖν ὁμοιωθῆτε αὐτοῖς, οἶδεν γὰρ [ὁ θεὸς] ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὧν χρείαν ἔχετε πρὸ τοῦ ὑμᾶς αἰτῆσαι αὐτόν.

text_en: Thus therefore shall you pray : Our Father who art in heaven , hallowed be your name .
text_la: Sic ergo vos orabitis : Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificetur nomen tuum.
text_pt: Portanto, vós orareis assim: Pai nosso, que estás nos céus, santificado seja o teu nome;
text_el: οὕτως οὖν προσεύχεσθε ὑμεῖς: πάτερ ἡμῶν ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, ἁγιασθήτω τὸ ὄνομά σου,

text_en: Your kingdom come. Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven .
text_la: Adveniat regnum tuum; fiat voluntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra.
text_pt: Venha o teu reino, seja feita a tua vontade, assim na terra como no céu;
text_el: ἐλθέτω ἡ βασιλεία σου, γενηθήτω τὸ θέλημά σου, ὡς ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς.

text_en: Give us this day our supersubstantial bread.
text_la: Panem nostrum supersubstantialem da nobis hodie,
text_pt: O pão nosso de cada dia nos dá hoje;
text_el: τὸν ἄρτον ἡμῶν τὸν ἐπιούσιον δὸς ἡμῖν σήμερον:

text_en: And forgive us our debts , as we also forgive our debtors .
text_la: et dimitte nobis debita nostra, sicut et nos dimittimus debitoribus nostris.
text_pt: E perdoa-nos as nossas dívidas, assim como nós perdoamos aos nossos devedores;
text_el: καὶ ἄφες ἡμῖν τὰ ὀφειλήματα ἡμῶν, ὡς καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν τοῖς ὀφειλέταις ἡμῶν:

text_en: And lead us not into temptation . But deliver us from evil . Amen .
text_la: Et ne nos inducas in tentationem, sed libera nos a malo. Amen.
text_pt: E não nos conduzas à tentação; mas livra-nos do mal; porque teu é o reino, e o poder, e a glória, para sempre. Amém.
text_el: καὶ μὴ εἰσενέγκῃς ἡμᾶς εἰς πειρασμόν, ἀλλὰ ῥῦσαι ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ πονηροῦ.

text_en: For if you will forgive men their offences, your heavenly Father will forgive you also your offences.
text_la: Si enim dimiseritis hominibus peccata eorum : dimittet et vobis Pater vester cælestis delicta vestra.
text_pt: Porque, se perdoardes aos homens as suas ofensas, também vosso Pai celestial vos perdoará a vós;
text_el: Ἐὰν γὰρ ἀφῆτε τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τὰ παραπτώματα αὐτῶν, ἀφήσει καὶ ὑμῖν ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ οὐράνιος:

text_en: But if you will not forgive men , neither will your Father forgive you your offences.
text_la: Si autem non dimiseritis hominibus : nec Pater vester dimittet vobis peccata vestra.
text_pt: Se, porém, não perdoardes aos homens as suas ofensas, também vosso Pai vos não perdoará as vossas ofensas.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ἀφῆτε τοῖς ἀνθρώποις, [τὰ παραπτώματα αὐτῶν] οὐδὲ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἀφήσει τὰ παραπτώματα ὑμῶν.

text_en: And when you fast , be not as the hypocrites , sad. For they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast . Amen I say to you, they have received their reward.
text_la: Cum autem jejunatis, nolite fieri sicut hypocritæ, tristes. Exterminant enim facies suas, ut appareant hominibus jejunantes. Amen dico vobis, quia receperunt mercedem suam.
text_pt: E, quando jejuardes, não vos mostreis contristados como os hipócritas; porque desfiguram os seus rostos, para que aos homens pareça que jejuam. Em verdade vos digo que já receberam o seu galardão.
text_el: Ὅταν δὲ νηστεύητε, μὴ γίνεσθε ὡς οἱ ὑποκριταὶ σκυθρωποί, ἀφανίζουσιν γὰρ τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν ὅπως φανῶσιν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις νηστεύοντες: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀπέχουσιν τὸν μισθὸν αὐτῶν.

text_en: But you, when you fast , anoint your head and wash your face;
text_la: Tu autem, cum jejunas, unge caput tuum, et faciem tuam lava,
text_pt: Tu, porém, quando jejuares, unge a tua cabeça, e lava o teu rosto,
text_el: σὺ δὲ νηστεύων ἄλειψαί σου τὴν κεφαλὴν καὶ τὸ πρόσωπόν σου νίψαι,

text_en: that you appear not to men to fast , but to your Father who is in secret: and your Father who sees in secret, will repay you.
text_la: ne videaris hominibus jejunans, sed Patri tuo, qui est in abscondito : et Pater tuus, qui videt in abscondito, reddet tibi.
text_pt: Para não pareceres aos homens que jejuas, mas a teu Pai, que está em secreto; e teu Pai, que vê em secreto, te recompensará publicamente.
text_el: ὅπως μὴ φανῇς τοῖς ἀνθρώποις νηστεύων ἀλλὰ τῷ πατρί σου τῷ ἐν τῷ κρυφαίῳ: καὶ ὁ πατήρ σου ὁ βλέπων ἐν τῷ κρυφαίῳ ἀποδώσει σοι.

text_en: Lay not up to yourselves treasures on earth: where the rust, and moth consume, and where thieves break through, and steal .
text_la: Nolite thesaurizare vobis thesauros in terra : ubi ærugo, et tinea demolitur : et ubi fures effodiunt, et furantur.
text_pt: Não ajunteis tesouros na terra, onde a traça e a ferrugem tudo consomem, e onde os ladrões minam e roubam;
text_el: Μὴ θησαυρίζετε ὑμῖν θησαυροὺς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, ὅπου σὴς καὶ βρῶσις ἀφανίζει, καὶ ὅπου κλέπται διορύσσουσιν καὶ κλέπτουσιν:

text_en: But lay up to yourselves treasures in heaven : where neither the rust nor moth does consume, and where thieves do not break through, nor steal .
text_la: Thesaurizate autem vobis thesauros in cælo, ubi neque ærugo, neque tinea demolitur, et ubi fures non effodiunt, nec furantur.
text_pt: Mas ajuntai tesouros no céu, onde nem a traça nem a ferrugem consomem, e onde os ladrões não minam nem roubam.
text_el: θησαυρίζετε δὲ ὑμῖν θησαυροὺς ἐν οὐρανῷ, ὅπου οὔτε σὴς οὔτε βρῶσις ἀφανίζει, καὶ ὅπου κλέπται οὐ διορύσσουσιν οὐδὲ κλέπτουσιν:

text_en: For where your treasure is, there is your heart also.
text_la: Ubi enim est thesaurus tuus, ibi est et cor tuum.
text_pt: Porque onde estiver o vosso tesouro, aí estará também o vosso coração.
text_el: ὅπου γάρ ἐστιν ὁ θησαυρός σου, ἐκεῖ ἔσται [καὶ] ἡ καρδία σου.

text_en: The light of your body is your eye. If your eye be single, your whole body shall be lightsome.
text_la: Lucerna corporis tui est oculus tuus. Si oculus tuus fuerit simplex, totum corpus tuum lucidum erit.
text_pt: A candeia do corpo são os olhos; de sorte que, se os teus olhos forem bons, todo o teu corpo terá luz;
text_el: Ὁ λύχνος τοῦ σώματός ἐστιν ὁ ὀφθαλμός. ἐὰν οὖν ᾖ ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ἁπλοῦς, ὅλον τὸ σῶμά σου φωτεινὸν ἔσται:

text_en: But if your eye be evil your whole body shall be darksome. If then the light that is in you, be darkness: the darkness itself how great shall it be!
text_la: Si autem oculus tuus fuerit nequam, totum corpus tuum tenebrosum erit. Si ergo lumen, quod in te est, tenebræ sunt : ipsæ tenebræ quantæ erunt?
text_pt: Se, porém, os teus olhos forem maus, o teu corpo será tenebroso. Se, portanto, a luz que em ti há são trevas, quão grandes serão tais trevas!
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου πονηρὸς ᾖ, ὅλον τὸ σῶμά σου σκοτεινὸν ἔσται. εἰ οὖν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἐν σοὶ σκότος ἐστίν, τὸ σκότος πόσον.

text_en: No man can serve two masters. For either he will hate the one, and love the other: or he will sustain the one, and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon .
text_la: Nemo potest duobus dominis servire : aut enim unum odio habebit, et alterum diliget : aut unum sustinebit, et alterum contemnet. Non potestis Deo servire et mammonæ.
text_pt: Ninguém pode servir a dois senhores; porque ou há de odiar um e amar o outro, ou se dedicará a um e desprezará o outro. Não podeis servir a Deus e a Mamom.
text_el: Οὐδεὶς δύναται δυσὶ κυρίοις δουλεύειν: ἢ γὰρ τὸν ἕνα μισήσει καὶ τὸν ἕτερον ἀγαπήσει, ἢ ἑνὸς ἀνθέξεται καὶ τοῦ ἑτέρου καταφρονήσει: οὐ δύνασθε θεῷ δουλεύειν καὶ μαμωνᾷ.

text_en: Therefore I say to you, be not solicitous for your life, what you shall eat, nor for your body, what you shall put on. Is not the life more than the meat: and the body more than the raiment?
text_la: Ideo dico vobis, ne solliciti sitis animæ vestræ quid manducetis, neque corpori vestro quid induamini. Nonne anima plus est quam esca, et corpus plus quam vestimentum?
text_pt: Por isso vos digo: Não andeis cuidadosos quanto à vossa vida, pelo que haveis de comer ou pelo que haveis de beber; nem quanto ao vosso corpo, pelo que haveis de vestir. Não é a vida mais do que o mantimento, e o corpo mais do que o vestuário?
text_el: Διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν, μὴ μεριμνᾶτε τῇ ψυχῇ ὑμῶν τί φάγητε, [ἢ τί πίητε] μηδὲ τῷ σώματι ὑμῶν τί ἐνδύσησθε: οὐχὶ ἡ ψυχὴ πλεῖόν ἐστιν τῆς τροφῆς καὶ τὸ σῶμα τοῦ ἐνδύματος;

text_en: Behold the birds of the air, for they neither sow, nor do they reap, nor gather into barns: and your heavenly Father feeds them. Are not you of much more value than they?
text_la: Respicite volatilia cæli, quoniam non serunt, neque metunt, neque congregant in horrea : et Pater vester cælestis pascit illa. Nonne vos magis pluris estis illis?
text_pt: Olhai para as aves do céu, que nem semeiam, nem segam, nem ajuntam em celeiros; e vosso Pai celestial as alimenta. Não tendes vós muito mais valor do que elas?
text_el: ἐμβλέψατε εἰς τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὅτι οὐ σπείρουσιν οὐδὲ θερίζουσιν οὐδὲ συνάγουσιν εἰς ἀποθήκας, καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ οὐράνιος τρέφει αὐτά: οὐχ ὑμεῖς μᾶλλον διαφέρετε αὐτῶν;

text_en: And which of you by taking thought, can add to his stature one cubit?
text_la: Quis autem vestrum cogitans potest adjicere ad staturam suam cubitum unum?
text_pt: E qual de vós poderá, com todos os seus cuidados, acrescentar um côvado à sua estatura?
text_el: τίς δὲ ἐξ ὑμῶν μεριμνῶν δύναται προσθεῖναι ἐπὶ τὴν ἡλικίαν αὐτοῦ πῆχυν ἕνα;

text_en: And for raiment why are you solicitous? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow: they labour not, neither do they spin.
text_la: Et de vestimento quid solliciti estis? Considerate lilia agri quomodo crescunt : non laborant, neque nent.
text_pt: E, quanto ao vestuário, por que andais solícitos? Olhai para os lírios do campo, como eles crescem; não trabalham nem fiam;
text_el: καὶ περὶ ἐνδύματος τί μεριμνᾶτε; καταμάθετε τὰ κρίνα τοῦ ἀγροῦ πῶς αὐξάνουσιν: οὐ κοπιῶσιν οὐδὲ νήθουσιν:

text_en: But I say to you, that not even Solomon in all his glory was arrayed as one of these.
text_la: Dico autem vobis, quoniam nec Salomon in omni gloria sua coopertus est sicut unum ex istis.
