text_pt: E eu vos digo que nem mesmo Salomão, em toda a sua glória, se vestiu como qualquer deles.
text_el: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδὲ Σολομὼν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ δόξῃ αὐτοῦ περιεβάλετο ὡς ἓν τούτων.

text_en: And if the grass of the field, which is today, and tomorrow is cast into the oven, God does so clothe: how much more you, O you of little faith ?
text_la: Si autem fœnum agri, quod hodie est, et cras in clibanum mittitur, Deus sic vestit, quanto magis vos modicæ fidei?
text_pt: Pois, se Deus assim veste a erva do campo, que hoje existe, e amanhã é lançada no forno, não vos vestirá muito mais a vós, homens de pouca fé?
text_el: εἰ δὲ τὸν χόρτον τοῦ ἀγροῦ σήμερον ὄντα καὶ αὔριον εἰς κλίβανον βαλλόμενον ὁ θεὸς οὕτως ἀμφιέννυσιν, οὐ πολλῷ μᾶλλον ὑμᾶς, ὀλιγόπιστοι;

text_en: Be not solicitous therefore, saying: What shall we eat: or what shall we drink, or wherewith shall we be clothed?
text_la: Nolite ergo solliciti esse, dicentes : Quid manducabimus, aut quid bibemus, aut quo operiemur?
text_pt: Não andeis, pois, inquietos, dizendo: Que comeremos, ou que beberemos, ou com que nos vestiremos?
text_el: μὴ οὖν μεριμνήσητε λέγοντες, τί φάγωμεν; ἤ, τί πίωμεν; ἤ, τί περιβαλώμεθα;

text_en: For after all these things do the heathens seek. For your Father knows that you have need of all these things.
text_la: hæc enim omnia gentes inquirunt. Scit enim Pater vester, quia his omnibus indigetis.
text_pt: Porque todas estas coisas os gentios procuram. Decerto vosso Pai celestial bem sabe que necessitais de todas estas coisas;
text_el: πάντα γὰρ ταῦτα τὰ ἔθνη ἐπιζητοῦσιν: οἶδεν γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ οὐράνιος ὅτι χρῄζετε τούτων ἁπάντων.

text_en: Seek therefore first the kingdom of God , and his justice , and all these things shall be added unto you.
text_la: Quærite ergo primum regnum Dei, et justitiam ejus : et hæc omnia adjicientur vobis.
text_pt: Mas, buscai primeiro o reino de Deus, e a sua justiça, e todas estas coisas vos serão acrescentadas.
text_el: ζητεῖτε δὲ πρῶτον τὴν βασιλείαν καὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ, καὶ ταῦτα πάντα προστεθήσεται ὑμῖν.

text_en: Be not therefore solicitous for tomorrow; for the morrow will be solicitous for itself. Sufficient for the day is the evil thereof.
text_la: Nolite ergo solliciti esse in crastinum. Crastinus enim dies sollicitus erit sibi ipsi : sufficit diei malitia sua.
text_pt: Não vos inquieteis, pois, pelo dia de amanhã, porque o dia de amanhã cuidará de si mesmo. Basta a cada dia o seu mal.
text_el: μὴ οὖν μεριμνήσητε εἰς τὴν αὔριον, ἡ γὰρ αὔριον μεριμνήσει ἑαυτῆς: ἀρκετὸν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἡ κακία αὐτῆς.

text_en: Judge not, that you may not be judged.
text_la: Nolite judicare, ut non judicemini.
text_pt: Não julgueis, para que não sejais julgados.
text_el: Μὴ κρίνετε, ἵνα μὴ κριθῆτε.

text_en: For with what judgment you judge, you shall be judged: and with what measure you mete, it shall be measured to you again.
text_la: In quo enim judicio judicaveritis, judicabimini : et in qua mensura mensi fueritis, remetietur vobis.
text_pt: Porque com o juízo com que julgardes sereis julgados, e com a medida com que tiverdes medido vos hão de medir a vós.
text_el: ἐν ᾧ γὰρ κρίματι κρίνετε κριθήσεσθε, καὶ ἐν ᾧ μέτρῳ μετρεῖτε μετρηθήσεται ὑμῖν.

text_en: And why do you see the mote that is in your brother's eye; and see not the beam that is in your own eye?
text_la: Quid autem vides festucam in oculo fratris tui, et trabem in oculo tuo non vides?
text_pt: E por que reparas tu no argueiro que está no olho do teu irmão, e não vês a trave que está no teu olho?
text_el: τί δὲ βλέπεις τὸ κάρφος τὸ ἐν τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου, τὴν δὲ ἐν τῷ σῷ ὀφθαλμῷ δοκὸν οὐ κατανοεῖς;

text_en: Or how do you say to your brother: Let me cast the mote out of your eye; and behold a beam is in your own eye?
text_la: aut quomodo dicis fratri tuo : Sine ejiciam festucam de oculo tuo, et ecce trabs est in oculo tuo?
text_pt: Ou como dirás a teu irmão: Deixa-me tirar o argueiro do teu olho, estando uma trave no teu?
text_el: ἢ πῶς ἐρεῖς τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου, ἄφες ἐκβάλω τὸ κάρφος ἐκ τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ σου, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ δοκὸς ἐν τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ σοῦ;

text_en: You hypocrite , cast out first the beam out of your own eye, and then shall you see to cast out the mote out of your brother's eye.
text_la: Hypocrita, ejice primum trabem de oculo tuo, et tunc videbis ejicere festucam de oculo fratris tui.
text_pt: Hipócrita, tira primeiro a trave do teu olho, e então cuidarás em tirar o argueiro do olho do teu irmão.
text_el: ὑποκριτά, ἔκβαλε πρῶτον ἐκ τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ σοῦ τὴν δοκόν, καὶ τότε διαβλέψεις ἐκβαλεῖν τὸ κάρφος ἐκ τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου.

text_en: Give not that which is holy to dogs; neither cast your pearls before swine, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turning upon you, they tear you.
text_la: Nolite dare sanctum canibus : neque mittatis margaritas vestras ante porcos, ne forte conculcent eas pedibus suis, et conversi dirumpant vos.
text_pt: Não deis aos cães as coisas santas, nem deiteis aos porcos as vossas pérolas, não aconteça que as pisem com os pés e, voltando-se, vos despedacem.
text_el: Μὴ δῶτε τὸ ἅγιον τοῖς κυσίν, μηδὲ βάλητε τοὺς μαργαρίτας ὑμῶν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν χοίρων, μήποτε καταπατήσουσιν αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτῶν καὶ στραφέντες ῥήξωσιν ὑμᾶς.

text_en: Ask, and it shall be given you: seek, and you shall find: knock, and it shall be opened to you.
text_la: Petite, et dabitur vobis : quærite, et invenietis : pulsate, et aperietur vobis.
text_pt: Pedi, e dar-se-vos-á; buscai, e encontrareis; batei, e abrir-se-vos-á.
text_el: αἰτεῖτε, καὶ δοθήσεται ὑμῖν: ζητεῖτε, καὶ εὑρήσετε: κρούετε, καὶ ἀνοιγήσεται ὑμῖν.

text_en: For every one that asks, receives: and he that seeks, finds: and to him that knocks, it shall be opened.
text_la: Omnis enim qui petit, accipit : et qui quærit, invenit : et pulsanti aperietur.
text_pt: Porque, aquele que pede, recebe; e, o que busca, encontra; e, ao que bate, abrir-se-lhe-á.
text_el: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ αἰτῶν λαμβάνει καὶ ὁ ζητῶν εὑρίσκει καὶ τῷ κρούοντι ἀνοιγήσεται.

text_en: Or what man is there among you, of whom if his son shall ask bread, will he reach him a stone?
text_la: Aut quis est ex vobis homo, quem si petierit filius suus panem, numquid lapidem porriget ei?
text_pt: E qual dentre vós é o homem que, pedindo-lhe pão o seu filho, lhe dará uma pedra?
text_el: ἢ τίς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἄνθρωπος, ὃν αἰτήσει ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἄρτον, μὴ λίθον ἐπιδώσει αὐτῷ;

text_en: Or if he shall ask him a fish, will he reach him a serpent?
text_la: aut si piscem petierit, numquid serpentem porriget ei?
text_pt: E, pedindo-lhe peixe, lhe dará uma serpente?
text_el: ἢ καὶ ἰχθὺν αἰτήσει, μὴ ὄφιν ἐπιδώσει αὐτῷ;

text_en: If you then being evil , know how to give good gifts to your children: how much more will your Father who is in heaven , give good things to them that ask him?
text_la: Si ergo vos, cum sitis mali, nostis bona data dare filiis vestris : quanto magis Pater vester, qui in cælis est, dabit bona petentibus se?
text_pt: Se vós, pois, sendo maus, sabeis dar boas coisas aos vossos filhos, quanto mais vosso Pai, que está nos céus, dará bens aos que lhe pedirem?
text_el: εἰ οὖν ὑμεῖς πονηροὶ ὄντες οἴδατε δόματα ἀγαθὰ διδόναι τοῖς τέκνοις ὑμῶν, πόσῳ μᾶλλον ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς δώσει ἀγαθὰ τοῖς αἰτοῦσιν αὐτόν.

text_en: All things therefore whatsoever you would that men should do to you, do also to them. For this is the law and the prophets .
text_la: Omnia ergo quæcumque vultis ut faciant vobis homines, et vos facite illis. Hæc est enim lex, et prophetæ.
text_pt: Portanto, tudo o que vós quereis que os homens vos façam, fazei-lho também vós, porque esta é a lei e os profetas.
text_el: πάντα οὖν ὅσα ἐὰν θέλητε ἵνα ποιῶσιν ὑμῖν οἱ ἄνθρωποι, οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε αὐτοῖς: οὗτος γάρ ἐστιν ὁ νόμος καὶ οἱ προφῆται.

text_en: Enter in at the narrow gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many there are who go in thereat.
text_la: Intrate per angustam portam : quia lata porta, et spatiosa via est, quæ ducit ad perditionem, et multi sunt qui intrant per eam.
text_pt: Entrai pela porta estreita; porque larga é a porta, e espaçoso o caminho que conduz à perdição, e muitos são os que entram por ela;
text_el: εἰσέλθατε διὰ τῆς στενῆς πύλης: ὅτι πλατεῖα καὶ εὐρύχωρος ἡ ὁδὸς ἡ ἀπάγουσα εἰς τὴν ἀπώλειαν, καὶ πολλοί εἰσιν οἱ εἰσερχόμενοι δι' αὐτῆς:

text_en: How narrow is the gate, and strait is the way that leads to life: and few there are that find it!
text_la: Quam angusta porta, et arcta via est, quæ ducit ad vitam : et pauci sunt qui inveniunt eam!
text_pt: E porque estreita é a porta, e apertado o caminho que leva à vida, e poucos há que a encontrem.
text_el: ὅτι στενὴ ἡ[ἡ πύλη] καὶ τεθλιμμένη ἡ ὁδὸς ἡ ἀπάγουσα εἰς τὴν ζωήν, καὶ ὀλίγοι εἰσὶν οἱ εὑρίσκοντες αὐτήν.

text_en: Beware of false prophets , who come to you in the clothing of sheep, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
text_la: Attendite a falsis prophetis, qui veniunt ad vos in vestimentis ovium, intrinsecus autem sunt lupi rapaces:
text_pt: Acautelai-vos, porém, dos falsos profetas, que vêm até vós vestidos como ovelhas, mas, interiormente, são lobos devoradores.
text_el: Προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῶν ψευδοπροφητῶν, οἵτινες ἔρχονται πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν ἐνδύμασιν προβάτων, ἔσωθεν δέ εἰσιν λύκοι ἅρπαγες.

text_en: By their fruits you shall know them. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
text_la: a fructibus eorum cognoscetis eos. Numquid colligunt de spinis uvas, aut de tribulis ficus?
text_pt: Por seus frutos os conhecereis. Porventura colhem-se uvas dos espinheiros, ou figos dos abrolhos?
text_el: ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν αὐτῶν ἐπιγνώσεσθε αὐτούς. μήτι συλλέγουσιν ἀπὸ ἀκανθῶν σταφυλὰς ἢ ἀπὸ τριβόλων σῦκα;

text_en: Even so every good tree brings forth good fruit, and the evil tree brings forth evil fruit.
text_la: Sic omnis arbor bona fructus bonos facit : mala autem arbor malos fructus facit.
text_pt: Assim, toda a árvore boa produz bons frutos, e toda a árvore má produz frutos maus.
text_el: οὕτως πᾶν δένδρον ἀγαθὸν καρποὺς καλοὺς ποιεῖ, τὸ δὲ σαπρὸν δένδρον καρποὺς πονηροὺς ποιεῖ:

text_en: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can an evil tree bring forth good fruit.
text_la: Non potest arbor bona malos fructus facere : neque arbor mala bonos fructus facere.
text_pt: Não pode a árvore boa dar maus frutos; nem a árvore má dar frutos bons.
text_el: οὐ δύναται δένδρον ἀγαθὸν καρποὺς πονηροὺς ἐνεγκεῖν, οὐδὲ δένδρον σαπρὸν καρποὺς καλοὺς ποιεῖν.

text_en: Every tree that brings not forth good fruit, shall be cut down, and shall be cast into the fire.
text_la: Omnis arbor, quæ non facit fructum bonum, excidetur, et in ignem mittetur.
text_pt: Toda a árvore que não dá bom fruto corta-se e lança-se no fogo.
text_el: πᾶν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.

text_en: Wherefore by their fruits you shall know them.
text_la: Igitur ex fructibus eorum cognoscetis eos.
text_pt: Portanto, pelos seus frutos os conhecereis.
text_el: ἄρα γε ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν αὐτῶν ἐπιγνώσεσθε αὐτούς.

text_en: Not every one that says to me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven : but he that does the will of my Father who is in heaven , he shall enter into the kingdom of heaven .
text_la: Non omnis qui dicit mihi, Domine, Domine, intrabit in regnum cælorum : sed qui facit voluntatem Patris mei, qui in cælis est, ipse intrabit in regnum cælorum.
text_pt: Nem todo o que me diz: Senhor, Senhor! entrará no reino dos céus, mas aquele que faz a vontade de meu Pai, que está nos céus.
text_el: Οὐ πᾶς ὁ λέγων μοι, κύριε κύριε, εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἀλλ' ὁ ποιῶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

text_en: Many will say to me in that day: Lord, Lord, have not we prophesied in your name , and cast out devils in your name , and done many miracles in your name ?
text_la: Multi dicent mihi in illa die : Domine, Domine, nonne in nomine tuo prophetavimus, et in nomine tuo dæmonia ejecimus, et in nomine tuo virtutes multas fecimus?
text_pt: Muitos me dirão naquele dia: Senhor, Senhor, não profetizamos nós em teu nome? e em teu nome não expulsamos demônios? e em teu nome não fizemos muitas maravilhas?
text_el: πολλοὶ ἐροῦσίν μοι ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ, κύριε κύριε, οὐ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι ἐπροφητεύσαμεν, καὶ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι δαιμόνια ἐξεβάλομεν, καὶ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι δυνάμεις πολλὰς ἐποιήσαμεν;

text_en: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, you that work iniquity .
text_la: Et tunc confitebor illis : Quia numquam novi vos : discedite a me, qui operamini iniquitatem.
text_pt: E então lhes direi abertamente: Nunca vos conheci; apartai-vos de mim, vós que praticais a iniqüidade.
text_el: καὶ τότε ὁμολογήσω αὐτοῖς ὅτι οὐδέποτε ἔγνων ὑμᾶς: ἀποχωρεῖτε ἀπ' ἐμοῦ οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν.

text_en: Every one therefore that hears these my words, and does them, shall be likened to a wise man that built his house upon a rock,
text_la: Omnis ergo qui audit verba mea hæc, et facit ea, assimilabitur viro sapienti, qui ædificavit domum suam supra petram,
text_pt: Todo aquele, pois, que escuta estas minhas palavras, e as pratica, assemelhá-lo-ei ao homem prudente, que edificou a sua casa sobre a rocha;
text_el: Πᾶς οὖν ὅστις ἀκούει μου τοὺς λόγους [τούτους] καὶ ποιεῖ αὐτοὺς ὁμοιωθήσεται ἀνδρὶ φρονίμῳ, ὅστις ᾠκοδόμησεν αὐτοῦ τὴν οἰκίαν ἐπὶ τὴν πέτραν.

text_en: and the rain fell, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and they beat upon that house, and it fell not, for it was founded on a rock.
text_la: et descendit pluvia, et venerunt flumina, et flaverunt venti, et irruerunt in domum illam, et non cecidit : fundata enim erat super petram.
text_pt: E desceu a chuva, e correram rios, e assopraram ventos, e combateram aquela casa, e não caiu, porque estava edificada sobre a rocha.
text_el: καὶ κατέβη ἡ βροχὴ καὶ ἦλθον οἱ ποταμοὶ καὶ ἔπνευσαν οἱ ἄνεμοι καὶ προσέπεσαν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἐκείνῃ, καὶ οὐκ ἔπεσεν, τεθεμελίωτο γὰρ ἐπὶ τὴν πέτραν.

text_en: And every one that hears these my words and does them not, shall be like a foolish man that built his house upon the sand,
text_la: Et omnis qui audit verba mea hæc, et non facit ea, similis erit viro stulto, qui ædificavit domum suam super arenam:
text_pt: E aquele que ouve estas minhas palavras, e não as cumpre, compará-lo-ei ao homem insensato, que edificou a sua casa sobre a areia;
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἀκούων μου τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ μὴ ποιῶν αὐτοὺς ὁμοιωθήσεται ἀνδρὶ μωρῷ, ὅστις ᾠκοδόμησεν αὐτοῦ τὴν οἰκίαν ἐπὶ τὴν ἄμμον.

text_en: and the rain fell, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and they beat upon that house, and it fell, and great was the fall thereof.
text_la: et descendit pluvia, et venerunt flumina, et flaverunt venti, et irruerunt in domum illam, et cecidit, et fuit ruina illius magna.
text_pt: E desceu a chuva, e correram rios, e assopraram ventos, e combateram aquela casa, e caiu, e foi grande a sua queda.
text_el: καὶ κατέβη ἡ βροχὴ καὶ ἦλθον οἱ ποταμοὶ καὶ ἔπνευσαν οἱ ἄνεμοι καὶ προσέκοψαν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἐκείνῃ, καὶ ἔπεσεν, καὶ ἦν ἡ πτῶσις αὐτῆς μεγάλη.

text_en: And it came to pass when Jesus had fully ended these words, the people were in admiration at his doctrine.
text_la: Et factum est : cum consummasset Jesus verba hæc, admirabantur turbæ super doctrina ejus.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, concluindo Jesus este discurso, a multidão se admirou da sua doutrina;
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοὺς λόγους τούτους ἐξεπλήσσοντο οἱ ὄχλοι ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ:

text_en: For he was teaching them as one having power, and not as the scribes and Pharisees .
text_la: Erat enim docens eos sicut potestatem habens, et non sicut scribæ eorum, et pharisæi.
text_pt: Porquanto os ensinava como tendo autoridade; e não como os escribas.
text_el: ἦν γὰρ διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ὡς ἐξουσίαν ἔχων καὶ οὐχ ὡς οἱ γραμματεῖς αὐτῶν.

text_en: And when he had come down from the mountain , great multitudes followed him:
text_la: Cum autem descendisset de monte, secutæ sunt eum turbæ multæ:
text_pt: E, descendo ele do monte, seguiu-o uma grande multidão.
text_el: Καταβάντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί.

text_en: And behold a leper came and adored him, saying: Lord, if you will, you can make me clean .
text_la: et ecce leprosus veniens, adorabat eum, dicens : Domine, si vis, potes me mundare.
text_pt: E, eis que veio um leproso, e o adorou, dizendo: Senhor, se quiseres, podes tornar-me limpo.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ λεπρὸς προσελθὼν προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγων, κύριε, ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί με καθαρίσαι.

text_en: And Jesus stretching forth his hand, touched him, saying: I will, be made clean. And forthwith his leprosy was cleansed .
text_la: Et extendens Jesus manum, tetigit eum, dicens : Volo : mundare. Et confestim mundata est lepra ejus.
text_pt: E Jesus, estendendo a mão, tocou-o, dizendo: Quero; sê limpo. E logo ficou purificado da lepra.
text_el: καὶ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἥψατο αὐτοῦ λέγων, θέλω, καθαρίσθητι: καὶ εὐθέως ἐκαθαρίσθη αὐτοῦ ἡ λέπρα.

text_en: And Jesus said to him: See that you tell no man : but go, show yourself to the priest , and offer the gift which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
text_la: Et ait illi Jesus : Vide, nemini dixeris : sed vade, ostende te sacerdoti, et offer munus, quod præcepit Moyses, in testimonium illis.
text_pt: Disse-lhe então Jesus: Olha, não o digas a alguém, mas vai, mostra-te ao sacerdote, e apresenta a oferta que Moisés determinou, para lhes servir de testemunho.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, ὅρα μηδενὶ εἴπῃς, ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε σεαυτὸν δεῖξον τῷ ἱερεῖ, καὶ προσένεγκον τὸ δῶρον ὃ προσέταξεν Μωϋσῆς, εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And when he had entered into Capharnaum , there came to him a centurion , beseeching him,
text_la: Cum autem introisset Capharnaum, accessit ad eum centurio, rogans eum,
text_pt: E, entrando Jesus em Cafarnaum, chegou junto dele um centurião, rogando-lhe,
text_el: Εἰσελθόντος δὲ αὐτοῦ εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ ἑκατόνταρχος παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν

text_en: and saying, Lord, my servant lies at home sick of the palsy, and is grievously tormented.
text_la: et dicens : Domine, puer meus jacet in domo paralyticus, et male torquetur.
text_pt: E dizendo: Senhor, o meu criado jaz em casa, paralítico, e violentamente atormentado.
text_el: καὶ λέγων, κύριε, ὁ παῖς μου βέβληται ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ παραλυτικός, δεινῶς βασανιζόμενος.

text_en: And Jesus said to him: I will come and heal him.
text_la: Et ait illi Jesus : Ego veniam, et curabo eum.
text_pt: E Jesus lhe disse: Eu irei, e lhe darei saúde.
text_el: Λέγει αὐτῷ, ἐγὼ ἐλθὼν θεραπεύσω αὐτόν.

text_en: And the centurion , making answer, said: Lord, I am not worthy that you should enter under my roof; but only say the word, and my servant shall be healed.
text_la: Et respondens centurio, ait : Domine, non sum dignus ut intres sub tectum meum : sed tantum dic verbo, et sanabitur puer meus.
text_pt: E o centurião, respondendo, disse: Senhor, não sou digno de que entres debaixo do meu telhado, mas dize somente uma palavra, e o meu criado há de sarar.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἑκατόνταρχος ἔφη, κύριε, οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς ἵνα μου ὑπὸ τὴν στέγην εἰσέλθῃς: ἀλλὰ μόνον εἰπὲ λόγῳ, καὶ ἰαθήσεται ὁ παῖς μου.

text_en: For I also am a man subject to authority , having under me soldiers; and I say to this, Go , and he goes, and to another Come , and he comes, and to my servant, Do this , and he does it.
text_la: Nam et ego homo sum sub potestate constitutus, habens sub me milites, et dico huic : Vade, et vadit : et alii : Veni, et venit : et servo meo : Fac hoc, et facit.
text_pt: Pois também eu sou homem sob autoridade, e tenho soldados às minhas ordens; e digo a este: Vai, e ele vai; e a outro: Vem, e ele vem; e ao meu criado: Faze isto, e ele o faz.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπός εἰμι ὑπὸ ἐξουσίαν, [τασσόμενος] ἔχων ὑπ' ἐμαυτὸν στρατιώτας, καὶ λέγω τούτῳ, πορεύθητι, καὶ πορεύεται, καὶ ἄλλῳ, ἔρχου, καὶ ἔρχεται, καὶ τῷ δούλῳ μου, ποίησον τοῦτο, καὶ ποιεῖ.

text_en: And Jesus hearing this, marvelled; and said to them that followed him: Amen I say to you, I have not found so great faith in Israel .
text_la: Audiens autem Jesus miratus est, et sequentibus se dixit : Amen dico vobis, non inveni tantam fidem in Israël.
text_pt: E maravilhou-se Jesus, ouvindo isto, e disse aos que o seguiam: Em verdade vos digo que nem mesmo em Israel encontrei tanta fé.
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐθαύμασεν καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἀκολουθοῦσιν, ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, παρ' οὐδενὶ τοσαύτην πίστιν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ εὗρον.

text_en: And I say to you that many shall come from the east and the west, and shall sit down with Abraham , and Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven :
text_la: Dico autem vobis, quod multi ab oriente et occidente venient, et recumbent cum Abraham, et Isaac, et Jacob in regno cælorum:
text_pt: Mas eu vos digo que muitos virão do oriente e do ocidente, e assentar-se-ão à mesa com Abraão, e Isaque, e Jacó, no reino dos céus;
text_el: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι πολλοὶ ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν ἥξουσιν καὶ ἀνακλιθήσονται μετὰ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν:

text_en: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into the exterior darkness : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text_la: filii autem regni ejicientur in tenebras exteriores : ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium.
text_pt: E os filhos do reino serão lançados nas trevas exteriores; ali haverá pranto e ranger de dentes.
text_el: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ τῆς βασιλείας ἐκβληθήσονται εἰς τὸ σκότος τὸ ἐξώτερον: ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.

text_en: And Jesus said to the centurion : Go, and as you have believed , so be it done to you. And the servant was healed at the same hour.
text_la: Et dixit Jesus centurioni : Vade, et sicut credidisti, fiat tibi. Et sanatus est puer in illa hora.
text_pt: Então disse Jesus ao centurião: Vai, e como creste te seja feito. E naquela mesma hora o seu criado sarou.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ ἑκατοντάρχῃ, ὕπαγε, ὡς ἐπίστευσας γενηθήτω σοι. καὶ ἰάθη ὁ παῖς ἐν τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐκείνῃ.

text_en: And when Jesus had come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother lying, and sick of a fever;
text_la: Et cum venisset Jesus in domum Petri, vidit socrum ejus jacentem, et febricitantem:
text_pt: E Jesus, entrando em casa de Pedro, viu a sogra deste acamada, e com febre.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Πέτρου εἶδεν τὴν πενθερὰν αὐτοῦ βεβλημένην καὶ πυρέσσουσαν:

text_en: and he touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she arose and ministered to them.
text_la: et tetigit manum ejus, et dimisit eam febris, et surrexit, et ministrabat eis.
text_pt: E tocou-lhe na mão, e a febre a deixou; e levantou-se, e serviu-os.
text_el: καὶ ἥψατο τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῆς, καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν ὁ πυρετός: καὶ ἠγέρθη καὶ διηκόνει αὐτῷ.

text_en: And when evening had come, they brought to him many that were possessed with devils : and he cast out the spirits with his word: and all that were sick he healed:
text_la: Vespere autem facto, obtulerunt ei multos dæmonia habentes : et ejiciebat spiritus verbo, et omnes male habentes curavit:
text_pt: E, chegada a tarde, trouxeram-lhe muitos endemoninhados, e ele com a sua palavra expulsou deles os espíritos, e curou todos os que estavam enfermos;
text_el: ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δαιμονιζομένους πολλούς: καὶ ἐξέβαλεν τὰ πνεύματα λόγῳ, καὶ πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ἐθεράπευσεν:

text_en: That it might be fulfilled, which was spoken by the prophet Isaias , saying: He took our infirmities, and bore our diseases .
text_la: ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Isaiam prophetam, dicentem : Ipse infirmitates nostras accepit : et ægrotationes nostras portavit.
text_pt: Para que se cumprisse o que fora dito pelo profeta Isaías, que diz: Ele tomou sobre si as nossas enfermidades, e levou as nossas doenças.
text_el: ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος: αὐτὸς τὰς ἀσθενείας ἡμῶν ἔλαβεν καὶ τὰς νόσους ἐβάστασεν.

text_en: And Jesus seeing great multitudes about him, gave orders to pass over the water.
text_la: Videns autem Jesus turbas multas circum se, jussit ire trans fretum.
text_pt: E Jesus, vendo em torno de si uma grande multidão, ordenou que passassem para o outro lado;
text_el: Ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὄχλον περὶ αὐτὸν ἐκέλευσεν ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὸ πέραν.

text_en: And a certain scribe came and said to him: Master, I will follow you wherever you shall go.
text_la: Et accedens unus scriba, ait illi : Magister, sequar te, quocumque ieris.
text_pt: E, aproximando-se dele um escriba, disse-lhe: Mestre, aonde quer que fores, eu te seguirei.
text_el: καὶ προσελθὼν εἷς γραμματεὺς εἶπεν αὐτῷ, διδάσκαλε, ἀκολουθήσω σοι ὅπου ἐὰν ἀπέρχῃ.

text_en: And Jesus said to him: The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air nests; but the Son of man has not where to lay his head.
text_la: Et dicit ei Jesus : Vulpes foveas habent, et volucres cæli nidos; Filius autem hominis non habet ubi caput reclinet.
text_pt: E disse Jesus: As raposas têm covis, e as aves do céu têm ninhos, mas o Filho do homem não tem onde reclinar a cabeça.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, αἱ ἀλώπεκες φωλεοὺς ἔχουσιν καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνώσεις, ὁ δὲ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἔχει ποῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν κλίνῃ.

text_en: And another of his disciples said to him: Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
text_la: Alius autem de discipulis ejus ait illi : Domine, permitte me primum ire, et sepelire patrem meum.
text_pt: E outro de seus discípulos lhe disse: Senhor, permite-me que primeiramente vá sepultar meu pai.
text_el: ἕτερος δὲ τῶν μαθητῶν εἶπεν αὐτῷ, κύριε, ἐπίτρεψόν μοι πρῶτον ἀπελθεῖν καὶ θάψαι τὸν πατέρα μου.

text_en: But Jesus said to him: Follow me, and let the dead bury their dead.
text_la: Jesus autem ait illi : Sequere me, et dimitte mortuos sepelire mortuos suos.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, disse-lhe: Segue-me, e deixa os mortos sepultar os seus mortos.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτῷ, ἀκολούθει μοι, καὶ ἄφες τοὺς νεκροὺς θάψαι τοὺς ἑαυτῶν νεκρούς.

text_en: And when he entered into the boat, his disciples followed him:
text_la: Et ascendente eo in naviculam, secuti sunt eum discipuli ejus:
text_pt: E, entrando ele no barco, seus discípulos o seguiram;
text_el: Καὶ ἐμβάντι αὐτῷ εἰς πλοῖον ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And behold a great tempest arose in the sea, so that the boat was covered with waves, but he was asleep.
text_la: et ecce motus magnus factus est in mari, ita ut navicula operiretur fluctibus : ipse vero dormiebat.
text_pt: E eis que no mar se levantou uma tempestade, tão grande que o barco era coberto pelas ondas; ele, porém, estava dormindo.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ σεισμὸς μέγας ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ, ὥστε τὸ πλοῖον καλύπτεσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν κυμάτων: αὐτὸς δὲ ἐκάθευδεν.

text_en: And they came to him, and awaked him, saying: Lord, save us, we perish.
text_la: Et accesserunt ad eum discipuli ejus, et suscitaverunt eum, dicentes : Domine, salva nos : perimus.
text_pt: E os seus discípulos, aproximando-se, o despertaram, dizendo: Senhor, salva-nos! que perecemos.
text_el: καὶ προσελθόντες ἤγειραν αὐτὸν λέγοντες, κύριε, σῶσον, ἀπολλύμεθα.

text_en: And Jesus says to them: Why are you fearful, O you of little faith ? Then rising up, he commanded the winds, and the sea, and there came a great calm.
text_la: Et dicit eis Jesus : Quid timidi estis, modicæ fidei? Tunc surgens imperavit ventis, et mari, et facta est tranquillitas magna.
text_pt: E ele disse-lhes: Por que temeis, homens de pouca fé? Então, levantando-se, repreendeu os ventos e o mar, e seguiu-se uma grande bonança.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς, τί δειλοί ἐστε, ὀλιγόπιστοι; τότε ἐγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τοῖς ἀνέμοις καὶ τῇ θαλάσσῃ, καὶ ἐγένετο γαλήνη μεγάλη.

text_en: But the men wondered, saying: What manner of man is this, for the winds and the sea obey him?
text_la: Porro homines mirati sunt, dicentes : Qualis est hic, quia venti et mare obediunt ei?
text_pt: E aqueles homens se maravilharam, dizendo: Que homem é este, que até os ventos e o mar lhe obedecem?
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἄνθρωποι ἐθαύμασαν λέγοντες, ποταπός ἐστιν οὗτος ὅτι καὶ οἱ ἄνεμοι καὶ ἡ θάλασσα αὐτῷ ὑπακούουσιν;

text_en: And when he had come on the other side of the water, into the country of the Gerasens , there met him two that were possessed with devils , coming out of the sepulchres, exceeding fierce, so that none could pass by that way.
text_la: Et cum venisset trans fretum in regionem Gerasenorum, occurrerunt ei duo habentes dæmonia, de monumentis exeuntes, sævi nimis, ita ut nemo posset transire per viam illam.
text_pt: E, tendo chegado ao outro lado, à província dos gergesenos, saíram-lhe ao encontro dois endemoninhados, vindos dos sepulcros; tão ferozes eram que ninguém podia passar por aquele caminho.
text_el: Καὶ ἐλθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πέραν εἰς τὴν χώραν τῶν Γαδαρηνῶν ὑπήντησαν αὐτῷ δύο δαιμονιζόμενοι ἐκ τῶν μνημείων ἐξερχόμενοι, χαλεποὶ λίαν, ὥστε μὴ ἰσχύειν τινὰ παρελθεῖν διὰ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἐκείνης.

text_en: And behold they cried out, saying: What have we to do with you, Jesus Son of God ? Are you come hither to torment us before the time?
text_la: Et ecce clamaverunt, dicentes : Quid nobis et tibi, Jesu fili Dei? Venisti huc ante tempus torquere nos?
text_pt: E eis que clamaram, dizendo: Que temos nós contigo, Jesus, Filho de Deus? Vieste aqui atormentar-nos antes do tempo?
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔκραξαν λέγοντες, τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί, υἱὲ τοῦ θεοῦ; ἦλθες ὧδε πρὸ καιροῦ βασανίσαι ἡμᾶς;

text_en: And there was, not far from them, a herd of many swine feeding.
text_la: Erat autem non longe ab illis grex multorum porcorum pascens.
text_pt: E andava pastando distante deles uma manada de muitos porcos.
text_el: ἦν δὲ μακρὰν ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἀγέλη χοίρων πολλῶν βοσκομένη.

text_en: And the devils besought him, saying: If you cast us out hence, send us into the herd of swine.
text_la: Dæmones autem rogabant eum, dicentes : Si ejicis nos hinc, mitte nos in gregem porcorum.
text_pt: E os demônios rogaram-lhe, dizendo: Se nos expulsas, permite-nos que entremos naquela manada de porcos.
text_el: οἱ δὲ δαίμονες παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν λέγοντες, εἰ ἐκβάλλεις ἡμᾶς, ἀπόστειλον ἡμᾶς εἰς τὴν ἀγέλην τῶν χοίρων.

text_en: And he said to them: Go. But they going out went into the swine, and behold the whole herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea : and they perished in the waters.
text_la: Et ait illis : Ite. At illi exeuntes abierunt in porcos, et ecce impetu abiit totus grex per præceps in mare : et mortui sunt in aquis.
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Ide. E, saindo eles, se introduziram na manada dos porcos; e eis que toda aquela manada de porcos se precipitou no mar por um despenhadeiro, e morreram nas águas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, ὑπάγετε. οἱ δὲ ἐξελθόντες ἀπῆλθον εἰς τοὺς χοίρους: καὶ ἰδοὺ ὥρμησεν πᾶσα ἡ ἀγέλη κατὰ τοῦ κρημνοῦ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, καὶ ἀπέθανον ἐν τοῖς ὕδασιν.

text_en: And they that kept them fled: and coming into the city, told everything, and concerning them that had been possessed by the devils .
text_la: Pastores autem fugerunt : et venientes in civitatem, nuntiaverunt omnia, et de eis qui dæmonia habuerant.
text_pt: Os porqueiros fugiram e, chegando à cidade, divulgaram tudo o que acontecera aos endemoninhados.
text_el: οἱ δὲ βόσκοντες ἔφυγον, καὶ ἀπελθόντες εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἀπήγγειλαν πάντα καὶ τὰ τῶν δαιμονιζομένων.

text_en: And behold the whole city went out to meet Jesus , and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart from their coast.
text_la: Et ecce tota civitas exiit obviam Jesu : et viso eo, rogabant ut transiret a finibus eorum.
text_pt: E eis que toda aquela cidade saiu ao encontro de Jesus e, vendo-o, rogaram-lhe que se retirasse dos seus termos.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ πᾶσα ἡ πόλις ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ὑπάντησιν τῷ Ἰησοῦ, καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν παρεκάλεσαν ὅπως μεταβῇ ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν.

text_en: And entering into a boat, he passed over the water and came into his own city.
text_la: Et ascendens in naviculam, transfretavit, et venit in civitatem suam.
text_pt: E, entrando no barco, passou para o outro lado, e chegou à sua cidade. E eis que lhe trouxeram um paralítico, deitado numa cama.
text_el: Καὶ ἐμβὰς εἰς πλοῖον διεπέρασεν, καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν ἰδίαν πόλιν.

text_en: And behold they brought to him one sick of the palsy lying in a bed. And Jesus , seeing their faith , said to the man sick of the palsy: Be of good heart, son, your sins are forgiven you.
text_la: Et ecce offerebant ei paralyticum jacentem in lecto. Et videns Jesus fidem illorum, dixit paralytico : Confide fili, remittuntur tibi peccata tua.
text_pt: E Jesus, vendo a fé deles, disse ao paralítico: Filho, tem bom ânimo, perdoados te são os teus pecados.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ προσέφερον αὐτῷ παραλυτικὸν ἐπὶ κλίνης βεβλημένον. καὶ ἰδὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὴν πίστιν αὐτῶν εἶπεν τῷ παραλυτικῷ: θάρσει, τέκνον: ἀφίενταί σου αἱ ἁμαρτίαι.

text_en: And behold some of the scribes said within themselves: He blasphemes .
text_la: Et ecce quidam de scribis dixerunt intra se : Hic blasphemat.
text_pt: E eis que alguns dos escribas diziam entre si: Ele blasfema.
text_el: καὶ ἰδού τινες τῶν γραμματέων εἶπαν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς: οὗτος βλασφημεῖ.

text_en: And Jesus seeing their thoughts, said: Why do you think evil in your hearts?
text_la: Et cum vidisset Jesus cogitationes eorum, dixit : Ut quid cogitatis mala in cordibus vestris?
text_pt: Mas Jesus, conhecendo os seus pensamentos, disse: Por que pensais mal em vossos corações?
text_el: καὶ εἰδὼς ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὰς ἐνθυμήσεις αὐτῶν εἶπεν, ἱνατί ἐνθυμεῖσθε πονηρὰ ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν;

text_en: Whether is easier, to say, Your sins are forgiven you: or to say, Arise, and walk?
text_la: Quid est facilius dicere : Dimittuntur tibi peccata tua : an dicere : Surge, et ambula?
text_pt: Pois, qual é mais fácil? dizer: Perdoados te são os teus pecados; ou dizer: Levanta-te e anda?
text_el: τί γάρ ἐστιν εὐκοπώτερον, εἰπεῖν, ἀφίενταί σου αἱ ἁμαρτίαι, ἢ εἰπεῖν, ἔγειρε καὶ περιπάτει;

text_en: But that you may know that the Son of man has power on earth to forgive sins , (then said he to the man sick of the palsy), Arise, take up your bed, and go into your house .
text_la: Ut autem sciatis, quia Filius hominis habet potestatem in terra dimittendi peccata, tunc ait paralytico : Surge, tolle lectum tuum, et vade in domum tuam.
text_pt: Ora, para que saibais que o Filho do homem tem na terra autoridade para perdoar pecados (disse então ao paralítico): Levanta-te, toma a tua cama, e vai para tua casa.
text_el: ἵνα δὲ εἰδῆτε ὅτι ἐξουσίαν ἔχει ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἀφιέναι ἁμαρτίας, τότε λέγει τῷ παραλυτικῷ, ἔγειρε ἆρόν σου τὴν κλίνην καὶ ὕπαγε εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου.

text_en: And he arose, and went into his house.
text_la: Et surrexit, et abiit in domum suam.
text_pt: E, levantando-se, foi para sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐγερθεὶς ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the multitude seeing it, feared, and glorified God that gave such power to men .
text_la: Videntes autem turbæ timuerunt, et glorificaverunt Deum, qui dedit potestatem talem hominibus.
text_pt: E a multidão, vendo isto, maravilhou-se, e glorificou a Deus, que dera tal poder aos homens.
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ ὄχλοι ἐφοβήθησαν καὶ ἐδόξασαν τὸν θεὸν τὸν δόντα ἐξουσίαν τοιαύτην τοῖς ἀνθρώποις.

text_en: And when Jesus passed on from thence, he saw a man sitting in the custom house, named Matthew ; and he said to him: Follow me. And he arose up and followed him.
text_la: Et, cum transiret inde Jesus, vidit hominem sedentem in telonio, Matthæum nomine. Et ait illi : Sequere me. Et surgens, secutus est eum.
text_pt: E Jesus, passando adiante dali, viu assentado na alfândega um homem, chamado Mateus, e disse-lhe: Segue-me. E ele, levantando-se, o seguiu.
text_el: Καὶ παράγων ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐκεῖθεν εἶδεν ἄνθρωπον καθήμενον ἐπὶ τὸ τελώνιον, Μαθθαῖον λεγόμενον, καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ, ἀκολούθει μοι. καὶ ἀναστὰς ἠκολούθησεν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And it came to pass as he was sitting at meat in the house, behold many publicans and sinners came, and sat down with Jesus and his disciples .
text_la: Et factum est, discumbente eo in domo, ecce multi publicani et peccatores venientes, discumbebant cum Jesu, et discipulis ejus.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, estando ele em casa sentado à mesa, chegaram muitos publicanos e pecadores, e sentaram-se juntamente com Jesus e seus discípulos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτοῦ ἀνακειμένου ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ, καὶ ἰδοὺ πολλοὶ τελῶναι καὶ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἐλθόντες συνανέκειντο τῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the Pharisees seeing it, said to his disciples : Why does your master eat with publicans and sinners?
text_la: Et videntes pharisæi, dicebant discipulis ejus : Quare cum publicanis et peccatoribus manducat magister vester?
text_pt: E os fariseus, vendo isto, disseram aos seus discípulos: Por que come o vosso Mestre com os publicanos e pecadores?
text_el: καὶ ἰδόντες οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ἔλεγον τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ, διὰ τί μετὰ τῶν τελωνῶν καὶ ἁμαρτωλῶν ἐσθίει ὁ διδάσκαλος ὑμῶν;

text_en: But Jesus hearing it, said: They that are in health need not a physician, but they that are ill.
text_la: At Jesus audiens, ait : Non est opus valentibus medicus, sed male habentibus.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, ouvindo, disse-lhes: Não necessitam de médico os sãos, mas, sim, os doentes.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀκούσας εἶπεν, οὐ χρείαν ἔχουσιν οἱ ἰσχύοντες ἰατροῦ ἀλλ' οἱ κακῶς ἔχοντες.

text_en: Go then and learn what this means, I will have mercy and not sacrifice . For I am not come to call the just , but sinners.
text_la: Euntes autem discite quid est : Misericordiam volo, et non sacrificium. Non enim veni vocare justos, sed peccatores.
text_pt: Ide, porém, e aprendei o que significa: Misericórdia quero, e não sacrifício. Porque eu nào vim a chamar os justos, mas os pecadores, ao arrependimento.
text_el: πορευθέντες δὲ μάθετε τί ἐστιν, ἔλεος θέλω καὶ οὐ θυσίαν: οὐ γὰρ ἦλθον καλέσαι δικαίους ἀλλὰ ἁμαρτωλούς.

text_en: Then came to him the disciples of John , saying: Why do we and the Pharisees , fast often, but your disciples do not fast ?
text_la: Tunc accesserunt ad eum discipuli Joannis, dicentes : Quare nos, et pharisæi, jejunamus frequenter : discipuli autem tui non jejunant?
text_pt: Então, chegaram ao pé dele os discípulos de João, dizendo: Por que jejuamos nós e os fariseus muitas vezes, e os teus discípulos não jejuam?
text_el: Τότε προσέρχονται αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ Ἰωάννου λέγοντες, διὰ τί ἡμεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι νηστεύομεν, οἱ δὲ μαθηταί σου οὐ νηστεύουσιν;

text_en: And Jesus said to them: Can the children of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then they shall fast .
text_la: Et ait illis Jesus : Numquid possunt filii sponsi lugere, quamdiu cum illis est sponsus? Venient autem dies cum auferetur ab eis sponsus : et tunc jejunabunt.
text_pt: E disse-lhes Jesus: Podem porventura andar tristes os filhos das bodas, enquanto o esposo está com eles? Dias, porém, virão, em que lhes será tirado o esposo, e então jejuarão.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, μὴ δύνανται οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ νυμφῶνος πενθεῖν ἐφ' ὅσον μετ' αὐτῶν ἐστιν ὁ νυμφίος; ἐλεύσονται δὲ ἡμέραι ὅταν ἀπαρθῇ ἀπ' αὐτῶν ὁ νυμφίος, καὶ τότε νηστεύσουσιν.

text_en: And nobody puts a piece of raw cloth unto an old garment. For it takes away the fullness thereof from the garment, and there is made a greater rent.
text_la: Nemo autem immittit commissuram panni rudis in vestimentum vetus : tollit enim plenitudinem ejus a vestimento, et pejor scissura fit.
text_pt: Ninguém deita remendo de pano novo em roupa velha, porque semelhante remendo rompe a roupa, e faz-se maior a rotura.
text_el: οὐδεὶς δὲ ἐπιβάλλει ἐπίβλημα ῥάκους ἀγνάφου ἐπὶ ἱματίῳ παλαιῷ: αἴρει γὰρ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἱματίου, καὶ χεῖρον σχίσμα γίνεται.

text_en: Neither do they put new wine into old bottles. Otherwise the bottles break, and the wine runs out, and the bottles perish. But new wine they put into new bottles: and both are preserved.
text_la: Neque mittunt vinum novum in utres veteres : alioquin rumpuntur utres, et vinum effunditur, et utres pereunt. Sed vinum novum in utres novos mittunt : et ambo conservantur.
text_pt: Nem se deita vinho novo em odres velhos; aliás rompem-se os odres, e entorna-se o vinho, e os odres estragam-se; mas deita-se vinho novo em odres novos, e assim ambos se conservam.
text_el: οὐδὲ βάλλουσιν οἶνον νέον εἰς ἀσκοὺς παλαιούς: εἰ δὲ μή γε, ῥήγνυνται οἱ ἀσκοί, καὶ ὁ οἶνος ἐκχεῖται καὶ οἱ ἀσκοὶ ἀπόλλυνται: ἀλλὰ βάλλουσιν οἶνον νέον εἰς ἀσκοὺς καινούς, καὶ ἀμφότεροι συντηροῦνται.

text_en: As he was speaking these things unto them, behold a certain ruler came up, and adored him, saying: Lord, my daughter is even now dead; but come, lay your hand upon her, and she shall live.
text_la: Hæc illo loquente ad eos, ecce princeps unus accessit, et adorabat eum, dicens : Domine, filia mea modo defuncta est : sed veni, impone manum tuam super eam, et vivet.
text_pt: Dizendo-lhes ele estas coisas, eis que chegou um chefe, e o adorou, dizendo: Minha filha faleceu agora mesmo; mas vem, impõe-lhe a tua mão, e ela viverá.
text_el: Ταῦτα αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος αὐτοῖς ἰδοὺ ἄρχων [εἷς] προσελθὼν προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγων: ὅτι ἡ θυγάτηρ μου ἄρτι ἐτελεύτησεν, ἀλλὰ ἐλθὼν ἐπίθες τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐπ' αὐτήν, καὶ ζήσεται.

text_en: And Jesus rising up followed him, with his disciples .
text_la: Et surgens Jesus, sequebatur eum, et discipuli ejus.
text_pt: E Jesus, levantando-se, seguiu-o, ele e os seus discípulos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγερθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And behold a woman who was troubled with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment.
text_la: Et ecce mulier, quæ sanguinis fluxum patiebatur duodecim annis, accessit retro, et tetigit fimbriam vestimenti ejus.
text_pt: E eis que uma mulher que havia já doze anos padecia de um fluxo de sangue, chegando por detrás dele, tocou a orla de sua roupa;
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ γυνὴ αἱμορροοῦσα δώδεκα ἔτη προσελθοῦσα ὄπισθεν ἥψατο τοῦ κρασπέδου τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ:

text_en: For she said within herself: If I shall touch only his garment, I shall be healed.
text_la: Dicebat enim intra se : Si tetigero tantum vestimentum ejus, salva ero.
text_pt: Porque dizia consigo: Se eu tão-somente tocar a sua roupa, ficarei sã.
text_el: ἔλεγεν γὰρ ἐν ἑαυτῇ, ἐὰν μόνον ἅψωμαι τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ σωθήσομαι.

text_en: But Jesus turning and seeing her, said: Be of good heart, daughter, your faith has made you whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
text_la: At Jesus conversus, et videns eam, dixit : Confide, filia, fides tua te salvam fecit. Et salva facta est mulier ex illa hora.
text_pt: E Jesus, voltando-se, e vendo-a, disse: Tem ânimo, filha, a tua fé te salvou. E imediatamente a mulher ficou sã.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς στραφεὶς καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὴν εἶπεν: θάρσει θύγατερ, ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε. καὶ ἐσώθη ἡ γυνὴ ἀπὸ τῆς ὥρας ἐκείνης.

text_en: And when Jesus had come into the house of the ruler, and saw the minstrels and the multitude making a rout,
text_la: Et cum venisset Jesus in domum principis, et vidisset tibicines et turbam tumultuantem, dicebat:
text_pt: E Jesus, chegando à casa daquele chefe, e vendo os instrumentistas, e o povo em alvoroço,
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἄρχοντος καὶ ἰδὼν τοὺς αὐλητὰς καὶ τὸν ὄχλον θορυβούμενον

text_en: he said: Give place, for the girl is not dead, but sleeps. And they laughed him to scorn.
text_la: Recedite : non est enim mortua puella, sed dormit. Et deridebant eum.
text_pt: Disse-lhes: Retirai-vos, que a menina não está morta, mas dorme. E riam-se dele.
text_el: ἔλεγεν: ἀναχωρεῖτε: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέθανεν τὸ κοράσιον ἀλλὰ καθεύδει. καὶ κατεγέλων αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And when the multitude was put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand. And the maid arose.
text_la: Et cum ejecta esset turba, intravit : et tenuit manum ejus, et surrexit puella.
text_pt: E, logo que o povo foi posto fora, entrou Jesus, e pegou-lhe na mão, e a menina levantou-se.
text_el: ὅτε δὲ ἐξεβλήθη ὁ ὄχλος, εἰσελθὼν ἐκράτησεν τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῆς, καὶ ἠγέρθη τὸ κοράσιον.

text_en: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that country.
text_la: Et exiit fama hæc in universam terram illam.
text_pt: E espalhou-se aquela notícia por todo aquele país.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἡ φήμη αὕτη εἰς ὅλην τὴν γῆν ἐκείνην.

text_en: And as Jesus passed from thence, there followed him two blind men crying out and saying, Have mercy on us, O Son of David .
text_la: Et transeunte inde Jesu, secuti sunt eum duo cæci, clamantes, et dicentes : Miserere nostri, fili David.
text_pt: E, partindo Jesus dali, seguiram-no dois cegos, clamando, e dizendo: Tem compaixão de nós, filho de Davi.
text_el: Καὶ παράγοντι ἐκεῖθεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἠκολούθησαν δύο τυφλοὶ κράζοντες καὶ λέγοντες, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς, υἱὲ Δαυίδ.

text_en: And when he had come to the house, the blind men came to him. And Jesus says to them, Do you believe , that I can do this unto you? They say to him, Yea, Lord.
text_la: Cum autem venisset domum, accesserunt ad eum cæci. Et dicit eis Jesus : Creditis quia hoc possum facere vobis? Dicunt ei : Utique, Domine.
text_pt: E, quando chegou à casa, os cegos se aproximaram dele; e Jesus disse-lhes: Credes vós que eu possa fazer isto? Disseram-lhe eles: Sim, Senhor.
text_el: ἐλθόντι δὲ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν προσῆλθον αὐτῷ οἱ τυφλοί, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, πιστεύετε ὅτι δύναμαι τοῦτο ποιῆσαι; λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: ναί, κύριε.

text_en: Then he touched their eyes, saying, According to your faith , be it done unto you.
text_la: Tunc tetigit oculos eorum, dicens : Secundum fidem vestram, fiat vobis.
text_pt: Tocou então os olhos deles, dizendo: Seja-vos feito segundo a vossa fé.
text_el: τότε ἥψατο τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν λέγων: Κατὰ τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν γενηθήτω ὑμῖν.

text_en: And their eyes were opened, and Jesus strictly charged them, saying, See that no man know this.
text_la: Et aperti sunt oculi eorum : et comminatus est illis Jesus, dicens : Videte ne quis sciat.
text_pt: E os olhos se lhes abriram. E Jesus ameaçou-os, dizendo: Olhai que ninguém o saiba.
text_el: καὶ ἠνεῴχθησαν αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί. καὶ ἐνεβριμήθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων: ὁρᾶτε μηδεὶς γινωσκέτω.

text_en: But they going out, spread his fame abroad in all that country.
text_la: Illi autem exeuntes, diffamaverunt eum in tota terra illa.
text_pt: Mas, tendo eles saído, divulgaram a sua fama por toda aquela terra.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐξελθόντες διεφήμισαν αὐτὸν ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ γῇ ἐκείνῃ.

text_en: And when they had gone out, behold they brought him a dumb man , possessed with a devil .
text_la: Egressis autem illis, ecce obtulerunt ei hominem mutum, dæmonium habentem.
text_pt: E, havendo-se eles retirado, trouxeram-lhe um homem mudo e endemoninhado.
text_el: Αὐτῶν δὲ ἐξερχομένων, ἰδοὺ προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ κωφὸν δαιμονιζόμενον:

text_en: And after the devil was cast out , the dumb man spoke, and the multitudes wondered, saying, Never was the like seen in Israel .
text_la: Et ejecto dæmonio, locutus est mutus, et miratæ sunt turbæ, dicentes : Numquam apparuit sic in Israël.
text_pt: E, expulso o demônio, falou o mudo; e a multidão se maravilhou, dizendo: Nunca tal se viu em Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐκβληθέντος τοῦ δαιμονίου ἐλάλησεν ὁ κωφός. καὶ ἐθαύμασαν οἱ ὄχλοι λέγοντες: οὐδέποτε ἐφάνη οὕτως ἐν τῷ Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: But the Pharisees said, By the prince of devils he casts out devils .
text_la: Pharisæi autem dicebant : In principe dæmoniorum ejicit dæmones.
text_pt: Mas os fariseus diziam: Ele expulsa os demônios pelo príncipe dos demônios.
text_el: [οἱ δὲ Φαρισαῖοι ἔλεγον: ἐν τῷ ἄρχοντι τῶν δαιμονίων ἐκβάλλει τὰ δαιμόνια].

text_en: And Jesus went about all the cities and towns, teaching in their synagogues , and preaching the gospel of the kingdom , and healing every disease, and every infirmity.
text_la: Et circuibat Jesus omnes civitates, et castella, docens in synagogis eorum, et prædicans Evangelium regni, et curans omnem languorem, et omnem infirmitatem.
text_pt: E percorria Jesus todas as cidades e aldeias, ensinando nas sinagogas deles, e pregando o evangelho do reino, e curando todas as enfermidades e moléstias entre o povo.
text_el: Καὶ περιῆγεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὰς πόλεις πάσας καὶ τὰς κώμας, διδάσκων ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν καὶ κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς βασιλείας καὶ θεραπεύων πᾶσαν νόσον καὶ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν.

text_en: And seeing the multitudes, he had compassion on them: because they were distressed, and lying like sheep that have no shepherd.
text_la: Videns autem turbas, misertus est eis : quia erant vexati, et jacentes sicut oves non habentes pastorem.
text_pt: E, vendo as multidões, teve grande compaixão delas, porque andavam cansadas e desgarradas, como ovelhas que não têm pastor.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ τοὺς ὄχλους ἐσπλαγχνίσθη περὶ αὐτῶν, ὅτι ἦσαν ἐσκυλμένοι καὶ ἐρριμμένοι ὡσεὶ πρόβατα μὴ ἔχοντα ποιμένα.

text_en: Then he says to his disciples , The harvest indeed is great, but the labourers are few.
text_la: Tunc dicit discipulis suis : Messis quidem multa, operarii autem pauci.
text_pt: Então, disse aos seus discípulos: A seara é realmente grande, mas poucos os ceifeiros.
text_el: τότε λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ: ὁ μὲν θερισμὸς πολύς, οἱ δὲ ἐργάται ὀλίγοι:

text_en: Pray therefore the Lord of the harvest , that he send forth labourers into his harvest.
text_la: Rogate ergo Dominum messis, ut mittat operarios in messem suam.
text_pt: Rogai, pois, ao Senhor da seara, que mande ceifeiros para a sua seara.
text_el: δεήθητε οὖν τοῦ κυρίου τοῦ θερισμοῦ ὅπως ἐκβάλῃ ἐργάτας εἰς τὸν θερισμὸν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And having called his twelve disciples together, he gave them power over unclean spirits , to cast them out , and to heal all manner of diseases, and all manner of infirmities.
text_la: Et convocatis duodecim discipulis suis, dedit illis potestatem spirituum immundorum, ut ejicerent eos, et curarent omnem languorem, et omnem infirmitatem.
text_pt: E, chamando os seus doze discípulos, deu-lhes poder sobre os espíritos imundos, para os expulsarem, e para curarem toda a enfermidade e todo o mal.
text_el: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τοὺς δώδεκα μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν πνευμάτων ἀκαθάρτων, ὥστε ἐκβάλλειν αὐτὰ καὶ θεραπεύειν πᾶσαν νόσον καὶ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν.

text_en: And the names of the twelve Apostles are these: The first, Simon who is called Peter , and Andrew his brother,
text_la: Duodecim autem Apostolorum nomina sunt hæc. Primus, Simon, qui dicitur Petrus : et Andreas frater ejus,
text_pt: Ora, os nomes dos doze apóstolos são estes: O primeiro, Simão, chamado Pedro, e André, seu irmão; Tiago, filho de Zebedeu, e João, seu irmão;
text_el: Τῶν δὲ δώδεκα ἀποστόλων τὰ ὀνόματά ἐστιν ταῦτα: πρῶτος Σίμων ὁ λεγόμενος Πέτρος καὶ Ἀνδρέας ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ Ἰάκωβος ὁ τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάννης ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ,

text_en: James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother, Philip and Bartholomew , Thomas and Matthew the publican , and James the son of Alpheus , and Thaddeus ,
text_la: Jacobus Zebedæi, et Joannes frater ejus, Philippus, et Bartholomæus, Thomas, et Matthæus publicanus, Jacobus Alphæi, et Thaddæus,
text_pt: Filipe e Bartolomeu; Tomé e Mateus, o publicano; Tiago, filho de Alfeu, e Lebeu, apelidado Tadeu;
text_el: Φίλιππος καὶ Βαρθολομαῖος, Θωμᾶς καὶ Μαθθαῖος ὁ τελώνης, Ἰάκωβος ὁ τοῦ Ἁλφαίου καὶ Θαδδαῖος,

text_en: Simon the Cananean , and Judas Iscariot , who also betrayed him.
text_la: Simon Chananæus, et Judas Iscariotes, qui et tradidit eum.
text_pt: Simão, o Cananita, e Judas Iscariotes, aquele que o traiu.
text_el: Σίμων ὁ Καναναῖος καὶ Ἰούδας ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης ὁ καὶ παραδοὺς αὐτόν.

text_en: These twelve Jesus sent: commanding them, saying: Go not into the way of the Gentiles , and into the city of the Samaritans enter not.
text_la: Hos duodecim misit Jesus, præcipiens eis, dicens : In viam gentium ne abieritis, et in civitates Samaritanorum ne intraveritis:
text_pt: Jesus enviou estes doze, e lhes ordenou, dizendo: Não ireis pelo caminho dos gentios, nem entrareis em cidade de samaritanos;
text_el: Τούτους τοὺς δώδεκα ἀπέστειλεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς παραγγείλας αὐτοῖς λέγων: εἰς ὁδὸν ἐθνῶν μὴ ἀπέλθητε, καὶ εἰς πόλιν Σαμαριτῶν μὴ εἰσέλθητε:

text_en: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel .
text_la: sed potius ite ad oves quæ perierunt domus Israël.
text_pt: Mas ide antes às ovelhas perdidas da casa de Israel;
text_el: πορεύεσθε δὲ μᾶλλον πρὸς τὰ πρόβατα τὰ ἀπολωλότα οἴκου Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: And going, preach, saying: The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
text_la: Euntes autem prædicate, dicentes : Quia appropinquavit regnum cælorum.
text_pt: E, indo, pregai, dizendo: É chegado o reino dos céus.
text_el: πορευόμενοι δὲ κηρύσσετε λέγοντες ὅτι ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

text_en: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers , cast out devils . Freely have you received, freely give.
text_la: Infirmos curate, mortuos suscitate, leprosos mundate, dæmones ejicite : gratis accepistis, gratis date.
text_pt: Curai os enfermos, limpai os leprosos, ressuscitai os mortos, expulsai os demônios; de graça recebestes, de graça dai.
text_el: ἀσθενοῦντας θεραπεύετε, νεκροὺς ἐγείρετε, λεπροὺς καθαρίζετε, δαιμόνια ἐκβάλλετε: δωρεὰν ἐλάβετε, δωρεὰν δότε.

text_en: Do not possess gold, nor silver, nor money in your purses;
text_la: Nolite possidere aurum, neque argentum, neque pecuniam in zonis vestris:
text_pt: Não possuais ouro, nem prata, nem cobre, em vossos cintos,
text_el: μὴ κτήσησθε χρυσὸν μηδὲ ἄργυρον μηδὲ χαλκὸν εἰς τὰς ζώνας ὑμῶν,

text_en: nor scrip for your journey, nor two coats, nor shoes, nor a staff; for the workman is worthy of his meat.
text_la: non peram in via, neque duas tunicas, neque calceamenta, neque virgam : dignus enim est operarius cibo suo.
text_pt: Nem alforges para o caminho, nem duas túnicas, nem alparcas, nem bordões; porque digno é o operário do seu alimento.
text_el: μὴ πήραν εἰς ὁδὸν μηδὲ δύο χιτῶνας μηδὲ ὑποδήματα μηδὲ ῥάβδον: ἄξιος γὰρ ὁ ἐργάτης τῆς τροφῆς αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And into whatsoever city or town you shall enter, inquire who in it is worthy, and there abide till you go thence.
text_la: In quamcumque autem civitatem aut castellum intraveritis, interrogate, quis in ea dignus sit : et ibi manete donec exeatis.
text_pt: E, em qualquer cidade ou aldeia em que entrardes, procurai saber quem nela seja digno, e hospedai-vos aí, até que vos retireis.
text_el: εἰς ἣν δ' ἂν πόλιν ἢ κώμην εἰσέλθητε, ἐξετάσατε τίς ἐν αὐτῇ ἄξιός ἐστιν: κἀκεῖ μείνατε ἕως ἂν ἐξέλθητε.

text_en: And when you come into the house, salute it, saying: Peace be to this house.
text_la: Intrantes autem in domum, salutate eam, dicentes : Pax huic domui.
text_pt: E, quando entrardes nalguma casa, saudai-a;
text_el: εἰσερχόμενοι δὲ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν ἀσπάσασθε αὐτήν:

text_en: And if that house be worthy, your peace shall come upon it; but if it be not worthy, your peace shall return to you.
text_la: Et siquidem fuerit domus illa digna, veniet pax vestra super eam : si autem non fuerit digna, pax vestra revertetur ad vos.
text_pt: E, se a casa for digna, desça sobre ela a vossa paz; mas, se não for digna, torne para vós a vossa paz.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν μὲν ᾖ ἡ οἰκία ἀξία, ἐλθάτω ἡ εἰρήνη ὑμῶν ἐπ' αὐτήν: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ᾖ ἀξία, ἡ εἰρήνη ὑμῶν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ἐπιστραφήτω.

text_en: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words: going forth out of that house or city shake off the dust from your feet.
text_la: Et quicumque non receperit vos, neque audierit sermones vestros : exeunte foras de domo, vel civitate, excutite pulverem de pedibus vestris.
text_pt: E, se ninguém vos receber, nem escutar as vossas palavras, saindo daquela casa ou cidade, sacudi o pó dos vossos pés.
text_el: καὶ ὃς ἂν μὴ δέξηται ὑμᾶς μηδὲ ἀκούσῃ τοὺς λόγους ὑμῶν, ἐξερχόμενοι ἔξω τῆς οἰκίας ἢ τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης ἐκτινάξατε τὸν κονιορτὸν τῶν ποδῶν ὑμῶν.

text_en: Amen I say to you, it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city.
text_la: Amen dico vobis : Tolerabilius erit terræ Sodomorum et Gomorrhæorum in die judicii, quam illi civitati.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que, no dia do juízo, haverá menos rigor para o país de Sodoma e Gomorra do que para aquela cidade.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀνεκτότερον ἔσται γῇ Σοδόμων καὶ Γομόρρων ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως ἢ τῇ πόλει ἐκείνῃ.

text_en: Behold I send you as sheep in the midst of wolves. Be therefore wise as serpents and simple as doves.
text_la: Ecce ego mitto vos sicut oves in medio luporum. Estote ergo prudentes sicut serpentes, et simplices sicut columbæ.
text_pt: Eis que vos envio como ovelhas ao meio de lobos; portanto, sede prudentes como as serpentes e inofensivos como as pombas.
text_el: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω ὑμᾶς ὡς πρόβατα ἐν μέσῳ λύκων: γίνεσθε οὖν φρόνιμοι ὡς οἱ ὄφεις καὶ ἀκέραιοι ὡς αἱ περιστεραί.

text_en: But beware of men . For they will deliver you up in councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues .
text_la: Cavete autem ab hominibus. Tradent enim vos in conciliis, et in synagogis suis flagellabunt vos:
text_pt: Acautelai-vos, porém, dos homens; porque eles vos entregarão aos sinédrios, e vos açoitarão nas suas sinagogas;
text_el: προσέχετε δὲ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων: παραδώσουσιν γὰρ ὑμᾶς εἰς συνέδρια, καὶ ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν μαστιγώσουσιν ὑμᾶς:

text_en: And you shall be brought before governors, and before kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the Gentiles :
text_la: et ad præsides, et ad reges ducemini propter me in testimonium illis, et gentibus.
text_pt: E sereis até conduzidos à presença dos governadores, e dos reis, por causa de mim, para lhes servir de testemunho a eles, e aos gentios.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ ἡγεμόνας δὲ καὶ βασιλεῖς ἀχθήσεσθε ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς καὶ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν.

text_en: But when they shall deliver you up, take no thought how or what to speak: for it shall be given you in that hour what to speak:
text_la: Cum autem tradent vos, nolite cogitare quomodo, aut quid loquamini : dabitur enim vobis in illa hora, quid loquamini:
text_pt: Mas, quando vos entregarem, não vos dê cuidado como, ou o que haveis de falar, porque naquela mesma hora vos será ministrado o que haveis de dizer.
text_el: ὅταν δὲ παραδῶσιν ὑμᾶς, μὴ μεριμνήσητε πῶς ἢ τί λαλήσητε: δοθήσεται γὰρ ὑμῖν ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ τί λαλήσητε:

text_en: For it is not you that speak, but the Spirit of your Father that speaks in you.
text_la: non enim vos estis qui loquimini, sed Spiritus Patris vestri, qui loquitur in vobis.
text_pt: Porque não sois vós quem falará, mas o Espírito de vosso Pai é que fala em vós.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ὑμεῖς ἐστε οἱ λαλοῦντες ἀλλὰ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν τὸ λαλοῦν ἐν ὑμῖν.

text_en: The brother also shall deliver up the brother to death , and the father the son; and the children shall rise up against their parents , and shall put them to death .
text_la: Tradet autem frater fratrem in mortem, et pater filium : et insurgent filii in parentes, et morte eos afficient:
text_pt: E o irmão entregará à morte o irmão, e o pai o filho; e os filhos se levantarão contra os pais, e os matarão.
text_el: παραδώσει δὲ ἀδελφὸς ἀδελφὸν εἰς θάνατον καὶ πατὴρ τέκνον, καὶ ἐπαναστήσονται τέκνα ἐπὶ γονεῖς καὶ θανατώσουσιν αὐτούς.

text_en: And you shall be hated by all men for my name's sake: but he that shall persevere unto the end , he shall be saved .
text_la: et eritis odio omnibus propter nomen meum : qui autem perseveraverit usque in finem, hic salvus erit.
text_pt: E odiados de todos sereis por causa do meu nome; mas aquele que perseverar até ao fim, esse será salvo.
text_el: καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου: ὁ δὲ ὑπομείνας εἰς τέλος οὗτος σωθήσεται.

text_en: And when they shall persecute you in this city, flee into another. Amen I say to you, you shall not finish all the cities of Israel , till the Son of man come.
text_la: Cum autem persequentur vos in civitate ista, fugite in aliam. Amen dico vobis, non consummabitis civitates Israël, donec veniat Filius hominis.
text_pt: Quando pois vos perseguirem nesta cidade, fugi para outra; porque em verdade vos digo que não acabareis de percorrer as cidades de Israel sem que venha o Filho do homem.
text_el: ὅταν δὲ διώκωσιν ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ, φεύγετε εἰς τὴν ἑτέραν: ἀμὴν γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐ μὴ τελέσητε τὰς πόλεις [τοῦ] Ἰσραὴλ ἕως ἔλθῃ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

text_en: The disciple is not above the master, nor the servant above his lord.
text_la: Non est discipulus super magistrum, nec servus super dominum suum:
text_pt: Não é o discípulo mais do que o mestre, nem o servo mais do que o seu senhor.
text_el: Οὐκ ἔστιν μαθητὴς ὑπὲρ τὸν διδάσκαλον οὐδὲ δοῦλος ὑπὲρ τὸν κύριον αὐτοῦ.

text_en: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the good man of the house Beelzebub , how much more them of his household?
text_la: sufficit discipulo ut sit sicut magister ejus, et servo, sicut dominus ejus. Si patremfamilias Beelzebub vocaverunt, quanto magis domesticos ejus?
text_pt: Basta ao discípulo ser como seu mestre, e ao servo como seu senhor. Se chamaram Belzebu ao pai de família, quanto mais aos seus domésticos?
text_el: ἀρκετὸν τῷ μαθητῇ ἵνα γένηται ὡς ὁ διδάσκαλος αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὁ δοῦλος ὡς ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ. εἰ τὸν οἰκοδεσπότην Βεελζεβοὺλ ἐπεκάλεσαν, πόσῳ μᾶλλον τοὺς οἰκιακοὺς αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Therefore fear them not. For nothing is covered that shall not be revealed: nor hid, that shall not be known .
text_la: Ne ergo timueritis eos. Nihil enim est opertum, quod non revelabitur : et occultum, quod non scietur.
text_pt: Portanto, não os temais; porque nada há encoberto que não haja de revelar-se, nem oculto que não haja de saber-se.
text_el: μὴ οὖν φοβηθῆτε αὐτούς: οὐδὲν γάρ ἐστιν κεκαλυμμένον ὃ οὐκ ἀποκαλυφθήσεται, καὶ κρυπτὸν ὃ οὐ γνωσθήσεται.

text_en: That which I tell you in the dark, speak in the light: and that which you hear in the ear, preach upon the housetops.
text_la: Quod dico vobis in tenebris, dicite in lumine : et quod in aure auditis, prædicate super tecta.
text_pt: O que vos digo em trevas dizei-o em luz; e o que escutais ao ouvido pregai-o sobre os telhados.
text_el: ὃ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ, εἴπατε ἐν τῷ φωτί: καὶ ὃ εἰς τὸ οὖς ἀκούετε, κηρύξατε ἐπὶ τῶν δωμάτων.

text_en: And fear not them that kill the body, and are not able to kill the soul : but rather fear him that can destroy both soul and body in hell .
text_la: Et nolite timere eos qui occidunt corpus, animam autem non possunt occidere : sed potius timete eum, qui potest et animam et corpus perdere in gehennam.
text_pt: E não temais os que matam o corpo e não podem matar a alma; temei antes aquele que pode fazer perecer no inferno a alma e o corpo.
text_el: καὶ μὴ φοβηθῆτε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀποκτεινόντων τὸ σῶμα, τὴν δὲ ψυχὴν μὴ δυναμένων ἀποκτεῖναι: φοβεῖσθε δὲ μᾶλλον τὸν δυνάμενον καὶ ψυχὴν καὶ σῶμα ἀπολέσαι ἐν γεέννῃ.

text_en: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? And not one of them shall fall on the ground without your Father .
text_la: Nonne duo passeres asse veneunt? et unus ex illis non cadet super terram sine Patre vestro.
text_pt: Não se vendem dois passarinhos por um ceitil? e nenhum deles cairá em terra sem a vontade de vosso Pai.
text_el: οὐχὶ δύο στρουθία ἀσσαρίου πωλεῖται; καὶ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐ πεσεῖται ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἄνευ τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν.

text_en: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
text_la: Vestri autem capilli capitis omnes numerati sunt.
text_pt: E até mesmo os cabelos da vossa cabeça estão todos contados.
text_el: ὑμῶν δὲ καὶ αἱ τρίχες τῆς κεφαλῆς πᾶσαι ἠριθμημέναι εἰσίν.

text_en: Fear not therefore: better are you than many sparrows.
text_la: Nolite ergo timere : multis passeribus meliores estis vos.
text_pt: Não temais, pois; mais valeis vós do que muitos passarinhos.
text_el: μὴ οὖν φοβεῖσθε: πολλῶν στρουθίων διαφέρετε ὑμεῖς.

text_en: Every one therefore that shall confess me before men , I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven .
text_la: Omnis ergo qui confitebitur me coram hominibus, confitebor et ego eum coram Patre meo, qui in cælis est.
text_pt: Portanto, qualquer que me confessar diante dos homens, eu o confessarei diante de meu Pai, que está nos céus.
text_el: Πᾶς οὖν ὅστις ὁμολογήσει ἐν ἐμοὶ ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὁμολογήσω κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς:

text_en: But he that shall deny me before men , I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven .
text_la: Qui autem negaverit me coram hominibus, negabo et ego eum coram Patre meo, qui in cælis est.
text_pt: Mas qualquer que me negar diante dos homens, eu o negarei também diante de meu Pai, que está nos céus.
text_el: ὅστις δὲ δ' ἀρνήσηταί με ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ἀρνήσομαι κἀγὼ αὐτὸν ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

text_en: Do not think that I came to send peace upon earth: I came not to send peace, but the sword.
text_la: Nolite arbitrari quia pacem venerim mittere in terram : non veni pacem mittere, sed gladium:
text_pt: Não cuideis que vim trazer a paz à terra; não vim trazer paz, mas espada;
text_el: Μὴ νομίσητε ὅτι ἦλθον βαλεῖν εἰρήνην ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν: οὐκ ἦλθον βαλεῖν εἰρήνην ἀλλὰ μάχαιραν.

text_en: For I came to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
text_la: veni enim separare hominem adversus patrem suum, et filiam adversus matrem suam, et nurum adversus socrum suam:
text_pt: Porque eu vim pôr em dissensão o homem contra seu pai, e a filha contra sua mãe, e a nora contra sua sogra;
text_el: ἦλθον γὰρ διχάσαι ἄνθρωπον κατὰ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ θυγατέρα κατὰ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτῆς καὶ νύμφην κατὰ τῆς πενθερᾶς αὐτῆς,

text_en: And a man's enemies shall be they of his own household .
text_la: et inimici hominis, domestici ejus.
text_pt: E assim os inimigos do homem serão os seus familiares.
text_el: καὶ ἐχθροὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οἱ οἰκιακοὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: He that loves father or mother more than me, is not worthy of me; and he that loves son or daughter more than me, is not worthy of me.
text_la: Qui amat patrem aut matrem plus quam me, non est me dignus : et qui amat filium aut filiam super me, non est me dignus.
text_pt: Quem ama o pai ou a mãe mais do que a mim não é digno de mim; e quem ama o filho ou a filha mais do que a mim não é digno de mim.
text_el: Ὁ φιλῶν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα ὑπὲρ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἔστιν μου ἄξιος, καὶ ὁ φιλῶν υἱὸν ἢ θυγατέρα ὑπὲρ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἔστιν μου ἄξιος,

text_en: And he that takes not up his cross , and follows me, is not worthy of me.
text_la: Et qui non accipit crucem suam, et sequitur me, non est me dignus.
text_pt: E quem não toma a sua cruz, e não segue após mim, não é digno de mim.
text_el: καὶ ὃς οὐ λαμβάνει τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκολουθεῖ ὀπίσω μου, οὐκ ἔστιν μου ἄξιος.

text_en: He that finds his life , shall lose it: and he that shall lose his life for me, shall find it.
text_la: Qui invenit animam suam, perdet illam : et qui perdiderit animam suam propter me, inveniet eam.
text_pt: Quem achar a sua vida perdê-la-á; e quem perder a sua vida, por amor de mim, achá-la-á.
text_el: ὁ εὑρὼν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἀπολέσει αὐτήν, καὶ ὁ ἀπολέσας τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ εὑρήσει αὐτήν.

text_en: He that receives you, receives me: and he that receives me, receives him that sent me.
text_la: Qui recipit vos, me recipit : et qui me recipit, recipit eum qui me misit.
text_pt: Quem vos recebe, a mim me recebe; e quem me recebe a mim, recebe aquele que me enviou.
text_el: Ὁ δεχόμενος ὑμᾶς ἐμὲ δέχεται, καὶ ὁ ἐμὲ δεχόμενος δέχεται τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με.

text_en: He that receives a prophet in the name of a prophet , shall receive the reward of a prophet : and he that receives a just man in the name of a just man , shall receive the reward of a just man .
text_la: Qui recipit prophetam in nomine prophetæ, mercedem prophetæ accipiet : et qui recipit justum in nomine justi, mercedem justi accipiet.
text_pt: Quem recebe um profeta em qualidade de profeta, receberá galardão de profeta; e quem recebe um justo na qualidade de justo, receberá galardão de justo.
text_el: ὁ δεχόμενος προφήτην εἰς ὄνομα προφήτου μισθὸν προφήτου λήμψεται, καὶ ὁ δεχόμενος δίκαιον εἰς ὄνομα δικαίου μισθὸν δικαίου λήμψεται.

text_en: And whosoever shall give to drink to one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple , amen I say to you he shall not lose his reward.
text_la: Et quicumque potum dederit uni ex minimis istis calicem aquæ frigidæ tantum in nomine discipuli : amen dico vobis, non perdet mercedem suam.
text_pt: E qualquer que tiver dado só que seja um copo de água fria a um destes pequenos, em nome de discípulo, em verdade vos digo que de modo algum perderá o seu galardão.
text_el: καὶ ὃς ἂν ποτίσῃ ἕνα τῶν μικρῶν τούτων ποτήριον ψυχροῦ μόνον εἰς ὄνομα μαθητοῦ, ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐ μὴ ἀπολέσῃ τὸν μισθὸν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples , he passed from thence, to teach and to preach in their cities.
text_la: Et factum est, cum consummasset Jesus, præcipiens duodecim discipulis suis, transiit inde ut doceret, et prædicaret in civitatibus eorum.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, acabando Jesus de dar instruções aos seus doze discípulos, partiu dali a ensinar e a pregar nas cidades deles.
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς διατάσσων τοῖς δώδεκα μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ, μετέβη ἐκεῖθεν τοῦ διδάσκειν καὶ κηρύσσειν ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν αὐτῶν.

text_en: Now when John had heard in prison the works of Christ : sending two of his disciples he said to him:
text_la: Joannes autem cum audisset in vinculis opera Christi, mittens duos de discipulis suis,
text_pt: E João, ouvindo no cárcere falar dos feitos de Cristo, enviou dois dos seus discípulos,
text_el: Ὁ δὲ Ἰωάννης ἀκούσας ἐν τῷ δεσμωτηρίῳ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Χριστοῦ πέμψας διὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Are you he that is to come , or look we for another?
text_la: ait illi : Tu es, qui venturus es, an alium exspectamus?
text_pt: A dizer-lhe: És tu aquele que havia de vir, ou esperamos outro?
text_el: εἶπεν αὐτῷ, σὺ εἶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἢ ἕτερον προσδοκῶμεν;

text_en: And Jesus making answer said to them: Go and relate to John what you have heard and seen.
text_la: Et respondens Jesus ait illis : Euntes renuntiate Joanni quæ audistis, et vidistis.
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Ide, e anunciai a João as coisas que ouvis e vedes:
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, πορευθέντες ἀπαγγείλατε Ἰωάννῃ ἃ ἀκούετε καὶ βλέπετε:

text_en: The blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead rise again, the poor have the gospel preached to them.
text_la: Cæci vident, claudi ambulant, leprosi mundantur, surdi audiunt, mortui resurgunt, pauperes evangelizantur:
text_pt: Os cegos vêem, e os coxos andam; os leprosos são limpos, e os surdos ouvem; os mortos são ressuscitados, e aos pobres é anunciado o evangelho.
text_el: τυφλοὶ ἀναβλέπουσιν καὶ χωλοὶ περιπατοῦσιν, λεπροὶ καθαρίζονται καὶ κωφοὶ ἀκούουσιν, καὶ νεκροὶ ἐγείρονται καὶ πτωχοὶ εὐαγγελίζονται:

text_en: And blessed is he that shall not be scandalized in me.
text_la: et beatus est, qui non fuerit scandalizatus in me.
text_pt: E bem-aventurado é aquele que não se escandalizar em mim.
text_el: καὶ μακάριός ἐστιν ὃς ἐὰν μὴ σκανδαλισθῇ ἐν ἐμοί.

text_en: And when they went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John : What went you out into the desert to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
text_la: Illis autem abeuntibus, cœpit Jesus dicere ad turbas de Joanne : Quid existis in desertum videre? arundinem vento agitatam?
text_pt: E, partindo eles, começou Jesus a dizer às turbas, a respeito de João: Que fostes ver no deserto? uma cana agitada pelo vento?
text_el: Τούτων δὲ πορευομένων ἤρξατο ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγειν τοῖς ὄχλοις περὶ Ἰωάννου: τί ἐξήλθατε εἰς τὴν ἔρημον θεάσασθαι; κάλαμον ὑπὸ ἀνέμου σαλευόμενον;

text_en: But what went you out to see? A man clothed in soft garments? Behold they that are clothed in soft garments, are in the houses of kings.
text_la: Sed quid existis videre? hominem mollibus vestitum? Ecce qui mollibus vestiuntur, in domibus regum sunt.
text_pt: Sim, que fostes ver? um homem ricamente vestido? Os que trajam ricamente estão nas casas dos reis.
text_el: ἀλλὰ τί ἐξήλθατε ἰδεῖν; ἄνθρωπον ἐν μαλακοῖς ἠμφιεσμένον; ἰδοὺ οἱ τὰ μαλακὰ φοροῦντες ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις τῶν βασιλέων.

text_en: But what went you out to see? A prophet ? Yea I tell you, and more than a prophet .
text_la: Sed quid existis videre? prophetam? Etiam dico vobis, et plus quam prophetam.
text_pt: Mas, então que fostes ver? um profeta? Sim, vos digo eu, e muito mais do que profeta;
text_el: ἀλλὰ τί ἐξήλθατε; προφήτην; ἰδεῖν ναί λέγω ὑμῖν, καὶ περισσότερον προφήτου.

text_en: For this is he of whom it is written: Behold I send my angel before your face, who shall prepare your way before you.
text_la: Hic est enim de quo scriptum est : Ecce ego mitto angelum meum ante faciem tuam, qui præparabit viam tuam ante te.
text_pt: Porque é este de quem está escrito:Eis que diante da tua face envio o meu anjo,que preparará diante de ti o teu caminho.
text_el: οὗτός ἐστιν περὶ οὗ γέγραπται: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω τὸν ἄγγελόν μου πρὸ προσώπου σου, ὃς κατασκευάσει τὴν ὁδόν σου ἔμπροσθέν σου.

text_en: Amen I say to you, there has not risen among them that are born of women a greater than John the Baptist : yet he that is the lesser in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
text_la: Amen dico vobis, non surrexit inter natos mulierum major Joanne Baptista : qui autem minor est in regno cælorum, major est illo.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que, entre os que de mulher têm nascido, não apareceu alguém maior do que João o Batista; mas aquele que é o menor no reino dos céus é maior do que ele.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐκ ἐγήγερται ἐν γεννητοῖς γυναικῶν μείζων Ἰωάννου τοῦ βαπτιστοῦ: ὁ δὲ μικρότερος ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν μείζων αὐτοῦ ἐστιν.

text_en: And from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffers violence , and the violent bear it away.
text_la: A diebus autem Joannis Baptistæ usque nunc, regnum cælorum vim patitur, et violenti rapiunt illud.
text_pt: E, desde os dias de João o Batista até agora, se faz violência ao reino dos céus, e pela força se apoderam dele.
text_el: ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν ἡμερῶν Ἰωάννου τοῦ βαπτιστοῦ ἕως ἄρτι ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν βιάζεται, καὶ βιασταὶ ἁρπάζουσιν αὐτήν.

text_en: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John :
text_la: Omnes enim prophetæ et lex usque ad Joannem prophetaverunt:
text_pt: Porque todos os profetas e a lei profetizaram até João.
text_el: πάντες γὰρ οἱ προφῆται καὶ ὁ νόμος ἕως Ἰωάννου ἐπροφήτευσαν,

text_en: And if you will receive it, he is Elias that is to come.
text_la: et si vultis recipere, ipse est Elias, qui venturus est.
text_pt: E, se quereis dar crédito, é este o Elias que havia de vir.
text_el: καὶ εἰ θέλετε δέξασθαι, αὐτός ἐστιν Ἠλίας ὁ μέλλων ἔρχεσθαι.

text_en: He that has ears to hear, let him hear.
text_la: Qui habet aures audiendi, audiat.
text_pt: Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
text_el: ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκουέτω.

text_en: But whereunto shall I esteem this generation to be like? It is like to children sitting in the market place.
text_la: Cui autem similem æstimabo generationem istam? Similis est pueris sedentibus in foro : qui clamantes coæqualibus
text_pt: Mas, a quem assemelharei esta geração? É semelhante aos meninos que se assentam nas praças, e clamam aos seus companheiros,
text_el: Τίνι δὲ ὁμοιώσω τὴν γενεὰν ταύτην; ὁμοία ἐστὶν παιδίοις καθημένοις ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς ἃ προσφωνοῦντα τοῖς ἑτέροις

text_en: Who crying to their companions say: We have piped to you, and you have not danced : we have lamented, and you have not mourned.
text_la: dicunt : Cecinimus vobis, et non saltastis : lamentavimus, et non planxistis.
text_pt: E dizem: Tocamo-vos flauta, e não dançastes; cantamo-vos lamentações, e não chorastes.
text_el: λέγουσιν: ηὐλήσαμεν ὑμῖν καὶ οὐκ ὠρχήσασθε: ἐθρηνήσαμεν καὶ οὐκ ἐκόψασθε.

text_en: For John came neither eating nor drinking; and they say: He has a devil .
text_la: Venit enim Joannes neque manducans, neque bibens, et dicunt : Dæmonium habet.
text_pt: Porquanto veio João, não comendo nem bebendo, e dizem: Tem demônio.
text_el: ἦλθεν γὰρ Ἰωάννης μήτε ἐσθίων μήτε πίνων, καὶ λέγουσιν, δαιμόνιον ἔχει:

text_en: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say: Behold a man that is a glutton and a wine drinker , a friend of publicans and sinners. And wisdom is justified by her children.
text_la: Venit Filius hominis manducans, et bibens, et dicunt : Ecce homo vorax, et potator vini, publicanorum et peccatorum amicus. Et justificata est sapientia a filiis suis.
text_pt: Veio o Filho do homem, comendo e bebendo, e dizem: Eis aí um homem comilão e beberrão, amigo dos publicanos e pecadores. Mas a sabedoria é justificada por seus filhos.
text_el: ἦλθεν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐσθίων καὶ πίνων, καὶ λέγουσιν: ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος φάγος καὶ οἰνοπότης, τελωνῶν φίλος καὶ ἁμαρτωλῶν. καὶ ἐδικαιώθη ἡ σοφία ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῆς.

text_en: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein were done the most of his miracles , for that they had not done penance .
text_la: Tunc cœpit exprobrare civitatibus, in quibus factæ sunt plurimæ virtutes ejus, quia non egissent pœnitentiam:
text_pt: Então começou ele a lançar em rosto às cidades onde se operou a maior parte dos seus prodígios o não se haverem arrependido, dizendo:
text_el: Τότε ἤρξατο ὀνειδίζειν τὰς πόλεις ἐν αἷς ἐγένοντο αἱ πλεῖσται δυνάμεις αὐτοῦ, ὅτι οὐ μετενόησαν:

text_en: Woe to you, Corozain, woe to you, Bethsaida : for if in Tyre and Sidon had been wrought the miracles that have been wrought in you, they had long ago done penance in sackcloth and ashes.
text_la: Væ tibi Corozain, væ tibi Bethsaida : quia, si in Tyro et Sidone factæ essent virtutes quæ factæ sunt in vobis, olim in cilicio et cinere pœnitentiam egissent.
text_pt: Ai de ti, Corazim! ai de ti, Betsaida! porque, se em Tiro e em Sidom fossem feitos os prodígios que em vós se fizeram, há muito que se teriam arrependido, com saco e com cinza.
text_el: οὐαί σοι, Χοραζίν, οὐαί σοι, Βηθσαϊδά, ὅτι εἰ ἐν Τύρῳ καὶ Σιδῶνι ἐγένοντο αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ γενόμεναι ἐν ὑμῖν, πάλαι ἂν ἐν σάκκῳ καὶ σποδῷ μετενόησαν.

text_en: But I say unto you, it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the day of judgment , than for you.
text_la: Verumtamen dico vobis : Tyro et Sidoni remissius erit in die judicii, quam vobis.
text_pt: Por isso eu vos digo que haverá menos rigor para Tiro e Sidom, no dia do juízo, do que para vós.
text_el: πλὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, Τύρῳ καὶ Σιδῶνι ἀνεκτότερον ἔσται ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως ἢ ὑμῖν.

text_en: And you Capharnaum , shall you be exalted up to heaven ? You shall go down even unto hell . For if in Sodom had been wrought the miracles that have been wrought in you, perhaps it had remained unto this day.
text_la: Et tu Capharnaum, numquid usque in cælum exaltaberis? usque in infernum descendes, quia si in Sodomis factæ fuissent virtutes quæ factæ sunt in te, forte mansissent usque in hanc diem.
text_pt: E tu, Cafarnaum, que te ergues até ao céu, serás abatida até ao inferno; porque, se em Sodoma tivessem sido feitos os prodígios que em ti se operaram, teria ela permanecido até hoje.
text_el: καὶ σύ, Καφαρναούμ, μὴ ἕως οὐρανοῦ ὑψωθήσῃ; ἕως ᾅδου καταβήσῃ, ὅτι εἰ ἐν Σοδόμοις ἐγενήθησαν αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ γενόμεναι ἐν σοί, ἔμεινεν ἂν μέχρι τῆς σήμερον.

text_en: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment than for you.
text_la: Verumtamen dico vobis, quia terræ Sodomorum remissius erit in die judicii, quam tibi.
text_pt: Eu vos digo, porém, que haverá menos rigor para os de Sodoma, no dia do juízo, do que para ti.
text_el: πλὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι γῇ Σοδόμων ἀνεκτότερον ἔσται ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως ἢ σοί.

text_en: At that time Jesus answered and said: I confess to you, O Father , Lord of Heaven and earth, because you have hid these things from the wise and prudent, and have revealed them to little ones.
text_la: In illo tempore respondens Jesus dixit : Confiteor tibi, Pater, Domine cæli et terræ, quia abscondisti hæc a sapientibus, et prudentibus, et revelasti ea parvulis.
