text_pt: Naquele tempo, respondendo Jesus, disse: Graças te dou, ó Pai, Senhor do céu e da terra, que ocultaste estas coisas aos sábios e entendidos, e as revelaste aos pequeninos.
text_el: Ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: ἐξομολογοῦμαί σοι, πάτερ, κύριε τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τῆς γῆς, ὅτι ἔκρυψας ταῦτα ἀπὸ σοφῶν καὶ συνετῶν, καὶ ἀπεκάλυψας αὐτὰ νηπίοις:

text_en: Yea, Father : for so has it seemed good in your sight.
text_la: Ita Pater: quoniam sic fuit placitum ante te.
text_pt: Sim, ó Pai, porque assim te aprouve.
text_el: ναί ὁ πατήρ, ὅτι οὕτως εὐδοκία ἐγένετο ἔμπροσθέν σου.

text_en: All things are delivered to me by my Father . And no one knows the Son but the Father : neither does any one know the Father , but the Son , and he to whom it shall please the Son to reveal him.
text_la: Omnia mihi tradita sunt a Patre meo. Et nemo novit Filium, nisi Pater : neque Patrem quis novit, nisi Filius, et cui voluerit Filius revelare.
text_pt: Todas as coisas me foram entregues por meu Pai, e ninguém conhece o Filho, senão o Pai; e ninguém conhece o Pai, senão o Filho, e aquele a quem o Filho o quiser revelar.
text_el: Πάντα μοι παρεδόθη ὑπὸ τοῦ πατρός μου, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπιγινώσκει τὸν υἱὸν εἰ μὴ ὁ πατήρ, οὐδὲ τὸν πατέρα τις ἐπιγινώσκει εἰ μὴ ὁ υἱὸς καὶ ᾧ ἐὰν βούληται ὁ υἱὸς ἀποκαλύψαι.

text_en: Come to me all you that labor and are burdened, and I will refresh you.
text_la: Venite ad me omnes qui laboratis, et onerati estis, et ego reficiam vos.
text_pt: Vinde a mim, todos os que estais cansados e oprimidos, e eu vos aliviarei.
text_el: Δεῦτε πρός με πάντες οἱ κοπιῶντες καὶ πεφορτισμένοι, κἀγὼ ἀναπαύσω ὑμᾶς.

text_en: Take up my yoke upon you, and learn of me, because I am meek , and humble of heart: And you shall find rest to your souls .
text_la: Tollite jugum meum super vos, et discite a me, quia mitis sum, et humilis corde : et invenietis requiem animabus vestris.
text_pt: Tomai sobre vós o meu jugo, e aprendei de mim, que sou manso e humilde de coração; e encontrareis descanso para as vossas almas.
text_el: ἄρατε τὸν ζυγόν μου ἐφ' ὑμᾶς καὶ μάθετε ἀπ' ἐμοῦ, ὅτι πραΰς εἰμι καὶ ταπεινὸς τῇ καρδίᾳ, καὶ εὑρήσετε ἀνάπαυσιν ταῖς ψυχαῖς ὑμῶν:

text_en: For my yoke is sweet and my burden light.
text_la: Jugum enim meum suave est, et onus meum leve.
text_pt: Porque o meu jugo é suave e o meu fardo é leve.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ ζυγός μου χρηστὸς καὶ τὸ φορτίον μου ἐλαφρόν ἐστιν.

text_en: At that time Jesus went through the corn on the sabbath : and his disciples being hungry, began to pluck the ears, and to eat.
text_la: In illo tempore abiit Jesus per sata sabbato : discipuli autem ejus esurientes cœperunt vellere spicas, et manducare.
text_pt: Naquele tempo passou Jesus pelas searas, em um sábado; e os seus discípulos, tendo fome, começaram a colher espigas, e a comer.
text_el: Ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ ἐπορεύθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς σάββασιν διὰ τῶν σπορίμων: οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπείνασαν, καὶ ἤρξαντο τίλλειν στάχυας καὶ ἐσθίειν.

text_en: And the Pharisees seeing them, said to him: Behold your disciples do that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days .
text_la: Pharisæi autem videntes, dixerunt ei : Ecce discipuli tui faciunt quod non licet facere sabbatis.
text_pt: E os fariseus, vendo isto, disseram-lhe: Eis que os teus discípulos fazem o que não é lícito fazer num sábado.
text_el: οἱ δὲ Φαρισαῖοι ἰδόντες εἶπαν αὐτῷ: ἰδοὺ οἱ μαθηταί σου ποιοῦσιν ὃ οὐκ ἔξεστιν ποιεῖν ἐν σαββάτῳ.

text_en: But he said to them: Have you not read what David did when he was hungry, and they that were with him:
text_la: At ille dixit eis : Non legistis quid fecerit David, quando esuriit, et qui cum eo erant:
text_pt: Ele, porém, lhes disse: Não tendes lido o que fez Davi, quando teve fome, ele e os que com ele estavam?
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε τί ἐποίησεν Δαυὶδ, ὅτε ἐπείνασεν καὶ οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ;

text_en: How he entered into the house of God , and ate the loaves of proposition , which it was not lawful for him to eat, nor for them that were with him, but for the priests only?
text_la: quomodo intravit in domum Dei, et panes propositionis comedit, quos non licebat ei edere, neque his qui cum eo erant, nisi solis sacerdotibus?
text_pt: Como entrou na casa de Deus, e comeu os pães da proposição, que não lhe era lícito comer, nem aos que com ele estavam, mas só aos sacerdotes?
text_el: πῶς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους τῆς προθέσεως ἔφαγον, ὃ οὐκ ἐξὸν ἦν αὐτῷ φαγεῖν οὐδὲ τοῖς μετ' αὐτοῦ, εἰ μὴ τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν μόνοις;

text_en: Or have you not read in the law , that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple break the sabbath , and are without blame?
text_la: aut non legistis in lege quia sabbatis sacerdotes in templo sabbatum violant, et sine crimine sunt?
text_pt: Ou não tendes lido na lei que, aos sábados, os sacerdotes no templo violam o sábado, e ficam sem culpa?
text_el: ἢ οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ὅτι τοῖς σάββασιν οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ τὸ σάββατον βεβηλοῦσιν καὶ ἀναίτιοί εἰσιν;

text_en: But I tell you that there is here a greater than the temple .
text_la: Dico autem vobis, quia templo major est hic.
text_pt: Pois eu vos digo que está aqui quem é maior do que o templo.
text_el: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι τοῦ ἱεροῦ μεῖζόν ἐστιν ὧδε.

text_en: And if you knew what this means: I will have mercy , and not sacrifice : you would never have condemned the innocent.
text_la: Si autem sciretis, quid est : Misericordiam volo, et non sacrificium : numquam condemnassetis innocentes:
text_pt: Mas, se vós soubésseis o que significa: Misericórdia quero, e não sacrifício, não condenaríeis os inocentes.
text_el: εἰ δὲ ἐγνώκειτε τί ἐστιν: ἔλεος θέλω καὶ οὐ θυσίαν, οὐκ ἂν κατεδικάσατε τοὺς ἀναιτίους.

text_en: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath .
text_la: dominus enim est Filius hominis etiam sabbati.
text_pt: Porque o Filho do homem até do sábado é Senhor.
text_el: κύριος γάρ ἐστιν τοῦ σαββάτου ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

text_en: And when he had passed from thence, he came into their synagogues .
text_la: Et cum inde transisset, venit in synagogam eorum.
text_pt: E, partindo dali, chegou à sinagoga deles.
text_el: Καὶ μεταβὰς ἐκεῖθεν ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν αὐτῶν:

text_en: And behold there was a man who had a withered hand, and they asked him, saying: Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days ? That they might accuse him.
text_la: Et ecce homo manum habens aridam, et interrogabant eum, dicentes : Si licet sabbatis curare? ut accusarent eum.
text_pt: E, estava ali um homem que tinha uma das mãos mirrada; e eles, para o acusarem, o interrogaram, dizendo: É lícito curar nos sábados?
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος χεῖρα ἔχων ξηράν: καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν λέγοντες: εἰ ἔξεστιν τοῖς σάββασιν θεραπεύειν; ἵνα κατηγορήσωσιν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: But he said to them: What man shall there be among you, that has one sheep: and if the same fall into a pit on the sabbath day , will he not take hold on it and lift it up?
text_la: Ipse autem dixit illis : Quis erit ex vobis homo, qui habeat ovem unam, et si ceciderit hæc sabbatis in foveam, nonne tenebit et levabit eam?
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Qual dentre vós será o homem que tendo uma ovelha, se num sábado ela cair numa cova, não lançará mão dela, e a levantará?
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τίς [ἔσται] ἐξ ὑμῶν ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἕξει πρόβατον ἕν, καὶ ἐὰν ἐμπέσῃ τοῦτο τοῖς σάββασιν εἰς βόθυνον, οὐχὶ κρατήσει αὐτὸ καὶ ἐγερεῖ;

text_en: How much better is a man than a sheep? Therefore it is lawful to do a good deed on the sabbath days .
text_la: Quanto magis melior est homo ove? itaque licet sabbatis benefacere.
text_pt: Pois, quanto mais vale um homem do que uma ovelha? É, por conseqüência, lícito fazer bem nos sábados.
text_el: πόσῳ οὖν διαφέρει ἄνθρωπος προβάτου: ὥστε ἔξεστιν τοῖς σάββασιν καλῶς ποιεῖν.

text_en: Then he says to the man : Stretch forth your hand; and he stretched it forth, and it was restored to health even as the other.
text_la: Tunc ait homini : Extende manum tuam. Et extendit, et restituta est sanitati sicut altera.
text_pt: Então disse àquele homem: Estende a tua mão. E ele a estendeu, e ficou sã como a outra.
text_el: τότε λέγει τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ: ἔκτεινόν σου τὴν χεῖρα. καὶ ἐξέτεινεν, καὶ ἀπεκατεστάθη ὑγιὴς ὡς ἡ ἄλλη.

text_en: And the Pharisees going out made a consultation against him, how they might destroy him.
text_la: Exeuntes autem pharisæi, consilium faciebant adversus eum, quomodo perderent eum.
text_pt: E os fariseus, tendo saído, formaram conselho contra ele, para o matarem.
text_el: ἐξελθόντες δὲ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι συμβούλιον ἔλαβον κατ' αὐτοῦ, ὅπως αὐτὸν ἀπολέσωσιν.

text_en: But Jesus knowing it, retired from thence: and many followed him, and he healed them all.
text_la: Jesus autem sciens recessit inde : et secuti sunt eum multi, et curavit eos omnes:
text_pt: Jesus, sabendo isso, retirou-se dali, e acompanharam-no grandes multidões, e ele curou a todas.
text_el: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς γνοὺς ἀνεχώρησεν ἐκεῖθεν. καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ πολλοί, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτοὺς πάντας,

text_en: And he charged them that they should not make him known .
text_la: et præcepit eis ne manifestum eum facerent.
text_pt: E recomendava-lhes rigorosamente que o não descobrissem,
text_el: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα μὴ φανερὸν αὐτὸν ποιήσωσιν:

text_en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet , saying:
text_la: Ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Isaiam prophetam, dicentem:
text_pt: Para que se cumprisse o que fora dito pelo profeta Isaías, que diz:
text_el: ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος:

text_en: Behold my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul has been well pleased. I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall show judgment to the Gentiles .
text_la: Ecce puer meus, quem elegi, dilectus meus, in quo bene complacuit animæ meæ. Ponam spiritum meum super eum, et judicium gentibus nuntiabit.
text_pt: Eis aqui o meu servo, que escolhi,o meu amado, em quem a minha alma se compraz;porei sobre ele o meu espírito,e anunciará aos gentios o juízo.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ὁ παῖς μου ὃν ᾑρέτισα, ὁ ἀγαπητός μου ὃν εὐδόκησεν ἡ ψυχή μου: θήσω τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐπ' αὐτόν, καὶ κρίσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἀπαγγελεῖ.

text_en: He shall not contend, nor cry out, neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
text_la: Non contendet, neque clamabit, neque audiet aliquis in plateis vocem ejus :
text_pt: Não contenderá, nem clamará,Nem alguém ouvirá pelas ruas a sua voz;
text_el: οὐκ ἐρίσει οὐδὲ κραυγάσει, οὐδὲ ἀκούσει τις ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: The bruised reed he shall not break: and smoking flax he shall not extinguish: till he send forth judgment unto victory.
text_la: arundinem quassatam non confringet, et linum fumigans non extinguet, donec ejiciat ad victoriam judicium :
text_pt: Não esmagará a cana quebrada,enão apagará o morrão que fumega,até que faça triunfar o juízo;
text_el: κάλαμον συντετριμμένον οὐ κατεάξει καὶ λίνον τυφόμενον οὐ σβέσει, ἕως ἂν ἐκβάλῃ εἰς νῖκος τὴν κρίσιν.

text_en: And in his name the Gentiles shall hope.
text_la: et in nomine ejus gentes sperabunt.
text_pt: E no seu nome os gentios esperarão.
text_el: καὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν.

text_en: Then was offered to him one possessed with a devil , blind and dumb: and he healed him, so that he spoke and saw.
text_la: Tunc oblatus est ei dæmonium habens, cæcus, et mutus, et curavit eum ita ut loqueretur, et videret.
text_pt: Trouxeram-lhe, então, um endemoninhado cego e mudo; e, de tal modo o curou, que o cego e mudo falava e via.
text_el: Τότε προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δαιμονιζόμενον τυφλὸν καὶ κωφόν: καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτόν, ὥστε τὸν κωφὸν λαλεῖν καὶ βλέπειν.

text_en: And all the multitudes were amazed, and said: Is not this the son of David ?
text_la: Et stupebant omnes turbæ, et dicebant : Numquid hic est filius David?
text_pt: E toda a multidão se admirava e dizia: Não é este o Filho de Davi?
text_el: καὶ ἐξίσταντο πάντες οἱ ὄχλοι καὶ ἔλεγον: μήτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς Δαυίδ;

text_en: But the Pharisees hearing it, said: This man casts not out devils but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils .
text_la: Pharisæi autem audientes, dixerunt : Hic non ejicit dæmones nisi in Beelzebub principe dæmoniorum.
text_pt: Mas os fariseus, ouvindo isto, diziam: Este não expulsa os demônios senão por Belzebu, príncipe dos demônios.
text_el: οἱ δὲ Φαρισαῖοι ἀκούσαντες εἶπον: οὗτος οὐκ ἐκβάλλει τὰ δαιμόνια εἰ μὴ ἐν τῷ Βεελζεβοὺλ ἄρχοντι τῶν δαιμονίων.

text_en: And Jesus knowing their thoughts, said to them: Every kingdom divided against itself shall be made desolate: and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand.
text_la: Jesus autem sciens cogitationes eorum, dixit eis : Omne regnum divisum contra se desolabitur : et omnis civitas vel domus divisa contra se, non stabit.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, conhecendo os seus pensamentos, disse-lhes: Todo o reino dividido contra si mesmo é devastado; e toda a cidade, ou casa, dividida contra si mesma não subsistirá.
text_el: εἰδὼς δὲ τὰς ἐνθυμήσεις αὐτῶν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: πᾶσα βασιλεία μερισθεῖσα καθ' ἑαυτῆς ἐρημοῦται, καὶ πᾶσα πόλις ἢ οἰκία μερισθεῖσα καθ' ἑαυτῆς οὐ σταθήσεται.

text_en: And if Satan cast out Satan , he is divided against himself: how then shall his kingdom stand?
text_la: Et si Satanas Satanam ejicit, adversus se divisus est : quomodo ergo stabit regnum ejus?
text_pt: E, se Satanás expulsa a Satanás, está dividido contra si mesmo; como subsistirá, pois, o seu reino?
text_el: καὶ εἰ ὁ Σατανᾶς τὸν Σατανᾶν ἐκβάλλει, ἐφ' ἑαυτὸν ἐμερίσθη: πῶς οὖν σταθήσεται ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ;

text_en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils , by whom do your children cast them out ? Therefore they shall be your judges.
text_la: Et si ego in Beelzebub ejicio dæmones, filii vestri in quo ejiciunt? ideo ipsi judices vestri erunt.
text_pt: E, se eu expulso os demônios por Belzebu, por quem os expulsam então vossos filhos? Portanto, eles mesmos serão os vossos juízes.
text_el: καὶ εἰ ἐγὼ ἐν Βεελζεβοὺλ ἐκβάλλω τὰ δαιμόνια, οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν ἐν τίνι ἐκβάλλουσιν; διὰ τοῦτο αὐτοὶ κριταὶ ἔσονται ὑμῶν.

text_en: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out devils , then is the kingdom of God come upon you.
text_la: Si autem ego in Spiritu Dei ejicio dæmones, igitur pervenit in vos regnum Dei.
text_pt: Mas, se eu expulso os demônios pelo Espírito de Deus, logo é chegado a vós o reino de Deus.
text_el: εἰ δὲ ἐν πνεύματι θεοῦ ἐγὼ ἐκβάλλω τὰ δαιμόνια, ἄρα ἔφθασεν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: Or how can any one enter into the house of the strong, and rifle his goods , unless he first bind the strong? And then he will rifle his house.
text_la: Aut quomodo potest quisquam intrare in domum fortis, et vasa ejus diripere, nisi prius alligaverit fortem? et tunc domum illius diripiet.
text_pt: Ou, como pode alguém entrar na casa do homem valente, e furtar os seus bens, se primeiro não maniatar o valente, saqueando então a sua casa?
text_el: ἢ πῶς δύναταί τις εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἰσχυροῦ καὶ τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ ἁρπάσαι, ἐὰν μὴ πρῶτον δήσῃ τὸν ἰσχυρόν, καὶ τότε τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ διαρπάσει;

text_en: He that is not with me, is against me: and he that gathers not with me, scatters.
text_la: Qui non est mecum, contra me est; et qui non congregat mihi, spargit.
text_pt: Quem não é comigo é contra mim; e quem comigo não ajunta, espalha.
text_el: ὁ μὴ ὢν μετ' ἐμοῦ κατ' ἐμοῦ ἐστιν, καὶ ὁ μὴ συνάγων μετ' ἐμοῦ σκορπίζει.

text_en: Therefore I say to you: Every sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven men , but the blasphemy of the Spirit shall not be forgiven.
text_la: Ideo dico vobis : Omne peccatum et blasphemia remittetur hominibus, Spiritus autem blasphemia non remittetur.
text_pt: Portanto, eu vos digo: Todo o pecado e blasfêmia se perdoará aos homens; mas a blasfêmia contra o Espírito não será perdoada aos homens.
text_el: Διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν, πᾶσα ἁμαρτία καὶ βλασφημία ἀφεθήσεται τοῖς ἀνθρώποις, ἡ δὲ τοῦ πνεύματος βλασφημία οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται.

text_en: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him: but he that shall speak against the Holy Ghost , it shall not be forgiven him neither in this world, nor in the world to come.
text_la: Et quicumque dixerit verbum contra Filium hominis, remittetur ei : qui autem dixerit contra Spiritum Sanctum, non remittetur ei, neque in hoc sæculo, neque in futuro.
text_pt: E, se qualquer disser alguma palavra contra o Filho do homem, ser-lhe-á perdoado; mas, se alguém falar contra o Espírito Santo, não lhe será perdoado, nem neste século nem no futuro.
text_el: καὶ ὃς ἐὰν εἴπῃ λόγον κατὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, ἀφεθήσεται αὐτῷ: ὃς δ' ἂν εἴπῃ κατὰ τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ ἁγίου, οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται αὐτῷ οὔτε ἐν τούτῳ τῷ αἰῶνι οὔτε ἐν τῷ μέλλοντι.

text_en: Either make the tree good and its fruit good : or make the tree evil , and its fruit evil . For by the fruit the tree is known .
text_la: Aut facite arborem bonam, et fructum ejus bonum : aut facite arborem malam, et fructum ejus malum : siquidem ex fructu arbor agnoscitur.
text_pt: Ou fazei a árvore boa, e o seu fruto bom, ou fazei a árvore má, e o seu fruto mau; porque pelo fruto se conhece a árvore.
text_el: Ἢ ποιήσατε τὸ δένδρον καλὸν καὶ τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ καλόν, ἢ ποιήσατε τὸ δένδρον σαπρὸν καὶ τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ σαπρόν: ἐκ γὰρ τοῦ καρποῦ τὸ δένδρον γινώσκεται.

text_en: O generation of vipers, how can you speak good things, whereas you are evil ? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
text_la: Progenies viperarum, quomodo potestis bona loqui, cum sitis mali? ex abundantia enim cordis os loquitur.
text_pt: Raça de víboras, como podeis vós dizer boas coisas, sendo maus? Pois do que há em abundância no coração, disso fala a boca.
text_el: γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, πῶς δύνασθε ἀγαθὰ λαλεῖν πονηροὶ ὄντες; ἐκ γὰρ τοῦ περισσεύματος τῆς καρδίας τὸ στόμα λαλεῖ.

text_en: A good man out of a good treasure brings forth good things: and an evil man out of an evil treasure brings forth evil things.
text_la: Bonus homo de bono thesauro profert bona : et malus homo de malo thesauro profert mala.
text_pt: O homem bom tira boas coisas do bom tesouro do seu coração, e o homem mau do mau tesouro tira coisas más.
text_el: ὁ ἀγαθὸς ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ θησαυροῦ ἐκβάλλει ἀγαθά, καὶ ὁ πονηρὸς ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ θησαυροῦ ἐκβάλλει πονηρά.

text_en: But I say unto you, that every idle word that men shall speak, they shall render an account for it in the day of judgment .
text_la: Dico autem vobis quoniam omne verbum otiosum, quod locuti fuerint homines, reddent rationem de eo in die judicii.
text_pt: Mas eu vos digo que de toda a palavra ociosa que os homens disserem hão de dar conta no dia do juízo.
text_el: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶν ῥῆμα ἀργὸν ὃ λαλήσουσιν οἱ ἄνθρωποι ἀποδώσουσιν περὶ αὐτοῦ λόγον ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως.

text_en: For by your words you shall be justified, and by your words you shall be condemned.
text_la: Ex verbis enim tuis justificaberis et ex verbis tuis condemnaberis.
text_pt: Porque por tuas palavras serás justificado, e por tuas palavras serás condenado.
text_el: ἐκ γὰρ τῶν λόγων σου δικαιωθήσῃ, καὶ ἐκ τῶν λόγων σου καταδικασθήσῃ.

text_en: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees answered him, saying: Master, we would see a sign from you.
text_la: Tunc responderunt ei quidam de scribis et pharisæis, dicentes : Magister, volumus a te signum videre.
text_pt: Então alguns dos escribas e dos fariseus tomaram a palavra, dizendo: Mestre, quiséramos ver da tua parte algum sinal.
text_el: Τότε ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ τινες τῶν γραμματέων καὶ Φαρισαίων λέγοντες: διδάσκαλε, θέλομεν ἀπὸ σοῦ σημεῖον ἰδεῖν.

text_en: Who answering said to them: An evil and adulterous generation seeks a sign: and a sign shall not be given it, but the sign of Jonah the prophet .
text_la: Qui respondens ait illis : Generatio mala et adultera signum quærit : et signum non dabitur ei, nisi signum Jonæ prophetæ.
text_pt: Mas ele lhes respondeu, e disse: Uma geração má e adúltera pede um sinal, porém, não se lhe dará outro sinal senão o sinal do profeta Jonas;
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: γενεὰ πονηρὰ καὶ μοιχαλὶς σημεῖον ἐπιζητεῖ, καὶ σημεῖον οὐ δοθήσεται αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ τὸ σημεῖον Ἰωνᾶ τοῦ προφήτου.

text_en: For as Jonah was in the whale's belly three days and three nights: so shall the Son of man be in the heart of the earth three days and three nights.
text_la: Sicut enim fuit Jonas in ventre ceti tribus diebus, et tribus noctibus, sic erit Filius hominis in corde terræ tribus diebus et tribus noctibus.
text_pt: Pois, como Jonas esteve três dias e três noites no ventre da baleia, assim estará o Filho do homem três dias e três noites no seio da terra.
text_el: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἦν Ἰωνᾶς ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ τοῦ κήτους τρεῖς ἡμέρας καὶ τρεῖς νύκτας, οὕτως ἔσται ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ τῆς γῆς τρεῖς ἡμέρας καὶ τρεῖς νύκτας.

text_en: The men of Ninive shall rise in judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it: because they did penance at the preaching of Jonah . And behold a greater than Jonah here.
text_la: Viri Ninivitæ surgent in judicio cum generatione ista, et condemnabunt eam : quia pœnitentiam egerunt in prædicatione Jonæ, et ecce plus quam Jonas hic.
text_pt: Os ninivitas ressurgirão no juízo com esta geração, e a condenarão, porque se arrependeram com a pregação de Jonas. E eis que está aqui quem é maior do que Jonas.
text_el: ἄνδρες Νινευῖται ἀναστήσονται ἐν τῇ κρίσει μετὰ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτήν, ὅτι μετενόησαν εἰς τὸ κήρυγμα Ἰωνᾶ, καὶ ἰδοὺ πλεῖον Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε.

text_en: The queen of the south shall rise in judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it: because she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon , and behold a greater than Solomon here.
text_la: Regina austri surget in judicio cum generatione ista, et condemnabit eam : quia venit a finibus terræ audire sapientiam Salomonis, et ecce plus quam Salomon hic.
text_pt: A rainha do sul se levantará no dia do juízo com esta geração, e a condenará; porque veio dos confins da terra para ouvir a sabedoria de Salomão. E eis que está aqui quem é maior do que Salomão.
text_el: βασίλισσα νότου ἐγερθήσεται ἐν τῇ κρίσει μετὰ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ κατακρινεῖ αὐτήν, ὅτι ἦλθεν ἐκ τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς ἀκοῦσαι τὴν σοφίαν Σολομῶνος, καὶ ἰδοὺ πλεῖον Σολομῶνος ὧδε.

text_en: And when an unclean spirit has gone out of a man he walks through dry places seeking rest, and finds none.
text_la: Cum autem immundus spiritus exierit ab homine, ambulat per loca arida, quærens requiem, et non invenit.
text_pt: E, quando o espírito imundo tem saído do homem, anda por lugares áridos, buscando repouso, e não o encontra.
text_el: Ὅταν δὲ τὸ ἀκάθαρτον πνεῦμα ἐξέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, διέρχεται δι' ἀνύδρων τόπων ζητοῦν ἀνάπαυσιν, καὶ οὐχ εὑρίσκει.

text_en: Then he says: I will return into my house from whence I came out. And coming he finds it empty, swept, and garnished.
text_la: Tunc dicit : Revertar in domum meam, unde exivi. Et veniens invenit eam vacantem, scopis mundatam, et ornatam.
text_pt: Então diz: Voltarei para a minha casa, de onde saí. E, voltando, acha-a desocupada, varrida e adornada.
text_el: τότε λέγει: εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου ἐπιστρέψω ὅθεν ἐξῆλθον. καὶ ἐλθὸν εὑρίσκει σχολάζοντα [καὶ] σεσαρωμένον καὶ κεκοσμημένον.

text_en: Then he goes, and takes with him seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is made worse than the first. So shall it be also to this wicked generation .
text_la: Tunc vadit, et assumit septem alios spiritus secum nequiores se, et intrantes habitant ibi : et fiunt novissima hominis illius pejora prioribus. Sic erit et generationi huic pessimæ.
text_pt: Então vai, e leva consigo outros sete espíritos piores do que ele e, entrando, habitam ali; e são os últimos atos desse homem piores do que os primeiros. Assim acontecerá também a esta geração má.
text_el: τότε πορεύεται καὶ παραλαμβάνει μεθ' ἑαυτοῦ ἑπτὰ ἕτερα πνεύματα πονηρότερα ἑαυτοῦ, καὶ εἰσελθόντα κατοικεῖ ἐκεῖ, καὶ γίνεται τὰ ἔσχατα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκείνου χείρονα τῶν πρώτων. οὕτως ἔσται καὶ τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ τῇ πονηρᾷ.

text_en: As he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold his mother and his brethren stood without, seeking to speak to him.
text_la: Adhuc eo loquente ad turbas, ecce mater ejus et fratres stabant foris, quærentes loqui ei.
text_pt: E, falando ele ainda à multidão, eis que estavam fora sua mãe e seus irmãos, pretendendo falar-lhe.
text_el: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος τοῖς ὄχλοις ἰδοὺ ἡ μήτηρ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ εἱστήκεισαν ἔξω ζητοῦντες αὐτῷ λαλῆσαι.

text_en: And one said unto him: Behold your mother and your brethren stand without, seeking you.
text_la: Dixit autem ei quidam : Ecce mater tua, et fratres tui foris stant quærentes te.
text_pt: E disse-lhe alguém: Eis que estão ali fora tua mãe e teus irmãos, que querem falar-te.

text_en: But he answering him that told him, said: Who is my mother, and who are my brethren?
text_la: At ipse respondens dicenti sibi, ait : Quæ est mater mea, et qui sunt fratres mei?
text_pt: Ele, porém, respondendo, disse ao que lhe falara: Quem é minha mãe? E quem são meus irmãos?
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν τῷ λέγοντι αὐτῷ: τίς ἐστιν ἡ μήτηρ μου, καὶ τίνες εἰσὶν οἱ ἀδελφοί μου;

text_en: And stretching forth his hand towards his disciples , he said: Behold my mother and my brethren.
text_la: Et extendens manum in discipulos suos, dixit : Ecce mater mea, et fratres mei.
text_pt: E, estendendo a sua mão para os seus discípulos, disse: Eis aqui minha mãe e meus irmãos;
text_el: καὶ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα [αὐτοῦ] ἐπὶ τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ εἶπεν: ἰδοὺ ἡ μήτηρ μου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου:

text_en: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father , that is in heaven , he is my brother, and sister, and mother.
text_la: Quicumque enim fecerit voluntatem Patris mei, qui in cælis est, ipse meus frater, et soror, et mater est.
text_pt: Porque, qualquer que fizer a vontade de meu Pai que está nos céus, este é meu irmão, e irmã e mãe.
text_el: ὅστις γὰρ ἂν ποιήσῃ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς, αὐτός μου ἀδελφὸς καὶ ἀδελφὴ καὶ μήτηρ ἐστίν.

text_en: The same day Jesus going out of the house, sat by the sea side.
text_la: In illo die exiens Jesus de domo, sedebat secus mare.
text_pt: Tendo Jesus saído de casa, naquele dia, estava assentado junto ao mar;
text_el: Ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐξελθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῆς οἰκίας ἐκάθητο παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν:

text_en: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went up into a boat and sat: and all the multitude stood on the shore.
text_la: Et congregatæ sunt ad eum turbæ multæ, ita ut naviculam ascendens sederet : et omnis turba stabat in littore,
text_pt: E ajuntou-se muita gente ao pé dele, de sorte que, entrando num barco, se assentou; e toda a multidão estava em pé na praia.
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν πρὸς αὐτὸν ὄχλοι πολλοί, ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς πλοῖον ἐμβάντα καθῆσθαι, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἐπὶ τὸν αἰγιαλὸν εἱστήκει.

text_en: And he spoke to them many things in parables , saying: Behold the sower went forth to sow.
text_la: et locutus est eis multa in parabolis, dicens : Ecce exiit qui seminat, seminare.
text_pt: E falou-lhe de muitas coisas por parábolas, dizendo: Eis que o semeador saiu a semear.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς πολλὰ ἐν παραβολαῖς λέγων: ἰδοὺ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ σπείρων τοῦ σπείρειν.

text_en: And whilst he sows some fell by the way side, and the birds of the air came and ate them up.
text_la: Et dum seminat, quædam ceciderunt secus viam, et venerunt volucres cæli, et comederunt ea.
text_pt: E, quando semeava, uma parte da semente caiu ao pé do caminho, e vieram as aves, e comeram-na;
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ σπείρειν αὐτὸν ἃ μὲν ἔπεσεν παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν, καὶ ἐλθόντα τὰ πετεινὰ κατέφαγεν αὐτά.

text_en: And other some fell upon stony ground, where they had not much earth: and they sprung up immediately, because they had no deepness of earth.
text_la: Alia autem ceciderunt in petrosa, ubi non habebant terram multam : et continuo exorta sunt, quia non habebant altitudinem terræ:
text_pt: E outra parte caiu em pedregais, onde não havia terra bastante, e logo nasceu, porque não tinha terra funda;
text_el: ἄλλα δὲ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὰ πετρώδη ὅπου οὐκ εἶχεν γῆν πολλήν, καὶ εὐθέως ἐξανέτειλεν διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν βάθος γῆς:

text_en: And when the sun was up they were scorched: and because they had not root, they withered away.
text_la: sole autem orto æstuaverunt; et quia non habebant radicem, aruerunt.
text_pt: Mas, vindo o sol, queimou-se, e secou-se, porque não tinha raiz.
text_el: ἡλίου δὲ ἀνατείλαντος ἐκαυματίσθη καὶ διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν ῥίζαν ἐξηράνθη.

text_en: And others fell among thorns: and the thorns grew up and choked them.
text_la: Alia autem ceciderunt in spinas : et creverunt spinæ, et suffocaverunt ea.
text_pt: E outra caiu entre espinhos, e os espinhos cresceram e sufocaram-na.
text_el: ἄλλα δὲ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὰς ἀκάνθας, καὶ ἀνέβησαν αἱ ἄκανθαι καὶ ἀπέπνιξαν αὐτά.

text_en: And others fell upon good ground: and they brought forth fruit, some an hundred fold, some sixty fold, and some thirty fold.
text_la: Alia autem ceciderunt in terram bonam : et dabant fructum, aliud centesimum, aliud sexagesimum, aliud trigesimum.
text_pt: E outra caiu em boa terra, e deu fruto: um a cem, outro a sessenta e outro a trinta.
text_el: ἄλλα δὲ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τὴν καλὴν καὶ ἐδίδου καρπόν, ὃ μὲν ἑκατόν, ὃ δὲ ἑξήκοντα, ὃ δὲ τριάκοντα.

text_en: He that has ears to hear, let him hear.
text_la: Qui habet aures audiendi, audiat.
text_pt: Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
text_el: ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκουέτω.

text_en: And his disciples came and said to him: Why do you speak to them in parables ?
text_la: Et accedentes discipuli dixerunt ei : Quare in parabolis loqueris eis?
text_pt: E, acercando-se dele os discípulos, disseram-lhe: Por que lhes falas por parábolas?
text_el: Καὶ προσελθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: διὰ τί ἐν παραβολαῖς λαλεῖς αὐτοῖς;

text_en: Who answered and said to them: Because to you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven : but to them it is not given.
text_la: Qui respondens, ait illis : Quia vobis datum est nosse mysteria regni cælorum : illis autem non est datum.
text_pt: Ele, respondendo, disse-lhes: Porque a vós é dado conhecer os mistérios do reino dos céus, mas a eles não lhes é dado;
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: ὅτι ὑμῖν δέδοται γνῶναι τὰ μυστήρια τῆς βασιλείας τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἐκείνοις δὲ οὐ δέδοται.

text_en: For he that has, to him shall be given, and he shall abound: but he that has not, from him shall be taken away that also which he has.
text_la: Qui enim habet, dabitur ei, et abundabit : qui autem non habet, et quod habet auferetur ab eo.
text_pt: Porque àquele que tem, se dará, e terá em abundância; mas àquele que não tem, até aquilo que tem lhe será tirado.
text_el: ὅστις γὰρ ἔχει, δοθήσεται αὐτῷ καὶ περισσευθήσεται: ὅστις δὲ οὐκ ἔχει, καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Therefore do I speak to them in parables : because seeing they see not, and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
text_la: Ideo in parabolis loquor eis : quia videntes non vident, et audientes non audiunt, neque intelligunt.
text_pt: Por isso lhes falo por parábolas; porque eles, vendo, não vêem; e, ouvindo, não ouvem nem compreendem.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐν παραβολαῖς αὐτοῖς λαλῶ, ὅτι βλέποντες οὐ βλέπουσιν καὶ ἀκούοντες οὐκ ἀκούουσιν οὐδὲ συνίουσιν.

text_en: And the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled in them, who says: By hearing you shall hear, and shall not understand: and seeing you shall see, and shall not perceive.
text_la: Et adimpletur in eis prophetia Isaiæ, dicentis : Auditu audietis, et non intelligetis : et videntes videbitis, et non videbitis.
text_pt: E neles se cumpre a profecia de Isaías, que diz:Ouvindo, ouvireis, mas não compreendereis,e, vendo, vereis, mas não percebereis.
text_el: καὶ ἀναπληροῦται αὐτοῖς ἡ προφητεία Ἠσαΐου ἡ λέγουσα: ἀκοῇ ἀκούσετε καὶ οὐ μὴ συνῆτε, καὶ βλέποντες βλέψετε καὶ οὐ μὴ ἴδητε.

text_en: For the heart of this people is grown gross, and with their ears they have been dull of hearing, and their eyes they have shut: lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and be converted , and I should heal them.
text_la: Incrassatum est enim cor populi hujus, et auribus graviter audierunt, et oculos suos clauserunt : nequando videant oculis, et auribus audiant, et corde intelligant, et convertantur, et sanem eos.
text_pt: Porque o coração deste povo está endurecido,E ouviram de mau grado com seus ouvidos,E fecharam seus olhos;Para que não vejam com os olhos,E ouçam com os ouvidos,e compreendam com o coração,e se convertam,e eu os cure.
text_el: ἐπαχύνθη γὰρ ἡ καρδία τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου, καὶ τοῖς ὠσὶν βαρέως ἤκουσαν, καὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν ἐκάμμυσαν, μήποτε ἴδωσιν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς καὶ τοῖς ὠσὶν ἀκούσωσιν καὶ τῇ καρδίᾳ συνῶσιν καὶ ἐπιστρέψωσιν, καὶ ἰάσομαι αὐτούς.

text_en: But blessed are your eyes, because they see, and your ears, because they hear.
text_la: Vestri autem beati oculi quia vident, et aures vestræ quia audiunt.
text_pt: Mas, bem-aventurados os vossos olhos, porque vêem, e os vossos ouvidos, porque ouvem.
text_el: ὑμῶν δὲ μακάριοι οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ὅτι βλέπουσιν, καὶ τὰ ὦτα [ὑμῶν] ὅτι ἀκούουσιν.

text_en: For, amen , I say to you, many prophets and just men have desired to see the things that you see, and have not seen them: and to hear the things that you hear and have not heard them.
text_la: Amen quippe dico vobis, quia multi prophetæ et justi cupierunt videre quæ videtis, et non viderunt : et audire quæ auditis, et non audierunt.
text_pt: Porque em verdade vos digo que muitos profetas e justos desejaram ver o que vós vedes, e não o viram; e ouvir o que vós ouvis, e não o ouviram.
text_el: ἀμὴν γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πολλοὶ προφῆται καὶ δίκαιοι ἐπεθύμησαν ἰδεῖν ἃ βλέπετε καὶ οὐκ εἶδαν, καὶ ἀκοῦσαι ἃ ἀκούετε καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν.

text_en: Hear you therefore the parable of the sower.
text_la: Vos ergo audite parabolam seminantis.
text_pt: Escutai vós, pois, a parábola do semeador.
text_el: ὑμεῖς οὖν ἀκούσατε τὴν παραβολὴν τοῦ σπείραντος.

text_en: When any one hears the word of the kingdom , and understands it not, there comes the wicked one , and catches away that which was sown in his heart: this is he that received the seed by the way side.
text_la: Omnis qui audit verbum regni, et non intelligit, venit malus, et rapit quod seminatum est in corde ejus : hic est qui secus viam seminatus est.
text_pt: Ouvindo alguém a palavra do reino, e não a entendendo, vem o maligno, e arrebata o que foi semeado no seu coração; este é o que foi semeado ao pé do caminho.
text_el: παντὸς ἀκούοντος τὸν λόγον τῆς βασιλείας καὶ μὴ συνιέντος, ἔρχεται ὁ πονηρὸς καὶ ἁρπάζει τὸ ἐσπαρμένον ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ παρὰ τὴν ὁδὸν σπαρείς.

text_en: And he that received the seed upon stony ground, is he that hears the word , and immediately receives it with joy .
text_la: Qui autem super petrosa seminatus est, hic est qui verbum audit, et continuo cum gaudio accipit illud:
text_pt: O que foi semeado em pedregais é o que ouve a palavra, e logo a recebe com alegria;
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἐπὶ τὰ πετρώδη σπαρείς, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ τὸν λόγον ἀκούων καὶ εὐθὺς μετὰ χαρᾶς λαμβάνων αὐτόν:

text_en: Yet has he not root in himself, but is only for a time: and when there arises tribulation and persecution because of the word , he is presently scandalized .
text_la: non habet autem in se radicem, sed est temporalis : facta autem tribulatione et persecutione propter verbum, continuo scandalizatur.
text_pt: Mas não tem raiz em si mesmo, antes é de pouca duração; e, chegada a angústia e a perseguição, por causa da palavra, logo se ofende;
text_el: οὐκ ἔχει δὲ ῥίζαν ἐν ἑαυτῷ ἀλλὰ πρόσκαιρός ἐστιν, γενομένης δὲ θλίψεως ἢ διωγμοῦ διὰ τὸν λόγον εὐθὺς σκανδαλίζεται.

text_en: And he that received the seed among thorns, is he that hears the word , and the care of this world and the deceitfulness of riches chokes up the word , and he becomes fruitless.
text_la: Qui autem seminatus est in spinis, hic est qui verbum audit, et sollicitudo sæculi istius, et fallacia divitiarum suffocat verbum, et sine fructu efficitur.
text_pt: E o que foi semeado entre espinhos é o que ouve a palavra, mas os cuidados deste mundo, e a sedução das riquezas sufocam a palavra, e fica infrutífera;
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας σπαρείς, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ τὸν λόγον ἀκούων καὶ ἡ μέριμνα τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἡ ἀπάτη τοῦ πλούτου συμπνίγει τὸν λόγον, καὶ ἄκαρπος γίνεται.

text_en: But he that received the seed upon good ground, is he that hears the word , and understands, and bears fruit, and yields the one an hundredfold, and another sixty, and another thirty.
text_la: Qui vero in terram bonam seminatus est, hic est qui audit verbum, et intelligit, et fructum affert, et facit aliud quidem centesimum, aliud autem sexagesimum, aliud vero trigesimum.
text_pt: Mas, o que foi semeado em boa terra é o que ouve e compreende a palavra; e dá fruto, e um produz cem, outro sessenta, e outro trinta.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἐπὶ τὴν καλὴν γῆν σπαρείς, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ τὸν λόγον ἀκούων καὶ συνιείς, ὃς δὴ καρποφορεῖ καὶ ποιεῖ ὃ μὲν ἑκατόν, ὃ δὲ ἑξήκοντα, ὃ δὲ τριάκοντα.

text_en: Another parable he proposed to them, saying: The kingdom of heaven is likened to a man that sowed good seed in his field.
text_la: Aliam parabolam proposuit illis, dicens : Simile factum est regnum cælorum homini, qui seminavit bonum semen in agro suo:
text_pt: Propôs-lhes outra parábola, dizendo: O reino dos céus é semelhante ao homem que semeia a boa semente no seu campo;
text_el: Ἄλλην παραβολὴν παρέθηκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων: ὡμοιώθη ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἀνθρώπῳ σπείραντι καλὸν σπέρμα ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: But while men were asleep, his enemy came and oversowed cockle among the wheat and went his way.
text_la: cum autem dormirent homines, venit inimicus ejus, et superseminavit zizania in medio tritici, et abiit.
text_pt: Mas, dormindo os homens, veio o seu inimigo, e semeou joio no meio do trigo, e retirou-se.
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῷ καθεύδειν τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἦλθεν αὐτοῦ ὁ ἐχθρὸς καὶ ἐπέσπειρεν ζιζάνια ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σίτου καὶ ἀπῆλθεν.

text_en: And when the blade was sprung up, and had brought forth fruit, then appeared also the cockle.
text_la: Cum autem crevisset herba, et fructum fecisset, tunc apparuerunt et zizania.
text_pt: E, quando a erva cresceu e frutificou, apareceu também o joio.
text_el: ὅτε δὲ ἐβλάστησεν ὁ χόρτος καὶ καρπὸν ἐποίησεν, τότε ἐφάνη καὶ τὰ ζιζάνια.

text_en: And the servants of the good man of the house coming said to him. Sir, did you not sow good seed in your field? Why then has it cockle?
text_la: Accedentes autem servi patrisfamilias, dixerunt ei : Domine, nonne bonum semen seminasti in agro tuo? unde ergo habet zizania?
text_pt: E os servos do pai de família, indo ter com ele, disseram-lhe: Senhor, não semeaste tu, no teu campo, boa semente? Por que tem, então, joio?
text_el: προσελθόντες δὲ οἱ δοῦλοι τοῦ οἰκοδεσπότου εἶπον αὐτῷ: κύριε, οὐχὶ καλὸν σπέρμα ἔσπειρας ἐν τῷ σῷ ἀγρῷ; πόθεν οὖν ἔχει ζιζάνια;

text_en: And he said to them: An enemy has done this. And the servants said to him: Will you that we go and gather it up?
text_la: Et ait illis : Inimicus homo hoc fecit. Servi autem dixerunt ei : Vis, imus, et colligimus ea?
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Um inimigo é quem fez isso. E os servos lhe disseram: Queres pois que vamos arrancá-lo?
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἔφη αὐτοῖς: ἐχθρὸς ἄνθρωπος τοῦτο ἐποίησεν. οἱ δὲ αὐτῷ λέγουσιν: θέλεις οὖν ἀπελθόντες συλλέξωμεν αὐτά;

text_en: And he said: No, lest perhaps gathering up the cockle, you root up the wheat also together with it.
text_la: Et ait : Non : ne forte colligentes zizania, eradicetis simul cum eis et triticum.
text_pt: Ele, porém, lhes disse: Não; para que, ao colher o joio, não arranqueis também o trigo com ele.
text_el: ὁ δέ φησιν: οὔ, μήποτε συλλέγοντες τὰ ζιζάνια ἐκριζώσητε ἅμα αὐτοῖς τὸν σῖτον.

text_en: Suffer both to grow until the harvest, and in the time of the harvest I will say to the reapers: Gather up first the cockle, and bind it into bundles to burn, but the wheat gather into my barn.
text_la: Sinite utraque crescere usque ad messem, et in tempore messis dicam messoribus : Colligite primum zizania, et alligate ea in fasciculos ad comburendum : triticum autem congregate in horreum meum.
text_pt: Deixai crescer ambos juntos até à ceifa; e, por ocasião da ceifa, direi aos ceifeiros: Colhei primeiro o joio, e atai-o em molhos para o queimar; mas, o trigo, ajuntai-o no meu celeiro.
text_el: ἄφετε συναυξάνεσθαι ἀμφότερα ἕως τοῦ θερισμοῦ, καὶ ἐν καιρῷ τοῦ θερισμοῦ ἐρῶ τοῖς θερισταῖς: συλλέξατε πρῶτον τὰ ζιζάνια καὶ δήσατε αὐτὰ [εἰς] δέσμας πρὸς τὸ κατακαῦσαι αὐτά, τὸν δὲ σῖτον συνάγετε εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην μου.

text_en: Another parable he proposed unto them, saying: The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took and sowed in his field.
text_la: Aliam parabolam proposuit eis dicens : Simile est regnum cælorum grano sinapis, quod accipiens homo seminavit in agro suo:
text_pt: Outra parábola lhes propôs, dizendo: O reino dos céus é semelhante ao grão de mostarda que o homem, pegando nele, semeou no seu campo;
text_el: Ἄλλην παραβολὴν παρέθηκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων: ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν κόκκῳ σινάπεως, ὃν λαβὼν ἄνθρωπος ἔσπειρεν ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ αὐτοῦ:

text_en: Which is the least indeed of all seeds; but when it is grown up, it is greater than all herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come, and dwell in the branches thereof.
text_la: quod minimum quidem est omnibus seminibus : cum autem creverit, majus est omnibus oleribus, et fit arbor, ita ut volucres cæli veniant, et habitent in ramis ejus.
text_pt: O qual é, realmente, a menor de todas as sementes; mas, crescendo, é a maior das plantas, e faz-se uma árvore, de sorte que vêm as aves do céu, e se aninham nos seus ramos.
text_el: ὃ μικρότερον μέν ἐστιν πάντων τῶν σπερμάτων, ὅταν δὲ αὐξηθῇ μεῖζον τῶν λαχάνων ἐστὶν καὶ γίνεται δένδρον, ὥστε ἐλθεῖν τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ κατασκηνοῦν ἐν τοῖς κλάδοις αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Another parable he spoke to them: The kingdom of heaven is like to leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until the whole was leavened.
text_la: Aliam parabolam locutus est eis : Simile est regnum cælorum fermento, quod acceptum mulier abscondit in farinæ satis tribus, donec fermentatum est totum.
text_pt: Outra parábola lhes disse: O reino dos céus é semelhante ao fermento, que uma mulher toma e introduz em três medidas de farinha, até que tudo esteja levedado.
text_el: Ἄλλην παραβολὴν [ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς]: ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ζύμῃ, ἣν λαβοῦσα γυνὴ ἐνέκρυψεν εἰς ἀλεύρου σάτα τρία ἕως οὗ ἐζυμώθη ὅλον.

text_en: All these things Jesus spoke in parables to the multitudes: and without parables he did not speak to them.
text_la: Hæc omnia locutus est Jesus in parabolis ad turbas : et sine parabolis non loquebatur eis:
text_pt: Tudo isto disse Jesus, por parábolas à multidão, e nada lhes falava sem parábolas;
text_el: Ταῦτα πάντα ἐλάλησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν παραβολαῖς τοῖς ὄχλοις, καὶ χωρὶς παραβολῆς οὐδὲν ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς:

text_en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet , saying: I will open my mouth in parables , I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.
text_la: ut impleretur quod dictum erat per prophetam dicentem : Aperiam in parabolis os meum; eructabo abscondita a constitutione mundi.
text_pt: Para que se cumprisse o que fora dito pelo profeta, que disse: Abrirei em parábolas a minha boca; Publicarei coisas ocultas desde a fundação do mundo.
text_el: ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν λέγοντος ἀνοίξω: ἐν παραβολαῖς τὸ στόμα μου ἐρεύξομαι, κεκρυμμένα ἀπὸ καταβολῆς.

text_en: Then having sent away the multitudes, he came into the house, and his disciples came to him, saying: Expound to us the parable of the cockle of the field.
text_la: Tunc, dimissis turbis, venit in domum : et accesserunt ad eum discipuli ejus, dicentes : Edissere nobis parabolam zizaniorum agri.
text_pt: Então, tendo despedido a multidão, foi Jesus para casa. E chegaram ao pé dele os seus discípulos, dizendo: Explica-nos a parábola do joio do campo.
text_el: Τότε ἀφεὶς τοὺς ὄχλους ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν. καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ λέγοντες: διασάφησον ἡμῖν τὴν παραβολὴν τῶν ζιζανίων τοῦ ἀγροῦ.

text_en: Who made answer and said to them: He that sows the good seed is the Son of man .
text_la: Qui respondens ait illis : Qui seminat bonum semen, est Filius hominis.
text_pt: E ele, respondendo, disse-lhes: O que semeia a boa semente, é o Filho do homem;
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: ὁ σπείρων τὸ καλὸν σπέρμα ἐστὶν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου,

text_en: And the field is the world. And the good seed are the children of the kingdom . And the cockle are the children of the wicked one .
text_la: Ager autem est mundus. Bonum vero semen, hi sunt filii regnum. Zizania autem, filii sunt nequam.
text_pt: O campo é o mundo; e a boa semente são os filhos do reino; e o joio são os filhos do maligno;
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀγρός ἐστιν ὁ κόσμος: τὸ δὲ καλὸν σπέρμα, οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ υἱοὶ τῆς βασιλείας: τὰ δὲ ζιζάνιά εἰσιν οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ πονηροῦ,

text_en: And the enemy that sowed them, is the devil . But the harvest is the end of the world . And the reapers are the angels .
text_la: Inimicus autem, qui seminavit ea, est diabolus. Messis vero, consummatio sæculi est. Messores autem, angeli sunt.
text_pt: O inimigo, que o semeou, é o diabo; e a ceifa é o fim do mundo; e os ceifeiros são os anjos.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἐχθρὸς ὁ σπείρας αὐτά ἐστιν ὁ διάβολος: ὁ δὲ θερισμὸς συντέλεια αἰῶνός ἐστιν, οἱ δὲ θερισταὶ ἄγγελοί εἰσιν.

text_en: Even as cockle therefore is gathered up, and burnt with fire: so shall it be at the end of the world .
text_la: Sicut ergo colliguntur zizania, et igni comburuntur : sic erit in consummatione sæculi.
text_pt: Assim como o joio é colhido e queimado no fogo, assim será na consumação deste mundo.
text_el: ὥσπερ οὖν συλλέγεται τὰ ζιζάνια καὶ πυρὶ κατακαίεται, οὕτως ἔσται ἐν τῇ συντελείᾳ τοῦ αἰῶνος:

text_en: The Son of man shall send his angels , and they shall gather out of his kingdom all scandals , and them that work iniquity .
text_la: Mittet Filius hominis angelos suos, et colligent de regno ejus omnia scandala, et eos qui faciunt iniquitatem:
text_pt: Mandará o Filho do homem os seus anjos, e eles colherão do seu reino tudo o que causa escândalo, e os que cometem iniqüidade.
text_el: ἀποστελεῖ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ, καὶ συλλέξουσιν ἐκ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ πάντα τὰ σκάνδαλα καὶ τοὺς ποιοῦντας τὴν ἀνομίαν,

text_en: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text_la: et mittent eos in caminum ignis. Ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium.
text_pt: E lançá-los-ão na fornalha de fogo; ali haverá pranto e ranger de dentes.
text_el: καὶ βαλοῦσιν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν κάμινον τοῦ πυρός: ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.

text_en: Then shall the just shine as the sun, in the kingdom of their Father . He that has ears to hear, let him hear.
text_la: Tunc justi fulgebunt sicut sol in regno Patris eorum. Qui habet aures audiendi, audiat.
text_pt: Então os justos resplandecerão como o sol, no reino de seu Pai. Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
text_el: τότε οἱ δίκαιοι ἐκλάμψουσιν ὡς ὁ ἥλιος ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν. ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκουέτω.

text_en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a treasure hidden in a field. Which a man having found, hid it, and for joy thereof goes, and sells all that he has, and buys that field.
text_la: Simile est regnum cælorum thesauro abscondito in agro : quem qui invenit homo, abscondit, et præ gaudio illius vadit, et vendit universa quæ habet, et emit agrum illum.
text_pt: Também o reino dos céus é semelhante a um tesouro escondido num campo, que um homem achou e escondeu; e, pelo gozo dele, vai, vende tudo quanto tem, e compra aquele campo.
text_el: Ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν θησαυρῷ κεκρυμμένῳ ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ, ὃν εὑρὼν ἄνθρωπος ἔκρυψεν, καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς χαρᾶς αὐτοῦ ὑπάγει καὶ πωλεῖ ὅσα ἔχει καὶ ἀγοράζει τὸν ἀγρὸν ἐκεῖνον.

text_en: Again the kingdom of heaven is like to a merchant seeking good pearls.
text_la: Iterum simile est regnum cælorum homini negotiatori, quærenti bonas margaritas.
text_pt: Outrossim o reino dos céus é semelhante ao homem, negociante, que busca boas pérolas;
text_el: Πάλιν ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἐμπόρῳ ζητοῦντι καλοὺς μαργαρίτας:

text_en: Who when he had found one pearl of great price, went his way, and sold all that he had, and bought it.
text_la: Inventa autem una pretiosa margarita, abiit, et vendidit omnia quæ habuit, et emit eam.
text_pt: E, encontrando uma pérola de grande valor, foi, vendeu tudo quanto tinha, e comprou-a.
text_el: εὑρὼν δὲ ἕνα πολύτιμον μαργαρίτην ἀπελθὼν πέπρακεν πάντα ὅσα εἶχεν καὶ ἠγόρασεν αὐτόν.

text_en: Again the kingdom of heaven is like to a net cast into the sea, and gathering together of all kinds of fishes.
text_la: Iterum simile est regnum cælorum sagenæ missæ in mare, et ex omni genere piscium congreganti.
text_pt: Igualmente o reino dos céus é semelhante a uma rede lançada ao mar, e que apanha toda a qualidade de peixes.
text_el: Πάλιν ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν σαγήνῃ βληθείσῃ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ ἐκ παντὸς γένους συναγαγούσῃ:

text_en: Which, when it was filled, they drew out, and sitting by the shore, they chose out the good into vessels, but the bad they cast forth.
text_la: Quam, cum impleta esset, educentes, et secus littus sedentes, elegerunt bonis in vasa, malos autem foras miserunt.
text_pt: E, estando cheia, a puxam para a praia; e, assentando-se, apanham para os cestos os bons; os ruins, porém, lançam fora.
text_el: ἣν ὅτε ἐπληρώθη ἀναβιβάσαντες ἐπὶ τὸν αἰγιαλὸν καὶ καθίσαντες συνέλεξαν τὰ καλὰ εἰς ἄγγη, τὰ δὲ σαπρὰ ἔξω ἔβαλον.

text_en: So shall it be at the end of the world . The angels shall go out, and shall separate the wicked from among the just .
text_la: Sic erit in consummatione sæculi : exibunt angeli, et separabunt malos de medio justorum,
text_pt: Assim será na consumação dos séculos: virão os anjos, e separarão os maus de entre os justos,
text_el: οὕτως ἔσται ἐν τῇ συντελείᾳ τοῦ αἰῶνος: ἐξελεύσονται οἱ ἄγγελοι καὶ ἀφοριοῦσιν τοὺς πονηροὺς ἐκ μέσου τῶν δικαίων,

text_en: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text_la: et mittent eos in caminum ignis : ibi erit fletus, et stridor dentium.
text_pt: E lançá-los-ão na fornalha de fogo; ali haverá pranto e ranger de dentes.
text_el: καὶ βαλοῦσιν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν κάμινον τοῦ πυρός: ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.

text_en: Have you understood all these things? They say to him: Yes.
text_la: Intellexistis hæc omnia? Dicunt ei : Etiam.
text_pt: E disse-lhes Jesus: Entendestes todas estas coisas? Disseram-lhe eles: Sim, Senhor.
text_el: συνήκατε ταῦτα πάντα; λέγουσιν αὐτῷ, ναί.

text_en: He said unto them: Therefore every scribe instructed in the kingdom of heaven , is like to a man that is a householder, who brings forth out of his treasure new things and old.
text_la: Ait illis : Ideo omnis scriba doctus in regno cælorum, similis est homini patrifamilias, qui profert de thesauro suo nova et vetera.
text_pt: E ele disse-lhes: Por isso, todo o escriba instruído acerca do reino dos céus é semelhante a um pai de família, que tira do seu tesouro coisas novas e velhas.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: διὰ τοῦτο πᾶς γραμματεὺς μαθητευθεὶς τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν ὅμοιός ἐστιν ἀνθρώπῳ οἰκοδεσπότῃ, ὅστις ἐκβάλλει ἐκ τοῦ θησαυροῦ αὐτοῦ καινὰ καὶ παλαιά.

text_en: And it came to pass: when Jesus had finished these parables , he passed from thence.
text_la: Et factum est, cum consummasset Jesus parabolas istas, transiit inde.
text_pt: E aconteceu que Jesus, concluindo estas parábolas, se retirou dali.
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὰς παραβολὰς ταύτας, μετῆρεν ἐκεῖθεν.

text_en: And coming into his own country , he taught them in their synagogues , so that they wondered and said: How came this man by this wisdom and miracles ?
text_la: Et veniens in patriam suam, docebat eos in synagogis eorum, ita ut mirarentur, et dicerent : Unde huic sapientia hæc, et virtutes?
text_pt: E, chegando à sua pátria, ensinava-os na sinagoga deles, de sorte que se maravilhavam, e diziam: De onde veio a este a sabedoria, e estas maravilhas?
text_el: Καὶ ἐλθὼν εἰς τὴν πατρίδα αὐτοῦ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ αὐτῶν, ὥστε ἐκπλήσσεσθαι αὐτοὺς καὶ λέγειν: πόθεν τούτῳ ἡ σοφία αὕτη καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις;

text_en: Is not this the carpenter's son? Is not his mother called Mary , and his brethren James , and Joseph, and Simon , and Jude :
text_la: Nonne hic est fabri filius? nonne mater ejus dicitur Maria, et fratres ejus, Jacobus, et Joseph, et Simon, et Judas?
text_pt: Não é este o filho do carpinteiro? e não se chama sua mãe Maria, e seus irmãos Tiago, e José, e Simão, e Judas?
text_el: οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ τοῦ τέκτονος υἱός; οὐχ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ λέγεται Μαριὰμ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἰωσὴφ καὶ Σίμων καὶ Ἰούδας;

text_en: And his sisters , are they not all with us? Whence therefore has he all these things?
text_la: et sorores ejus, nonne omnes apud nos sunt? unde ergo huic omnia ista?
text_pt: E não estão entre nós todas as suas irmãs? De onde lhe veio, pois, tudo isto?
text_el: καὶ αἱ ἀδελφαὶ αὐτοῦ οὐχὶ πᾶσαι πρὸς ἡμᾶς εἰσιν; πόθεν οὖν τούτῳ ταῦτα πάντα;

text_en: And they were scandalized in his regard. But Jesus said to them: A prophet is not without honour , save in his own country, and in his own house.
text_la: Et scandalizabantur in eo. Jesus autem dixit eis : Non est propheta sine honore, nisi in patria sua, et in domo sua.
text_pt: E escandalizavam-se nele. Jesus, porém, lhes disse: Não há profeta sem honra, a não ser na sua pátria e na sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐσκανδαλίζοντο ἐν αὐτῷ. ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: οὐκ ἔστιν προφήτης ἄτιμος εἰ μὴ ἐν τῇ πατρίδι καὶ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he wrought not many miracles there, because of their unbelief.
text_la: Et non fecit ibi virtutes multas propter incredulitatem illorum.
text_pt: E não fez ali muitas maravilhas, por causa da incredulidade deles.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησεν ἐκεῖ δυνάμεις πολλὰς διὰ τὴν ἀπιστίαν αὐτῶν.

text_en: At that time Herod the Tetrarch heard the fame of Jesus .
text_la: In illo tempore audivit Herodes tetrarcha famam Jesu:
text_pt: Naquele tempo ouviu Herodes, o tetrarca, a fama de Jesus,
text_el: Ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ ἤκουσεν Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης τὴν ἀκοὴν Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: And he said to his servants: This is John the Baptist : he is risen from the dead , and therefore mighty works show forth themselves in him.
text_la: et ait pueris suis : Hic est Joannes Baptista : ipse surrexit a mortuis, et ideo virtutes operantur in eo.
text_pt: E disse aos seus criados: Este é João o Batista; ressuscitou dos mortos, e por isso estas maravilhas operam nele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ: οὗτός ἐστιν Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτιστής: αὐτὸς ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ διὰ τοῦτο αἱ δυνάμεις ἐνεργοῦσιν ἐν αὐτῷ.

text_en: For Herod had apprehended John and bound him, and put him into prison , because of Herodias , his brother's wife.
text_la: Herodes enim tenuit Joannem, et alligavit eum : et posuit in carcerem propter Herodiadem uxorem fratris sui.
text_pt: Porque Herodes tinha prendido João, e tinha-o maniatado e encerrado no cárcere, por causa de Herodias, mulher de seu irmão Filipe;
text_el: ὁ γὰρ Ἡρῴδης κρατήσας τὸν Ἰωάννην ἔδησεν καὶ ἐν φυλακῇ ἀπέθετο διὰ Ἡρῳδιάδα τὴν γυναῖκα Φιλίππου] τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: For John said to him: It is not lawful for you to have her.
text_la: Dicebat enim illi Joannes : Non licet tibi habere eam.
text_pt: Porque João lhe dissera: Não te é lícito possuí-la.
text_el: ἔλεγεν γὰρ ὁ Ἰωάννης αὐτῷ: οὐκ ἔξεστίν σοι ἔχειν αὐτήν.

text_en: And having a mind to put him to death , he feared the people: because they esteemed him as a prophet .
text_la: Et volens illum occidere, timuit populum : quia sicut prophetam eum habebant.
text_pt: E, querendo matá-lo, temia o povo; porque o tinham como profeta.
text_el: καὶ θέλων αὐτὸν ἀποκτεῖναι ἐφοβήθη τὸν ὄχλον, ὅτι ὡς προφήτην αὐτὸν εἶχον.

text_en: But on Herod's birthday, the daughter of Herodias danced before them: and pleased Herod .
text_la: Die autem natalis Herodis saltavit filia Herodiadis in medio, et placuit Herodi:
text_pt: Festejando-se, porém, o dia natalício de Herodes, dançou a filha de Herodias diante dele, e agradou a Herodes.
text_el: γενεσίοις δὲ γενομένοις τοῦ Ἡρῴδου ὠρχήσατο ἡ θυγάτηρ τῆς Ἡρῳδιάδος ἐν τῷ μέσῳ καὶ ἤρεσεν τῷ Ἡρῴδῃ,

text_en: Whereupon he promised with an oath , to give her whatsoever she would ask of him.
text_la: unde cum juramento pollicitus est ei dare quodcumque postulasset ab eo.
text_pt: Por isso prometeu, com juramento, dar-lhe tudo o que pedisse;
text_el: ὅθεν μεθ' ὅρκου ὡμολόγησεν αὐτῇ δοῦναι ὃ ἐὰν αἰτήσηται.

text_en: But she being instructed before by her mother, said: Give me here in a dish the head of John the Baptist .
text_la: At illa præmonita a matre sua : Da mihi, inquit, hic in disco caput Joannis Baptistæ.
text_pt: E ela, instruída previamente por sua mãe, disse: Dá-me aqui, num prato, a cabeça de João o Batista.
text_el: ἡ δὲ προβιβασθεῖσα ὑπὸ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτῆς: δός μοι, φησίν, ὧδε ἐπὶ πίνακι τὴν κεφαλὴν Ἰωάννου τοῦ βαπτιστοῦ.

text_en: And the king was struck sad: yet because of his oath , and for them that sat with him at table, he commanded it to be given.
text_la: Et contristatus est rex : propter juramentum autem, et eos qui pariter recumbebant, jussit dari.
text_pt: E o rei afligiu-se, mas, por causa do juramento, e dos que estavam à mesa com ele, ordenou que se lhe desse.
text_el: καὶ λυπηθεὶς ὁ βασιλεὺς διὰ τοὺς ὅρκους καὶ τοὺς συνανακειμένους ἐκέλευσεν δοθῆναι,

text_en: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
text_la: Misitque et decollavit Joannem in carcere.
text_pt: E mandou degolar João no cárcere.
text_el: καὶ πέμψας ἀπεκεφάλισεν Ἰωάννην ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ:

text_en: And his head was brought in a dish: and it was given to the damsel, and she brought it to her mother.
text_la: Et allatum est caput ejus in disco, et datum est puellæ, et attulit matri suæ.
text_pt: E a sua cabeça foi trazida num prato, e dada à jovem, e ela a levou a sua mãe.
text_el: καὶ ἠνέχθη ἡ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πίνακι καὶ ἐδόθη τῷ κορασίῳ, καὶ ἤνεγκεν τῇ μητρὶ αὐτῆς.

text_en: And his disciples came and took the body, and buried it, and came and told Jesus .
text_la: Et accedentes discipuli ejus, tulerunt corpus ejus, et sepelierunt illud : et venientes nuntiaverunt Jesu.
text_pt: E chegaram os seus discípulos, e levaram o corpo, e o sepultaram; e foram anunciá-lo a Jesus.
text_el: καὶ προσελθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἦραν τὸ πτῶμα καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτόν, καὶ ἐλθόντες ἀπήγγειλαν τῷ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: Which when Jesus had heard, he retired from thence by a boat, into a desert place apart, and the multitudes having heard of it, followed him on foot out of the cities.
text_la: Quod cum audisset Jesus, secessit inde in navicula, in locum desertum seorsum : et cum audissent turbæ, secutæ sunt eum pedestres de civitatibus.
text_pt: E Jesus, ouvindo isto, retirou-se dali num barco, para um lugar deserto, apartado; e, sabendo-o o povo, seguiu-o a pé desde as cidades.
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀνεχώρησεν ἐκεῖθεν ἐν πλοίῳ εἰς ἔρημον τόπον κατ' ἰδίαν: καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ ὄχλοι ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ πεζῇ ἀπὸ τῶν πόλεων.

text_en: And he coming forth saw a great multitude, and had compassion on them, and healed their sick.
text_la: Et exiens vidit turbam multam, et misertus est eis, et curavit languidos eorum.
text_pt: E, Jesus, saindo, viu uma grande multidão, e possuído de íntima compaixão para com ela, curou os seus enfermos.
text_el: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν εἶδεν πολὺν ὄχλον, καὶ ἐσπλαγχνίσθη ἐπ' αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν τοὺς ἀρρώστους αὐτῶν.

text_en: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying: This is a desert place , and the hour is now past: send away the multitudes, that going into the towns, they may buy themselves victuals.
text_la: Vespere autem facto, accesserunt ad eum discipuli ejus, dicentes : Desertus est locus, et hora jam præteriit : dimitte turbas, ut euntes in castella, emant sibi escas.
text_pt: E, sendo chegada a tarde, os seus discípulos aproximaram-se dele, dizendo: O lugar é deserto, e a hora é já avançada; despede a multidão, para que vão pelas aldeias, e comprem comida para si.
text_el: ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης προσῆλθον αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ λέγοντες: ἔρημός ἐστιν ὁ τόπος καὶ ἡ ὥρα ἤδη παρῆλθεν: ἀπόλυσον τοὺς ὄχλους, ἵνα ἀπελθόντες εἰς τὰς κώμας ἀγοράσωσιν ἑαυτοῖς βρώματα.

text_en: But Jesus said to them, They have no need to go: give you them to eat.
text_la: Jesus autem dixit eis : Non habent necesse ire : date illis vos manducare.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, lhes disse: Não é mister que vão; dai-lhes vós de comer.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: οὐ χρείαν ἔχουσιν ἀπελθεῖν: δότε αὐτοῖς ὑμεῖς φαγεῖν.

text_en: They answered him: We have not here, but five loaves, and two fishes.
text_la: Responderunt ei: Non habemus hic nisi quinque panes et duos pisces.
text_pt: Então eles lhe disseram: Não temos aqui senão cinco pães e dois peixes.
text_el: οἱ δὲ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: οὐκ ἔχομεν ὧδε εἰ μὴ πέντε ἄρτους καὶ δύο ἰχθύας.

text_en: Who said to them: Bring them hither to me.
text_la: Qui ait eis : Afferte mihi illos huc.
text_pt: E ele disse: Trazei-mos aqui.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: φέρετέ μοι ὧδε αὐτούς.

text_en: And when he had commanded the multitude to sit down upon the grass, he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven , he blessed , and broke, and gave the loaves to his disciples , and the disciples to the multitudes.
text_la: Et cum jussisset turbam discumbere super fœnum, acceptis quinque panibus et duobus piscibus, aspiciens in cælum benedixit, et fregit, et dedit discipulis panes, discipuli autem turbis.
text_pt: E, tendo mandado que a multidão se assentasse sobre a erva, tomou os cinco pães e os dois peixes, e, erguendo os olhos ao céu, os abençoou, e, partindo os pães, deu-os aos discípulos, e os discípulos à multidão.
text_el: καὶ κελεύσας τοὺς ὄχλους ἀνακλιθῆναι ἐπὶ τοῦ χόρτου, λαβὼν τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους καὶ τοὺς δύο ἰχθύας, ἀναβλέψας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εὐλόγησεν, καὶ κλάσας ἔδωκεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς τοὺς ἄρτους οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ τοῖς ὄχλοις.

text_en: And they did all eat, and were filled. And they took up what remained, twelve full baskets of fragments.
text_la: Et manducaverunt omnes, et saturati sunt. Et tulerunt reliquias, duodecim cophinos fragmentorum plenos.
text_pt: E comeram todos, e saciaramse; e levantaram dos pedaços, que sobejaram, doze alcofas cheias.
text_el: καὶ ἔφαγον πάντες καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν, καὶ ἦραν τὸ περισσεῦον τῶν κλασμάτων δώδεκα κοφίνους πλήρεις.

text_en: And the number of them that ate, was five thousand men , besides women and children.
text_la: Manducantium autem fuit numerus quinque millia virorum, exceptis mulieribus et parvulis.
text_pt: E os que comeram foram quase cinco mil homens, além das mulheres e crianças.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐσθίοντες ἦσαν ἄνδρες ὡσεὶ πεντακισχίλιοι χωρὶς γυναικῶν καὶ παιδίων.

text_en: And forthwith Jesus obliged his disciples to go up into the boat, and to go before him over the water, till he dismissed the people.
text_la: Et statim compulit Jesus discipulos ascendere in naviculam, et præcedere eum trans fretum, donec dimitteret turbas.
text_pt: E logo ordenou Jesus que os seus discípulos entrassem no barco, e fossem adiante para o outro lado, enquanto despedia a multidão.
text_el: Καὶ [εὐθέως] ἠνάγκασεν τοὺς μαθητὰς ἐμβῆναι εἰς πλοῖον καὶ προάγειν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ πέραν, ἕως οὗ ἀπολύσῃ τοὺς ὄχλους.

text_en: And having dismissed the multitude, he went into a mountain alone to pray . And when it was evening, he was there alone.
text_la: Et dimissa turba, ascendit in montem solus orare. Vespere autem facto solus erat ibi:
text_pt: E, despedida a multidão, subiu ao monte para orar, à parte. E, chegada já a tarde, estava ali só.
text_el: καὶ ἀπολύσας τοὺς ὄχλους ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος κατ' ἰδίαν προσεύξασθαι. ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης μόνος ἦν ἐκεῖ.

text_en: But the boat in the midst of the sea was tossed with the waves: for the wind was contrary.
text_la: navicula autem in medio mari jactabatur fluctibus : erat enim contrarius ventus.
text_pt: E o barco estava já no meio do mar, açoitado pelas ondas; porque o vento era contrário;
text_el: τὸ δὲ πλοῖον ἤδη σταδίους πολλοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἀπεῖχεν βασανιζόμενον ὑπὸ τῶν κυμάτων: ἦν γὰρ ἐναντίος ὁ ἄνεμος.

text_en: And in the fourth watch of the night, he came to them walking upon the sea.
text_la: Quarta enim vigilia noctis, venit ad eos ambulans super mare.
text_pt: Mas, à quarta vigília da noite, dirigiu-se Jesus para eles, andan-do por cima do mar.
text_el: τετάρτῃ δὲ φυλακῇ τῆς νυκτὸς ἦλθεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς περιπατῶν ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν.

text_en: And they seeing him walking upon the sea, were troubled, saying: It is an apparition . And they cried out for fear.
text_la: Et videntes eum super mare ambulantem, turbati sunt, dicentes : Quia phantasma est. Et præ timore clamaverunt.
text_pt: E os discípulos, vendo-o an-dando sobre o mar, assustaram-se, dizendo: É um fantasma. E gritaram com medo.
text_el: οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης περιπατοῦντα ἐταράχθησαν λέγοντες ὅτι φάντασμά ἐστιν, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ φόβου ἔκραξαν.

text_en: And immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying: Be of good heart: it is I, fear not.
text_la: Statimque Jesus locutus est eis, dicens : Habete fiduciam : ego sum, nolite timere.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, lhes falou logo, dizendo: Tende bom ânimo, sou eu, não temais.
text_el: εὐθὺς δὲ ἐλάλησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς αὐτοῖς λέγων: θαρσεῖτε, ἐγώ εἰμι: μὴ φοβεῖσθε.

text_en: And Peter making answer, said: Lord, if it be you, bid me come to you upon the waters.
text_la: Respondens autem Petrus, dixit : Domine, si tu es, jube me ad te venire super aquas.
text_pt: E respondeu-lhe Pedro, e disse: Senhor, se és tu, manda-me ir ter contigo por cima das águas.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ: κύριε, εἰ σὺ εἶ, κέλευσόν με ἐλθεῖν πρὸς σὲ ἐπὶ τὰ ὕδατα:

text_en: And he said: Come. And Peter going down out of the boat walked upon the water to come to Jesus .
text_la: At ipse ait : Veni. Et descendens Petrus de navicula, ambulabat super aquam ut veniret ad Jesum.
text_pt: E ele disse: Vem. E Pedro, descendo do barco, andou sobre as águas para ir ter com Jesus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: ἐλθέ. καὶ καταβὰς ἀπὸ τοῦ πλοίου Πέτρος περιεπάτησεν ἐπὶ τὰ ὕδατα καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: But seeing the wind strong, he was afraid: and when he began to sink, he cried out, saying: Lord, save me.
text_la: Videns vero ventum validum, timuit : et cum cœpisset mergi, clamavit dicens : Domine, salvum me fac.
text_pt: Mas, sentindo o vento forte, teve medo; e, começando a ir para o fundo, clamou, dizendo: Senhor, salva-me!
text_el: βλέπων δὲ τὸν ἄνεμον ἐφοβήθη, καὶ ἀρξάμενος καταποντίζεσθαι ἔκραξεν λέγων: κύριε, σῶσόν με.

text_en: And immediately Jesus stretching forth his hand took hold of him, and said to him: O you of little faith , why did you doubt ?
text_la: Et continuo Jesus extendens manum, apprehendit eum : et ait illi : Modicæ fidei, quare dubitasti?
text_pt: E logo Jesus, estendendo a mão, segurou-o, e disse-lhe: Homem de pouca fé, por que duvidaste?
text_el: εὐθέως δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἐπελάβετο αὐτοῦ καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ: ὀλιγόπιστε, εἰς τί ἐδίστασας;

text_en: And when they had come up into the boat, the wind ceased.
text_la: Et cum ascendissent in naviculam, cessavit ventus.
text_pt: E, quando subiram para o barco, acalmou o vento.
text_el: καὶ ἀναβάντων αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον ἐκόπασεν ὁ ἄνεμος.

text_en: And they that were in the boat came and adored him, saying: Indeed you are the Son of God .
text_la: Qui autem in navicula erant, venerunt, et adoraverunt eum, dicentes : Vere Filius Dei es.
text_pt: Então aproximaram-se os que estavam no barco, e adoraram-no, dizendo: És verdadeiramente o Filho de Deus.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες: ἀληθῶς θεοῦ υἱὸς εἶ.

text_en: And having passed the water, they came into the country of Genesar .
text_la: Et cum transfretassent, venerunt in terram Genesar.
text_pt: E, tendo passado para o outro lado, chegaram à terra de Genesaré.
text_el: Καὶ διαπεράσαντες ἦλθον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν εἰς Γεννησαρέτ.

text_en: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent into all that country, and brought to him all that were diseased.
text_la: Et cum cognovissent eum viri loci illius, miserunt in universam regionem illam, et obtulerunt ei omnes male habentes:
text_pt: E, quando os homens daquele lugar o conheceram, mandaram por todas aquelas terras em redor e trouxeram-lhe todos os que estavam enfermos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιγνόντες αὐτὸν οἱ ἄνδρες τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου ἀπέστειλαν εἰς ὅλην τὴν περίχωρον ἐκείνην, καὶ προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας,

text_en: And they besought him that they might touch but the hem of his garment . And as many as touched, were made whole.
text_la: et rogabant eum ut vel fimbriam vestimenti ejus tangerent. Et quicumque tetigerunt, salvi facti sunt.
text_pt: E rogavam-lhe que ao menos eles pudessem tocar a orla da sua roupa; e todos os que a tocavam ficavam sãos.
text_el: καὶ παρεκάλουν [αὐτὸν] ἵνα μόνον ἅψωνται τοῦ κρασπέδου τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ: καὶ ὅσοι ἥψαντο διεσώθησαν.

text_en: Then came to him from Jerusalem scribes and Pharisees , saying:
text_la: Tunc accesserunt ad eum ab Jerosolymis scribæ et pharisæi, dicentes:
text_pt: Então chegaram ao pé de Jesus uns escribas e fariseus de Jerusalém, dizendo:
text_el: Τότε προσέρχονται τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων Φαρισαῖοι καὶ γραμματεῖς λέγοντες:

text_en: Why do your disciples transgress the tradition of the ancients? For they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
text_la: Quare discipuli tui transgrediuntur traditionem seniorum? non enim lavant manus suas cum panem manducant.
text_pt: Por que transgridem os teus discípulos a tradição dos anciãos? pois não lavam as mãos quando comem pão.
text_el: διὰ τί οἱ μαθηταί σου παραβαίνουσιν τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν πρεσβυτέρων; οὐ γὰρ νίπτονται τὰς χεῖρας ὅταν ἄρτον ἐσθίωσιν.

text_en: But he answering, said to them: Why do you also transgress the commandment of God for your tradition? For God said:
text_la: Ipse autem respondens ait illis : Quare et vos transgredimini mandatum Dei propter traditionem vestram? Nam Deus dixit:
text_pt: Ele, porém, respondendo, disse-lhes: Por que transgredis vós, também, o mandamento de Deus pela vossa tradição?
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: διὰ τί καὶ ὑμεῖς παραβαίνετε τὴν ἐντολὴν τοῦ θεοῦ διὰ τὴν παράδοσιν ὑμῶν;

text_en: Honour your father and mother : And: He that shall curse father or mother , let him die the death .
text_la: Honora patrem, et matrem : et, Qui maledixerit patri, vel matri, morte moriatur.
text_pt: Porque Deus ordenou, dizendo: Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe; e: Quem maldisser ao pai ou à mãe, certamente morrerá.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ θεὸς εἶπεν: τίμα τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα, καί ὁ κακολογῶν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα θανάτῳ τελευτάτω:

text_en: But you say: Whosoever shall say to father or mother , The gift whatsoever proceeds from me, shall profit you.
text_la: Vos autem dicitis : Quicumque dixerit patri, vel matri : Munus, quodcumque est ex me, tibi proderit:
text_pt: Mas vós dizeis: Qualquer que disser ao pai ou à mãe: É oferta ao Senhor o que poderias aproveitar de mim; esse não precisa honrar nem a seu pai nem a sua mãe,
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ λέγετε: ὃς ἂν εἴπῃ τῷ πατρὶ ἢ τῇ μητρί: δῶρον ὃ ἐὰν ἐξ ἐμοῦ ὠφεληθῇς,

text_en: And he shall not honour his father or his mother : and you have made void the commandment of God for your tradition.
text_la: et non honorificabit patrem suum, aut matrem suam : et irritum fecistis mandatum Dei propter traditionem vestram.
text_pt: E assim invalidastes, pela vossa tradição, o mandamento de Deus.
text_el: οὐ μὴ τιμήσει τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ [ἢ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ]: καὶ ἠκυρώσατε τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ διὰ τὴν παράδοσιν ὑμῶν.

text_en: Hypocrites , well has Isaiah prophesied of you, saying:
text_la: Hypocritæ, bene prophetavit de vobis Isaias, dicens:
text_pt: Hipócritas, bem profetizou Isaías a vosso respeito, dizendo:
text_el: ὑποκριταί, καλῶς ἐπροφήτευσεν περὶ ὑμῶν Ἠσαΐας λέγων:

text_en: This people honours me with their lips: but their heart is far from me.
text_la: Populus hic labiis me honorat : cor autem eorum longe est a me.
text_pt: Este povo se aproxima de mim com a sua boca e me honra com os seus lábios, mas o seu coração está longe de mim.
text_el: ὁ λαὸς οὗτος τοῖς χείλεσίν με τιμᾷ, ἡ δὲ καρδία αὐτῶν πόρρω ἀπέχει ἀπ' ἐμοῦ:

text_en: And in vain do they worship me, teaching doctrines and commandments of men .
text_la: Sine causa autem colunt me, docentes doctrinas et mandata hominum.
text_pt: Mas, em vão me adoram, ensinando doutrinas que são preceitos dos homens.
text_el: μάτην δὲ σέβονταί με, διδάσκοντες διδασκαλίας ἐντάλματα ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: And having called together the multitudes unto him, he said to them: Hear and understand.
text_la: Et convocatis ad se turbis, dixit eis : Audite, et intelligite.
text_pt: E, chamando a si a multidão, disse-lhes: Ouvi, e entendei:
text_el: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τὸν ὄχλον εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἀκούετε καὶ συνίετε:

text_en: Not that which goes into the mouth defiles a man : but what comes out of the mouth, this defiles a man .
text_la: Non quod intrat in os, coinquinat hominem : sed quod procedit ex ore, hoc coinquinat hominem.
text_pt: O que contamina o homem não é o que entra na boca, mas o que sai da boca, isso é o que contamina o homem.
text_el: οὐ τὸ εἰσερχόμενον εἰς τὸ στόμα κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον, ἀλλὰ τὸ ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ τοῦ στόματος, τοῦτο κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον.

text_en: Then came his disciples , and said to him: Do you know that the Pharisees , when they heard this word, were scandalized ?
text_la: Tunc accedentes discipuli ejus, dixerunt ei : Scis quia pharisæi audito verbo hoc, scandalizati sunt?
text_pt: Então, acercando-se dele os seus discípulos, disseram-lhe: Sabes que os fariseus, ouvindo essas palavras, se escandalizaram?
text_el: τότε προσελθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: οἶδας ὅτι οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον ἐσκανδαλίσθησαν;

text_en: But he answering, said: Every plant which my heavenly Father has not planted, shall be rooted up.
text_la: At ille respondens ait : Omnis plantatio, quam non plantavit Pater meus cælestis, eradicabitur.
text_pt: Ele, porém, respondendo, disse: Toda a planta, que meu Pai celestial não plantou, será arrancada.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: πᾶσα φυτεία ἣν οὐκ ἐφύτευσεν ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ οὐράνιος ἐκριζωθήσεται.

text_en: Let them alone: they are blind, and leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both fall into the pit.
text_la: Sinite illos : cæci sunt, et duces cæcorum; cæcus autem si cæco ducatum præstet, ambo in foveam cadunt.
text_pt: Deixai-os; são cegos condutores de cegos. Ora, se um cego guiar outro cego, ambos cairão na cova.
text_el: ἄφετε αὐτούς: τυφλοί εἰσιν ὁδηγοί τυφλὸς δὲ τυφλὸν ἐὰν ὁδηγῇ, ἀμφότεροι εἰς βόθυνον πεσοῦνται.

text_en: And Peter answering, said to him: Expound to us this parable .
text_la: Respondens autem Petrus dixit ei: Edissere nobis parabolam istam.
text_pt: E Pedro, tomando a palavra, disse-lhe: Explica-nos essa parábola.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ: φράσον ἡμῖν τὴν παραβολήν.

text_en: But he said: Are you also yet without understanding?
text_la: At ille dixit : Adhuc et vos sine intellectu estis?
text_pt: Jesus, porém, disse: Até vós mesmos estais ainda sem entender?
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: ἀκμὴν καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀσύνετοί ἐστε;

text_en: Do you not understand, that whatsoever enters into the mouth, goes into the belly, and is cast out into the privy?
text_la: Non intelligitis quia omne quod in os intrat, in ventrem vadit, et in secessum emittitur?
text_pt: Ainda não compreendeis que tudo o que entra pela boca desce para o ventre, e é lançado fora?
text_el: οὐ νοεῖτε ὅτι πᾶν τὸ εἰσπορευόμενον εἰς τὸ στόμα εἰς τὴν κοιλίαν χωρεῖ καὶ εἰς ἀφεδρῶνα ἐκβάλλεται;

text_en: But the things which proceed out of the mouth, come forth from the heart , and those things defile a man .
text_la: Quæ autem procedunt de ore, de corde exeunt, et ea coinquinant hominem:
text_pt: Mas, o que sai da boca, procede do coração, e isso contamina o homem.
text_el: τὰ δὲ ἐκπορευόμενα ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ἐκ τῆς καρδίας ἐξέρχεται, κἀκεῖνα κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον.

text_en: For from the heart come forth evil thoughts, murders , adulteries , fornications, thefts , false testimonies , blasphemies .
text_la: de corde enim exeunt cogitationes malæ, homicidia, adulteria, fornicationes, furta, falsa testimonia, blasphemiæ:
text_pt: Porque do coração procedem os maus pensamentos, mortes, adultérios, fornicação, furtos, falsos testemunhos e blasfêmias.
text_el: ἐκ γὰρ τῆς καρδίας ἐξέρχονται διαλογισμοὶ πονηροί, φόνοι, μοιχεῖαι, πορνεῖαι, κλοπαί, ψευδομαρτυρίαι, βλασφημίαι.

text_en: These are the things that defile a man . But to eat with unwashed hands does not defile a man .
text_la: hæc sunt, quæ coinquinant hominem. Non lotis autem manibus manducare, non coinquinat hominem.
text_pt: São estas coisas que contaminam o homem; mas comer sem lavar as mãos, isso não contamina o homem.
text_el: ταῦτά ἐστιν τὰ κοινοῦντα τὸν ἄνθρωπον: τὸ δὲ ἀνίπτοις χερσὶν φαγεῖν οὐ κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον.

text_en: And Jesus went from thence, and retired into the coast of Tyre and Sidon .
text_la: Et egressus inde Jesus secessit in partes Tyri et Sidonis.
text_pt: E, partindo Jesus dali, foi para as partes de Tiro e de Sidom.
text_el: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἐκεῖθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὰ μέρη Τύρου καὶ Σιδῶνος.

text_en: And behold a woman of Canaan who came out of those coasts, crying out, said to him: Have mercy on me, O Lord, you son of David : my daughter is grievously troubled by a devil .
text_la: Et ecce mulier chananæa a finibus illis egressa clamavit, dicens ei : Miserere mei, Domine fili David : filia mea male a dæmonio vexatur.
text_pt: E eis que uma mulher cananéia, que saíra daquelas cercanias, clamou, dizendo: Senhor, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim, que minha filha está miseravelmente endemoninhada.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ γυνὴ Χαναναία ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων ἐκείνων ἐξελθοῦσα ἔκραζεν λέγουσα: ἐλέησόν με, κύριε, υἱὸς Δαυίδ: ἡ θυγάτηρ μου κακῶς δαιμονίζεται.

text_en: Who answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying: Send her away, for she cries after us:
text_la: Qui non respondit ei verbum. Et accedentes discipuli ejus rogabant eum dicentes : Dimitte eam : quia clamat post nos.
text_pt: Mas ele não lhe respondeu palavra. E os seus discípulos, chegando ao pé dele, rogaram-lhe, dizendo: Despede-a, que vem gritando atrás de nós.
text_el: ὁ δὲ οὐκ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῇ λόγον. καὶ προσελθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἠρώτουν αὐτὸν λέγοντες: ἀπόλυσον αὐτήν, ὅτι κράζει ὄπισθεν ἡμῶν.

text_en: And he answering, said: I was not sent but to the sheep, that are lost of the house of Israel .
text_la: Ipse autem respondens ait : Non sum missus nisi ad oves, quæ perierunt domus Israël.
text_pt: E ele, respondendo, disse: Eu não fui enviado senão às ovelhas perdidas da casa de Israel.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: οὐκ ἀπεστάλην εἰ μὴ εἰς τὰ πρόβατα τὰ ἀπολωλότα οἴκου Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: But she came and adored him, saying: Lord, help me.
text_la: At illa venit, et adoravit eum, dicens : Domine, adjuva me.
text_pt: Então chegou ela, e adorou-o, dizendo: Senhor, socorre-me!
text_el: ἡ δὲ ἐλθοῦσα προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγουσα: κύριε, βοήθει μοι.

text_en: Who answering, said: It is not good to take the bread of the children, and to cast it to the dogs.
text_la: Qui respondens ait : Non est bonum sumere panem filiorum, et mittere canibus.
text_pt: Ele, porém, respondendo, disse: Não é bom pegar no pão dos filhos e deitá-lo aos cachorrinhos.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: οὐκ ἔστιν καλὸν λαβεῖν τὸν ἄρτον τῶν τέκνων καὶ βαλεῖν τοῖς κυναρίοις.

text_en: But she said: Yea, Lord; for the whelps also eat of the crumbs that fall from the table of their masters.
