text_la: At illa dixit : Etiam Domine : nam et catelli edunt de micis quæ cadunt de mensa dominorum suorum.
text_pt: E ela disse: Sim, Senhor, mas também os cachorrinhos comem das migalhas que caem da mesa dos seus senhores.
text_el: ἡ δὲ εἶπεν: ναί, κύριε: καὶ [γὰρ] τὰ κυνάρια ἐσθίει ἀπὸ τῶν ψιχίων τῶν πιπτόντων ἀπὸ τῆς τραπέζης τῶν κυρίων αὐτῶν.

text_en: Then Jesus answering, said to her: O woman , great is your faith : be it done to you as you will: and her daughter was cured from that hour.
text_la: Tunc respondens Jesus, ait illi : O mulier, magna est fides tua : fiat tibi sicut vis. Et sanata est filia ejus ex illa hora.
text_pt: Então respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhe: Ó mulher, grande é a tua fé! Seja isso feito para contigo como tu desejas. E desde aquela hora a sua filha ficou sã.
text_el: τότε ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῇ: ὦ γύναι, μεγάλη σου ἡ πίστις: γενηθήτω σοι ὡς θέλεις. καὶ ἰάθη ἡ θυγάτηρ αὐτῆς ἀπὸ τῆς ὥρας ἐκείνης.

text_en: And when Jesus had passed away from thence, he came near the sea of Galilee : and going up into a mountain, he sat there.
text_la: Et cum transisset inde Jesus, venit secus mare Galilææ : et ascendens in montem, sedebat ibi.
text_pt: Partindo Jesus dali, chegou ao pé do mar da Galiléia, e, subindo a um monte, assentou-se lá.
text_el: Καὶ μεταβὰς ἐκεῖθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἦλθεν παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας, καὶ ἀναβὰς εἰς τὸ ὄρος ἐκάθητο ἐκεῖ.

text_en: And there came to him great multitudes, having with them the dumb, the blind, the lame, the maimed, and many others: and they cast them down at his feet, and he healed them:
text_la: Et accesserunt ad eum turbæ multæ, habentes secum mutos, cæcos, claudos, debiles, et alios multos : et projecerunt eos ad pedes ejus, et curavit eos,
text_pt: E veio ter com ele grandes multidões, que traziam coxos, cegos, mudos, aleijados, e outros muitos, e os puseram aos pés de Jesus, e ele os sarou,
text_el: καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοὶ ἔχοντες μεθ' ἑαυτῶν χωλούς, κυλλούς, τυφλούς, κωφούς, καὶ ἑτέρους πολλούς, καὶ ἔρριψαν αὐτοὺς παρὰ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ: καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτούς,

text_en: So that the multitudes marvelled seeing the dumb speak, the lame walk, the blind see: and they glorified the God of Israel .
text_la: ita ut turbæ mirarentur, videntes mutos loquentes, claudos ambulantes, cæcos videntes : et magnificabant Deum Israël.
text_pt: De tal sorte, que a multidão se maravilhou vendo os mudos a falar, os aleijados sãos, os coxos a andar, e os cegos a ver; e glorificava o Deus de Israel.
text_el: ὥστε τὸν ὄχλον θαυμάσαι βλέποντας κωφοὺς λαλοῦντας, καὶ χωλοὺς περιπατοῦντας καὶ τυφλοὺς βλέποντας: καὶ ἐδόξασαν τὸν θεὸν Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: And Jesus called together his disciples , and said: I have compassion on the multitudes, because they continue with me now three days, and have not what to eat, and I will not send them away fasting , lest they faint in the way.
text_la: Jesus autem, convocatis discipulis suis, dixit : Misereor turbæ, quia triduo jam perseverant mecum, et non habent quod manducent : et dimittere eos jejunos nolo, ne deficiant in via.
text_pt: E Jesus, chamando os seus discípulos, disse: Tenho compaixão da multidão, porque já está comigo há três dias, e não tem o que comer; e não quero despedi-la em jejum, para que não desfaleça no caminho.
text_el: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς προσκαλεσάμενος τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ εἶπεν: σπλαγχνίζομαι ἐπὶ τὸν ὄχλον, ὅτι [ἤδη] ἡμέραι τρεῖς προσμένουσίν μοι καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν τί φάγωσιν: καὶ ἀπολῦσαι αὐτοὺς νήστεις οὐ θέλω, μήποτε ἐκλυθῶσιν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.

text_en: And the disciples say unto him: Whence then should we have so many loaves in the desert , as to fill so great a multitude?
text_la: Et dicunt ei discipuli : Unde ergo nobis in deserto panes tantos, ut saturemus turbam tantam?
text_pt: E os seus discípulos disseram-lhe: De onde nos viriam, num deserto, tantos pães, para saciar tal multidão?
text_el: καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταί: πόθεν ἡμῖν ἐν ἐρημίᾳ ἄρτοι τοσοῦτοι ὥστε χορτάσαι ὄχλον τοσοῦτον;

text_en: And Jesus said to them: How many loaves have you? But they said: Seven, and a few little fishes.
text_la: Et ait illis Jesus : Quot habetis panes? At illi dixerunt : Septem, et paucos pisciculos.
text_pt: E Jesus disse-lhes: Quantos pães tendes? E eles disseram: Sete, e uns poucos de peixinhos.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, πόσους ἄρτους ἔχετε; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: ἑπτά, καὶ ὀλίγα ἰχθύδια.

text_en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down upon the ground.
text_la: Et præcepit turbæ ut discumberent super terram.
text_pt: Então mandou à multidão que se assentasse no chão,
text_el: καὶ παραγγείλας τῷ ὄχλῳ ἀναπεσεῖν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And taking the seven loaves and the fishes, and giving thanks, he broke, and gave to his disciples , and the disciples gave to the people.
text_la: Et accipiens septem panes, et pisces, et gratias agens, fregit, et dedit discipulis suis, et discipuli dederunt populo.
text_pt: E, tomando os sete pães e os peixes, e dando graças, partiu-os, e deu-os aos seus discípulos, e os discípulos à multidão.
text_el: ἔλαβεν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἄρτους καὶ τοὺς ἰχθύας καὶ εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἐδίδου τοῖς μαθηταῖς, οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ τοῖς ὄχλοις.

text_en: And they did all eat, and had their fill. And they took up seven baskets full, of what remained of the fragments.
text_la: Et comederunt omnes, et saturati sunt. Et quod superfuit de fragmentis, tulerunt septem sportas plenas.
text_pt: E todos comeram e se saciaram; e levantaram, do que sobejou, sete cestos cheios de pedaços.
text_el: καὶ ἔφαγον πάντες καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν, καὶ τὸ περισσεῦον τῶν κλασμάτων ἦραν, ἑπτὰ σπυρίδας πλήρεις.

text_en: And they that ate, were four thousand men , beside children and women .
text_la: Erant autem qui manducaverunt quatuor millia hominum, extra parvulos et mulieres.
text_pt: Ora, os que tinham comido eram quatro mil homens, além de mulheres e crianças.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐσθίοντες ἦσαν τετρακισχίλιοι ἄνδρες χωρὶς γυναικῶν καὶ παιδίων.

text_en: And having dismissed the multitude, he went up into a boat, and came into the coasts of Magedan .
text_la: Et, dimissa turba, ascendit in naviculam : et venit in fines Magedan.
text_pt: E, tendo despedido a multidão, entrou no barco, e dirigiu-se ao território de Magadã.
text_el: καὶ ἀπολύσας τοὺς ὄχλους ἐνέβη εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὰ ὅρια Μαγαδάν.

text_en: And there came to him the Pharisees and Sadducees tempting: and they asked him to show them a sign from heaven .
text_la: Et accesserunt ad eum pharisæi et sadducæi tentantes : et rogaverunt eum ut signum de cælo ostenderet eis.
text_pt: E, chegando-se os fariseus e os saduceus, para o tentarem, pediram-lhe que lhes mostrasse algum sinal do céu.
text_el: Καὶ προσελθόντες [οἱ] Φαρισαῖοι καὶ Σαδδουκαῖοι πειράζοντες ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν σημεῖον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπιδεῖξαι αὐτοῖς.

text_en: But he answered and said to them: When it is evening, you say, It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.
text_la: At ille respondens, ait illis : Facto vespere dicitis : Serenum erit, rubicundum est enim cælum.
text_pt: Mas ele, respondendo, disse-lhes: Quando é chegada a tarde, dizeis: Haverá bom tempo, porque o céu está rubro.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, [[Ὀψίας γενομένης λέγετε: εὐδία, πυρράζει γὰρ ὁ οὐρανός:

text_en: And in the morning: Today there will be a storm, for the sky is red and lowering. You know then how to discern the face of the sky: and can you not know the signs of the times?
text_la: Et mane : Hodie tempestas, rutilat enim triste cælum.
text_pt: E, pela manhã: Hoje haverá tempestade, porque o céu está de um vermelho sombrio. Hipócritas, sabeis discernir a face do céu, e não conheceis os sinais dos tempos?
text_el: καὶ πρωΐ: σήμερον χειμών, πυρράζει γὰρ στυγνάζων ὁ οὐρανός. τὸ μὲν πρόσωπον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ γινώσκετε διακρίνειν, τὰ δὲ σημεῖα τῶν καιρῶν οὐ δύνασθε;]]

text_en: A wicked and adulterous generation seeks after a sign: and a sign shall not be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet . And he left them, and went away.
text_la: Faciem ergo cæli dijudicare nostis : signa autem temporum non potestis scire? Generatio mala et adultera signum quærit : et signum non dabitur ei, nisi signum Jonæ prophetæ. Et relictis illis, abiit.
text_pt: Uma geração má e adúltera pede um sinal, e nenhum sinal lhe será dado, senão o sinal do profeta Jonas. E, deixando-os, retirou-se.
text_el: γενεὰ πονηρὰ καὶ μοιχαλὶς σημεῖον ἐπιζητεῖ, καὶ σημεῖον οὐ δοθήσεται αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ τὸ σημεῖον Ἰωνᾶ. καὶ καταλιπὼν αὐτοὺς ἀπῆλθεν.

text_en: And when his disciples had come over the water, they had forgotten to take bread.
text_la: Et cum venissent discipuli ejus trans fretum, obliti sunt panes accipere.
text_pt: E, passando seus discípulos para o outro lado, tinham-se esquecido de trazer pão.
text_el: Καὶ ἐλθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ εἰς τὸ πέραν ἐπελάθοντο ἄρτους λαβεῖν.

text_en: Who said to them: Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees .
text_la: Qui dixit illis : Intuemini, et cavete a fermento pharisæorum et sadducæorum.
text_pt: E Jesus disse-lhes: Adverti, e acautelai-vos do fermento dos fariseus e saduceus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ὁρᾶτε καὶ προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων.

text_en: But they thought within themselves, saying: Because we have taken no bread.
text_la: At illi cogitabant intra se dicentes: Quia panes non accepimus.
text_pt: E eles arrazoavam entre si, dizendo: É porque não trouxemos pão.
text_el: οἱ δὲ διελογίζοντο ἐν ἑαυτοῖς λέγοντες ὅτι ἄρτους οὐκ ἐλάβομεν.

text_en: And Jesus knowing it, said: Why do you think within yourselves, O you of little faith , for that you have no bread?
text_la: Sciens autem Jesus, dixit : Quid cogitatis intra vos modicæ fidei, quia panes non habetis?
text_pt: E Jesus, percebendo isso, disse: Por que arrazoais entre vós, homens de pouca fé, sobre o não terdes trazido pão?
text_el: γνοὺς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: τί διαλογίζεσθε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς, ὀλιγόπιστοι, ὅτι ἄρτους οὐκ ἔχετε;

text_en: Do you not yet understand, neither do you remember the five loaves among five thousand men , and how many baskets you took up?
text_la: Nondum intelligitis, neque recordamini quinque panum in quinque millia hominum, et quot cophinos sumpsistis?
text_pt: Não compreendeis ainda, nem vos lembrais dos cinco pães para cinco mil homens, e de quantas alcofas levantastes?
text_el: οὔπω νοεῖτε, οὐδὲ μνημονεύετε τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους τῶν πεντακισχιλίων καὶ πόσους κοφίνους ἐλάβετε;

text_en: Nor the seven loaves, among four thousand men , and how many baskets you took up?
text_la: neque septem panum in quatuor millia hominum, et quot sportas sumpsistis?
text_pt: Nem dos sete pães para quatro mil, e de quantos cestos levantastes?
text_el: οὐδὲ τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἄρτους τῶν τετρακισχιλίων καὶ πόσας σπυρίδας ἐλάβετε;

text_en: Why do you not understand that it was not concerning bread I said to you: Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees ?
text_la: Quare non intelligitis, quia non de pane dixi vobis : Cavete a fermento pharisæorum et sadducæorum?
text_pt: Como não compreendestes que não vos falei a respeito do pão, mas que vos guardásseis do fermento dos fariseus e saduceus?
text_el: πῶς οὐ νοεῖτε ὅτι οὐ περὶ ἄρτων εἶπον ὑμῖν; προσέχετε δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων.

text_en: Then they understood that he said not that they should beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and Sadducees .
text_la: Tunc intellexerunt quia non dixerit cavendum a fermento panum, sed a doctrina pharisæorum et sadducæorum.
text_pt: Então compreenderam que não dissera que se guardassem do fermento do pão, mas da doutrina dos fariseus.
text_el: τότε συνῆκαν ὅτι οὐκ εἶπεν προσέχειν ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης [τῶν ἄρτων], ἀλλὰ ἀπὸ τῆς διδαχῆς τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων.

text_en: And Jesus came into the quarters of Caesarea Philippi : and he asked his disciples , saying: Whom do men say that the Son of man is?
text_la: Venit autem Jesus in partes Cæsareæ Philippi : et interrogabat discipulos suos, dicens : Quem dicunt homines esse Filium hominis?
text_pt: E, chegando Jesus às partes de Cesaréia de Filipe, interrogou os seus discípulos, dizendo: Quem dizem os homens ser o Filho do homem?
text_el: Ἐλθὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὰ μέρη Καισαρείας τῆς Φιλίππου ἠρώτα τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ λέγων: τίνα λέγουσιν οἱ ἄνθρωποι εἶναι τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου;

text_en: But they said: Some John the Baptist , and other some Elias , and others Jeremiah , or one of the prophets .
text_la: At illi dixerunt : Alii Joannem Baptistam, alii autem Eliam, alii vero Jeremiam, aut unum ex prophetis.
text_pt: E eles disseram: Uns, João o Batista; outros, Elias; e outros, Jeremias, ou um dos profetas.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: οἱ μὲν Ἰωάννην τὸν βαπτιστήν, ἄλλοι δὲ Ἠλίαν, ἕτεροι δὲ Ἰερεμίαν ἢ ἕνα τῶν προφητῶν.

text_en: Jesus says to them: But whom do you say that I am?
text_la: Dicit illis Jesus : Vos autem, quem me esse dicitis?
text_pt: Disse-lhes ele: E vós, quem dizeis que eu sou?
text_el: λέγει αὐτοῖς: ὑμεῖς δὲ τίνα με λέγετε εἶναι;

text_en: Simon Peter answered and said: You are Christ , the Son of the living God .
text_la: Respondens Simon Petrus dixit : Tu es Christus, Filius Dei vivi.
text_pt: E Simão Pedro, respondendo, disse: Tu és o Cristo, o Filho do Deus vivo.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Σίμων Πέτρος εἶπεν: σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ζῶντος.

text_en: And Jesus answering said to him: Blessed are you, Simon Bar-Jona : because flesh and blood has not revealed it to you, but my Father who is in heaven .
text_la: Respondens autem Jesus, dixit ei : Beatus es Simon Bar Jona : quia caro et sanguis non revelavit tibi, sed Pater meus, qui in cælis est.
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhe: Bem-aventurado és tu, Simão Barjonas, porque to não revelou a carne e o sangue, mas meu Pai, que está nos céus.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ: μακάριος εἶ, Σίμων Βαριωνᾶ, ὅτι σὰρξ καὶ αἷμα οὐκ ἀπεκάλυψέν σοι ἀλλ' ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ ἐν [τοῖς] οὐρανοῖς.

text_en: And I say to you: That you are Peter ; and upon this rock I will build my church , and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
text_la: Et ego dico tibi, quia tu es Petrus, et super hanc petram ædificabo Ecclesiam meam, et portæ inferi non prævalebunt adversus eam.
text_pt: Pois também eu te digo que tu és Pedro, e sobre esta pedra edificarei a minha igreja, e as portas do inferno não prevalecerão contra ela;
text_el: κἀγὼ δέ σοι λέγω ὅτι σὺ εἶ Πέτρος, καὶ ἐπὶ ταύτῃ τῇ πέτρᾳ οἰκοδομήσω μου τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, καὶ πύλαι ᾅδου οὐ κατισχύσουσιν αὐτῆς.

text_en: And I will give to you the keys of the kingdom of heaven . And whatsoever you shall bind upon earth, it shall be bound also in heaven : and whatsoever you shall loose on earth, it shall be loosed also in heaven .
text_la: Et tibi dabo claves regni cælorum. Et quodcumque ligaveris super terram, erit ligatum et in cælis : et quodcumque solveris super terram, erit solutum et in cælis.
text_pt: E eu te darei as chaves do reino dos céus; e tudo o que ligares na terra será ligado nos céus, e tudo o que desligares na terra será desligado nos céus.
text_el: δώσω σοι τὰς κλεῖδας τῆς βασιλείας τῶν οὐρανῶν, καὶ ὃ ἐὰν δήσῃς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται δεδεμένον ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, καὶ ὃ ἐὰν λύσῃς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται λελυμένον ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

text_en: Then he commanded his disciples , that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ .
text_la: Tunc præcepit discipulis suis ut nemini dicerent quia ipse esset Jesus Christus.
text_pt: Então mandou aos seus discípulos que a ninguém dissessem que ele era Jesus o Cristo.
text_el: τότε ἐπετίμησεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἵνα μηδενὶ εἴπωσιν ὅτι αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός.

text_en: From that time Jesus began to show to his disciples , that he must go to Jerusalem , and suffer many things from the ancients and scribes and chief priests , and be put to death , and the third day rise again .
text_la: Exinde cœpit Jesus ostendere discipulis suis, quia oporteret eum ire Jerosolymam, et multa pati a senioribus, et scribis, et principibus sacerdotum, et occidi, et tertia die resurgere.
text_pt: Desde então começou Jesus a mostrar aos seus discípulos que convinha ir a Jerusalém, e padecer muitas coisas dos anciãos, e dos principais dos sacerdotes, e dos escribas, e ser morto, e ressuscitar ao terceiro dia.
text_el: Ἀπὸ τότε ἤρξατο Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς δεικνύειν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ὅτι δεῖ αὐτὸν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἀπελθεῖν καὶ πολλὰ παθεῖν ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ ἀρχιερέων καὶ γραμματέων καὶ ἀποκτανθῆναι καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἐγερθῆναι.

text_en: And Peter taking him, began to rebuke him, saying: Lord, be it far from you, this shall not be unto you.
text_la: Et assumens eum Petrus, cœpit increpare illum dicens : Absit a te, Domine : non erit tibi hoc.
text_pt: E Pedro, tomando-o de parte, começou a repreendê-lo, dizendo: Senhor, tem compaixão de ti; de modo nenhum te acontecerá isso.
text_el: καὶ προσλαβόμενος αὐτὸν ὁ Πέτρος ἤρξατο ἐπιτιμᾶν αὐτῷ λέγων: ἵλεώς σοι, κύριε: οὐ μὴ ἔσται σοι τοῦτο.

text_en: Who turning, said to Peter : Go behind me, Satan , you are a scandal unto me: because you savour not the things that are of God , but the things that are of men .
text_la: Qui conversus, dixit Petro : Vade post me Satana, scandalum es mihi : quia non sapis ea quæ Dei sunt, sed ea quæ hominum.
text_pt: Ele, porém, voltando-se, disse a Pedro: Para trás de mim, Satanás, que me serves de escândalo; porque não compreendes as coisas que são de Deus, mas só as que são dos homens.
text_el: ὁ δὲ στραφεὶς εἶπεν τῷ Πέτρῳ: ὕπαγε ὀπίσω μου, Σατανᾶ: σκάνδαλον εἶ ἐμοῦ, ὅτι οὐ φρονεῖς τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἀλλὰ τὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: Then Jesus said to his disciples : If any man will come after me, let him deny himself , and take up his cross, and follow me.
text_la: Tunc Jesus dixit discipulis suis : Si quis vult post me venire, abneget semetipsum, et tollat crucem suam, et sequatur me.
text_pt: Então disse Jesus aos seus discípulos: Se alguém quiser vir após mim, renuncie-se a si mesmo, tome sobre si a sua cruz, e siga-me;
text_el: Τότε [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ: εἴ τις θέλει ὀπίσω μου ἐλθεῖν, ἀπαρνησάσθω ἑαυτὸν καὶ ἀράτω τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκολουθείτω μοι.

text_en: For he that will save his life, shall lose it: and he that shall lose his life for my sake, shall find it.
text_la: Qui enim voluerit animam suam salvam facere, perdet eam : qui autem perdiderit animam suam propter me, inveniet eam.
text_pt: Porque aquele que quiser salvar a sua vida, perdê-la-á, e quem perder a sua vida por amor de mim, achá-la-á.
text_el: ὃς γὰρ ἐὰν θέλῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ σῶσαι ἀπολέσει αὐτήν: ὃς δ' ἂν ἀπολέσῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ εὑρήσει αὐτήν.

text_en: For what does it profit a man , if he gain the whole world and suffer the loss of his own soul ? Or what exchange shall a man give for his soul ?
text_la: Quid enim prodest homini, si mundum universum lucretur, animæ vero suæ detrimentum patiatur? aut quam dabit homo commutationem pro anima sua?
text_pt: Pois que aproveita ao homem ganhar o mundo inteiro, se perder a sua alma? Ou que dará o homem em recompensa da sua alma?
text_el: τί γὰρ ὠφεληθήσεται ἄνθρωπος, ἐὰν τὸν κόσμον ὅλον κερδήσῃ τὴν δὲ ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ζημιωθῇ; ἢ τί δώσει ἄνθρωπος ἀντάλλαγμα τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ;

text_en: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels : and then will he render to every man according to his works .
text_la: Filius enim hominis venturus est in gloria Patris sui cum angelis suis : et tunc reddet unicuique secundum opera ejus.
text_pt: Porque o Filho do homem virá na glória de seu Pai, com os seus anjos; e então dará a cada um segundo as suas obras.
text_el: μέλλει γὰρ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔρχεσθαι ἐν τῇ δόξῃ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ, καὶ τότε ἀποδώσει ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὴν πρᾶξιν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Amen I say to you, there are some of them that stand here, that shall not taste death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom .
text_la: Amen dico vobis, sunt quidam de hic stantibus, qui non gustabunt mortem, donec videant Filium hominis venientem in regno suo.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que alguns há, dos que aqui estão, que não provarão a morte até que vejam vir o Filho do homem no seu reino.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἰσίν τινες τῶν ὧδε ἑστώτων οἵτινες οὐ μὴ γεύσωνται θανάτου ἕως ἂν ἴδωσιν τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And after six days Jesus takes unto him Peter and James , and John his brother, and brings them up into a high mountain apart:
text_la: Et post dies sex assumit Jesus Petrum, et Jacobum, et Joannem fratrem ejus, et ducit illos in montem excelsum seorsum:
text_pt: Seis dias depois, tomou Jesus consigo a Pedro, e a Tiago, e a João, seu irmão, e os conduziu em particular a um alto monte,
text_el: Καὶ μεθ' ἡμέρας ἓξ παραλαμβάνει ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὸν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰάκωβον καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀναφέρει αὐτοὺς εἰς ὄρος ὑψηλὸν κατ' ἰδίαν.

text_en: And he was transfigured before them. And his face did shine as the sun: and his garments became white as snow.
text_la: et transfiguratus est ante eos. Et resplenduit facies ejus sicut sol : vestimenta autem ejus facta sunt alba sicut nix.
text_pt: E transfigurou-se diante deles; e o seu rosto resplandeceu como o sol, e as suas vestes se tornaram brancas como a luz.
text_el: καὶ μετεμορφώθη ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἔλαμψεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος, τὰ δὲ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο λευκὰ ὡς τὸ φῶς.

text_en: And behold there appeared to them Moses and Elias talking with him.
text_la: Et ecce apparuerunt illis Moyses et Elias cum eo loquentes.
text_pt: E eis que lhes apareceram Moisés e Elias, falando com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ὤφθη αὐτοῖς Μωϋσῆς καὶ Ἠλίας συλλαλοῦντες μετ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And Peter answering, said to Jesus : Lord, it is good for us to be here: if you will, let us make here three tabernacles, one for you, and one for Moses , and one for Elias .
text_la: Respondens autem Petrus, dixit ad Jesum : Domine, bonum est nos hic esse : si vis, faciamus tria tabernacula, tibi unum, Moysi unum, et Eliæ unum.
text_pt: E Pedro, tomando a palavra, disse a Jesus: Senhor, bom é estarmos aqui; se queres, façamos aqui três tabernáculos, um para ti, um para Moisés, e um para Elias.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ: κύριε, καλόν ἐστιν ἡμᾶς ὧδε εἶναι: εἰ θέλεις, ποιήσω ὧδε τρεῖς σκηνάς, σοὶ μίαν καὶ Μωϋσεῖ μίαν καὶ Ἠλίᾳ μίαν.

text_en: And as he was yet speaking, behold a bright cloud overshadowed them. And lo a voice out of the cloud, saying: This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased: hear him.
text_la: Adhuc eo loquente, ecce nubes lucida obumbravit eos. Et ecce vox de nube, dicens : Hic est Filius meus dilectus, in quo mihi bene complacui : ipsum audite.
text_pt: E, estando ele ainda a falar, eis que uma nuvem luminosa os cobriu. E da nuvem saiu uma voz que dizia: Este é o meu amado Filho, em quem me comprazo; escutai-o.
text_el: ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος, ἰδοὺ νεφέλη φωτεινὴ ἐπεσκίασεν αὐτούς, καὶ ἰδοὺ φωνὴ ἐκ τῆς νεφέλης λέγουσα: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν ᾧ εὐδόκησα: ἀκούετε αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the disciples hearing fell upon their face, and were very much afraid.
text_la: Et audientes discipuli ceciderunt in faciem suam, et timuerunt valde.
text_pt: E os discípulos, ouvindo isto, caíram sobre os seus rostos, e tiveram grande medo.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ μαθηταὶ ἔπεσαν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν σφόδρα.

text_en: And Jesus came and touched them: and said to them: Arise, and fear not.
text_la: Et accessit Jesus, et tetigit eos : dixitque eis : Surgite, et nolite timere.
text_pt: E, aproximando-se Jesus, tocou-lhes, e disse: Levantai-vos, e não tenhais medo.
text_el: καὶ προσῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἁψάμενος αὐτῶν εἶπεν: ἐγέρθητε καὶ μὴ φοβεῖσθε.

text_en: And they lifting up their eyes, saw no one, but only Jesus .
text_la: Levantes autem oculos suos, neminem viderunt, nisi solum Jesum.
text_pt: E, erguendo eles os olhos, ninguém viram senão unicamente a Jesus.
text_el: ἐπάραντες δὲ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν οὐδένα εἶδον εἰ μὴ αὐτὸν Ἰησοῦν μόνον.

text_en: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying: Tell the vision to no man , till the Son of man be risen from the dead .
text_la: Et descendentibus illis de monte, præcepit eis Jesus, dicens : Nemini dixeritis visionem, donec Filius hominis a mortuis resurgat.
text_pt: E, descendo eles do monte, Jesus lhes ordenou, dizendo: A ninguém conteis a visão, até que o Filho do homem seja ressuscitado dentre os mortos.
text_el: καὶ καταβαινόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων: μηδενὶ εἴπητε τὸ ὅραμα ἕως οὗ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ νεκρῶν ἐγερθῇ.

text_en: And his disciples asked him, saying: Why then do the scribes say that Elias must come first?
text_la: Et interrogaverunt eum discipuli, dicentes : Quid ergo scribæ dicunt, quod Eliam oporteat primum venire?
text_pt: E os seus discípulos o interrogaram, dizendo: Por que dizem então os escribas que é mister que Elias venha primeiro?
text_el: Καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ λέγοντες: τί οὖν οἱ γραμματεῖς λέγουσιν ὅτι Ἠλίαν δεῖ ἐλθεῖν πρῶτον;

text_en: But he answering, said to them: Elias indeed shall come, and restore all things.
text_la: At ille respondens, ait eis : Elias quidem venturus est, et restituet omnia.
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Em verdade Elias virá primeiro, e restaurará todas as coisas;
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: Ἠλίας μὲν ἔρχεται καὶ ἀποκαταστήσει πάντα.

text_en: But I say to you, that Elias is already come, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they had a mind. So also the Son of man shall suffer from them.
text_la: Dico autem vobis, quia Elias jam venit, et non cognoverunt eum, sed fecerunt in eo quæcumque voluerunt. Sic et Filius hominis passurus est ab eis.
text_pt: Mas digo-vos que Elias já veio, e não o conheceram, mas fizeram-lhe tudo o que quiseram. Assim farão eles também padecer o Filho do homem.
text_el: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι Ἠλίας ἤδη ἦλθεν, καὶ οὐκ ἐπέγνωσαν αὐτὸν, ἀλλὰ ἐποίησαν ἐν αὐτῷ ὅσα ἠθέλησαν. οὕτως καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου μέλλει πάσχειν ὑπ' αὐτῶν.

text_en: Then the disciples understood, that he had spoken to them of John the Baptist .
text_la: Tunc intellexerunt discipuli, quia de Joanne Baptista dixisset eis.
text_pt: Então entenderam os discípulos que lhes falara de João o Batista.
text_el: τότε συνῆκαν οἱ μαθηταὶ ὅτι περὶ Ἰωάννου τοῦ βαπτιστοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And when he had come to the multitude, there came to him a man falling down on his knees before him saying: Lord, have pity on my son, for he is a lunatic , and suffers much: for he falls often into the fire, and often into the water.
text_la: Et cum venisset ad turbam, accessit ad eum homo genibus provolutus ante eum, dicens : Domine, miserere filio meo, quia lunaticus est, et male patitur : nam sæpe cadit in ignem, et crebro in aquam.
text_pt: E, quando chegaram à multidão, aproximou-se-lhe um homem, pondo-se de joelhos diante dele, e dizendo:
text_el: Καὶ ἐλθόντων πρὸς τὸν ὄχλον, προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ ἄνθρωπος γονυπετῶν αὐτὸν

text_en: And I brought him to your disciples , and they could not cure him.
text_la: Et obtuli eum discipulis tuis, et non potuerunt curare eum.
text_pt: Senhor, tem misericórdia de meu filho, que é lunático e sofre muito; pois muitas vezes cai no fogo, e muitas vezes na água;
text_el: καὶ λέγων: κύριε, ἐλέησόν μου τὸν υἱόν, ὅτι σεληνιάζεται καὶ κακῶς ἔχει: πολλάκις γὰρ πίπτει εἰς τὸ πῦρ καὶ πολλάκις εἰς τὸ ὕδωρ.

text_en: Then Jesus answered and said: O unbelieving and perverse generation , how long shall I be with you? How long shall I suffer you? Bring him hither to me.
text_la: Respondens autem Jesus, ait : O generatio incredula, et perversa, quousque ero vobiscum? usquequo patiar vos? Afferte huc illum ad me.
text_pt: E trouxe-o aos teus discípulos; e não puderam curá-lo.
text_el: καὶ προσήνεγκα αὐτὸν τοῖς μαθηταῖς σου, καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν αὐτὸν θεραπεῦσαι.

text_en: And Jesus rebuked him, and the devil went out of him, and the child was cured from that hour.
text_la: Et increpavit illum Jesus, et exiit ab eo dæmonium, et curatus est puer ex illa hora.
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse: Ó geração incrédula e perversa! até quando estarei eu convosco, e até quando vos sofrerei? Trazeimo aqui.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: ὦ γενεὰ ἄπιστος καὶ διεστραμμένη, ἕως πότε μεθ' ὑμῶν ἔσομαι; ἕως πότε ἀνέξομαι ὑμῶν; φέρετέ μοι αὐτὸν ὧδε.

text_en: Then came the disciples to Jesus secretly, and said: Why could not we cast him out?
text_la: Tunc accesserunt discipuli ad Jesum secreto, et dixerunt : Quare nos non potuimus ejicere illum?
text_pt: E, repreendeu Jesus o demônio, que saiu dele, e desde aquela hora o menino sarou.
text_el: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ τὸ δαιμόνιον, καὶ ἐθεραπεύθη ὁ παῖς ἀπὸ τῆς ὥρας ἐκείνης.

text_en: Jesus said to them: Because of your unbelief. For, amen I say to you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you shall say to this mountain: Remove from hence hither, and it shall remove: and nothing shall be impossible to you.
text_la: Dixit illis Jesus : Propter incredulitatem vestram. Amen quippe dico vobis, si habueritis fidem sicut granum sinapis, dicetis monti huic : Transi hinc illuc, et transibit, et nihil impossibile erit vobis.
text_pt: Então os discípulos, aproximando-se de Jesus em particular, disseram: Por que não pudemos nós expulsá-lo?
text_el: Τότε προσελθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ τῷ Ἰησοῦ κατ' ἰδίαν εἶπον: διὰ τί ἡμεῖς οὐκ ἠδυνήθημεν ἐκβαλεῖν αὐτό;

text_en: But this kind is not cast out but by prayer and fasting .
text_la: Hoc autem genus non ejicitur nisi per orationem et jejunium.
text_pt: E Jesus lhes disse: Por causa de vossa incredulidade; porque em verdade vos digo que, se tiverdes fé como um grão de mostarda, direis a este monte: Passa daqui para acolá, e há de passar; e nada vos será impossível.
text_el: ὁ δὲ λέγει αὐτοῖς: διὰ τὴν ὀλιγοπιστίαν ὑμῶν: ἀμὴν γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν ἔχητε πίστιν ὡς κόκκον σινάπεως, ἐρεῖτε τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ: μετάβα ἔνθεν ἐκεῖ, καὶ μεταβήσεται, καὶ οὐδὲν ἀδυνατήσει ὑμῖν.

text_en: And when they abode together in Galilee , Jesus said to them: The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men :
text_la: Conversantibus autem eis in Galilæa, dixit illis Jesus : Filius hominis tradendus est in manus hominum:
text_pt: Mas esta casta de demônios não se expulsa senão pela oração e pelo jejum.
text_el: Συστρεφομένων δὲ αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, μέλλει ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοσθαι εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων,

text_en: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall rise again . And they were troubled exceedingly.
text_la: et occident eum, et tertia die resurget. Et contristati sunt vehementer.
text_pt: Ora, achando-se eles na Galiléia, disse-lhes Jesus: O Filho do homem será entregue nas mãos dos homens;
text_el: καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν αὐτόν, καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἐγερθήσεται. καὶ ἐλυπήθησαν σφόδρα.

text_en: And when they had come to Capharnaum , they that received the didrachmas, came to Peter , and said to him: Does not your master pay the didrachmas?
text_la: Et cum venissent Capharnaum, accesserunt qui didrachma accipiebant ad Petrum, et dixerunt ei : Magister vester non solvit didrachma?
text_pt: E matá-lo-ão, e ao terceiro dia ressuscitará. E eles se entristeceram muito.
text_el: Ἐλθόντων δὲ αὐτῶν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ προσῆλθον οἱ τὰ δίδραχμα λαμβάνοντες τῷ Πέτρῳ καὶ εἶπαν: ὁ διδάσκαλος ὑμῶν οὐ τελεῖ τὰ δίδραχμα;

text_en: He said: Yes. And when he had come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying: What is your opinion, Simon ? The kings of the earth, of whom do they receive tribute or custom, of their own children, or of strangers?
text_la: Ait : Etiam. Et cum intrasset in domum, prævenit eum Jesus, dicens : Quid tibi videtur Simon? reges terræ a quibus accipiunt tributum vel censum? a filiis suis, an ab alienis?
text_pt: E, chegando eles a Cafarnaum, aproximaram-se de Pedro os que cobravam as dracmas, e disseram: O vosso mestre não paga as dracmas?
text_el: λέγει: ναί. καὶ ἐλθόντα εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν προέφθασεν αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων: τί σοι δοκεῖ, Σίμων; οἱ Βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς ἀπὸ τίνων λαμβάνουσιν τέλη ἢ κῆνσον; ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτῶν ἢ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀλλοτρίων;

text_en: And he said: Of strangers. Jesus said to him: Then the children are free.
text_la: Et ille dixit : Ab alienis. Dixit illi Jesus : Ergo liberi sunt filii.
text_pt: Disse ele: Sim. E, entrando em casa, Jesus se lhe antecipou, dizendo: Que te parece, Simão? De quem cobram os reis da terra os tributos, ou o censo? Dos seus filhos, ou dos alheios?
text_el: εἰπόντος δέ: ἀπὸ τῶν ἀλλοτρίων, ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἄρα γε ἐλεύθεροί εἰσιν οἱ υἱοί.

text_en: But that we may not scandalize them, go to the sea, and cast in a hook: and that fish which shall first come up, take: and when you have opened it's mouth, you shall find a stater: take that, and give it to them for me and you.
text_la: Ut autem non scandalizemus eos, vade ad mare, et mitte hamum : et eum piscem, qui primus ascenderit, tolle : et aperto ore ejus, invenies staterem : illum sumens, da eis pro me et te.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Pedro: Dos alheios. Disse-lhe Jesus: Logo, estão livres os filhos.
text_el: ἵνα δὲ μὴ σκανδαλίσωμεν αὐτούς, πορευθεὶς εἰς θάλασσαν βάλε ἄγκιστρον καὶ τὸν ἀναβάντα πρῶτον ἰχθὺν ἆρον, καὶ ἀνοίξας τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ εὑρήσεις στατῆρα: ἐκεῖνον λαβὼν δὸς αὐτοῖς ἀντὶ ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ.

text_en: At that hour the disciples came to Jesus , saying: Who, do you think, is the greater in the kingdom of heaven ?
text_la: In illa hora accesserunt discipuli ad Jesum, dicentes : Quis, putas, major est in regno cælorum?
text_pt: Naquela mesma hora chegaram os discípulos ao pé de Jesus, dizendo: Quem é o maior no reino dos céus?
text_el: Ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ προσῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες: τίς ἄρα μείζων ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν;

text_en: And Jesus , calling unto him a little child, set him in the midst of them.
text_la: Et advocans Jesus parvulum, statuit eum in medio eorum,
text_pt: E Jesus, chamando um menino, o pôs no meio deles,
text_el: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος παιδίον ἔστησεν αὐτὸ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν

text_en: And said: amen I say to you, unless you be converted , and become as little children, you shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven .
text_la: et dixit : Amen dico vobis, nisi conversi fueritis, et efficiamini sicut parvuli, non intrabitis in regnum cælorum.
text_pt: E disse: Em verdade vos digo que, se não vos converterdes e não vos fizerdes como meninos, de modo algum entrareis no reino dos céus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν μὴ στραφῆτε καὶ γένησθε ὡς τὰ παιδία, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν.

text_en: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, he is the greater in the kingdom of heaven .
text_la: Quicumque ergo humiliaverit se sicut parvulus iste, hic est major in regno cælorum.
text_pt: Portanto, aquele que se tornar humilde como este menino, esse é o maior no reino dos céus.
text_el: ὅστις οὖν ταπεινώσει ἑαυτὸν ὡς τὸ παιδίον τοῦτο, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μείζων ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν.

text_en: And he that shall receive one such little child in my name , receives me.
text_la: Et qui susceperit unum parvulum talem in nomine meo, me suscipit:
text_pt: E qualquer que receber em meu nome um menino, tal como este, a mim me recebe.
text_el: καὶ ὃς ἐὰν δέξηται ἓν παιδίον τοιοῦτο ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐμὲ δέχεται.

text_en: But he that shall scandalize one of these little ones that believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone should be hanged about his neck, and that he should be drowned in the depth of the sea.
text_la: qui autem scandalizaverit unum de pusillis istis, qui in me credunt, expedit ei ut suspendatur mola asinaria in collo ejus, et demergatur in profundum maris.
text_pt: Mas, qualquer que escandalizar um destes pequeninos, que crêem em mim, melhor lhe fora que se lhe pendurasse ao pescoço uma mó de azenha, e se submergisse na profundeza do mar.
text_el: ὃς δ' ἂν σκανδαλίσῃ ἕνα τῶν μικρῶν τούτων τῶν πιστευόντων εἰς ἐμέ, συμφέρει αὐτῷ ἵνα κρεμασθῇ μύλος ὀνικὸς περὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ καὶ καταποντισθῇ ἐν τῷ πελάγει τῆς θαλάσσης.

text_en: Woe to the world because of scandals . For it must needs be that scandals come: but nevertheless woe to that man by whom the scandal comes.
text_la: Væ mundo a scandalis! Necesse est enim ut veniant scandala : verumtamen væ homini illi, per quem scandalum venit.
text_pt: Ai do mundo, por causa dos escândalos; porque é mister que venham escândalos, mas ai daquele homem por quem o escândalo vem!
text_el: Οὐαὶ τῷ κόσμῳ ἀπὸ τῶν σκανδάλων: ἀνάγκη γὰρ ἐλθεῖν τὰ σκάνδαλα, πλὴν οὐαὶ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ δι' οὗ τὸ σκάνδαλον ἔρχεται.

text_en: And if your hand, or your foot, scandalize you, cut it off, and cast it from you. It is better for you to go into life maimed or lame, than having two hands or two feet, to be cast into everlasting fire .
text_la: Si autem manus tua, vel pes tuus scandalizat te, abscide eum, et projice abs te : bonum tibi est ad vitam ingredi debilem, vel claudum, quam duas manus vel duos pedes habentem mitti in ignem æternum.
text_pt: Portanto, se a tua mão ou o teu pé te escandalizar, corta-o, e atira-o para longe de ti; melhor te é entrar na vida coxo, ou aleijado, do que, tendo duas mãos ou dois pés, seres lançado no fogo eterno.
text_el: εἰ δὲ ἡ χείρ σου ἢ ὁ πούς σου σκανδαλίζει σε, ἔκκοψον αὐτὸν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ: καλόν σοί ἐστιν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν ζωὴν κυλλὸν ἢ χωλόν, ἢ δύο χεῖρας ἢ δύο πόδας ἔχοντα βληθῆναι εἰς τὸ πῦρ τὸ αἰώνιον.

text_en: And if your eye scandalize you, pluck it out, and cast it from you. It is better for you having one eye to enter into life , than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire .
text_la: Et si oculus tuus scandalizat te, erue eum, et projice abs te : bonum tibi est cum uno oculo in vitam intrare, quam duos oculos habentem mitti in gehennam ignis.
text_pt: E, se o teu olho te escandalizar, arranca-o, e atira-o para longe de ti; melhor te é entrar na vida com um só olho, do que, tendo dois olhos, seres lançado no fogo do inferno.
text_el: καὶ εἰ ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου σκανδαλίζει σε, ἔξελε αὐτὸν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ: καλόν σοί ἐστιν μονόφθαλμον εἰς τὴν ζωὴν εἰσελθεῖν, ἢ δύο ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχοντα βληθῆναι εἰς τὴν γέενναν τοῦ πυρός.

text_en: See that you despise not one of these little ones: for I say to you, that their angels in heaven always see the face of my Father who is in heaven .
text_la: Videte ne contemnatis unum ex his pusillis : dico enim vobis, quia angeli eorum in cælis semper vident faciem Patris mei, qui in cælis est.
text_pt: Vede, não desprezeis algum destes pequeninos, porque eu vos digo que os seus anjos nos céus sempre vêem a face de meu Pai que está nos céus.
text_el: Ὁρᾶτε μὴ καταφρονήσητε ἑνὸς τῶν μικρῶν τούτων: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτῶν ἐν οὐρανοῖς διὰ παντὸς βλέπουσι τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς.

text_en: For the Son of man has come to save that which was lost.
text_la: Venit enim Filius hominis salvare quod perierat.
text_pt: Porque o Filho do homem veio salvar o que se tinha perdido.

text_en: What think you? If a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them should go astray: does he not leave the ninety-nine in the mountains, and goes to seek that which has gone astray?
text_la: Quid vobis videtur? si fuerint alicui centum oves, et erravit una ex eis : nonne relinquit nonaginta novem in montibus, et vadit quærere eam quæ erravit?
text_pt: Que vos parece? Se algum homem tiver cem ovelhas, e uma delas se desgarrar, não irá pelos montes, deixando as noventa e nove, em busca da que se desgarrou?
text_el: Τί ὑμῖν δοκεῖ; ἐὰν γένηταί τινι ἀνθρώπῳ ἑκατὸν πρόβατα καὶ πλανηθῇ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν, οὐχὶ ἀφήσει τὰ ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη καὶ πορευθεὶς ζητεῖ τὸ πλανώμενον;

text_en: And if it so be that he find it: Amen I say to you, he rejoices more for that, than for the ninety-nine that went not astray.
text_la: Et si contigerit ut inveniat eam : amen dico vobis, quia gaudet super eam magis quam super nonaginta novem, quæ non erraverunt.
text_pt: E, se porventura achá-la, em verdade vos digo que maior prazer tem por aquela do que pelas noventa e nove que se não desgarraram.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν γένηται εὑρεῖν αὐτό, ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι χαίρει ἐπ' αὐτῷ μᾶλλον ἢ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα τοῖς μὴ πεπλανημένοις.

text_en: Even so it is not the will of your Father , who is in heaven , that one of these little ones should perish.
text_la: Sic non est voluntas ante Patrem vestrum, qui in cælis est, ut pereat unus de pusillis istis.
text_pt: Assim, também, não é vontade de vosso Pai, que está nos céus, que um destes pequeninos se perca.
text_el: οὕτως οὐκ ἔστιν θέλημα ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ πατρὸς μου τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς ἵνα ἀπόληται ἓν τῶν μικρῶν τούτων.

text_en: But if your brother shall offend against you, go, and rebuke him between you and him alone. If he shall hear you, you shall gain your brother.
text_la: Si autem peccaverit in te frater tuus, vade, et corripe eum inter te, et ipsum solum : si te audierit, lucratus eris fratrem tuum.
text_pt: Ora, se teu irmão pecar contra ti, vai, e repreende-o entre ti e ele só; se te ouvir, ganhaste a teu irmão;
text_el: Ἐὰν δὲ ἁμαρτήσῃ ὁ ἀδελφός σου, ὕπαγε ἔλεγξον αὐτὸν μεταξὺ σοῦ καὶ αὐτοῦ μόνου: ἐάν σου ἀκούσῃ, ἐκέρδησας τὸν ἀδελφόν σου.

text_en: And if he will not hear you, take with you one or two more: that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may stand.
text_la: Si autem te non audierit, adhibe tecum adhuc unum, vel duos, ut in ore duorum, vel trium testium stet omne verbum.
text_pt: Mas, se não te ouvir, leva ainda contigo um ou dois, para que pela boca de duas ou três testemunhas toda a palavra seja confirmada.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ἀκούσῃ, παράλαβε μετὰ σοῦ ἔτι ἕνα ἢ δύο, ἵνα ἐπὶ στόματος δύο μαρτύρων ἢ τριῶν σταθῇ πᾶν ῥῆμα.

text_en: And if he will not hear them: tell the church . And if he will not hear the church , let him be to you as the heathen and publican .
text_la: Quod si non audierit eos : dic ecclesiæ. Si autem ecclesiam non audierit, sit tibi sicut ethnicus et publicanus.
text_pt: E, se não as escutar, dize-o à igreja; e, se também não escutar a igreja, considera-o como um gentio e publicano.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ παρακούσῃ αὐτῶν, εἰπὸν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ τῆς ἐκκλησίας παρακούσῃ, ἔστω σοι ὥσπερ ὁ ἐθνικὸς καὶ ὁ τελώνης.

text_en: Amen I say to you, whatsoever you shall bind upon earth, shall be bound also in heaven : and whatsoever you shall loose upon earth, shall be loosed also in heaven .
text_la: Amen dico vobis, quæcumque alligaveritis super terram, erunt ligata et in cælo : et quæcumque solveritis super terram, erunt soluta et in cælo.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que tudo o que ligardes na terra será ligado no céu, e tudo o que desligardes na terra será desligado no céu.
text_el: Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅσα ἐὰν δήσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται δεδεμένα ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ὅσα ἐὰν λύσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται λελυμένα ἐν οὐρανῷ.

text_en: Again I say to you, that if two of you shall consent upon earth, concerning anything whatsoever they shall ask, it shall be done to them by my Father who is in heaven .
text_la: Iterum dico vobis, quia si duo ex vobis consenserint super terram, de omni re quamcumque petierint, fiet illis a Patre meo, qui in cælis est.
text_pt: Também vos digo que, se dois de vós concordarem na terra acerca de qualquer coisa que pedirem, isso lhes será feito por meu Pai, que está nos céus.
text_el: Πάλιν [ἀμὴν] λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν δύο συμφωνήσωσιν ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς περὶ παντὸς πράγματος οὗ ἐὰν αἰτήσωνται, γενήσεται αὐτοῖς παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς.

text_en: For where there are two or three gathered together in my name , there am I in the midst of them.
text_la: Ubi enim sunt duo vel tres congregati in nomine meo, ibi sum in medio eorum.
text_pt: Porque, onde estiverem dois ou três reunidos em meu nome, aí estou eu no meio deles.
text_el: οὗ γάρ εἰσιν δύο ἢ τρεῖς συνηγμένοι εἰς τὸ ἐμὸν ὄνομα, ἐκεῖ εἰμι ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν.

text_en: Then came Peter unto him and said: Lord, how often shall my brother offend against me, and I forgive him? Till seven times?
text_la: Tunc accedens Petrus ad eum, dixit : Domine, quoties peccabit in me frater meus, et dimittam ei? usque septies?
text_pt: Então Pedro, aproximando-se dele, disse: Senhor, até quantas vezes pecará meu irmão contra mim, e eu lhe perdoarei? Até sete?
text_el: Τότε προσελθὼν ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν [αὐτῷ]: κύριε, ποσάκις ἁμαρτήσει εἰς ἐμὲ ὁ ἀδελφός μου καὶ ἀφήσω αὐτῷ; ἕως ἑπτάκις;

text_en: Jesus said to him: I say not to you, till seven times; but till seventy times seven times.
text_la: Dicit illi Jesus : Non dico tibi usque septies : sed usque septuagies septies.
text_pt: Jesus lhe disse: Não te digo que até sete; mas, até setenta vezes sete.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: οὐ λέγω σοι ἕως ἑπτάκις, ἀλλὰ' ἕως ἑβδομηκοντάκις ἑπτά.

text_en: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened to a king, who would take an account of his servants.
text_la: Ideo assimilatum est regnum cælorum homini regi, qui voluit rationem ponere cum servis suis.
text_pt: Por isso o reino dos céus pode comparar-se a um certo rei que quis fazer contas com os seus servos;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ὡμοιώθη ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἀνθρώπῳ βασιλεῖ, ὃς ἠθέλησεν συνᾶραι λόγον μετὰ τῶν δούλων αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And when he had begun to take the account, one was brought to him, that owed him ten thousand talents.
text_la: Et cum cœpisset rationem ponere, oblatus est ei unus, qui debebat ei decem millia talenta.
text_pt: E, começando a fazer contas, foi-lhe apresentado um que lhe devia dez mil talentos;
text_el: ἀρξαμένου δὲ αὐτοῦ συναίρειν προσήχθη εἷς αὐτῷ ὀφειλέτης μυρίων ταλάντων.

text_en: And as he had not wherewith to pay it, his lord commanded that he should be sold, and his wife and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
text_la: Cum autem non haberet unde redderet, jussit eum dominus ejus venundari, et uxorem ejus, et filios, et omnia quæ habebat, et reddi.
text_pt: E, não tendo ele com que pagar, o seu senhor mandou que ele, e sua mulher e seus filhos fossem vendidos, com tudo quanto tinha, para que a dívida se lhe pagasse.
text_el: μὴ ἔχοντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀποδοῦναι, ἐκέλευσεν αὐτὸν ὁ κύριος πραθῆναι καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ τὰ τέκνα καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἔχει, καὶ ἀποδοθῆναι.

text_en: But that servant falling down, besought him, saying: Have patience with me, and I will pay you all.
text_la: Procidens autem servus ille, orabat eum, dicens : Patientiam habe in me, et omnia reddam tibi.
text_pt: Então aquele servo, prostrando-se, o reverenciava, dizendo: Senhor, sê generoso para comigo, e tudo te pagarei.
text_el: πεσὼν οὖν ὁ δοῦλος προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγων: μακροθύμησον ἐπ' ἐμοί, καὶ πάντα ἀποδώσω σοι.

text_en: And the lord of that servant being moved with pity, let him go and forgave him the debt .
text_la: Misertus autem dominus servi illius, dimisit eum, et debitum dimisit ei.
text_pt: Então o Senhor daquele servo, movido de íntima compaixão, soltou-o e perdoou-lhe a dívida.
text_el: σπλαγχνισθεὶς δὲ ὁ κύριος τοῦ δούλου [ἐκείνου] ἀπέλυσεν αὐτόν, καὶ τὸ δάνειον ἀφῆκεν αὐτῷ.

text_en: But when that servant had gone out, he found one of his fellow-servants that owed him an hundred pence: and laying hold of him, he throttled him, saying: Pay what you owe.
text_la: Egressus autem servus ille invenit unum de conservis suis, qui debebat ei centum denarios : et tenens suffocavit eum, dicens : Redde quod debes.
text_pt: Saindo, porém, aquele servo, encontrou um dos seus conservos, que lhe devia cem dinheiros, e, lançando mão dele, sufocava-o, dizendo: Paga-me o que me deves.
text_el: ἐξελθὼν δὲ ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος εὗρεν ἕνα τῶν συνδούλων αὐτοῦ ὃς ὤφειλεν αὐτῷ ἑκατὸν δηνάρια, καὶ κρατήσας αὐτὸν ἔπνιγεν λέγων: ἀπόδος εἴ τι ὀφείλεις.

text_en: And his fellow-servant falling down, besought him, saying: Have patience with me, and I will pay you all.
text_la: Et procidens conservus ejus, rogabat eum, dicens : Patientiam habe in me, et omnia reddam tibi.
text_pt: Então o seu companheiro, prostrando-se a seus pés, rogava-lhe, dizendo: Sê generoso para comigo, e tudo te pagarei.
text_el: πεσὼν οὖν ὁ σύνδουλος αὐτοῦ παρεκάλει αὐτὸν λέγων, μακροθύμησον ἐπ' ἐμοί, καὶ ἀποδώσω σοι.

text_en: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison , till he paid the debt .
text_la: Ille autem noluit : sed abiit, et misit eum in carcerem donec redderet debitum.
text_pt: Ele, porém, não quis, antes foi encerrá-lo na prisão, até que pagasse a dívida.
text_el: ὁ δὲ οὐκ ἤθελεν, ἀλλὰ ἀπελθὼν ἔβαλεν αὐτὸν εἰς φυλακὴν ἕως ἀποδῷ τὸ ὀφειλόμενον.

text_en: Now his fellow servants seeing what was done, were very much grieved, and they came, and told their lord all that was done.
text_la: Videntes autem conservi ejus quæ fiebant, contristati sunt valde : et venerunt, et narraverunt domino suo omnia quæ facta fuerant.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, os seus conservos o que acontecia, contristaram-se muito, e foram declarar ao seu senhor tudo o que se passara.
text_el: ἰδόντες οὖν οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτοῦ τὰ γενόμενα ἐλυπήθησαν σφόδρα, καὶ ἐλθόντες διεσάφησαν τῷ κυρίῳ ἑαυτῶν πάντα τὰ γενόμενα.

text_en: Then his lord called him: and said to him: You wicked servant, I forgave you all the debt , because you besought me:
text_la: Tunc vocavit illum dominus suus : et ait illi : Serve nequam, omne debitum dimisi tibi quoniam rogasti me:
text_pt: Então o seu senhor, chamando-o à sua presença, disse-lhe: Servo malvado, perdoei-te toda aquela dívida, porque me suplicaste.
text_el: τότε προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτὸν ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ λέγει αὐτῷ: δοῦλε πονηρέ, πᾶσαν τὴν ὀφειλὴν ἐκείνην ἀφῆκά σοι, ἐπεὶ παρεκάλεσάς με:

text_en: Should you not then have had compassion also on your fellow servant, even as I had compassion on you?
text_la: nonne ergo oportuit et te misereri conservi tui, sicut et ego tui misertus sum?
text_pt: Não devias tu, igualmente, ter compaixão do teu companheiro, como eu também tive misericórdia de ti?
text_el: οὐκ ἔδει καὶ σὲ ἐλεῆσαι τὸν σύνδουλόν σου, ὡς κἀγὼ σὲ ἠλέησα;

text_en: And his lord being angry , delivered him to the torturers until he paid all the debt .
text_la: Et iratus dominus ejus tradidit eum tortoribus, quoadusque redderet universum debitum.
text_pt: E, indignado, o seu senhor o entregou aos atormentadores, até que pagasse tudo o que lhe devia.
text_el: καὶ ὀργισθεὶς ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ παρέδωκεν αὐτὸν τοῖς βασανισταῖς ἕως [οὗ] ἀποδῷ πᾶν τὸ ὀφειλόμενον.

text_en: So also shall my heavenly Father do to you, if you forgive not every one his brother from your hearts.
text_la: Sic et Pater meus cælestis faciet vobis, si non remiseritis unusquisque fratri suo de cordibus vestris.
text_pt: Assim vos fará, também, meu Pai celestial, se do coração não perdoardes, cada um a seu irmão, as suas ofensas.
text_el: Οὕτως καὶ ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ οὐράνιος ποιήσει ὑμῖν, ἐὰν μὴ ἀφῆτε ἕκαστος τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν καρδιῶν ὑμῶν.

text_en: And it came to pass when Jesus had ended these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the coasts of Judea , beyond Jordan .
text_la: Et factum est, cum consummasset Jesus sermones istos, migravit a Galilæa, et venit in fines Judææ trans Jordanem,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, concluindo Jesus estes discursos, saiu da Galiléia, e dirigiu- se aos confins da Judéia, além do Jordão;
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοὺς λόγους τούτους, μετῆρεν ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὰ ὅρια τῆς Ἰουδαίας πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου.

text_en: And great multitudes followed him: and he healed them there.
text_la: et secutæ sunt eum turbæ multæ, et curavit eos ibi.
text_pt: E seguiram-no grandes multidões, e curou-as ali.
text_el: Καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ.

text_en: And there came to him the Pharisees tempting him, saying: Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
text_la: Et accesserunt ad eum pharisæi tentantes eum, et dicentes : Si licet homini dimittere uxorem suam, quacumque ex causa?
text_pt: Então chegaram ao pé dele os fariseus, tentando-o, e dizendo-lhe: É lícito ao homem repudiar sua mulher por qualquer motivo?
text_el: καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ Φαρισαῖοι πειράζοντες αὐτὸν καὶ λέγοντες εἰ: ἔξεστιν ἀπολῦσαι τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ κατὰ πᾶσαν αἰτίαν;

text_en: Who answering, said to them: Have you not read, that he who made man from the beginning, made them male and female ? And he said:
text_la: Qui respondens, ait eis : Non legistis, quia qui fecit hominem ab initio, masculum et feminam fecit eos? Et dixit:
text_pt: Ele, porém, respondendo, disse-lhes: Não tendes lido que aquele que os fez no princípio macho e fêmea os fez,
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε ὅτι ὁ κτίσας ἀπ' ἀρχῆς ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἐποίησεν αὐτούς;

text_en: For this cause shall a man leave father and mother , and shall cleave to his wife, and they two shall be in one flesh.
text_la: Propter hoc dimittet homo patrem, et matrem, et adhærebit uxori suæ, et erunt duo in carne una.
text_pt: E disse: Portanto, deixará o homem pai e mãe, e se unirá a sua mulher, e serão dois numa só carne?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν: ἕνεκα τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ κολληθήσεται τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν.

text_en: Therefore now they are not two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, let no man put asunder.
text_la: Itaque jam non sunt duo, sed una caro. Quod ergo Deus conjunxit, homo non separet.
text_pt: Assim não são mais dois, mas uma só carne. Portanto, o que Deus ajuntou não o separe o homem.
text_el: ὥστε οὐκέτι εἰσὶν δύο ἀλλὰ σὰρξ μία. ὃ οὖν ὁ θεὸς συνέζευξεν ἄνθρωπος μὴ χωριζέτω.

text_en: They say to him: Why then did Moses command to give a bill of divorce , and to put away ?
text_la: Dicunt illi : Quid ergo Moyses mandavit dare libellum repudii, et dimittere?
text_pt: Disseram-lhe eles: Então, por que mandou Moisés dar-lhe carta de divórcio, e repudiá-la?
text_el: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: τί οὖν Μωϋσῆς ἐνετείλατο δοῦναι βιβλίον ἀποστασίου καὶ ἀπολῦσαι;

text_en: He says to them: Because Moses by reason of the hardness of your heart permitted you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
text_la: Ait illis : Quoniam Moyses ad duritiam cordis vestri permisit vobis dimittere uxores vestras : ab initio autem non fuit sic.
text_pt: Disse-lhes ele: Moisés, por causa da dureza dos vossos corações, vos permitiu repudiar vossas mulheres; mas ao princípio não foi assim.
text_el: λέγει αὐτοῖς: ὅτι Μωϋσῆς πρὸς τὴν σκληροκαρδίαν ὑμῶν ἐπέτρεψεν ὑμῖν ἀπολῦσαι τὰς γυναῖκας ὑμῶν: ἀπ' ἀρχῆς δὲ οὐ γέγονεν οὕτως.

text_en: And I say to you, that whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another , commits adultery : and he that shall marry her that is put away , commits adultery .
text_la: Dico autem vobis, quia quicumque dimiserit uxorem suam, nisi ob fornicationem, et aliam duxerit, mœchatur : et qui dimissam duxerit, mœchatur.
text_pt: Eu vos digo, porém, que qualquer que repudiar sua mulher, não sendo por causa de fornicação, e casar com outra, comete adultério; e o que casar com a repudiada também comete adultério.
text_el: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ μὴ ἐπὶ πορνείᾳ καὶ γαμήσῃ ἄλλην, μοιχᾶται.

text_en: His disciples say unto him: If the case of a man with his wife be so, it is not expedient to marry .
text_la: Dicunt ei discipuli ejus : Si ita est causa hominis cum uxore, non expedit nubere.
text_pt: Disseram-lhe seus discípulos: Se assim é a condição do homem relativamente à mulher, não convém casar.
text_el: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ: εἰ οὕτως ἐστὶν ἡ αἰτία τοῦ ἀνθρώπου μετὰ τῆς γυναικός, οὐ συμφέρει γαμῆσαι.

text_en: Who said to them: All men take not this word, but they to whom it is given.
text_la: Qui dixit illis : Non omnes capiunt verbum istud, sed quibus datum est.
text_pt: Ele, porém, lhes disse: Nem todos podem receber esta palavra, mas só aqueles a quem foi concedido.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: οὐ πάντες χωροῦσιν τὸν λόγον ἀλλ' οἷς δέδοται.

text_en: For there are eunuchs, who were born so from their mothers womb: and there are eunuchs, who were made so by men : and there are eunuchs, who have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven . He that can take, let him take it.
text_la: Sunt enim eunuchi, qui de matris utero sic nati sunt : et sunt eunuchi, qui facti sunt ab hominibus : et sunt eunuchi, qui seipsos castraverunt propter regnum cælorum. Qui potest capere capiat.
text_pt: Porque há eunucos que assim nasceram do ventre da mãe; e há eunucos que foram castrados pelos homens; e há eunucos que se castraram a si mesmos, por causa do reino dos céus. Quem pode receber isto, receba-o.
text_el: εἰσὶν γὰρ εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς ἐγεννήθησαν οὕτως, καὶ εἰσὶν εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες εὐνουχίσθησαν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, καὶ εἰσὶν εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες εὐνούχισαν ἑαυτοὺς διὰ τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν. ὁ δυνάμενος χωρεῖν χωρείτω.

text_en: Then were little children presented to him, that he should impose hands upon them and pray . And the disciples rebuked them.
text_la: Tunc oblati sunt ei parvuli, ut manus eis imponeret, et oraret. Discipuli autem increpabant eos.
text_pt: Trouxeram-lhe, então, alguns meninos, para que sobre eles pusesse as mãos, e orasse; mas os discípulos os repreendiam.
text_el: Τότε προσηνέχθησαν αὐτῷ παιδία, ἵνα τὰς χεῖρας ἐπιθῇ αὐτοῖς καὶ προσεύξηται: οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμησαν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: But Jesus said to them: Suffer the little children, and forbid them not to come to me: for the kingdom of heaven is for such.
text_la: Jesus vero ait eis : Sinite parvulos, et nolite eos prohibere ad me venire : talium est enim regnum cælorum.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, disse: Deixai os meninos, e não os estorveis de vir a mim; porque dos tais é o reino dos céus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία καὶ μὴ κωλύετε αὐτὰ ἐλθεῖν πρός με: τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

text_en: And when he had imposed hands upon them, he departed from thence.
text_la: Et cum imposuisset eis manus, abiit inde.
text_pt: E, tendo-lhes imposto as mãos, partiu dali.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῖς ἐπορεύθη ἐκεῖθεν.

text_en: And behold one came and said to him: Good master, what good shall I do that I may have life everlasting ?
text_la: Et ecce unus accedens, ait illi : Magister bone, quid boni faciam ut habeam vitam æternam?
text_pt: E eis que, aproximando-se dele um jovem, disse-lhe: Bom Mestre, que bem farei para conseguir a vida eterna?
text_el: Καὶ ἰδοὺ εἷς προσελθὼν αὐτῷ εἶπεν: διδάσκαλε, τί ἀγαθὸν ποιήσω ἵνα σχῶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον;

text_en: Who said to him: Why do you ask me concerning good ? One is good , God . But if you will enter into life , keep the commandments .
text_la: Qui dixit ei : Quid me interrogas de bono? Unus est bonus, Deus. Si autem vis ad vitam ingredi, serva mandata.
text_pt: E ele disse-lhe: Por que me chamas bom? Não há bom senão um só, que é Deus. Se queres, porém, entrar na vida, guarda os mandamentos.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, τί με ἐρωτᾷς περὶ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ; εἷς ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαθός. εἰ δὲ θέλεις εἰς τὴν ζωὴν εἰσελθεῖν, τήρει τὰς ἐντολάς.

text_en: He said to him: Which? And Jesus said: You shall do no murder , You shall not commit adultery , You shall not steal , You shall not bear false witness .
text_la: Dicit illi : Quæ? Jesus autem dixit : Non homicidium facies; non adulterabis; non facies furtum; non falsum testimonium dices;
text_pt: Disse-lhe ele: Quais? E Jesus disse: Não matarás, não cometerás adultério, não furtarás, não dirás falso testemunho;
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ; ποίας ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἔφη: τὸ οὐ φονεύσεις, οὐ μοιχεύσεις, οὐ κλέψεις, οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις,

text_en: Honour your father and your mother : and, You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
text_la: honora patrem tuum, et matrem tuam, et diliges proximum tuum sicut teipsum.
text_pt: Honra teu pai e tua mãe, e amarás o teu próximo como a ti mesmo.
text_el: τίμα τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα, καί, ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.

text_en: The young man said to him: All these have I kept from my youth, what is yet wanting to me?
text_la: Dicit illi adolescens : Omnia hæc custodivi a juventute mea : quid adhuc mihi deest?
text_pt: Disse-lhe o jovem: Tudo isso tenho guardado desde a minha mocidade; que me falta ainda?
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ νεανίσκος: ταῦτα πάντα ἐφύλαξα: τί ἔτι ὑστερῶ;

text_en: Jesus said to him: If you will be perfect , go sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven : and come, follow me.
text_la: Ait illi Jesus : Si vis perfectus esse, vade, vende quæ habes, et da pauperibus, et habebis thesaurum in cælo : et veni, sequere me.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Se queres ser perfeito, vai, vende tudo o que tens e dá-o aos pobres, e terás um tesouro no céu; e vem, e segue-me.
text_el: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, εἰ θέλεις τέλειος εἶναι, ὕπαγε πώλησόν σου τὰ ὑπάρχοντα καὶ δὸς τοῖς πτωχοῖς, καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι.

text_en: And when the young man had heard this word, he went away sad: for he had great possessions .
text_la: Cum audisset autem adolescens verbum, abiit tristis : erat enim habens multas possessiones.
text_pt: E o jovem, ouvindo esta palavra, retirou-se triste, porque possuía muitas propriedades.
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ νεανίσκος τὸν λόγον [τοῦτον] ἀπῆλθεν λυπούμενος: ἦν γὰρ ἔχων κτήματα πολλά.

text_en: Then Jesus said to his disciples : Amen , I say to you, that a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven .
text_la: Jesus autem dixit discipulis suis : Amen dico vobis, quia dives difficile intrabit in regnum cælorum.
text_pt: Disse então Jesus aos seus discípulos: Em verdade vos digo que é difícil entrar um rico no reino dos céus.
text_el: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πλούσιος δυσκόλως εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν.

text_en: And again I say to you: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of heaven .
text_la: Et iterum dico vobis : Facilius est camelum per foramen acus transire, quam divitem intrare in regnum cælorum.
text_pt: E, outra vez vos digo que é mais fácil passar um camelo pelo fundo de uma agulha do que entrar um rico no reino de Deus.
text_el: πάλιν δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν εὐκοπώτερόν ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ τρήματος ῥαφίδος εἰσελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And when they had heard this, the disciples wondered much, saying: Who then can be saved ?
text_la: Auditis autem his, discipuli mirabantur valde, dicentes : Quis ergo poterit salvus esse?
text_pt: Os seus discípulos, ouvindo isto, admiraram-se muito, dizendo: Quem poderá pois salvar-se?
text_el: ἀκούσαντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο σφόδρα λέγοντες: τίς ἄρα δύναται σωθῆναι;

text_en: And Jesus beholding, said to them: With men this is impossible: but with God all things are possible.
text_la: Aspiciens autem Jesus, dixit illis : Apud homines hoc impossibile est : apud Deum autem omnia possibilia sunt.
text_pt: E Jesus, olhando para eles, disse-lhes: Aos homens é isso impossível, mas a Deus tudo é possível.
text_el: ἐμβλέψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: παρὰ ἀνθρώποις τοῦτο ἀδύνατόν ἐστιν, παρὰ δὲ θεῷ πάντα δυνατά.

text_en: Then Peter answering, said to him: Behold we have left all things, and have followed you: what therefore shall we have?
text_la: Tunc respondens Petrus, dixit ei : Ecce nos reliquimus omnia, et secuti sumus te : quid ergo erit nobis?
text_pt: Então Pedro, tomando a palavra, disse-lhe: Eis que nós deixamos tudo, e te seguimos; que receberemos?
text_el: Τότε ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν πάντα καὶ ἠκολουθήσαμέν σοι: τί ἄρα ἔσται ἡμῖν;

text_en: And Jesus said to them: Amen I say to you, that you who have followed me, in the regeneration, when the Son of man shall sit on the seat of his majesty, you also shall sit on twelve seats judging the twelve tribes of Israel .
text_la: Jesus autem dixit illis : Amen dico vobis, quod vos, qui secuti estis me, in regeneratione cum sederit Filius hominis in sede majestatis suæ, sedebitis et vos super sedes duodecim, judicantes duodecim tribus Israël.
text_pt: E Jesus disse-lhes: Em verdade vos digo que vós, que me seguistes, quando, na regeneração, o Filho do homem se assentar no trono da sua glória, também vos assentareis sobre doze tronos, para julgar as doze tribos de Israel.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὑμεῖς οἱ ἀκολουθήσαντές μοι, ἐν τῇ παλιγγενεσίᾳ, ὅταν καθίσῃ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης αὐτοῦ, καθήσεσθε καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐπὶ δώδεκα θρόνους κρίνοντες τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: And every one that has left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father , or mother , or wife, or children, or lands for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall possess life everlasting .
text_la: Et omnis qui reliquerit domum, vel fratres, aut sorores, aut patrem, aut matrem, aut uxorem, aut filios, aut agros propter nomen meum, centuplum accipiet, et vitam æternam possidebit.
text_pt: E todo aquele que tiver deixado casas, ou irmãos, ou irmãs, ou pai, ou mãe, ou mulher, ou filhos, ou terras, por amor de meu nome, receberá cem vezes tanto, e herdará a vida eterna.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὅστις ἀφῆκεν οἰκίας ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ ἀδελφὰς ἢ πατέρα ἢ μητέρα ἢ τέκνα ἢ ἀγροὺς ἕνεκεν τοῦ ἐμοῦ ὀνόματός πολλαπλασίονα λήμψεται καὶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσει.

text_en: And many that are first, shall be last: and the last shall be first.
text_la: Multi autem erunt primi novissimi, et novissimi primi.
text_pt: Porém, muitos primeiros serão os derradeiros, e muitos derradeiros serão os primeiros.
text_el: πολλοὶ δὲ ἔσονται πρῶτοι ἔσχατοι καὶ ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι.

text_en: The kingdom of heaven is like to an householder, who went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
text_la: Simile est regnum cælorum homini patrifamilias, qui exiit primo mane conducere operarios in vineam suam.
text_pt: Porque o reino dos céus é semelhante a um homem, pai de família, que saiu de madrugada a assalariar trabalhadores para a sua vinha.
text_el: Ὁμοία γάρ ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἀνθρώπῳ οἰκοδεσπότῃ ὅστις ἐξῆλθεν ἅμα πρωῒ μισθώσασθαι ἐργάτας εἰς τὸν ἀμπελῶνα αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And having agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
text_la: Conventione autem facta cum operariis ex denario diurno, misit eos in vineam suam.
text_pt: E, ajustando com os trabalhadores a um dinheiro por dia, mandou-os para a sua vinha.
text_el: συμφωνήσας δὲ μετὰ τῶν ἐργατῶν ἐκ δηναρίου τὴν ἡμέραν ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν ἀμπελῶνα αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And going out about the third hour , he saw others standing in the marketplace idle.
text_la: Et egressus circa horam tertiam, vidit alios stantes in foro otiosos,
text_pt: E, saindo perto da hora terceira, viu outros que estavam ociosos na praça,
text_el: καὶ ἐξελθὼν περὶ τρίτην ὥραν εἶδεν ἄλλους ἑστῶτας ἐν τῇ ἀγορᾷ ἀργούς,

text_en: And he said to them: Go you also into my vineyard, and I will give you what shall be just .
text_la: et dixit illis : Ite et vos in vineam meam, et quod justum fuerit dabo vobis.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Ide vós também para a vinha, e dar-vos-ei o que for justo. E eles foram.
text_el: καὶ ἐκείνοις εἶπεν: ὑπάγετε καὶ ὑμεῖς εἰς τὸν ἀμπελῶνα, καὶ ὃ ἐὰν ᾖ δίκαιον δώσω ὑμῖν.

text_en: And they went their way. And again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour , and did in like manner.
text_la: Illi autem abierunt. Iterum autem exiit circa sextam et nonam horam : et fecit similiter.
text_pt: Saindo outra vez, perto da hora sexta e nona, fez o mesmo.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀπῆλθον. πάλιν δὲ ἐξελθὼν περὶ ἕκτην καὶ ἐνάτην ὥραν ἐποίησεν ὡσαύτως.

text_en: But about the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing, and he says to them: Why stand you here all the day idle?
text_la: Circa undecimam vero exiit, et invenit alios stantes, et dicit illis : Quid hic statis tota die otiosi?
text_pt: E, saindo perto da hora undécima, encontrou outros que estavam ociosos, e perguntou- lhes: Por que estais ociosos todo o dia?
text_el: περὶ δὲ τὴν ἑνδεκάτην ἐξελθὼν εὗρεν ἄλλους ἑστῶτας, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: τί ὧδε ἑστήκατε ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἀργοί;

text_en: They say to him: Because no man has hired us. He says to them: Go also into my vineyard.
text_la: Dicunt ei : Quia nemo nos conduxit. Dicit illis : Ite et vos in vineam meam.
text_pt: Disseram-lhe eles: Porque ninguém nos assalariou. Diz-lhes ele: Ide vós também para a vinha, e recebereis o que for justo.
text_el: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: ὅτι οὐδεὶς ἡμᾶς ἐμισθώσατο. λέγει αὐτοῖς: ὑπάγετε καὶ ὑμεῖς εἰς τὸν ἀμπελῶνα.

text_en: And when evening had come, the lord of the vineyard says to his steward: Call the labourers and pay them their hire, beginning from the last even to the first.
text_la: Cum sero autem factum esset, dicit dominus vineæ procuratori suo : Voca operarios, et redde illis mercedem incipiens a novissimis usque ad primos.
text_pt: E, aproximando-se a noite, diz o senhor da vinha ao seu mordomo: Chama os trabalhadores, e paga-lhes o jornal, começando pelos derradeiros, até aos primeiros.
text_el: ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης λέγει ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος τῷ ἐπιτρόπῳ αὐτοῦ: κάλεσον τοὺς ἐργάτας καὶ ἀπόδος τὸν μισθὸν ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τῶν ἐσχάτων ἕως τῶν πρώτων.

text_en: When therefore they had come that came about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
text_la: Cum venissent ergo qui circa undecimam horam venerant, acceperunt singulos denarios.
text_pt: E, chegando os que tinham ido perto da hora undécima, receberam um dinheiro cada um.
text_el: ἐλθόντες δὲ οἱ περὶ τὴν ἑνδεκάτην ὥραν ἔλαβον ἀνὰ δηνάριον.

text_en: But when the first also came, they thought that they should receive more: And they also received every man a penny.
text_la: Venientes autem et primi, arbitrati sunt quod plus essent accepturi : acceperunt autem et ipsi singulos denarios.
text_pt: Vindo, porém, os primeiros, cuidaram que haviam de receber mais; mas do mesmo modo receberam um dinheiro cada um.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθόντες οἱ πρῶτοι ἐνόμισαν ὅτι πλεῖον λήμψονται: καὶ ἔλαβον [τὸ] ἀνὰ δηνάριον καὶ αὐτοί.

text_en: And receiving it they murmured against the master of the house,
text_la: Et accipientes murmurabant adversus patremfamilias,
text_pt: E, recebendo-o, murmuravam contra o pai de família,
text_el: λαβόντες δὲ ἐγόγγυζον κατὰ τοῦ οἰκοδεσπότου

text_en: saying: These last have worked but one hour and you have made them equal to us, that have borne the burden of the day and the heats.
text_la: dicentes : Hi novissimi una hora fecerunt, et pares illos nobis fecisti, qui portavimus pondus diei, et æstus.
text_pt: Dizendo: Estes derradeiros trabalharam só uma hora, e tu os igualaste conosco, que suportamos a fadiga e a calma do dia.
text_el: λέγοντες: οὗτοι οἱ ἔσχατοι μίαν ὥραν ἐποίησαν, καὶ ἴσους αὐτοὺς ἡμῖν ἐποίησας τοῖς βαστάσασι τὸ βάρος τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὸν καύσωνα.

text_en: But he answering said to one of them: friend, I do you no wrong: did you not agree with me for a penny?
text_la: At ille respondens uni eorum, dixit : Amice, non facio tibi injuriam : nonne ex denario convenisti mecum?
text_pt: Mas ele, respondendo, disse a um deles: Amigo, não te faço agravo; não ajustaste tu comigo um dinheiro?
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς ἑνὶ αὐτῶν εἶπεν: ἑταῖρε, οὐκ ἀδικῶ σε: οὐχὶ δηναρίου συνεφώνησάς μοι;

text_en: Take what is yours, and go your way: I will also give to this last even as to you.
text_la: Tolle quod tuum est, et vade : volo autem et huic novissimo dare sicut et tibi.
text_pt: Toma o que é teu, e retira-te; eu quero dar a este derradeiro tanto como a ti.
text_el: ἆρον τὸ σὸν καὶ ὕπαγε. θέλω δὲ τούτῳ τῷ ἐσχάτῳ δοῦναι ὡς καὶ σοί:

text_en: Or, is it not lawful for me to do what I will? Is your eye evil , because I am good ?
text_la: Aut non licet mihi quod volo, facere? an oculus tuus nequam est, quia ego bonus sum?
text_pt: Ou não me é lícito fazer o que quiser do que é meu? Ou é mau o teu olho porque eu sou bom?
text_el: οὐκ ἔξεστίν μοι ὃ θέλω ποιῆσαι ἐν τοῖς ἐμοῖς; ἢ ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου πονηρός ἐστιν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἀγαθός εἰμι;

text_en: So shall the last be first and the first last. For many are called but few chosen.
text_la: Sic erunt novissimi primi, et primi novissimi. Multi enim sunt vocati, pauci vero electi.
text_pt: Assim os derradeiros serão primeiros, e os primeiros derradeiros; porque muitos são chamados, mas poucos escolhidos.
text_el: οὕτως ἔσονται οἱ ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι καὶ οἱ πρῶτοι ἔσχατοι.

text_en: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem , took the twelve disciples apart and said to them:
text_la: Et ascendens Jesus Jerosolymam, assumpsit duodecim discipulos secreto, et ait illis:
text_pt: E, subindo Jesus a Jerusalém, chamou à parte os seus doze discípulos, e no caminho disse-lhes:
text_el: Καὶ ἀναβαίνων ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα παρέλαβεν τοὺς δώδεκα [μαθητὰς] κατ' ἰδίαν, καὶ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς:

text_en: Behold we go up to Jerusalem , and the Son of man shall be betrayed to the chief priests and the scribes : and they shall condemn him to death .
text_la: Ecce ascendimus Jerosolymam, et Filius hominis tradetur principibus sacerdotum, et scribis, et condemnabunt eum morte,
text_pt: Eis que vamos para Jerusalém, e o Filho do homem será entregue aos príncipes dos sacerdotes, e aos escribas, e condená-lo-ão à morte.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἀναβαίνομεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδοθήσεται τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ γραμματεῦσιν, καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτὸν [θανάτῳ].

text_en: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to be mocked and scourged and crucified: and the third day he shall rise again .
text_la: et tradent eum gentibus ad illudendum, et flagellandum, et crucifigendum, et tertia die resurget.
text_pt: E o entregarão aos gentios para que dele escarneçam, e o açoitem e crucifiquem, e ao terceiro dia ressuscitará.
text_el: καὶ παραδώσουσιν αὐτὸν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εἰς τὸ ἐμπαῖξαι καὶ μαστιγῶσαι καὶ σταυρῶσαι, καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἐγερθήσεται.

text_en: Then came to him the mother of the sons of Zebedee with her sons, adoring and asking something of him.
text_la: Tunc accessit ad eum mater filiorum Zebedæi cum filiis suis, adorans et petens aliquid ab eo.
text_pt: Então se aproximou dele a mãe dos filhos de Zebedeu, com seus filhos, adorando-o, e fazendo-lhe um pedido.
text_el: Τότε προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ ἡ μήτηρ τῶν υἱῶν Ζεβεδαίου μετὰ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτῆς, προσκυνοῦσα καὶ αἰτοῦσά τι ἀπ'' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Who said to her: What will you? She said to him: say that these my two sons may sit, the one on your right hand, and the other on your left, in your kingdom .
text_la: Qui dixit ei : Quid vis? Ait illi : Dic ut sedeant hi duo filii mei, unus ad dexteram tuam, et unus ad sinistram in regno tuo.
text_pt: E ele diz-lhe: Que queres? Ela respondeu: Dize que estes meus dois filhos se assentem, um à tua direita e outro à tua esquerda, no teu reino.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῇ: τί θέλεις; λέγει αὐτῷ: εἰπὲ ἵνα καθίσωσιν οὗτοι οἱ δύο υἱοί μου εἷς ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ εἷς ἐξ εὐωνύμων σου ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ σου.

text_en: And Jesus answering, said: You know not what you ask. Can you drink the chalice that I shall drink? They say to him: We can.
text_la: Respondens autem Jesus, dixit : Nescitis quid petatis. Potestis bibere calicem, quem ego bibiturus sum? Dicunt ei : Possumus.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, respondendo, disse: Não sabeis o que pedis. Podeis vós beber o cálice que eu hei de beber, e ser batizados com o batismo com que eu sou batizado? Dizem-lhe eles: Podemos.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: οὐκ οἴδατε τί αἰτεῖσθε. δύνασθε πιεῖν τὸ ποτήριον ὃ ἐγὼ μέλλω πίνειν; λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: δυνάμεθα.

text_en: He says to them: My chalice indeed you shall drink; but to sit on my right or left hand is not mine to give to you, but to them for whom it is prepared by my Father .
text_la: Ait illis : Calicem quidem meum bibetis : sedere autem ad dexteram meam vel sinistram non est meum dare vobis, sed quibus paratum est a Patre meo.
text_pt: E diz-lhes ele: Na verdade bebereis o meu cálice e sereis batizados com o batismo com que eu sou batizado, mas o assentar-se à minha direita ou à minha esquerda não me pertence dá-lo, mas é para aqueles para quem meu Pai o tem preparado.
text_el: λέγει αὐτοῖς: τὸ μὲν ποτήριόν μου πίεσθε, τὸ δὲ καθίσαι ἐκ δεξιῶν μου καὶ ἐξ εὐωνύμων, οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὸν δοῦναι, ἀλλ' οἷς ἡτοίμασται ὑπὸ τοῦ πατρός μου.

text_en: And the ten, hearing it, were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
text_la: Et audientes decem, indignati sunt de duobus fratribus.
text_pt: E, quando os dez ouviram isto, indignaram-se contra os dois irmãos.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ δέκα ἠγανάκτησαν περὶ τῶν δύο ἀδελφῶν.

text_en: But Jesus called them to him and said: You know that the princes of the Gentiles lord it over them; and that they that are the greater, exercise power upon them.
text_la: Jesus autem vocavit eos ad se, et ait : Scitis quia principes gentium dominantur eorum : et qui majores sunt, potestatem exercent in eos.
text_pt: Então Jesus, chamando-os para junto de si, disse: Bem sabeis que pelos príncipes dos gentios são estes dominados, e que os grandes exercem autoridade sobre eles.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτοὺς εἶπεν: οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν ἐθνῶν κατακυριεύουσιν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ μεγάλοι κατεξουσιάζουσιν αὐτῶν.

text_en: It shall not be so among you: but whosoever is the greater among you, let him be your minister .
text_la: Non ita erit inter vos : sed quicumque voluerit inter vos major fieri, sit vester minister:
text_pt: Não será assim entre vós; mas todo aquele que quiser entre vós fazer-se grande seja vosso serviçal;
text_el: οὐχ οὕτως ἐστὶν ἐν ὑμῖν: ἀλλ' ὃς ἂν θέλῃ ἐν ὑμῖν μέγας γενέσθαι ἔσται ὑμῶν διάκονος,

text_en: And he that will be first among you shall be your servant.
text_la: et qui voluerit inter vos primus esse, erit vester servus.
text_pt: E, qualquer que entre vós quiser ser o primeiro, seja vosso servo;
text_el: καὶ ὃς ἂν θέλῃ ἐν ὑμῖν εἶναι πρῶτος ἔσται ὑμῶν δοῦλος:

text_en: Even as the Son of man is not come to be ministered unto, but to minister and to give his life a redemption for many.
text_la: Sicut Filius hominis non venit ministrari, sed ministrare, et dare animam suam redemptionem pro multis.
text_pt: Bem como o Filho do homem não veio para ser servido, mas para servir, e para dar a sua vida em resgate de muitos.
text_el: ὥσπερ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἦλθεν διακονηθῆναι, ἀλλὰ διακονῆσαι καὶ δοῦναι τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ λύτρον ἀντὶ πολλῶν.

text_en: And when they went out from Jericho , a great multitude followed him.
text_la: Et egredientibus illis ab Jericho, secuta est eum turba multa,
text_pt: E, saindo eles de Jericó, seguiu-o grande multidão.
text_el: Καὶ ἐκπορευομένων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Ἰεριχὼ ἠκολούθησεν αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς.

text_en: And behold two blind men sitting by the way side heard that Jesus passed by. And they cried out, saying: O Lord, you son of David , have mercy on us.
text_la: et ecce duo cæci sedentes secus viam audierunt quia Jesus transiret : et clamaverunt, dicentes : Domine, miserere nostri, fili David.
text_pt: E eis que dois cegos, assentados junto do caminho, ouvindo que Jesus passava, clamaram, dizendo: Senhor, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de nós!
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ δύο τυφλοὶ καθήμενοι παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν, ἀκούσαντες ὅτι Ἰησοῦς παράγει, ἔκραξαν λέγοντες, κύριε] ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς, υἱὸς Δαυίδ.

text_en: And the multitude rebuked them that they should hold their peace. But they cried out the more, saying: O Lord, you son of David , have mercy on us.
text_la: Turba autem increpabat eos ut tacerent. At illi magis clamabant, dicentes : Domine, miserere nostri, fili David.
text_pt: E a multidão os repreendia, para que se calassem; eles, porém, cada vez clamavam mais, dizendo: Senhor, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de nós!
text_el: ὁ δὲ ὄχλος ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα σιωπήσωσιν: οἱ δὲ μεῖζον ἔκραξαν λέγοντες: κύριε, ἐλέησον, ἡμᾶς υἱὸς Δαυίδ.

text_en: And Jesus stood and called them and said: What will you that I do to you?
text_la: Et stetit Jesus, et vocavit eos, et ait : Quid vultis ut faciam vobis?
text_pt: E Jesus, parando, chamou-os, e disse: Que quereis que vos faça?
text_el: καὶ στὰς [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς ἐφώνησεν αὐτοὺς καὶ εἶπεν: τί θέλετε ποιήσω ὑμῖν;

text_en: They say to him: Lord, that our eyes be opened.
