text_la: Dicunt illi : Domine, ut aperiantur oculi nostri.
text_pt: Disseram-lhe eles: Senhor, que os nossos olhos sejam abertos.
text_el: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: κύριε, ἵνα ἀνοιγῶσιν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν.

text_en: And Jesus having compassion on them, touched their eyes. And immediately they saw and followed him.
text_la: Misertus autem eorum Jesus, tetigit oculos eorum. Et confestim viderunt, et secuti sunt eum.
text_pt: Então Jesus, movido de íntima compaixão, tocou-lhes nos olhos, e logo seus olhos viram; e eles o seguiram.
text_el: σπλαγχνισθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἥψατο τῶν ὀμμάτων αὐτῶν, καὶ εὐθέως ἀνέβλεψαν καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And when they drew near to Jerusalem and had come to Bethphage, unto mount Olivet , then Jesus sent two disciples ,
text_la: Et cum appropinquassent Jerosolymis, et venissent Bethphage ad montem Oliveti : tunc Jesus misit duos discipulos,
text_pt: E, quando se aproximaram de Jerusalém, e chegaram a Betfagé, ao Monte das Oliveiras, enviou, então, Jesus dois discípulos, dizendo-lhes:
text_el: Καὶ ὅτε ἤγγισαν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Βηθφαγὴ εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν ἐλαιῶν, τότε Ἰησοῦς ἀπέστειλεν δύο μαθητὰς

text_en: saying to them: Go into the village that is over against you: and immediately you shall find an ass tied and a colt with her. Loose them and bring them to me.
text_la: dicens eis : Ite in castellum, quod contra vos est, et statim invenietis asinam alligatam, et pullum cum ea : solvite, et adducite mihi:
text_pt: Ide à aldeia que está defronte de vós, e logo encontrareis uma jumenta presa, e um jumentinho com ela; desprendei-a, e trazei-mos.
text_el: λέγων αὐτοῖς: πορεύεσθε εἰς τὴν κώμην τὴν κατέναντι ὑμῶν, καὶ εὐθέως εὑρήσετε ὄνον δεδεμένην καὶ πῶλον μετ' αὐτῆς: λύσαντες ἀγάγετέ μοι.

text_en: And if any man shall say anything to you, say that the Lord has need of them. And forthwith he will let them go.
text_la: et si quis vobis aliquid dixerit, dicite quia Dominus his opus habet : et confestim dimittet eos.
text_pt: E, se alguém vos disser alguma coisa, direis que o Senhor os há de mister; e logo os enviará.
text_el: καὶ ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ τι, ἐρεῖτε ὅτι ὁ κύριος αὐτῶν χρείαν ἔχει: εὐθὺς δὲ ἀποστελεῖ αὐτούς.

text_en: Now all this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet , saying:
text_la: Hoc autem totum factum est, ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per prophetam dicentem:
text_pt: Ora, tudo isto aconteceu para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo profeta, que diz:
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ γέγονεν ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος:

text_en: Tell the daughter of Sion : Behold your king comes to you, meek and sitting upon an ass and a colt, the foal of her that is used to the yoke.
text_la: Dicite filiæ Sion : Ecce rex tuus venit tibi mansuetus, sedens super asinam, et pullum filium subjugalis.
text_pt: Dizei à filha de Sião: Eis que o teu Rei aí te vem,Manso, e assentado sobre uma jumenta,E sobre um jumentinho, filho de animal de carga.
text_el: εἴπατε τῇ θυγατρὶ Σιών: ἰδοὺ ὁ βασιλεύς σου ἔρχεταί σοι, πραῢς καὶ ἐπιβεβηκὼς ἐπὶ ὄνον, καὶ ἐπὶ πῶλον υἱὸν ὑποζυγίου.

text_en: And the disciples going, did as Jesus commanded them.
text_la: Euntes autem discipuli fecerunt sicut præcepit illis Jesus.
text_pt: E, indo os discípulos, e fazendo como Jesus lhes ordenara,
text_el: πορευθέντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ καὶ ποιήσαντες καθὼς συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς,

text_en: And they brought the ass and the colt and laid their garments upon them and made him sit thereon.
text_la: Et adduxerunt asinam, et pullum : et imposuerunt super eos vestimenta sua, et eum desuper sedere fecerunt.
text_pt: Trouxeram a jumenta e o jumentinho, e sobre eles puseram as suas vestes, e fizeram-no assentar em cima.
text_el: ἤγαγον τὴν ὄνον καὶ τὸν πῶλον, καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπ' αὐτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια, καὶ ἐπεκάθισεν ἐπάνω αὐτῶν.

text_en: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way: and others cut boughs from the trees and strewed them in the way.
text_la: Plurima autem turba straverunt vestimenta sua in via : alii autem cædebant ramos de arboribus, et sternebant in via:
text_pt: E muitíssima gente estendia as suas vestes pelo caminho, e outros cortavam ramos de árvores, e os espalhavam pelo caminho.
text_el: ὁ δὲ πλεῖστος ὄχλος ἔστρωσαν ἑαυτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ, ἄλλοι δὲ ἔκοπτον κλάδους ἀπὸ τῶν δένδρων καὶ ἐστρώννυον ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.

text_en: And the multitudes that went before and that followed cried, saying: Hosanna to the son of David : Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord : Hosanna in the highest.
text_la: turbæ autem, quæ præcedebant, et quæ sequebantur, clamabant, dicentes : Hosanna filio David : benedictus, qui venit in nomine Domini : hosanna in altissimis.
text_pt: E a multidão que ia adiante, e a que seguia, clamava, dizendo: Hosana ao Filho de Davi; bendito o que vem em nome do Senhor. Hosana nas alturas!
text_el: οἱ δὲ ὄχλοι οἱ προάγοντες αὐτὸν καὶ οἱ ἀκολουθοῦντες ἔκραζον λέγοντες: ὡσαννὰ τῷ υἱῷ Δαυίδ, εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου, ὡσαννὰ ἐν τοῖς ὑψίστοις.

text_en: And when he had come into Jerusalem , the whole city was moved, saying: Who is this?
text_la: Et cum intrasset Jerosolymam, commota est universa civitas, dicens : Quis est hic?
text_pt: E, entrando ele em Jerusalém, toda a cidade se alvoroçou, dizendo: Quem é este?
text_el: Καὶ εἰσελθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἐσείσθη πᾶσα ἡ πόλις λέγουσα: τίς ἐστιν οὗτος;

text_en: And the people said: This is Jesus , the prophet from Nazareth of Galilee .
text_la: Populi autem dicebant: Hic est Jesus propheta a Nazareth Galilææ.
text_pt: E a multidão dizia: Este é Jesus, o profeta de Nazaré da Galiléia.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ὄχλοι ἔλεγον: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ προφήτης Ἰησοῦς ὁ ἀπὸ Ναζαρὲθ τῆς Γαλιλαίας.

text_en: And Jesus went into the temple of God and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple and overthrew the tables of the money changers and the chairs of them that sold doves.
text_la: Et intravit Jesus in templum Dei, et ejiciebat omnes vendentes et ementes in templo, et mensas numulariorum, et cathedras vendentium columbas evertit:
text_pt: E entrou Jesus no templo de Deus, e expulsou todos os que vendiam e compravam no templo, e derribou as mesas dos cambistas e as cadeiras dos que vendiam pombas;
text_el: Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ ἱερόν καὶ ἐξέβαλεν πάντας τοὺς πωλοῦντας καὶ ἀγοράζοντας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ, καὶ τὰς τραπέζας τῶν κολλυβιστῶν κατέστρεψεν καὶ τὰς καθέδρας τῶν πωλούντων τὰς περιστεράς,

text_en: And he says to them: It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer ; but you have made it a den of thieves.
text_la: et dicit eis : Scriptum est : Domus mea domus orationis vocabitur : vos autem fecistis illam speluncam latronum.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Está escrito: A minha casa será chamada casa de oração; mas vós a tendes convertido em covil de ladrões.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: γέγραπται: ὁ οἶκός μου οἶκος προσευχῆς κληθήσεται, ὑμεῖς δὲ αὐτὸν ποιεῖτε σπήλαιον λῃστῶν.

text_en: And there came to him the blind and the lame in the temple : and he healed them.
text_la: Et accesserunt ad eum cæci, et claudi in templo : et sanavit eos.
text_pt: E foram ter com ele no templo cegos e coxos, e curou-os.
text_el: Καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ τυφλοὶ καὶ χωλοὶ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτούς.

text_en: And the chief priests and scribes , seeing the wonderful things that he did and the children crying in the temple and saying: Hosanna to the son of David , were moved with indignation,
text_la: Videntes autem principes sacerdotum et scribæ mirabilia quæ fecit, et pueros clamantes in templo, et dicentes : Hosanna filio David : indignati sunt,
text_pt: Vendo, então, os principais dos sacerdotes e os escribas as maravilhas que fazia, e os meninos clamando no templo: Hosana ao Filho de Davi, indignaram-se,
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς τὰ θαυμάσια ἃ ἐποίησεν καὶ τοὺς παῖδας τοὺς κράζοντας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ λέγοντας, ὡσαννὰ τῷ υἱῷ Δαυίδ, ἠγανάκτησαν

text_en: and said to him: Do you hear what these say? And Jesus said to them: Yea, have you never read: Out of the mouth of infants and of sucklings you have perfected praise ?
text_la: et dixerunt ei : Audis quid isti dicunt? Jesus autem dixit eis : Utique. Numquam legistis : Quia ex ore infantium et lactentium perfecisti laudem?
text_pt: E disseram-lhe: Ouves o que estes dizem? E Jesus lhes disse: Sim; nunca lestes: Pela boca dos meninos e das criancinhas de peito tiraste o perfeito louvor?
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: ἀκούεις τί οὗτοι λέγουσιν; ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς: ναί: οὐδέποτε ἀνέγνωτε ὅτι ἐκ στόματος νηπίων καὶ θηλαζόντων κατηρτίσω αἶνον;

text_en: And leaving them, he went out of the city into Bethania and remained here.
text_la: Et relictis illis, abiit foras extra civitatem in Bethaniam : ibique mansit.
text_pt: E, deixando-os, saiu da cidade para Betânia, e ali passou a noite.
text_el: καὶ καταλιπὼν αὐτοὺς ἐξῆλθεν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως εἰς Βηθανίαν, καὶ ηὐλίσθη ἐκεῖ.

text_en: And in the morning, returning into the city, he was hungry.
text_la: Mane autem revertens in civitatem, esuriit.
text_pt: E, de manhã, voltando para a cidade, teve fome;
text_el: Πρωῒ δὲ ἐπαναγαγὼν εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἐπείνασεν.

text_en: And seeing a certain fig tree by the way side, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves only. And he says to it: May no fruit grow on you henceforward for ever. And immediately the fig tree withered away.
text_la: Et videns fici arborem unam secus viam, venit ad eam : et nihil invenit in ea nisi folia tantum, et ait illi : Numquam ex te fructus nascatur in sempiternum. Et arefacta est continuo ficulnea.
text_pt: E, avistando uma figueira perto do caminho, dirigiu-se a ela, e não achou nela senão folhas. E disse-lhe: Nunca mais nasça fruto de ti! E a figueira secou imediatamente.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν συκῆν μίαν ἐπὶ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἦλθεν ἐπ' αὐτήν, καὶ οὐδὲν εὗρεν ἐν αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ φύλλα μόνον, καὶ λέγει αὐτῇ: οὐ μηκέτι ἐκ σοῦ καρπὸς γένηται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. καὶ ἐξηράνθη παραχρῆμα ἡ συκῆ.

text_en: And the disciples seeing it wondered, saying: How is it presently withered away?
text_la: Et videntes discipuli, mirati sunt, dicentes : Quomodo continuo aruit?
text_pt: E os discípulos, vendo isto, maravilharam-se, dizendo: Como secou imediatamente a figueira?
text_el: καὶ ἰδόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐθαύμασαν λέγοντες: πῶς παραχρῆμα ἐξηράνθη ἡ συκῆ;

text_en: And Jesus answering, said to them: Amen , I say to you, if you shall have faith and stagger not, not only this of the fig tree shall you do, but also if you shall say to this mountain, Take up and cast yourself into the sea, it shall be done.
text_la: Respondens autem Jesus, ait eis : Amen dico vobis, si habueritis fidem, et non hæsitaveritis, non solum de ficulnea facietis, sed et si monti huic dixeritis : Tolle, et jacta te in mare, fiet.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, respondendo, disse-lhes: Em verdade vos digo que, se tiverdes fé e não duvidardes, não só fareis o que foi feito à figueira, mas até se a este monte disserdes: Ergue-te, e precipita-te no mar, assim será feito;
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν ἔχητε πίστιν καὶ μὴ διακριθῆτε, οὐ μόνον τὸ τῆς συκῆς ποιήσετε, ἀλλὰ κἂν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ εἴπητε: ἄρθητι καὶ βλήθητι εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, γενήσεται:

text_en: And all things whatsoever you shall ask in prayer believing , you shall receive.
text_la: Et omnia quæcumque petieritis in oratione credentes, accipietis.
text_pt: E, tudo o que pedirdes em oração, crendo, o recebereis.
text_el: καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἂν αἰτήσητε ἐν τῇ προσευχῇ πιστεύοντες λήμψεσθε.

text_en: And when he had come into the temple , there came to him, as he was teaching, the chief priests and ancients of the people, saying: By what authority do you these things? And who has given you this authority?
text_la: Et cum venisset in templum, accesserunt ad eum docentem principes sacerdotum, et seniores populi, dicentes : In qua potestate hæc facis? et quis tibi dedit hanc potestatem?
text_pt: E, chegando ao templo, acercaram-se dele, estando já ensinando, os príncipes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos do povo, dizendo: Com que autoridade fazes isto? e quem te deu tal autoridade?
text_el: Καὶ ἐλθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν προσῆλθον αὐτῷ διδάσκοντι οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ λέγοντες: ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιεῖς; καὶ τίς σοι ἔδωκεν τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην;

text_en: Jesus answering, said to them: I also will ask you one word, which if you shall tell me, I will also tell you by what authority I do these things.
text_la: Respondens Jesus dixit eis : Interrogabo vos et ego unum sermonem : quem si dixeritis mihi, et ego vobis dicam in qua potestate hæc facio.
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Eu também vos perguntarei uma coisa; se ma disserdes, também eu vos direi com que autoridade faço isto.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς [δὲ] ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἐρωτήσω ὑμᾶς κἀγὼ λόγον ἕνα, ὃν ἐὰν εἴπητέ μοι κἀγὼ ὑμῖν ἐρῶ ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ:

text_en: The baptism of John , whence was it? From heaven or from men ? But they thought within themselves, saying:
text_la: Baptismus Joannis unde erat? e cælo, an ex hominibus? At illi cogitabant inter se, dicentes:
text_pt: O batismo de João, de onde era? Do céu, ou dos homens? E pensavam entre si, dizendo: Se dissermos: Do céu, ele nos dirá: Então por que não o crestes?
text_el: τὸ βάπτισμα τὸ Ἰωάννου πόθεν ἦν; ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἢ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων; οἱ δὲ διελογίζοντο ἐν' ἑαυτοῖς λέγοντες: Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν, Ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, ἐρεῖ ἡμῖν, Διὰ τί οὖν οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ;

text_en: If we shall say, from heaven , he will say to us: Why then did you not believe him? But if we shall say, from men , we are afraid of the multitude: for all held John as a prophet .
text_la: Si dixerimus, e cælo, dicet nobis : Quare ergo non credidistis illi? Si autem dixerimus, ex hominibus, timemus turbam : omnes enim habebant Joannem sicut prophetam.
text_pt: E, se dissermos: Dos homens, tememos o povo, porque todos consideram João como profeta.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ εἴπωμεν: ἐξ ἀνθρώπων, φοβούμεθα τὸν ὄχλον: πάντες γὰρ ὡς προφήτην ἔχουσιν τὸν Ἰωάννην.

text_en: And answering Jesus , they said: We know not. He also said to them: Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
text_la: Et respondentes Jesu, dixerunt : Nescimus. Ait illis et ipse : Nec ego dico vobis in qua potestate hæc facio.
text_pt: E, respondendo a Jesus, disseram: Não sabemos. Ele disse-lhes: Nem eu vos digo com que autoridade faço isto.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἶπαν: οὐκ οἴδαμεν. ἔφη αὐτοῖς καὶ αὐτός: οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ.

text_en: But what think you? A certain man had two sons: and coming to the first, he said: Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
text_la: Quid autem vobis videtur? Homo quidam habebat duos filios, et accedens ad primum, dixit : Fili, vade hodie, operare in vinea mea.
text_pt: Mas, que vos parece? Um homem tinha dois filhos, e, dirigindo-se ao primeiro, disse: Filho, vai trabalhar hoje na minha vinha.
text_el: Τί δὲ ὑμῖν δοκεῖ; ἄνθρωπος εἶχεν τέκνα δύο: προσελθὼν τῷ πρώτῳ εἶπεν: τέκνον, ὕπαγε σήμερον ἐργάζου ἐν τῷ ἀμπελῶνι.

text_en: And he answering, said: I will not. But afterwards, being moved with repentance , he went.
text_la: Ille autem respondens, ait : Nolo. Postea autem, pœnitentia motus, abiit.
text_pt: Ele, porém, respondendo, disse: Não quero. Mas depois, arrependendo-se, foi.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: ἐγώ, κύριε: καὶ οὐκ ἀπῆλθεν.

text_en: And coming to the other, he said in like manner. And he answering said: I go, Sir. And he went not.
text_la: Accedens autem ad alterum, dixit similiter. At ille respondens, ait : Eo, domine, et non ivit:
text_pt: E, dirigindo-se ao segundo, falou-lhe de igual modo; e, respondendo ele, disse: Eu vou, senhor; e não foi.
text_el: προσελθὼν δὲ τῷ δευτέρῳ εἶπεν ὡσαύτως. ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: οὐ θέλω: ὕστερον μεταμεληθεὶς ἀπῆλθεν.

text_en: Which of the two did the father's will? They say to him: The first. Jesus says to them: Amen I say to you that the publicans and the harlots shall go into the kingdom of God before you.
text_la: quis ex duobus fecit voluntatem patris? Dicunt ei : Primus. Dicit illis Jesus : Amen dico vobis, quia publicani et meretrices præcedent vos in regnum Dei.
text_pt: Qual dos dois fez a vontade do pai? Disseram-lhe eles: O primeiro. Disse-lhes Jesus: Em verdade vos digo que os publicanos e as meretrizes entram adiante de vós no reino de Deus.
text_el: τίς ἐκ τῶν δύο ἐποίησεν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πατρός; λέγουσιν: ὁ ὕστερος. λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οἱ τελῶναι καὶ αἱ πόρναι προάγουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: For John came to you in the way of justice : and you did not believe him. But the publicans and the harlots believed him: but you, seeing it, did not even afterwards repent , that you might believe him.
text_la: Venit enim ad vos Joannes in via justitiæ, et non credidistis ei : publicani autem et meretrices crediderunt ei : vos autem videntes nec pœnitentiam habuistis postea, ut crederetis ei.
text_pt: Porque João veio a vós no caminho da justiça, e não o crestes, mas os publicanos e as meretrizes o creram; vós, porém, vendo isto, nem depois vos arrependestes para o crer.
text_el: ἦλθεν γὰρ Ἰωάννης πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν ὁδῷ δικαιοσύνης, καὶ οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ: οἱ δὲ τελῶναι καὶ αἱ πόρναι ἐπίστευσαν αὐτῷ: ὑμεῖς δὲ ἰδόντες οὐδὲ μετεμελήθητε ὕστερον τοῦ πιστεῦσαι αὐτῷ.

text_en: Hear another parable . There was a man , an householder, who planted a vineyard and made a hedge round about it and dug in it a press and built a tower and let it out to husbandmen and went into a strange country.
text_la: Aliam parabolam audite : Homo erat paterfamilias, qui plantavit vineam, et sepem circumdedit ei, et fodit in ea torcular, et ædificavit turrim, et locavit eam agricolis, et peregre profectus est.
text_pt: Ouvi, ainda, outra parábola: Houve um homem, pai de família, que plantou uma vinha, e circundou-a de um valado, e construiu nela um lagar, e edificou uma torre, e arrendou-a a uns lavradores, e ausentou-se para longe.
text_el: Ἄλλην παραβολὴν ἀκούσατε. ἄνθρωπος ἦν οἰκοδεσπότης ὅστις ἐφύτευσεν ἀμπελῶνα καὶ φραγμὸν αὐτῷ περιέθηκεν καὶ ὤρυξεν ἐν αὐτῷ ληνὸν καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν πύργον, καὶ ἐξέδετο αὐτὸν γεωργοῖς, καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν.

text_en: And when the time of the fruits drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen that they might receive the fruits thereof.
text_la: Cum autem tempus fructuum appropinquasset, misit servos suos ad agricolas, ut acciperent fructus ejus.
text_pt: E, chegando o tempo dos frutos, enviou os seus servos aos lavradores, para receber os seus frutos.
text_el: ὅτε δὲ ἤγγισεν ὁ καιρὸς τῶν καρπῶν, ἀπέστειλεν τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ πρὸς τοὺς γεωργοὺς λαβεῖν τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the husbandmen laying hands on his servants, beat one and killed another and stoned another.
text_la: Et agricolæ, apprehensis servis ejus, alium ceciderunt, alium occiderunt, alium vero lapidaverunt.
text_pt: E os lavradores, apoderando-se dos servos, feriram um, mataram outro, e apedrejaram outro.
text_el: καὶ λαβόντες οἱ γεωργοὶ τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ ὃν μὲν ἔδειραν, ὃν δὲ ἀπέκτειναν, ὃν δὲ ἐλιθοβόλησαν.

text_en: Again he sent other servants, more than the former; and they did to them in like manner.
text_la: Iterum misit alios servos plures prioribus, et fecerunt illis similiter.
text_pt: Depois enviou outros servos, em maior número do que os primeiros; e eles fizeram-lhes o mesmo.
text_el: πάλιν ἀπέστειλεν ἄλλους δούλους πλείονας τῶν πρώτων, καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτοῖς ὡσαύτως.

text_en: And last of all he sent to them his son, saying: They will reverence my son.
text_la: Novissime autem misit ad eos filium suum, dicens : Verebuntur filium meum.
text_pt: E, por último, enviou-lhes seu filho, dizendo: Terão respeito a meu filho.
text_el: ὕστερον δὲ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ, λέγων: ἐντραπήσονται τὸν υἱόν μου.

text_en: But the husbandmen seeing the son, said among themselves: This is the heir: come, let us kill him, and we shall have his inheritance.
text_la: Agricolæ autem videntes filium dixerunt intra se : Hic est hæres, venite, occidamus eum, et habebimus hæreditatem ejus.
text_pt: Mas os lavradores, vendo o filho, disseram entre si: Este é o herdeiro; vinde, matemo-lo, e apoderemo-nos da sua herança.
text_el: οἱ δὲ γεωργοὶ ἰδόντες τὸν υἱὸν εἶπον ἐν ἑαυτοῖς: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ κληρονόμος: δεῦτε ἀποκτείνωμεν αὐτὸν καὶ σχῶμεν τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And taking him, they cast him forth out of the vineyard and killed him.
text_la: Et apprehensum eum ejecerunt extra vineam, et occiderunt.
text_pt: E, lançando mão dele, o arrastaram para fora da vinha, e o mataram.
text_el: καὶ λαβόντες αὐτὸν ἐξέβαλον ἔξω τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος καὶ ἀπέκτειναν.

text_en: When therefore the lord of the vineyard shall come, what will he do to those husbandmen?
text_la: Cum ergo venerit dominus vineæ, quid faciet agricolis illis?
text_pt: Quando, pois, vier o senhor da vinha, que fará àqueles lavradores?
text_el: ὅταν οὖν ἔλθῃ ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος, τί ποιήσει τοῖς γεωργοῖς ἐκείνοις;

text_en: They say to him: He will bring those evil men to an evil end and let out his vineyard to other husbandmen that shall render him the fruit in due season.
text_la: Aiunt illi : Malos male perdet : et vineam suam locabit aliis agricolis, qui reddant ei fructum temporibus suis.
text_pt: Dizem-lhe eles: Dará afrontosa morte aos maus, e arrendará a vinha a outros lavradores, que a seu tempo lhe dêem os frutos.
text_el: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: κακοὺς κακῶς ἀπολέσει αὐτούς, καὶ τὸν ἀμπελῶνα ἐκδώσεται ἄλλοις γεωργοῖς, οἵτινες ἀποδώσουσιν αὐτῷ τοὺς καρποὺς ἐν τοῖς καιροῖς αὐτῶν.

text_en: Jesus says to them: Have you never read in the Scriptures : The stone which the builders rejected, the same has become the head of the corner ? By the Lord this has been done; and it is wonderful in our eyes.
text_la: Dicit illis Jesus : Numquam legistis in Scripturis : Lapidem quem reprobaverunt ædificantes, hic factus est in caput anguli : a Domino factum est istud, et est mirabile in oculis nostris?
text_pt: Diz-lhes Jesus: Nunca lestes nas Escrituras:A pedra, que os edificadores rejeitaram,essa foi posta por cabeça do ângulo;pelo Senhor foi feito isto,E é maravilhoso aos nossos olhos?
text_el: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: οὐδέποτε ἀνέγνωτε ἐν ταῖς γραφαῖς: λίθον ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας: παρὰ κυρίου ἐγένετο αὕτη, καὶ ἔστιν θαυμαστὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν;

text_en: Therefore I say to you that the kingdom of God shall be taken from you and shall be given to a nation yielding the fruits thereof.
text_la: Ideo dico vobis, quia auferetur a vobis regnum Dei, et dabitur genti facienti fructus ejus.
text_pt: Portanto, eu vos digo que o reino de Deus vos será tirado, e será dado a uma nação que dê os seus frutos.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἀρθήσεται ἀφ' ὑμῶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ δοθήσεται ἔθνει ποιοῦντι τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτῆς.

text_en: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it shall grind him to powder.
text_la: Et qui ceciderit super lapidem istum, confringetur : super quem vero ceciderit, conteret eum.
text_pt: E, quem cair sobre esta pedra, despedaçar-se-á; e aquele sobre quem ela cair ficará reduzido a pó.
text_el: [καὶ ὁ πεσὼν ἐπὶ τὸν λίθον τοῦτον συνθλασθήσεται ἐφ' ὃν δ' ἂν πέσῃ λικμήσει αὐτόν]

text_en: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables , they knew that he spoke of them.
text_la: Et cum audissent principes sacerdotum et pharisæi parabolas ejus, cognoverunt quod de ipsis diceret.
text_pt: E os príncipes dos sacerdotes e os fariseus, ouvindo estas palavras, entenderam que falava deles;
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι τὰς παραβολὰς αὐτοῦ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι περὶ αὐτῶν λέγει:

text_en: And seeking to lay hands on him, they feared the multitudes, because they held him as a prophet .
text_la: Et quærentes eum tenere, timuerunt turbas : quoniam sicut prophetam eum habebant.
text_pt: E, pretendendo prendê-lo, recearam o povo, porquanto o tinham por profeta.
text_el: καὶ ζητοῦντες αὐτὸν κρατῆσαι ἐφοβήθησαν τοὺς ὄχλους, ἐπεὶ εἰς προφήτην αὐτὸν εἶχον.

text_en: And Jesus answering, spoke again in parables to them, saying:
text_la: Et respondens Jesus, dixit iterum in parabolis eis, dicens:
text_pt: Então Jesus, tomando a palavra, tornou a falar-lhes em parábolas, dizendo:
text_el: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς πάλιν εἶπεν ἐν παραβολαῖς αὐτοῖς λέγων:

text_en: The kingdom of heaven is likened to a king who made a marriage for his son.
text_la: Simile factum est regnum cælorum homini regi, qui fecit nuptias filio suo.
text_pt: O reino dos céus é semelhante a um certo rei que celebrou as bodas de seu filho;
text_el: ὡμοιώθη ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἀνθρώπῳ βασιλεῖ, ὅστις ἐποίησεν γάμους τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he sent his servants to call them that were invited to the marriage: and they would not come.
text_la: Et misit servos suos vocare invitatos ad nuptias, et nolebant venire.
text_pt: E enviou os seus servos a chamar os convidados para as bodas, e estes não quiseram vir.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ καλέσαι τοὺς κεκλημένους εἰς τοὺς γάμους, καὶ οὐκ ἤθελον ἐλθεῖν.

text_en: Again he sent other servants, saying: Tell them that were invited, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my beeves and fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the marriage.
text_la: Iterum misit alios servos, dicens : Dicite invitatis : Ecce prandium meum paravi, tauri mei et altilia occisa sunt, et omnia parata : venite ad nuptias.
text_pt: Depois, enviou outros servos, dizendo: Dizei aos convidados: Eis que tenho o meu jantar preparado, os meus bois e cevados já mortos, e tudo já pronto; vinde às bodas.
text_el: πάλιν ἀπέστειλεν ἄλλους δούλους λέγων: εἴπατε τοῖς κεκλημένοις: ἰδοὺ τὸ ἄριστόν μου ἡτοίμακα, οἱ ταῦροί μου καὶ τὰ σιτιστὰ τεθυμένα, καὶ πάντα ἕτοιμα: δεῦτε εἰς τοὺς γάμους.

text_en: But they neglected and went their ways, one to his farm and another to his merchandise.
text_la: Illi autem neglexerunt : et abierunt, alius in villam suam, alius vero ad negotiationem suam:
text_pt: Eles, porém, não fazendo caso, foram, um para o seu campo, outro para o seu negócio;
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀμελήσαντες ἀπῆλθον, ὃς μὲν εἰς τὸν ἴδιον ἀγρόν, ὃς δὲ ἐπὶ τὴν ἐμπορίαν αὐτοῦ:

text_en: And the rest laid hands on his servants and, having treated them contumeliously, put them to death .
text_la: reliqui vero tenuerunt servos ejus, et contumeliis affectos occiderunt.
text_pt: E os outros, apoderando-se dos servos, os ultrajaram e mataram.
text_el: οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ κρατήσαντες τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ ὕβρισαν καὶ ἀπέκτειναν.

text_en: But when the king had heard of it, he was angry : and sending his armies, he destroyed those murderers and burnt their city.
text_la: Rex autem cum audisset, iratus est : et missis exercitibus suis, perdidit homicidas illos, et civitatem illorum succendit.
text_pt: E o rei, tendo notícia disto, encolerizou-se e, enviando os seus exércitos, destruiu aqueles homicidas, e incendiou a sua cidade.
text_el: ὁ δὲ βασιλεὺς ὠργίσθη, καὶ πέμψας τὰ στρατεύματα αὐτοῦ ἀπώλεσεν τοὺς φονεῖς ἐκείνους καὶ τὴν πόλιν αὐτῶν ἐνέπρησεν.

text_en: Then he says to his servants: The marriage indeed is ready; but they that were invited were not worthy.
text_la: Tunc ait servis suis : Nuptiæ quidem paratæ sunt, sed qui invitati erant, non fuerunt digni:
text_pt: Então diz aos servos: As bodas, na verdade, estão preparadas, mas os convidados não eram dignos.
text_el: τότε λέγει τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ: ὁ μὲν γάμος ἕτοιμός ἐστιν, οἱ δὲ κεκλημένοι οὐκ ἦσαν ἄξιοι:

text_en: Go therefore into the highways; and as many as you shall find, call to the marriage.
text_la: ite ergo ad exitus viarum, et quoscumque inveneritis, vocate ad nuptias.
text_pt: Ide, pois, às saídas dos caminhos, e convidai para as bodas a todos os que encontrardes.
text_el: πορεύεσθε οὖν ἐπὶ τὰς διεξόδους τῶν ὁδῶν, καὶ ὅσους ἐὰν εὕρητε καλέσατε εἰς τοὺς γάμους.

text_en: And his servants going forth into the ways, gathered together all that they found, both bad and good : and the marriage was filled with guests.
text_la: Et egressi servi ejus in vias, congregaverunt omnes quos invenerunt, malos et bonos : et impletæ sunt nuptiæ discumbentium.
text_pt: E os servos, saindo pelos caminhos, ajuntaram todos quantos encontraram, tanto maus como bons; e a festa nupcial foi cheia de convidados.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελθόντες οἱ δοῦλοι ἐκεῖνοι εἰς τὰς ὁδοὺς συνήγαγον πάντας οὓς εὗρον, πονηρούς τε καὶ ἀγαθούς, καὶ ἐπλήσθη ὁ νυμφὼν ἀνακειμένων.

text_en: And the king went in to see the guests: and he saw there a man who had not on a wedding garment.
text_la: Intravit autem rex ut videret discumbentes, et vidit ibi hominem non vestitum veste nuptiali.
text_pt: E o rei, entrando para ver os convidados, viu ali um homem que não estava trajado com veste de núpcias.
text_el: εἰσελθὼν δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς θεάσασθαι τοὺς ἀνακειμένους εἶδεν ἐκεῖ ἄνθρωπον οὐκ ἐνδεδυμένον ἔνδυμα γάμου:

text_en: And he said to him: Friend, how did you come in here not having on a wedding garment? But he was silent.
text_la: Et ait illi : Amice, quomodo huc intrasti non habens vestem nuptialem? At ille obmutuit.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Amigo, como entraste aqui, não tendo veste nupcial? E ele emudeceu.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ: ἑταῖρε, πῶς εἰσῆλθες ὧδε μὴ ἔχων ἔνδυμα γάμου; ὁ δὲ ἐφιμώθη.

text_en: Then the king said to the waiters: Bind his hands and feet, and cast him into the exterior darkness. There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text_la: Tunc dicit rex ministris : Ligatis manibus et pedibus ejus, mittite eum in tenebras exteriores : ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium.
text_pt: Disse, então, o rei aos servos: Amarrai-o de pés e mãos, levai-o, e lançai-o nas trevas exteriores; ali haverá pranto e ranger de dentes.
text_el: τότε ὁ βασιλεὺς εἶπεν τοῖς διακόνοις: δήσαντες αὐτοῦ πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ἐκβάλετε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ σκότος τὸ ἐξώτερον: ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.

text_en: For many are called , but few are chosen.
text_la: Multi enim sunt vocati, pauci vero electi.
text_pt: Porque muitos são chamados, mas poucos escolhidos.
text_el: πολλοὶ γάρ εἰσιν κλητοὶ ὀλίγοι δὲ ἐκλεκτοί.

text_en: Then the Pharisees going, consulted among themselves how to insnare him in his speech.
text_la: Tunc abeuntes pharisæi, consilium inierunt ut caperent eum in sermone.
text_pt: Então, retirando-se os fariseus, consultaram entre si como o surpreenderiam nalguma palavra;
text_el: Τότε πορευθέντες οἱ Φαρισαῖοι συμβούλιον ἔλαβον ὅπως αὐτὸν παγιδεύσωσιν ἐν λόγῳ.

text_en: And they sent to him their disciples with the Herodians, saying: Master, we know that you are a true speaker and teach the way of God in truth . Neither care for any man : for you do not regard the person of men .
text_la: Et mittunt ei discipulos suos cum Herodianis, dicentes : Magister, scimus quia verax es, et viam Dei in veritate doces, et non est tibi cura de aliquo : non enim respicis personam hominum:
text_pt: E enviaram-lhe os seus discípulos, com os herodianos, dizendo: Mestre, bem sabemos que és verdadeiro, e ensinas o caminho de Deus segundo a verdade, e de ninguém se te dá, porque não olhas a aparência dos homens.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστέλλουσιν αὐτῷ τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτῶν μετὰ τῶν Ἡρῳδιανῶν λέγοντας: διδάσκαλε, οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀληθὴς εἶ καὶ τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ διδάσκεις, καὶ οὐ μέλει σοι περὶ οὐδενός, οὐ γὰρ βλέπεις εἰς πρόσωπον ἀνθρώπων:

text_en: Tell us therefore what do you think? Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar , or not?
text_la: dic ergo nobis quid tibi videtur, licet censum dare Cæsari, an non?
text_pt: Dize-nos, pois, que te parece? É lícito pagar o tributo a César, ou não?
text_el: εἰπὸν οὖν ἡμῖν, τί σοι δοκεῖ: ἔξεστιν δοῦναι κῆνσον Καίσαρι ἢ οὔ;

text_en: But Jesus knowing their wickedness , said: Why do you tempt me, you hypocrites ?
text_la: Cognita autem Jesus nequitia eorum, ait : Quid me tentatis, hypocritæ?
text_pt: Jesus, porém, conhecendo a sua malícia, disse: Por que me experimentais, hipócritas?
text_el: γνοὺς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὴν πονηρίαν αὐτῶν εἶπεν: τί με πειράζετε, ὑποκριταί;

text_en: Show me the coin of the tribute. And they offered him a penny.
text_la: ostendite mihi numisma census. At illi obtulerunt ei denarium.
text_pt: Mostrai-me a moeda do tributo. E eles lhe apresentaram um dinheiro.
text_el: ἐπιδείξατέ μοι τὸ νόμισμα τοῦ κήνσου. οἱ δὲ προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δηνάριον.

text_en: And Jesus says to them: Whose image and inscription is this?
text_la: Et ait illis Jesus : Cujus est imago hæc, et superscriptio?
text_pt: E ele diz-lhes: De quem é esta efígie e esta inscrição?
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: Τίνος ἡ εἰκὼν αὕτη καὶ ἡ ἐπιγραφή;

text_en: They say to him: Caesar's . Then he says to them: Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar's ; and to God , the things that are God's .
text_la: Dicunt ei : Cæsaris. Tunc ait illis : Reddite ergo quæ sunt Cæsaris, Cæsari : et quæ sunt Dei, Deo.
text_pt: Dizem-lhe eles: De César. Então ele lhes disse: Dai pois a César o que é de César, e a Deus o que é de Deus.
text_el: λέγουσιν: Καίσαρος. τότε λέγει αὐτοῖς: ἀπόδοτε οὖν τὰ Καίσαρος Καίσαρι καὶ τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τῷ θεῷ.

text_en: And hearing this, they wondered and, leaving him, went their ways.
text_la: Et audientes mirati sunt, et relicto eo abierunt.
text_pt: E eles, ouvindo isto, maravilharam-se, e, deixando-o, se retiraram.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσαντες ἐθαύμασαν, καὶ ἀφέντες αὐτὸν ἀπῆλθαν.

text_en: That day there came to him the Sadducees , who say there is no resurrection ; and asked him,
text_la: In illo die accesserunt ad eum sadducæi, qui dicunt non esse resurrectionem : et interrogaverunt eum,
text_pt: No mesmo dia chegaram junto dele os saduceus, que dizem não haver ressurreição, e o interrogaram,
text_el: Ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ Σαδδουκαῖοι, λέγοντες μὴ εἶναι ἀνάστασιν, καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν

text_en: saying: Master, Moses said: If a man die having no son, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up issue to his brother.
text_la: dicentes : Magister, Moyses dixit : Si quis mortuus fuerit non habens filium, ut ducat frater ejus uxorem illius, et suscitet semen fratri suo.
text_pt: Dizendo: Mestre, Moisés disse: Se morrer alguém, não tendo filhos, casará o seu irmão com a mulher dele, e suscitará descendência a seu irmão.
text_el: λέγοντες: διδάσκαλε, Μωϋσῆς εἶπεν: ἐάν τις ἀποθάνῃ μὴ ἔχων τέκνα, ἐπιγαμβρεύσει ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναστήσει σπέρμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first having married a wife, died; and not having issue, left his wife to his brother.
text_la: Erant autem apud nos septem fratres : et primus, uxore ducta, defunctus est : et non habens semen, reliquit uxorem suam fratri suo.
text_pt: Ora, houve entre nós sete irmãos; e o primeiro, tendo casado, morreu e, não tendo descendência, deixou sua mulher a seu irmão.
text_el: ἦσαν δὲ παρ' ἡμῖν ἑπτὰ ἀδελφοί, καὶ ὁ πρῶτος γήμας ἐτελεύτησεν, καὶ μὴ ἔχων σπέρμα ἀφῆκεν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: In like manner the second and the third and so on, to the seventh.
text_la: Similiter secundus, et tertius usque ad septimum.
text_pt: Da mesma sorte o segundo, e o terceiro, até ao sétimo;
text_el: ὁμοίως καὶ ὁ δεύτερος καὶ ὁ τρίτος, ἕως τῶν ἑπτά.

text_en: And last of all the woman died also.
text_la: Novissime autem omnium et mulier defuncta est.
text_pt: Por fim, depois de todos, morreu também a mulher.
text_el: ὕστερον δὲ πάντων ἀπέθανεν ἡ γυνή.

text_en: At the resurrection therefore, whose wife of the seven shall she be? For they all had her.
text_la: In resurrectione ergo cujus erit de septem uxor? omnes enim habuerunt eam.
text_pt: Portanto, na ressurreição, de qual dos sete será a mulher, visto que todos a possuíram?
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει οὖν τίνος τῶν ἑπτὰ ἔσται γυνή; πάντες γὰρ ἔσχον αὐτήν.

text_en: And Jesus answering, said to them: You err , not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God .
text_la: Respondens autem Jesus, ait illis : Erratis nescientes Scripturas, neque virtutem Dei.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, respondendo, disse-lhes: Errais, não conhecendo as Escrituras, nem o poder de Deus.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: πλανᾶσθε, μὴ εἰδότες τὰς γραφὰς μηδὲ τὴν δύναμιν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: For in the resurrection they shall neither marry nor be married , but shall be as the angels of God in heaven .
text_la: In resurrectione enim neque nubent, neque nubentur : sed erunt sicut angeli Dei in cælo.
text_pt: Porque na ressurreição nem casam nem são dados em casamento; mas serão como os anjos de Deus no céu.
text_el: ἐν γὰρ τῇ ἀναστάσει οὔτε γαμοῦσιν οὔτε γαμίζονται, ἀλλ' ὡς ἄγγελοι ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ εἰσιν.

text_en: And concerning the resurrection of the dead , have you not read that which was spoken by God , saying to you:
text_la: De resurrectione autem mortuorum non legistis quod dictum est a Deo dicente vobis:
text_pt: E, acerca da ressurreição dos mortos, não tendes lido o que Deus vos declarou, dizendo:
text_el: περὶ δὲ τῆς ἀναστάσεως τῶν νεκρῶν οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε τὸ ῥηθὲν ὑμῖν ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ λέγοντος:

text_en: I am the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob ? He is not the God of the dead but of the living.
text_la: Ego sum Deus Abraham, et Deus Isaac, et Deus Jacob? Non est Deus mortuorum, sed viventium.
text_pt: Eu sou o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó? Ora, Deus não é Deus dos mortos, mas dos vivos.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ θεὸς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ ὁ θεὸς Ἰσαὰκ καὶ ὁ θεὸς Ἰακώβ; οὐκ ἔστιν [ὁ] θεὸς νεκρῶν ἀλλὰ ζώντων.

text_en: And the multitudes hearing it were in admiration at his doctrine.
text_la: Et audientes turbæ, mirabantur in doctrina ejus.
text_pt: E, as turbas, ouvindo isto, ficaram maravilhadas da sua doutrina.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ ὄχλοι ἐξεπλήσσοντο ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: But the Pharisees , hearing that he had silenced the Sadducees , came together.
text_la: Pharisæi autem audientes quod silentium imposuisset sadducæis, convenerunt in unum:
text_pt: E os fariseus, ouvindo que ele fizera emudecer os saduceus, reuniram-se no mesmo lugar.
text_el: Οἱ δὲ Φαρισαῖοι ἀκούσαντες ὅτι ἐφίμωσεν τοὺς Σαδδουκαίους συνήχθησαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό,

text_en: And one of them, a doctor of the law , asked him, tempting him:
text_la: et interrogavit eum unus ex eis legis doctor, tentans eum:
text_pt: E um deles, doutor da lei, interrogou-o para o experimentar, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν νομικὸς πειράζων αὐτόν:

text_en: Master, which is the great commandment in the law ?
text_la: Magister, quod est mandatum magnum in lege?
text_pt: Mestre, qual é o grande mandamento na lei?
text_el: διδάσκαλε, ποία ἐντολὴ μεγάλη ἐν τῷ νόμῳ;

text_en: Jesus said to him: You shall love the Lord your God with your whole heart and with your whole soul and with your whole mind .
text_la: Ait illi Jesus : Diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo, et in tota anima tua, et in tota mente tua.
text_pt: E Jesus disse-lhe: Amarás o Senhor teu Deus de todo o teu coração, e de toda a tua alma, e de todo o teu pensamento.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἔφη αὐτῷ: ἀγαπήσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ψυχῇ σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ διανοίᾳ σου.

text_en: This is the greatest and the first commandment .
text_la: Hoc est maximum, et primum mandatum.
text_pt: Este é o primeiro e grande mandamento.
text_el: αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μεγάλη καὶ πρώτη ἐντολή.

text_en: And the second is like to this: You shall love your neighbour as yourself.
text_la: Secundum autem simile est huic : Diliges proximum tuum, sicut teipsum.
text_pt: E o segundo, semelhante a este, é: Amarás o teu próximo como a ti mesmo.
text_el: δευτέρα ὁμοία αὐτῇ: ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.

text_en: On these two commandments depends the whole law and the prophets .
text_la: In his duobus mandatis universa lex pendet, et prophetæ.
text_pt: Destes dois mandamentos dependem toda a lei e os profetas.
text_el: ἐν ταύταις ταῖς δυσὶν ἐντολαῖς ὅλος ὁ νόμος κρέμαται καὶ οἱ προφῆται.

text_en: And the Pharisees being gathered together, Jesus asked them,
text_la: Congregatis autem pharisæis, interrogavit eos Jesus,
text_pt: E, estando reunidos os fariseus, interrogou-os Jesus,
text_el: Συνηγμένων δὲ τῶν Φαρισαίων ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς

text_en: saying: What think you of Christ ? Whose son is he? They say to him: David's .
text_la: dicens : Quid vobis videtur de Christo? cujus filius est? Dicunt ei : David.
text_pt: Dizendo: Que pensais vós do Cristo? De quem é filho? Eles disseram-lhe: De Davi.
text_el: λέγων: τί ὑμῖν δοκεῖ περὶ τοῦ Χριστοῦ; τίνος υἱός ἐστιν; λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: τοῦ Δαυίδ.

text_en: He says to them: How then does David in spirit call him Lord, saying:
text_la: Ait illis : Quomodo ergo David in spiritu vocat eum Dominum, dicens:
text_pt: Disse-lhes ele: Como é então que Davi, em espírito, lhe chama Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: λέγει αὐτοῖς: πῶς οὖν Δαυὶδ ἐν πνεύματι καλεῖ αὐτὸν κύριον, λέγων:

text_en: The Lord said to my Lord: Sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool?
text_la: Dixit Dominus Domino meo : Sede a dextris meis, donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum?
text_pt: Disse o Senhor ao meu Senhor:Assenta-te à minha direita,Até que eu ponha os teus inimigos por escabelo de teus pés?
text_el: εἶπεν κύριος τῷ κυρίῳ μου: κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν σου.

text_en: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
text_la: Si ergo David vocat eum Dominum, quomodo filius ejus est?
text_pt: Se Davi, pois, lhe chama Senhor, como é seu filho?
text_el: εἰ οὖν Δαυὶδ καλεῖ αὐτὸν κύριον, πῶς υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἐστιν;

text_en: And no man was able to answer him a word: neither dared any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
text_la: Et nemo poterat ei respondere verbum : neque ausus fuit quisquam ex illa die eum amplius interrogare.
text_pt: E ninguém podia responder-lhe uma palavra; nem desde aquele dia ousou mais alguém interrogá-lo.
text_el: καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο ἀποκριθῆναι αὐτῷ λόγον, οὐδὲ ἐτόλμησέν τις ἀπ' ἐκείνης τῆς ἡμέρας ἐπερωτῆσαι αὐτὸν οὐκέτι.

text_en: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples ,
text_la: Tunc Jesus locutus est ad turbas, et ad discipulos suos,
text_pt: Então falou Jesus à multidão, e aos seus discípulos,
text_el: Τότε [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς ἐλάλησεν τοῖς ὄχλοις καὶ τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: saying: The scribes and the Pharisees have sitten on the chair of Moses .
text_la: dicens : Super cathedram Moysi sederunt scribæ et pharisæi.
text_pt: Dizendo: Na cadeira de Moisés estão assentados os escribas e fariseus.
text_el: λέγων, ἐπὶ τῆς Μωϋσέως καθέδρας ἐκάθισαν οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι.

text_en: All things therefore whatsoever they shall say to you, observe and do: but according to their works do not. For they say, and do not.
text_la: Omnia ergo quæcumque dixerint vobis, servate, et facite : secundum opera vero eorum nolite facere : dicunt enim, et non faciunt.
text_pt: Todas as coisas, pois, que vos disserem que observeis, observai-as e fazei-as; mas não procedais em conformidade com as suas obras, porque dizem e não fazem;
text_el: πάντα οὖν ὅσα ἐὰν εἴπωσιν ὑμῖν ποιήσατε καὶ τηρεῖτε, κατὰ δὲ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν μὴ ποιεῖτε: λέγουσιν γὰρ καὶ οὐ ποιοῦσιν.

text_en: For they bind heavy and insupportable burdens and lay them on men's shoulders: but with a finger of their own they will not move them.
text_la: Alligant enim onera gravia, et importabilia, et imponunt in humeros hominum : digito autem suo nolunt ea movere.
text_pt: Pois atam fardos pesados e difíceis de suportar, e os põem aos ombros dos homens; eles, porém, nem com seu dedo querem movê-los;
text_el: δεσμεύουσιν δὲ φορτία βαρέα καὶ ἐπιτιθέασιν ἐπὶ τοὺς ὤμους τῶν ἀνθρώπων, αὐτοὶ δὲ τῷ δακτύλῳ αὐτῶν οὐ θέλουσιν κινῆσαι αὐτά.

text_en: And all their works they do for to be seen of men . For they make their phylacteries broad and enlarge their fringes .
text_la: Omnia vero opera sua faciunt ut videantur ab hominibus : dilatant enim phylacteria sua, et magnificant fimbrias.
text_pt: E fazem todas as obras a fim de serem vistos pelos homens; pois trazem largos filactérios, e alargam as franjas das suas vestes,
text_el: πάντα δὲ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν ποιοῦσιν πρὸς τὸ θεαθῆναι τοῖς ἀνθρώποις: πλατύνουσιν γὰρ τὰ φυλακτήρια αὐτῶν καὶ μεγαλύνουσιν τὰ κράσπεδα,

text_en: And they love the first places at feasts and the first chairs in the synagogues ,
text_la: Amant autem primos recubitus in cœnis, et primas cathedras in synagogis,
text_pt: E amam os primeiros lugares nas ceias e as primeiras cadeiras nas sinagogas,
text_el: φιλοῦσιν δὲ τὴν πρωτοκλισίαν ἐν τοῖς δείπνοις καὶ τὰς πρωτοκαθεδρίας ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς

text_en: and salutations in the market place, and to be called by men , Rabbi .
text_la: et salutationes in foro, et vocari ab hominibus Rabbi.
text_pt: E as saudações nas praças, e o serem chamados pelos homens; Rabi, Rabi.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς ἀσπασμοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς καὶ καλεῖσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ῥαββί.

text_en: But be not you called Rabbi . For one is your master: and all you are brethren.
text_la: Vos autem nolite vocari Rabbi : unus est enim magister vester, omnes autem vos fratres estis.
text_pt: Vós, porém, não queirais ser chamados Rabi, porque um só é o vosso Mestre, a saber, o Cristo, e todos vós sois irmãos.
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ μὴ κληθῆτε, ῥαββί, εἷς γάρ ἐστιν ὑμῶν ὁ διδάσκαλος, πάντες δὲ ὑμεῖς ἀδελφοί ἐστε.

text_en: And call none your father upon earth; for one is your father , who is in heaven .
text_la: Et patrem nolite vocare vobis super terram: unus est enim pater vester qui in cælis est.
text_pt: E a ninguém na terra chameis vosso pai, porque um só é o vosso Pai, o qual está nos céus.
text_el: καὶ πατέρα μὴ καλέσητε ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς: εἷς γάρ ἐστιν ὑμῶν ὁ πατὴρ ὁ οὐράνιος.

text_en: Neither be called masters: for one is your master, Christ .
text_la: Nec vocemini magistri : quia magister vester unus est, Christus.
text_pt: Nem vos chameis mestres, porque um só é o vosso Mestre, que é o Cristo.
text_el: μηδὲ κληθῆτε καθηγηταί, ὅτι καθηγητὴς ὑμῶν ἐστιν εἷς ὁ Χριστός.

text_en: He that is the greatest among you shall be your servant.
text_la: Qui major est vestrum, erit minister vester.
text_pt: O maior dentre vós será vosso servo.
text_el: ὁ δὲ μείζων ὑμῶν ἔσται ὑμῶν διάκονος.

text_en: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be humbled : and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
text_la: Qui autem se exaltaverit, humiliabitur : et qui se humiliaverit, exaltabitur.
text_pt: E o que a si mesmo se exaltar será humilhado; e o que a si mesmo se humilhar será exaltado.
text_el: ὅστις δὲ ὑψώσει ἑαυτὸν ταπεινωθήσεται, καὶ ὅστις ταπεινώσει ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται.

text_en: But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites , because you shut the kingdom of heaven against men : for you yourselves do not enter in and those that are going in, you suffer not to enter.
text_la: Væ autem vobis scribæ et pharisæi hypocritæ, quia clauditis regnum cælorum ante homines! vos enim non intratis, nec introëuntes sinitis intrare.
text_pt: Mas ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! pois que fechais aos homens o reino dos céus; e nem vós entrais nem deixais entrar aos que estão entrando.
text_el: Οὐαὶ δὲ ὑμῖν, γραμματεῖς καὶ Φαρισαῖοι ὑποκριταί, ὅτι κλείετε τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων: ὑμεῖς γὰρ οὐκ εἰσέρχεσθε, οὐδὲ τοὺς εἰσερχομένους ἀφίετε εἰσελθεῖν.

text_en: Woe to you scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites , because you devour the houses of widows , praying long prayers . For this you shall receive the greater judgment .
text_la: Væ vobis scribæ et pharisæi hypocritæ, quia comeditis domos viduarum, orationes longas orantes! propter hoc amplius accipietis judicium.
text_pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! pois que devorais as casas das viúvas, sob pretexto de prolongadas orações; por isso sofrereis mais rigoroso juízo.

text_en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites , because you go round about the sea and the land to make one proselyte . And when he is made, you make him the child of hell twofold more than yourselves.
text_la: Væ vobis scribæ et pharisæi hypocritæ, quia circuitis mare, et aridam, ut faciatis unum proselytum, et cum fuerit factus, facitis eum filium gehennæ duplo quam vos.
text_pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! pois que percorreis o mar e a terra para fazer um prosélito; e, depois de o terdes feito, o fazeis filho do inferno duas vezes mais do que vós.
text_el: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, γραμματεῖς καὶ Φαρισαῖοι ὑποκριταί, ὅτι περιάγετε τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ τὴν ξηρὰν ποιῆσαι ἕνα προσήλυτον, καὶ ὅταν γένηται, ποιεῖτε αὐτὸν υἱὸν γεέννης διπλότερον ὑμῶν.

text_en: Woe to you, blind guides, that say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple , it is nothing; but he that shall swear by the gold of the temple is a debtor.
text_la: Væ vobis duces cæci, qui dicitis : Quicumque juraverit per templum, nihil est : qui autem juraverit in auro templi, debet.
text_pt: Ai de vós, condutores cegos! pois que dizeis: Qualquer que jurar pelo templo, isso nada é; mas o que jurar pelo ouro do templo, esse é devedor.
text_el: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, ὁδηγοὶ τυφλοὶ οἱ λέγοντες: ὃς ἂν ὀμόσῃ ἐν τῷ ναῷ, οὐδέν ἐστιν: ὃς δ' ἂν ὀμόσῃ ἐν τῷ χρυσῷ τοῦ ναοῦ ὀφείλει.

text_en: You foolish and blind: for whether is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
text_la: Stulti et cæci : quid enim majus est? aurum, an templum, quod sanctificat aurum?
text_pt: Insensatos e cegos! Pois qual é maior: o ouro, ou o templo, que santifica o ouro?
text_el: μωροὶ καὶ τυφλοί, τίς γὰρ μείζων ἐστίν, ὁ χρυσὸς ἢ ὁ ναὸς ὁ ἁγιάσας τὸν χρυσόν;

text_en: And whosoever shall swear by the altar , it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gift that is upon it is a debtor.
text_la: Et quicumque juraverit in altari, nihil est : quicumque autem juraverit in dono, quod est super illud, debet.
text_pt: E aquele que jurar pelo altar isso nada é; mas aquele que jurar pela oferta que está sobre o altar, esse é devedor.
text_el: καί: ὃς ἂν ὀμόσῃ ἐν τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ, οὐδέν ἐστιν: ὃς δ' ἂν ὀμόσῃ ἐν τῷ δώρῳ τῷ ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ ὀφείλει.

text_en: You foolish and blind: for whether is greater, the gift or the altar that sanctifies the gift ?
text_la: Cæci : quid enim majus est, donum, an altare, quod sanctificat donum?
text_pt: Insensatos e cegos! Pois qual é maior: a oferta, ou o altar, que santifica a oferta?
text_el: τυφλοί, τί γὰρ μεῖζον, τὸ δῶρον ἢ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ ἁγιάζον τὸ δῶρον;

text_en: He therefore that swears by the altar swears by it and by all things that are upon it.
text_la: Qui ergo jurat in altari, jurat in eo, et in omnibus quæ super illud sunt.
text_pt: Portanto, o que jurar pelo altar, jura por ele e por tudo o que sobre ele está;
text_el: ὁ οὖν ὀμόσας ἐν τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ ὀμνύει ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ:

text_en: And whosoever shall swear by the temple swears by it and by him that dwells in it.
text_la: Et quicumque juraverit in templo, jurat in illo, et in eo qui habitat in ipso:
text_pt: E, o que jurar pelo templo, jura por ele e por aquele que nele habita;
text_el: καὶ ὁ ὀμόσας ἐν τῷ ναῷ ὀμνύει ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν τῷ κατοικοῦντι αὐτόν:

text_en: And he that swears by heaven swears by the throne of God and by him that sits thereon .
text_la: et qui jurat in cælo, jurat in throno Dei, et in eo qui sedet super eum.
text_pt: E, o que jurar pelo céu, jura pelo trono de Deus e por aquele que está assentado nele.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ὀμόσας ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ὀμνύει ἐν τῷ θρόνῳ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ; because you tithe mint and anise and cumin and have left the weightier things of the law : judgment and mercy and faith . These things you ought to have done and not to leave those undone.
text_la: Væ vobis scribæ et pharisæi hypocritæ, qui decimatis mentham, et anethum, et cyminum, et reliquistis quæ graviora sunt legis, judicium, et misericordiam, et fidem! hæc oportuit facere, et illa non omittere.
text_pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! pois que dizimais a hortelã, o endro e o cominho, e desprezais o mais importante da lei, o juízo, a misericórdia e a fé; deveis, porém, fazer estas coisas, e não omitir aquelas.
text_el: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, γραμματεῖς καὶ Φαρισαῖοι ὑποκριταί, ὅτι ἀποδεκατοῦτε τὸ ἡδύοσμον καὶ τὸ ἄνηθον καὶ τὸ κύμινον, καὶ ἀφήκατε τὰ βαρύτερα τοῦ νόμου, τὴν κρίσιν καὶ τὸ ἔλεος καὶ τὴν πίστιν: ταῦτα δὲ ἔδει ποιῆσαι κἀκεῖνα μὴ ἀφεῖναι.

text_en: Blind guides, who strain out a gnat and swallow a camel.
text_la: Duces cæci, excolantes culicem, camelum autem glutientes.
text_pt: Condutores cegos! que coais um mosquito e engulis um camelo.
text_el: ὁδηγοὶ τυφλοί, διϋλίζοντες τὸν κώνωπα τὴν δὲ κάμηλον καταπίνοντες.

text_en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ; because you make clean the outside of the cup and of the dish, but within you are full of rapine and uncleanness .
text_la: Væ vobis scribæ et pharisæi hypocritæ, quia mundatis quod deforis est calicis et paropsidis; intus autem pleni estis rapina et immunditia!
text_pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! pois que limpais o exterior do copo e do prato, mas o interior está cheio de rapina e de intemperança.
text_el: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, γραμματεῖς καὶ Φαρισαῖοι ὑποκριταί, ὅτι καθαρίζετε τὸ ἔξωθεν τοῦ ποτηρίου καὶ τῆς παροψίδος, ἔσωθεν δὲ γέμουσιν ἐξ ἁρπαγῆς καὶ ἀκρασίας.

text_en: You blind Pharisee , first make clean the inside of the cup and of the dish, that the outside may become clean .
text_la: Pharisæe cæce, munda prius quod intus est calicis, et paropsidis, ut fiat id, quod deforis est, mundum.
text_pt: Fariseu cego! limpa primeiro o interior do copo e do prato, para que também o exterior fique limpo.
text_el: Φαρισαῖε τυφλέ, καθάρισον πρῶτον τὸ ἐντὸς τοῦ ποτηρίου, [καὶ τῆς παροψίδος] ἵνα γένηται καὶ τὸ ἐκτὸς αὐτοῦ καθαρόν.

text_en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ; because you are like to whited sepulchres , which outwardly appear to men beautiful but within are full of dead men's bones and of all filthiness.
text_la: Væ vobis scribæ et pharisæi hypocritæ, quia similes estis sepulchris dealbatis, quæ a foris parent hominibus speciosa, intus vero pleni sunt ossibus mortuorum, et omni spurcitia!
text_pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! pois que sois semelhantes aos sepulcros caiados, que por fora realmente parecem formosos, mas interiormente estão cheios de ossos de mortos e de toda a imundícia.
text_el: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, γραμματεῖς καὶ Φαρισαῖοι ὑποκριταί, ὅτι παρομοιάζετε τάφοις κεκονιαμένοις, οἵτινες ἔξωθεν μὲν φαίνονται ὡραῖοι ἔσωθεν δὲ γέμουσιν ὀστέων νεκρῶν καὶ πάσης ἀκαθαρσίας.

text_en: So you also outwardly indeed appear to men just : but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity .
text_la: Sic et vos a foris quidem paretis hominibus justi : intus autem pleni estis hypocrisi et iniquitate.
text_pt: Assim também vós exteriormente pareceis justos aos homens, mas interiormente estais cheios de hipocrisia e de iniqüidade.
text_el: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔξωθεν μὲν φαίνεσθε τοῖς ἀνθρώποις δίκαιοι, ἔσωθεν δέ ἐστε μεστοὶ ὑποκρίσεως καὶ ἀνομίας.

text_en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites , that build the sepulchres of the prophets and adorn the monuments of the just ,
text_la: Væ vobis scribæ et pharisæi hypocritæ, qui ædificatis sepulchra prophetarum, et ornatis monumenta justorum,
text_pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! pois que edificais os sepulcros dos profetas e adornais os monumentos dos justos,
text_el: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, γραμματεῖς καὶ Φαρισαῖοι ὑποκριταί, ὅτι οἰκοδομεῖτε τοὺς τάφους τῶν προφητῶν καὶ κοσμεῖτε τὰ μνημεῖα τῶν δικαίων,

text_en: and say: If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets .
text_la: et dicitis : Si fuissemus in diebus patrum nostrorum, non essemus socii eorum in sanguine prophetarum!
text_pt: E dizeis: Se existíssemos no tempo de nossos pais, nunca nos associaríamos com eles para derramar o sangue dos profetas.
text_el: καὶ λέγετε: εἰ ἤμεθα ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν, οὐκ ἂν ἤμεθα αὐτῶν κοινωνοὶ ἐν τῷ αἵματι τῶν προφητῶν.

text_en: Wherefore you are witnesses against yourselves, that you are the sons of them that killed the prophets .
text_la: itaque testimonio estis vobismetipsis, quia filii estis eorum, qui prophetas occiderunt.
text_pt: Assim, vós mesmos testificais que sois filhos dos que mataram os profetas.
text_el: ὥστε μαρτυρεῖτε ἑαυτοῖς ὅτι υἱοί ἐστε τῶν φονευσάντων τοὺς προφήτας.

text_en: Fill up then the measure of your fathers.
text_la: Et vos implete mensuram patrum vestrorum.
text_pt: Enchei vós, pois, a medida de vossos pais.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς πληρώσατε τὸ μέτρον τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν.

text_en: You serpents, generation of vipers, how will you flee from the judgment of hell ?
text_la: Serpentes, genimina viperarum, quomodo fugietis a judicio gehennæ?
text_pt: Serpentes, raça de víboras! como escapareis da condenação do inferno?
text_el: ὄφεις, γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, πῶς φύγητε ἀπὸ τῆς κρίσεως τῆς γεέννης;

text_en: Therefore behold I send to you prophets and wise men and scribes : and some of them you will put to death and crucify: and some you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city.
text_la: Ideo ecce ego mitto ad vos prophetas, et sapientes, et scribas, et ex illis occidetis, et crucifigetis, et ex eis flagellabitis in synagogis vestris, et persequemini de civitate in civitatem:
text_pt: Portanto, eis que eu vos envio profetas, sábios e escribas; a uns deles matareis e crucificareis; e a outros deles açoitareis nas vossas sinagogas e os perseguireis de cidade em cidade;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω πρὸς ὑμᾶς προφήτας καὶ σοφοὺς καὶ γραμματεῖς: ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀποκτενεῖτε καὶ σταυρώσετε, καὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν μαστιγώσετε ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς ὑμῶν καὶ διώξετε ἀπὸ πόλεως εἰς πόλιν:

text_en: That upon you may come all the just blood that has been shed upon the earth, from the blood of Abel the just , even unto the blood of Zechariah the son of Barachias , whom you killed between the temple and the altar .
text_la: ut veniat super vos omnis sanguis justus, qui effusus est super terram, a sanguine Abel justi usque ad sanguinem Zachariæ, filii Barachiæ, quem occidistis inter templum et altare.
text_pt: Para que sobre vós caia todo o sangue justo, que foi derramado sobre a terra, desde o sangue de Abel, o justo, até ao sangue de Zacarias, filho de Baraquias, que matastes entre o santuário e o altar.
text_el: ὅπως ἔλθῃ ἐφ' ὑμᾶς πᾶν αἷμα δίκαιον ἐκχυννόμενον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος Ἅβελ τοῦ δικαίου ἕως τοῦ αἵματος Ζαχαρίου υἱοῦ Βαραχίου, ὃν ἐφονεύσατε μεταξὺ τοῦ ναοῦ καὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου.

text_en: Amen I say to you, all these things shall come upon this generation .
text_la: Amen dico vobis, venient hæc omnia super generationem istam.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que todas estas coisas hão de vir sobre esta geração.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἥξει ταῦτα πάντα ἐπὶ τὴν γενεὰν ταύτην.

text_en: Jerusalem , Jerusalem , you that kill the prophets and stone them that are sent unto you, how often would I have gathered together your children, as the hen does gather her chickens under her wings, and you would not?
text_la: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, quæ occidis prophetas, et lapidas eos, qui ad te missi sunt, quoties volui congregare filios tuos, quemadmodum gallina congregat pullos suos sub alas, et noluisti?
text_pt: Jerusalém, Jerusalém, que matas os profetas, e apedrejas os que te são enviados! quantas vezes quis eu ajuntar os teus filhos, como a galinha ajunta os seus pintos debaixo das asas, e tu não quiseste!
text_el: Ἰερουσαλὴμ Ἰερουσαλήμ, ἡ ἀποκτείνουσα τοὺς προφήτας καὶ λιθοβολοῦσα τοὺς ἀπεσταλμένους πρὸς αὐτήν, ποσάκις ἠθέλησα ἐπισυναγαγεῖν τὰ τέκνα σου, ὃν τρόπον ὄρνις ἐπισυνάγει τὰ νοσσία [αὐτῆς] ὑπὸ τὰς πτέρυγας, καὶ οὐκ ἠθελήσατε.

text_en: Behold, your house shall be left to you, desolate.
text_la: Ecce relinquetur vobis domus vestra deserta.
text_pt: Eis que a vossa casa vai ficar-vos deserta;
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἀφίεται ὑμῖν ὁ οἶκος ὑμῶν.

text_en: For I say to you, you shall not see me henceforth till you say: Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord.
text_la: Dico enim vobis, non me videbitis amodo, donec dicatis : Benedictus, qui venit in nomine Domini.
text_pt: Porque eu vos digo que desde agora me não vereis mais, até que digais: Bendito o que vem em nome do Senhor.
text_el: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν, οὐ μή με ἴδητε ἀπ' ἄρτι ἕως ἂν εἴπητε: εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου.

text_en: And Jesus being come out of the temple , went away. And his disciples came to show him the buildings of the temple .
text_la: Et egressus Jesus de templo, ibat. Et accesserunt discipuli ejus, ut ostenderent ei ædificationes templi.
text_pt: E, quando Jesus ia saindo do templo, aproximaram-se dele os seus discípulos para lhe mostrarem a estrutura do templo.
text_el: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ τοῦ ἱεροῦ ἐπορεύετο, καὶ προσῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπιδεῖξαι αὐτῷ τὰς οἰκοδομὰς τοῦ ἱεροῦ:

text_en: And he answering, said to them: Do you see all these things? Amen I say to you, there shall not be left here a stone upon a stone that shall not be destroyed.
text_la: Ipse autem respondens dixit illis : Videtis hæc omnia? amen dico vobis, non relinquetur hic lapis super lapidem, qui non destruatur.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, lhes disse: Não vedes tudo isto? Em verdade vos digo que não ficará aqui pedra sobre pedra que não seja derrubada.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: οὐ βλέπετε ταῦτα πάντα; ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐ μὴ ἀφεθῇ ὧδε λίθος ἐπὶ λίθον, ὃς οὐ καταλυθήσεται.

text_en: And when he was sitting on mount Olivet , the disciples came to him privately, saying: Tell us when shall these things be? And what shall be the sign of your coming and of the consummation of the world?
text_la: Sedente autem eo super montem Oliveti, accesserunt ad eum discipuli secreto, dicentes : Dic nobis, quando hæc erunt? et quod signum adventus tui, et consummationis sæculi?
text_pt: E, estando assentado no Monte das Oliveiras, chegaram-se a ele os seus discípulos em particular, dizendo: Dize-nos, quando serão essas coisas, e que sinal haverá da tua vinda e do fim do mundo?
text_el: καθημένου δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ ὄρους τῶν ἐλαιῶν προσῆλθον αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ κατ' ἰδίαν λέγοντες: εἰπὸν ἡμῖν, πότε ταῦτα ἔσται, καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον τῆς σῆς παρουσίας καὶ συντελείας τοῦ αἰῶνος;

text_en: And Jesus answering, said to them: Take heed that no man seduce you.
text_la: Et respondens Jesus, dixit eis : Videte ne quis vos seducat:
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Acautelai-vos, que ninguém vos engane;
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς πλανήσῃ.

text_en: For many will come in my name saying, I am Christ . And they will seduce many.
text_la: multi enim venient in nomine meo, dicentes : Ego sum Christus : et multos seducent.
text_pt: Porque muitos virão em meu nome, dizendo: Eu sou o Cristo; e enganarão a muitos.
text_el: πολλοὶ γὰρ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου λέγοντες: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ Χριστός, καὶ πολλοὺς πλανήσουσιν.

text_en: And you shall hear of wars and rumours of wars . See that you be not troubled. For these things must come to pass: but the end is not yet.
text_la: Audituri enim estis prælia, et opiniones præliorum. Videte ne turbemini : oportet enim hæc fieri, sed nondum est finis:
text_pt: E ouvireis de guerras e de rumores de guerras; olhai, não vos assusteis, porque é mister que isso tudo aconteça, mas ainda não é o fim.
text_el: μελλήσετε δὲ ἀκούειν πολέμους καὶ ἀκοὰς πολέμων: ὁρᾶτε μὴ θροεῖσθε: δεῖ γὰρ γενέσθαι, ἀλλ' οὔπω ἐστὶν τὸ τέλος.

text_en: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be pestilences and famines and earthquakes in places.
text_la: consurget enim gens in gentem, et regnum in regnum, et erunt pestilentiæ, et fames, et terræmotus per loca:
text_pt: Porquanto se levantará nação contra nação, e reino contra reino, e haverá fomes, e pestes, e terremotos, em vários lugares.
text_el: ἐγερθήσεται γὰρ ἔθνος ἐπὶ' ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν, καὶ ἔσονται λιμοὶ καὶ σεισμοὶ κατὰ τόπους:

text_en: Now all these are the beginnings of sorrows.
text_la: hæc autem omnia initia sunt dolorum.
text_pt: Mas todas estas coisas são o princípio de dores.
text_el: πάντα δὲ ταῦτα ἀρχὴ ὠδίνων.

text_en: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted and shall put you to death : and you shall be hated by all nations for my name's sake.
text_la: Tunc tradent vos in tribulationem, et occident vos : et eritis odio omnibus gentibus propter nomen meum.
text_pt: Então vos hão de entregar para serdes atormentados, e matar-vosão; e sereis odiados de todas as nações por causa do meu nome.
text_el: τότε παραδώσουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς θλῖψιν καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν ὑμᾶς, καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου.

text_en: And then shall many be scandalized and shall betray one another and shall hate one another.
text_la: Et tunc scandalizabuntur multi, et invicem tradent, et odio habebunt invicem.
text_pt: Nesse tempo muitos serão escandalizados, e trair-se-ão uns aos outros, e uns aos outros se odiarào.
text_el: καὶ τότε σκανδαλισθήσονται πολλοὶ καὶ ἀλλήλους παραδώσουσιν καὶ μισήσουσιν ἀλλήλους:

text_en: And many false prophets shall rise and shall seduce many.
text_la: Et multi pseudoprophetæ surgent, et seducent multos.
text_pt: E surgirão muitos falsos profetas, e enganarão a muitos.
text_el: καὶ πολλοὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐγερθήσονται καὶ πλανήσουσιν πολλούς:

text_en: And because iniquity has abounded, the charity of many shall grow cold.
text_la: Et quoniam abundavit iniquitas, refrigescet caritas multorum:
text_pt: E, por se multiplicar a iniqüidade, o amor de muitos esfriará.
text_el: καὶ διὰ τὸ πληθυνθῆναι τὴν ἀνομίαν ψυγήσεται ἡ ἀγάπη τῶν πολλῶν.

text_en: But he that shall persevere to the end, he shall be saved .
text_la: qui autem perseveraverit usque in finem, hic salvus erit.
text_pt: Mas aquele que perseverar até ao fim, esse será salvo.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ὑπομείνας εἰς τέλος οὗτος σωθήσεται.

text_en: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in the whole world, for a testimony to all nations : and then shall the consummation come.
text_la: Et prædicabitur hoc Evangelium regni in universo orbe, in testimonium omnibus gentibus : et tunc veniet consummatio.
text_pt: E este evangelho do reino será pregado em todo o mundo, em testemunho a todas as nações, e então virá o fim.
text_el: καὶ κηρυχθήσεται τοῦτο τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς βασιλείας ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ οἰκουμένῃ εἰς μαρτύριον πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, καὶ τότε ἥξει τὸ τέλος.

text_en: When therefore you shall see the abomination of desolation , which was spoken of by Daniel the prophet , standing in the holy place: he that reads let him understand.
text_la: Cum ergo videritis abominationem desolationis, quæ dicta est a Daniele propheta, stantem in loco sancto, qui legit, intelligat:
text_pt: Quando, pois, virdes que a abominação da desolação, de que falou o profeta Daniel, está no lugar santo; quem lê, entenda;
text_el: Ὅταν οὖν ἴδητε τὸ βδέλυγμα τῆς ἐρημώσεως τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Δανιὴλ τοῦ προφήτου ἑστὸς ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ, ὁ ἀναγινώσκων νοείτω,

text_en: Then they that are in Judea , let them flee to the mountains:
text_la: tunc qui in Judæa sunt, fugiant ad montes:
text_pt: Então, os que estiverem na Judéia, fujam para os montes;
text_el: τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη,

text_en: And he that is on the housetop, let him not come down to take anything out of his house:
text_la: et qui in tecto, non descendat tollere aliquid de domo sua:
text_pt: E quem estiver sobre o telhado não desça a tirar alguma coisa de sua casa;
text_el: ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος μὴ καταβάτω ἆραι τὰ ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And he that is in the field, let him not go back to take his coat.
text_la: et qui in agro, non revertatur tollere tunicam suam.
text_pt: E quem estiver no campo não volte atrás a buscar as suas vestes.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ μὴ ἐπιστρεψάτω ὀπίσω ἆραι τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And woe to them that are with child and that give suck in those days.
text_la: Væ autem prægnantibus et nutrientibus in illis diebus!
text_pt: Mas ai das grávidas e das que amamentarem naqueles dias!
text_el: οὐαὶ δὲ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις.

text_en: But pray that your flight be not in the winter or on the sabbath .
text_la: Orate autem ut non fiat fuga vestra in hieme, vel sabbato:
text_pt: E orai para que a vossa fuga não aconteça no inverno nem no sábado;
text_el: προσεύχεσθε δὲ ἵνα μὴ γένηται ἡ φυγὴ ὑμῶν χειμῶνος μηδὲ σαββάτῳ:

text_en: For there shall be then great tribulation, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, neither shall be.
text_la: erit enim tunc tribulatio magna, qualis non fuit ab initio mundi usque modo, neque fiet.
text_pt: Porque haverá então grande aflição, como nunca houve desde o princípio do mundo até agora, nem tampouco há de haver.
text_el: ἔσται γὰρ τότε θλῖψις μεγάλη οἵα οὐ γέγονεν ἀπ' ἀρχῆς κόσμου ἕως τοῦ νῦν οὐδ' οὐ μὴ γένηται.

text_en: And unless those days had been shortened, no flesh should be saved: but for the sake of the elect those days shall be shortened.
text_la: Et nisi breviati fuissent dies illi, non fieret salva omnis caro : sed propter electos breviabuntur dies illi.
text_pt: E, se aqueles dias não fossem abreviados, nenhuma carne se salvaria; mas por causa dos escolhidos serão abreviados aqueles dias.
text_el: καὶ εἰ μὴ ἐκολοβώθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι ἐκεῖναι, οὐκ ἂν ἐσώθη πᾶσα σάρξ: διὰ δὲ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς κολοβωθήσονται αἱ ἡμέραι ἐκεῖναι.

text_en: Then if any man shall say to you, Lo here is Christ , or there: do not believe him.
text_la: Tunc si quis vobis dixerit : Ecce hic est Christus, aut illic : nolite credere.
text_pt: Então, se alguém vos disser: Eis que o Cristo está aqui, ou ali, não lhe deis crédito;
text_el: τότε ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ: ἰδοὺ ὧδε ὁ Χριστός, ἤ, ὧδε, μὴ πιστεύσητε:

text_en: For there shall arise false Christs and false prophets and shall show great signs and wonders , insomuch as to deceive (if possible) even the elect .
text_la: Surgent enim pseudochristi, et pseudoprophetæ : et dabunt signa magna, et prodigia, ita ut in errorem inducantur (si fieri potest) etiam electi.
text_pt: Porque surgirão falsos cristos e falsos profetas, e farão tão grandes sinais e prodígios que, se possível fora, enganariam até os escolhidos.
text_el: ἐγερθήσονται γὰρ ψευδόχριστοι καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται, καὶ δώσουσιν σημεῖα μεγάλα καὶ τέρατα, ὥστε πλανᾶσθαι, εἰ δυνατόν, καὶ τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς.

text_en: Behold I have told it to you, beforehand.
text_la: Ecce prædixi vobis.
text_pt: Eis que eu vo-lo tenho predito.
text_el: ἰδοὺ προείρηκα ὑμῖν.

text_en: If therefore they shall say to you, Behold he is in the desert : go not out. Behold he is in the closets: believe it not.
text_la: Si ergo dixerint vobis : Ecce in deserto est, nolite exire; Ecce in penetralibus, nolite credere.
text_pt: Portanto, se vos disserem: Eis que ele está no deserto, não saiais. Eis que ele está no interior da casa; não acrediteis.
text_el: ἐὰν οὖν εἴπωσιν ὑμῖν: ἰδοὺ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐστίν, μὴ ἐξέλθητε: ἰδοὺ ἐν τοῖς ταμείοις, μὴ πιστεύσητε:

text_en: For as lightning comes out of the east and appears even into the west: so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
text_la: Sicut enim fulgur exit ab oriente, et paret usque in occidentem : ita erit et adventus Filii hominis.
text_pt: Porque, assim como o relâmpago sai do oriente e se mostra até ao ocidente, assim será também a vinda do Filho do homem.
text_el: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἡ ἀστραπὴ ἐξέρχεται ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ φαίνεται ἕως δυσμῶν, οὕτως ἔσται ἡ παρουσία τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

text_en: Wheresoever the body shall be, there shall the eagles also be gathered together.
text_la: Ubicumque fuerit corpus, illic congregabuntur et aquilæ.
text_pt: Pois onde estiver o cadáver, aí se ajuntarão as águias.
text_el: ὅπου ἐὰν ᾖ τὸ πτῶμα, ἐκεῖ συναχθήσονται οἱ ἀετοί.

text_en: And immediately after the tribulation of those days, the sun shall be darkened and the moon shall not give her light and the stars shall fall from heaven and the powers of heaven shall be moved.
text_la: Statim autem post tribulationem dierum illorum sol obscurabitur, et luna non dabit lumen suum, et stellæ cadent de cælo, et virtutes cælorum commovebuntur:
text_pt: E, logo depois da aflição daqueles dias, o sol escurecerá, e a lua não dará a sua luz, e as estrelas cairão do céu, e as potências dos céus serão abaladas.
text_el: Εὐθέως δὲ μετὰ τὴν θλῖψιν τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐκείνων ὁ ἥλιος σκοτισθήσεται καὶ ἡ σελήνη οὐ δώσει τὸ φέγγος αὐτῆς, καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες πεσοῦνται ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις τῶν οὐρανῶν σαλευθήσονται.

text_en: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven . And then shall all tribes of the earth mourn: and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with much power and majesty.
text_la: et tunc parebit signum Filii hominis in cælo : et tunc plangent omnes tribus terræ : et videbunt Filium hominis venientem in nubibus cæli cum virtute multa et majestate.
text_pt: Então aparecerá no céu o sinal do Filho do homem; e todas as tribos da terra se lamentarão, e verão o Filho do homem, vindo sobre as nuvens do céu, com poder e grande glória.
text_el: καὶ τότε φανήσεται τὸ σημεῖον τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν οὐρανῷ, καὶ τότε κόψονται πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὄψονται τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐπὶ τῶν νεφελῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ μετὰ δυνάμεως καὶ δόξης πολλῆς.

text_en: And he shall send his angels with a trumpet and a great voice: and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the farthest parts of the heavens to the utmost bounds of them.
text_la: Et mittet angelos suos cum tuba, et voce magna : et congregabunt electos ejus a quatuor ventis, a summis cælorum usque ad terminos eorum.
text_pt: E ele enviará os seus anjos com rijo clamor de trombeta, os quais ajuntarão os seus escolhidos desde os quatro ventos, de uma à outra extremidade dos céus.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστελεῖ τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ μετὰ σάλπιγγος μεγάλης, καὶ ἐπισυνάξουσιν τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ἀνέμων ἀπ' ἄκρων οὐρανῶν ἕως τῶν ἄκρων αὐτῶν.

text_en: And from the fig tree learn a parable : When the branch thereof is now tender and the leaves come forth, you know that summer is near.
text_la: Ab arbore autem fici discite parabolam : cum jam ramus ejus tener fuerit, et folia nata, scitis quia prope est æstas:
text_pt: Aprendei, pois, esta parábola da figueira: Quando já os seus ramos se tornam tenros e brotam folhas, sabeis que está próximo o verão.
text_el: Ἀπὸ δὲ τῆς συκῆς μάθετε τὴν παραβολήν. ὅταν ἤδη ὁ κλάδος αὐτῆς γένηται ἁπαλὸς καὶ τὰ φύλλα ἐκφύῃ, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος:

text_en: So you also, when you shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
text_la: ita et vos cum videritis hæc omnia, scitote quia prope est, in januis.
text_pt: Igualmente, quando virdes todas estas coisas, sabei que ele está próximo, às portas.
text_el: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς, ὅταν ἴδητε πάντα ταῦτα, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἐπὶ θύραις.

text_en: Amen I say to you that this generation shall not pass till all these things be done.
text_la: Amen dico vobis, quia non præteribit generatio hæc, donec omnia hæc fiant.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que não passará esta geração sem que todas estas coisas aconteçam.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη ἕως [ἂν] πάντα ταῦτα γένηται.

text_en: Heaven and earth shall pass: but my words shall not pass.
text_la: Cælum et terra transibunt, verba autem mea non præteribunt.
text_pt: O céu e a terra passarão, mas as minhas palavras não hão de passar.
text_el: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσεται, οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ μὴ παρέλθωσιν.

text_en: But of that day and hour no one knows : no, not the angels of heaven , but the Father alone.
text_la: De die autem illa et hora nemo scit, neque angeli cælorum, nisi solus Pater.
text_pt: Mas daquele dia e hora ninguém sabe, nem os anjos do céu, mas unicamente meu Pai.
text_el: Περὶ δὲ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης καὶ ὥρας οὐδεὶς οἶδεν, οὐδὲ οἱ ἄγγελοι τῶν οὐρανῶν οὐδὲ ὁ υἱός, εἰ μὴ ὁ πατὴρ μόνος.

text_en: And as in the days of Noe , so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
text_la: Sicut autem in diebus Noë, ita erit et adventus Filii hominis:
text_pt: E, como foi nos dias de Noé, assim será também a vinda do Filho do homem.
text_el: ὥσπερ γὰρ αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ Νῶε, οὕτως ἔσται ἡ παρουσία τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

text_en: For, as in the days before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage , even till that day in which Noe entered into the ark :
text_la: sicut enim erant in diebus ante diluvium comedentes et bibentes, nubentes et nuptum tradentes, usque ad eum diem, quo intravit Noë in arcam,
text_pt: Porquanto, assim como, nos dias anteriores ao dilúvio, comiam, bebiam, casavam e davam-se em casamento, até ao dia em que Noé entrou na arca,
text_el: ὡς γὰρ ἦσαν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις [ἐκείναις] ταῖς πρὸ τοῦ κατακλυσμοῦ τρώγοντες καὶ πίνοντες, γαμοῦντες καὶ γαμίζοντες, ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας εἰσῆλθεν Νῶε εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν,

text_en: And they knew not till the flood came and took them all away: so also shall the coming of the Son of man be.
text_la: et non cognoverunt donec venit diluvium, et tulit omnes : ita erit et adventus Filii hominis.
text_pt: E não o perceberam, até que veio o dilúvio, e os levou a todos, assim será também a vinda do Filho do homem.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ἕως ἦλθεν ὁ κατακλυσμὸς καὶ ἦρεν ἅπαντας, οὕτως ἔσται ἡ παρουσία τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

text_en: Then two shall be in the field. One shall be taken and one shall be left.
text_la: Tunc duo erunt in agro : unus assumetur, et unus relinquetur.
text_pt: Então, estando dois no campo, será levado um, e deixado o outro;
text_el: τότε ἔσονται δύο ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ, εἷς παραλαμβάνεται καὶ εἷς ἀφίεται:

text_en: Two women shall be grinding at the mill. One shall be taken and one shall be left.
text_la: Duæ molentes in mola : una assumetur, et una relinquetur.
text_pt: Estando duas moendo no moinho, será levada uma, e deixada outra.
text_el: δύο ἀλήθουσαι ἐν τῷ μύλῳ, μία παραλαμβάνεται καὶ μία ἀφίεται.

text_en: Watch therefore, because you know not what hour your Lord will come.
text_la: Vigilate ergo, quia nescitis qua hora Dominus vester venturus sit.
text_pt: Vigiai, pois, porque não sabeis a que hora há de vir o vosso Senhor.
text_el: γρηγορεῖτε οὖν, ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε ποίᾳ ἡμέρᾳ ὁ κύριος ὑμῶν ἔρχεται.

text_en: But know this: that, if the goodman of the house knew at what hour the thief would come, he would certainly watch and would not suffer his house to be broken open.
text_la: Illud autem scitote, quoniam si sciret paterfamilias qua hora fur venturus esset, vigilaret utique, et non sineret perfodi domum suam.
text_pt: Mas considerai isto: se o pai de família soubesse a que vigília da noite havia de vir o ladrão, vigiaria e não deixaria minar a sua casa.
text_el: Ἐκεῖνο δὲ γινώσκετε, ὅτι εἰ ᾔδει ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης ποίᾳ φυλακῇ ὁ κλέπτης ἔρχεται, ἐγρηγόρησεν ἂν καὶ οὐκ ἂν εἴασεν διορυχθῆναι τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Wherefore be you also ready, because at what hour you know not the Son of man will come.
text_la: Ideo et vos estote parati : quia qua nescitis hora Filius hominis venturus est.
text_pt: Por isso, estai vós apercebidos também; porque o Filho do homem há de vir à hora em que não penseis.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ὑμεῖς γίνεσθε ἕτοιμοι, ὅτι ᾗ οὐ δοκεῖτε ὥρᾳ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔρχεται.

text_en: Who, do you think, is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has appointed over his family , to give them meat in season?
text_la: Quis, putas, est fidelis servus, et prudens, quem constituit dominus suus super familiam suam ut det illis cibum in tempore?
text_pt: Quem é, pois, o servo fiel e prudente, que o seu senhor constituiu sobre a sua casa, para dar o sustento a seu tempo?
text_el: Τίς ἄρα ἐστὶν ὁ πιστὸς δοῦλος καὶ φρόνιμος, ὃν κατέστησεν ὁ κύριος ἐπὶ τῆς οἰκετείας αὐτοῦ τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτοῖς τὴν τροφὴν ἐν καιρῷ;

text_en: Blessed is that servant, whom when his lord shall come he shall find so doing.
