text_la: Beatus ille servus, quem cum venerit dominus ejus, invenerit sic facientem.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado aquele servo que o seu senhor, quando vier, achar servindo assim.
text_el: μακάριος ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος ὃν ἐλθὼν ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ εὑρήσει οὕτως ποιοῦντα.

text_en: Amen I say to you: he shall place him over all his goods .
text_la: Amen dico vobis, quoniam super omnia bona sua constituet eum.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que o porá sobre todos os seus bens.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ὑπάρχουσιν αὐτοῦ καταστήσει αὐτόν.

text_en: But if that evil servant shall say in his heart: My lord is long a coming:
text_la: Si autem dixerit malus servus ille in corde suo : Moram fecit dominus meus venire:
text_pt: Mas se aquele mau servo disser no seu coração: O meu senhor tarde virá;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ εἴπῃ ὁ κακὸς δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ: χρονίζει μου ὁ κύριος,

text_en: And shall begin to strike his fellow servants and shall eat and drink with drunkards :
text_la: et cœperit percutere conservos suos, manducet autem et bibat cum ebriosis:
text_pt: E começar a espancar os seus conservos, e a comer e a beber com os ébrios,
text_el: καὶ ἄρξηται τύπτειν τοὺς συνδούλους αὐτοῦ, ἐσθίῃ δὲ καὶ πίνῃ μετὰ τῶν μεθυόντων:

text_en: The lord of that servant shall come in a day that he hopes not and at an hour that he knows not:
text_la: veniet dominus servi illius in die qua non sperat, et hora qua ignorat:
text_pt: Virá o senhor daquele servo num dia em que o não espera, e à hora em que ele não sabe,
text_el: ἥξει ὁ κύριος τοῦ δούλου ἐκείνου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ οὐ προσδοκᾷ καὶ ἐν ὥρᾳ ᾗ οὐ γινώσκει,

text_en: And shall separate him and appoint his portion with the hypocrites . There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text_la: et dividet eum, partemque ejus ponet cum hypocritis : illic erit fletus et stridor dentium.
text_pt: E separá-lo-á, e destinará a sua parte com os hipócritas; ali haverá pranto e ranger de dentes.
text_el: καὶ διχοτομήσει αὐτὸν, καὶ τὸ μέρος αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ὑποκριτῶν θήσει: ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.

text_en: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be like to ten virgins , who taking their lamps went out to meet the bridegroom and the bride.
text_la: Tunc simile erit regnum cælorum decem virginibus : quæ accipientes lampades suas exierunt obviam sponso et sponsæ.
text_pt: Então o reino dos céus será semelhante a dez virgens que, tomando as suas lâmpadas, saíram ao encontro do esposo.
text_el: Τότε ὁμοιωθήσεται ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν δέκα παρθένοις, αἵτινες λαβοῦσαι τὰς λαμπάδας ἑαυτῶν ἐξῆλθον εἰς ὑπάντησιν τοῦ νυμφίου.

text_en: And five of them were foolish and five wise.
text_la: Quinque autem ex eis erant fatuæ, et quinque prudentes:
text_pt: E cinco delas eram prudentes, e cinco loucas.
text_el: πέντε δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἦσαν μωραὶ καὶ πέντε φρόνιμοι.

text_en: But the five foolish, having taken their lamps, did not take oil with them.
text_la: sed quinque fatuæ, acceptis lampadibus, non sumpserunt oleum secum:
text_pt: As loucas, tomando as suas lâmpadas, não levaram azeite consigo.
text_el: αἱ γὰρ μωραὶ λαβοῦσαι τὰς λαμπάδας [αὐτῶν] οὐκ ἔλαβον μεθ' ἑαυτῶν ἔλαιον:

text_en: But the wise took oil in their vessels with the lamps.
text_la: prudentes vero acceperunt oleum in vasis suis cum lampadibus.
text_pt: Mas as prudentes levaram azeite em suas vasilhas, com as suas lâmpadas.
text_el: αἱ δὲ φρόνιμοι ἔλαβον ἔλαιον ἐν τοῖς ἀγγείοις μετὰ τῶν λαμπάδων ἑαυτῶν.

text_en: And the bridegroom tarrying, they all slumbered and slept.
text_la: Moram autem faciente sponso, dormitaverunt omnes et dormierunt.
text_pt: E, tardando o esposo, tosquenejaram todas, e adormeceram.
text_el: χρονίζοντος δὲ τοῦ νυμφίου ἐνύσταξαν πᾶσαι καὶ ἐκάθευδον.

text_en: And at midnight there was a cry made: Behold the bridegroom comes. Go forth to meet him.
text_la: Media autem nocte clamor factus est : Ecce sponsus venit, exite obviam ei.
text_pt: Mas à meia-noite ouviu-se um clamor: Aí vem o esposo, saí-lhe ao encontro.
text_el: μέσης δὲ νυκτὸς κραυγὴ γέγονεν: ἰδοὺ ὁ νυμφίος, ἐξέρχεσθε εἰς ἀπάντησιν.

text_en: Then all those virgins arose and trimmed their lamps.
text_la: Tunc surrexerunt omnes virgines illæ, et ornaverunt lampades suas.
text_pt: Então todas aquelas virgens se levantaram, e prepararam as suas lâmpadas.
text_el: τότε ἠγέρθησαν πᾶσαι αἱ παρθένοι ἐκεῖναι καὶ ἐκόσμησαν τὰς λαμπάδας ἑαυτῶν.

text_en: And the foolish said to the wise: Give us of your oil, for our lamps have gone out.
text_la: Fatuæ autem sapientibus dixerunt : Date nobis de oleo vestro, quia lampades nostræ extinguuntur.
text_pt: E as loucas disseram às prudentes: Dai-nos do vosso azeite, porque as nossas lâmpadas se apagam.
text_el: αἱ δὲ μωραὶ ταῖς φρονίμοις εἶπαν: δότε ἡμῖν ἐκ τοῦ ἐλαίου ὑμῶν, ὅτι αἱ λαμπάδες ἡμῶν σβέννυνται.

text_en: The wise answered, saying: Lest perhaps there be not enough for us and for you, go rather to them that sell and buy for yourselves.
text_la: Responderunt prudentes, dicentes : Ne forte non sufficiat nobis, et vobis, ite potius ad vendentes, et emite vobis.
text_pt: Mas as prudentes responderam, dizendo: Não seja caso que nos falte a nós e a vós, ide antes aos que o vendem, e comprai-o para vós.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν δὲ αἱ φρόνιμοι λέγουσαι: μήποτε οὐ μὴ ἀρκέσῃ ἡμῖν καὶ ὑμῖν: πορεύεσθε μᾶλλον πρὸς τοὺς πωλοῦντας καὶ ἀγοράσατε ἑαυταῖς.

text_en: Now whilst they went to buy the bridegroom came: and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage . And the door was shut.
text_la: Dum autem irent emere, venit sponsus : et quæ paratæ erant, intraverunt cum eo ad nuptias, et clausa est janua.
text_pt: E, tendo elas ido comprá-lo, chegou o esposo, e as que estavam preparadas entraram com ele para as bodas, e fechou-se a porta.
text_el: ἀπερχομένων δὲ αὐτῶν ἀγοράσαι ἦλθεν ὁ νυμφίος, καὶ αἱ ἕτοιμοι εἰσῆλθον μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τοὺς γάμους, καὶ ἐκλείσθη ἡ θύρα.

text_en: But at last came also the other virgins , saying: Lord, Lord, open to us.
text_la: Novissime vero veniunt et reliquæ virgines, dicentes : Domine, domine, aperi nobis.
text_pt: E depois chegaram também as outras virgens, dizendo: Senhor, Senhor, abre-nos.
text_el: ὕστερον δὲ ἔρχονται καὶ αἱ λοιπαὶ παρθένοι λέγουσαι: κύριε κύριε, ἄνοιξον ἡμῖν.

text_en: But he answering said: Amen I say to you, I know you not.
text_la: At ille respondens, ait : Amen dico vobis, nescio vos.
text_pt: E ele, respondendo, disse: Em verdade vos digo que vos não conheço.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐκ οἶδα ὑμᾶς.

text_en: Watch therefore, because you know not the day nor the hour.
text_la: Vigilate itaque, quia nescitis diem, neque horam.
text_pt: Vigiai, pois, porque não sabeis o dia nem a hora em que o Filho do homem há de vir.
text_el: γρηγορεῖτε οὖν, ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν ἡμέραν οὐδὲ τὴν ὥραν.

text_en: For even as a man going into a far country called his servants and delivered to them his goods ;
text_la: Sicut enim homo peregre proficiscens, vocavit servos suos, et tradidit illis bona sua.
text_pt: Porque isto é também como um homem que, partindo para fora da terra, chamou os seus servos, e entregou-lhes os seus bens.
text_el: Ὥσπερ γὰρ ἄνθρωπος ἀποδημῶν ἐκάλεσεν τοὺς ἰδίους δούλους καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοῖς τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ,

text_en: and to one he gave five talents, and to another two, and to another one, to every one according to his proper ability: and immediately he took his journey.
text_la: Et uni dedit quinque talenta, alii autem duo, alii vero unum, unicuique secundum propriam virtutem : et profectus est statim.
text_pt: E a um deu cinco talentos, e a outro dois, e a outro um, a cada um segundo a sua capacidade, e ausentou-se logo para longe.
text_el: καὶ ᾧ μὲν ἔδωκεν πέντε τάλαντα, ᾧ δὲ δύο, ᾧ δὲ ἕν, ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὴν ἰδίαν δύναμιν, καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν. εὐθέως

text_en: And he that had received the five talents went his way and traded with the same and gained other five.
text_la: Abiit autem qui quinque talenta acceperat, et operatus est in eis, et lucratus est alia quinque.
text_pt: E, tendo ele partido, o que recebera cinco talentos negociou com eles, e granjeou outros cinco talentos.
text_el: πορευθεὶς ὁ τὰ πέντε τάλαντα λαβὼν ἠργάσατο ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐκέρδησεν ἄλλα πέντε:

text_en: And in like manner he that had received the two gained other two.
text_la: Similiter et qui duo acceperat, lucratus est alia duo.
text_pt: Da mesma sorte, o que recebera dois, granjeou também outros dois.
text_el: ὡσαύτως ὁ τὰ δύο ἐκέρδησεν ἄλλα δύο.

text_en: But he that had received the one, going his way, digged into the earth and hid his lord's money.
text_la: Qui autem unum acceperat, abiens fodit in terram, et abscondit pecuniam domini sui.
text_pt: Mas o que recebera um, foi e cavou na terra e escondeu o dinheiro do seu senhor.
text_el: ὁ δὲ τὸ ἓν λαβὼν ἀπελθὼν ὤρυξεν γῆν καὶ ἔκρυψεν τὸ ἀργύριον τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ.

text_en: But after a long time the lord of those servants came and reckoned with them.
text_la: Post multum vero temporis venit dominus servorum illorum, et posuit rationem cum eis.
text_pt: E muito tempo depois veio o senhor daqueles servos, e fez contas com eles.
text_el: μετὰ δὲ πολὺν χρόνον ἔρχεται ὁ κύριος τῶν δούλων ἐκείνων καὶ συναίρει λόγον μετ' αὐτῶν.

text_en: And he that had received the five talents coming, brought other five talents, saying: Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold I have gained other five over and above.
text_la: Et accedens qui quinque talenta acceperat, obtulit alia quinque talenta, dicens : Domine, quinque talenta tradidisti mihi, ecce alia quinque superlucratus sum.
text_pt: Então aproximou-se o que recebera cinco talentos, e trouxe-lhe outros cinco talentos, dizendo: Senhor, entregaste-me cinco talentos; eis aqui outros cinco talentos que granjeei com eles.
text_el: καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ τὰ πέντε τάλαντα λαβὼν προσήνεγκεν ἄλλα πέντε τάλαντα λέγων: κύριε, πέντε τάλαντά μοι παρέδωκας, ἴδε ἄλλα πέντε τάλαντα ἐκέρδησα.

text_en: His lord said to him: Well done, good and faithful servant, because you have been faithful over a few things, I will place you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.
text_la: Ait illi dominus ejus : Euge serve bone, et fidelis : quia super pauca fuisti fidelis, super multa te constituam; intra in gaudium domini tui.
text_pt: E o seu senhor lhe disse: Bem está, servo bom e fiel. Sobre o pouco foste fiel, sobre muito te colocarei; entra no gozo do teu senhor.
text_el: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ: εὖ, δοῦλε ἀγαθὲ καὶ πιστέ, ἐπὶ ὀλίγα ἦς πιστός, ἐπὶ πολλῶν σε καταστήσω: εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν χαρὰν τοῦ κυρίου σου.

text_en: And he also that had received the two talents came and said: Lord, you delivered two talents to me. Behold I have gained other two.
text_la: Accessit autem et qui duo talenta acceperat, et ait : Domine, duo talenta tradidisti mihi, ecce alia duo lucratus sum.
text_pt: E, chegando também o que tinha recebido dois talentos, disse: Senhor, entregaste-me dois talentos; eis que com eles granjeei outros dois talentos.
text_el: προσελθὼν καὶ ὁ τὰ δύο τάλαντα εἶπεν: κύριε, δύο τάλαντά μοι παρέδωκας: ἴδε ἄλλα δύο τάλαντα ἐκέρδησα.

text_en: His lord said to him: Well done, good and faithful servant: because you have been faithful over a few things, I will place you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.
text_la: Ait illi dominus ejus : Euge serve bone, et fidelis : quia super pauca fuisti fidelis, super multa te constituam; intra in gaudium domini tui.
text_pt: Disse-lhe o seu senhor: Bem está, bom e fiel servo. Sobre o pouco foste fiel, sobre muito te colocarei; entra no gozo do teu senhor.
text_el: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ: εὖ, δοῦλε ἀγαθὲ καὶ πιστέ, ἐπὶ ὀλίγα ἦς πιστός, ἐπὶ πολλῶν σε καταστήσω: εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν χαρὰν τοῦ κυρίου σου.

text_en: But he that had received the one talent, came and said: Lord, I know that you are a hard man ; you reap where you have not sown and gather where you have not strewed.
text_la: Accedens autem et qui unum talentum acceperat, ait : Domine, scio quia homo durus es; metis ubi non seminasti, et congregas ubi non sparsisti:
text_pt: Mas, chegando também o que recebera um talento, disse: Senhor, eu conhecia-te, que és um homem duro, que ceifas onde não semeaste e ajuntas onde não espalhaste;
text_el: προσελθὼν δὲ καὶ ὁ τὸ ἓν τάλαντον εἰληφὼς εἶπεν: κύριε, ἔγνων σε ὅτι σκληρὸς εἶ ἄνθρωπος, θερίζων ὅπου οὐκ ἔσπειρας, καὶ συνάγων ὅθεν οὐ διεσκόρπισας:

text_en: And being afraid , I went and hid your talent in the earth. Behold here you have that which is yours.
text_la: et timens abii, et abscondi talentum tuum in terra : ecce habes quod tuum est.
text_pt: E, atemorizado, escondi na terra o teu talento; aqui tens o que é teu.
text_el: καὶ φοβηθεὶς ἀπελθὼν ἔκρυψα τὸ τάλαντόν σου ἐν τῇ γῇ: ἴδε ἔχεις τὸ σόν.

text_en: And his lord answering, said to him: Wicked and slothful servant, you knew that I reap where I sow not and gather where I have not strewed.
text_la: Respondens autem dominus ejus, dixit ei : Serve male, et piger, sciebas quia meto ubi non semino, et congrego ubi non sparsi:
text_pt: Respondendo, porém, o seu senhor, disse-lhe: Mau e negligente servo; sabias que ceifo onde não semeei e ajunto onde não espalhei?
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: πονηρὲ δοῦλε καὶ ὀκνηρέ, ᾔδεις ὅτι θερίζω ὅπου οὐκ ἔσπειρα καὶ συνάγω ὅθεν οὐ διεσκόρπισα;

text_en: You ought therefore to have committed my money to the bankers: and at my coming I should have received my own with usury .
text_la: oportuit ergo te committere pecuniam meam numulariis, et veniens ego recepissem utique quod meum est cum usura.
text_pt: Devias então ter dado o meu dinheiro aos banqueiros e, quando eu viesse, receberia o meu com os juros.
text_el: ἔδει σε οὖν βαλεῖν τὰ ἀργύριά μου τοῖς τραπεζίταις, καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐγὼ ἐκομισάμην ἂν τὸ ἐμὸν σὺν τόκῳ.

text_en: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it him that has ten talents.
text_la: Tollite itaque ab eo talentum, et date ei qui habet decem talenta:
text_pt: Tirai-lhe pois o talento, e dai-o ao que tem os dez talentos.
text_el: ἄρατε οὖν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ τὸ τάλαντον καὶ δότε τῷ ἔχοντι τὰ δέκα τάλαντα:

text_en: For to every one that has shall be given, and he shall abound: but from him that has not, that also which he seems to have shall be taken away.
text_la: omni enim habenti dabitur, et abundabit : ei autem qui non habet, et quod videtur habere, auferetur ab eo.
text_pt: Porque a qualquer que tiver será dado, e terá em abundância; mas ao que não tiver até o que tem ser-lhe-á tirado.
text_el: τῷ γὰρ ἔχοντι παντὶ δοθήσεται καὶ περισσευθήσεται: τοῦ δὲ μὴ ἔχοντος, καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the unprofitable servant, cast out into the exterior darkness. There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text_la: Et inutilem servum ejicite in tenebras exteriores : illic erit fletus, et stridor dentium.
text_pt: Lançai, pois, o servo inútil nas trevas exteriores; ali haverá pranto e ranger de dentes.
text_el: καὶ τὸν ἀχρεῖον δοῦλον ἐκβάλετε εἰς τὸ σκότος τὸ ἐξώτερον: ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.

text_en: And when the Son of man shall come in his majesty, and all the angels with him, then shall he sit upon the seat of his majesty.
text_la: Cum autem venerit Filius hominis in majestate sua, et omnes angeli cum eo, tunc sedebit super sedem majestatis suæ:
text_pt: E quando o Filho do homem vier em sua glória, e todos os santos anjos com ele, então se assentará no trono da sua glória;
text_el: Ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν τῇ δόξῃ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι μετ' αὐτοῦ, τότε καθίσει ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης αὐτοῦ:

text_en: And all nations shall be gathered together before him: and he shall separate them one from another, as the shepherd separates the sheep from the goats:
text_la: et congregabuntur ante eum omnes gentes, et separabit eos ab invicem, sicut pastor segregat oves ab hædis:
text_pt: E todas as nações serão reunidas diante dele, e apartará uns dos outros, como o pastor aparta dos bodes as ovelhas;
text_el: καὶ συναχθήσονται ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ ἀφορίσει αὐτοὺς ἀπ' ἀλλήλων, ὥσπερ ὁ ποιμὴν ἀφορίζει τὰ πρόβατα ἀπὸ τῶν ἐρίφων,

text_en: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on his left.
text_la: et statuet oves quidem a dextris suis, hædos autem a sinistris.
text_pt: E porá as ovelhas à sua direita, mas os bodes à esquerda.
text_el: καὶ στήσει τὰ μὲν πρόβατα ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ, τὰ δὲ ἐρίφια ἐξ εὐωνύμων.

text_en: Then shall the king say to them that shall be on his right hand: Come, you blessed of my Father , possess you the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
text_la: Tunc dicet rex his qui a dextris ejus erunt : Venite benedicti Patris mei, possidete paratum vobis regnum a constitutione mundi:
text_pt: Então dirá o Rei aos que estiverem à sua direita: Vinde, benditos de meu Pai, possuí por herança o reino que vos está preparado desde a fundação do mundo;
text_el: τότε ἐρεῖ ὁ βασιλεὺς τοῖς ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ: δεῦτε, οἱ εὐλογημένοι τοῦ πατρός μου, κληρονομήσατε τὴν ἡτοιμασμένην ὑμῖν βασιλείαν ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου.

text_en: For I was hungry, and you gave me to eat: I was thirsty, and you gave me to drink: I was a stranger, and you took me in:
text_la: esurivi enim, et dedistis mihi manducare : sitivi, et dedistis mihi bibere : hospes eram, et collegistis me:
text_pt: Porque tive fome, e destes-me de comer; tive sede, e destes-me de beber; era estrangeiro, e hospedastes-me;
text_el: ἐπείνασα γὰρ καὶ ἐδώκατέ μοι φαγεῖν, ἐδίψησα καὶ ἐποτίσατέ με, ξένος ἤμην καὶ συνηγάγετέ με,

text_en: Naked, and you covered me: sick, and you visited me: I was in prison , and you came to me.
text_la: nudus, et cooperuistis me : infirmus, et visitastis me : in carcere eram, et venistis ad me.
text_pt: Estava nu, e vestistes-me; adoeci, e visitastes-me; estive na prisão, e foste me ver.
text_el: γυμνὸς καὶ περιεβάλετέ με, ἠσθένησα καὶ ἐπεσκέψασθέ με, ἐν φυλακῇ ἤμην καὶ ἤλθατε πρός με.

text_en: Then shall the just answer him, saying: Lord, when did we see you hungry and fed you: thirsty and gave you drink?
text_la: Tunc respondebunt ei justi, dicentes : Domine, quando te vidimus esurientem, et pavimus te : sitientem, et dedimus tibi potum?
text_pt: Então os justos lhe responderão, dizendo: Senhor, quando te vimos com fome, e te demos de comer? ou com sede, e te demos de beber?
text_el: τότε ἀποκριθήσονται αὐτῷ οἱ δίκαιοι λέγοντες: κύριε, πότε σε εἴδομεν πεινῶντα καὶ ἐθρέψαμεν; ἢ διψῶντα καὶ ἐποτίσαμεν;

text_en: Or when did we see you a stranger and took you in? Or naked and covered you?
text_la: quando autem te vidimus hospitem, et collegimus te : aut nudum, et cooperuimus te?
text_pt: E quando te vimos estrangeiro, e te hospedamos? ou nu, e te vestimos?
text_el: πότε δέ σε εἴδομεν ξένον καὶ συνηγάγομεν; ἢ γυμνὸν καὶ περιεβάλομεν;

text_en: Or when did we see you sick or in prison and came to you?
text_la: aut quando te vidimus infirmum, aut in carcere, et venimus ad te?
text_pt: E quando te vimos enfermo, ou na prisão, e fomos ver-te?
text_el: πότε δέ σε εἴδομεν ἀσθενοῦντα ἢ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ ἤλθομεν πρός σε;

text_en: And the king answering shall say to them: Amen I say to you, as long as you did it to one of these my least brethren, you did it to me.
text_la: Et respondens rex, dicet illis : Amen dico vobis, quamdiu fecistis uni ex his fratribus meis minimis, mihi fecistis.
text_pt: E, respondendo o Rei, lhes dirá: Em verdade vos digo que quando o fizestes a um destes meus pequeninos irmãos, a mim o fizestes.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐρεῖ αὐτοῖς: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐφ' ὅσον ἐποιήσατε ἑνὶ τούτων τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου τῶν ἐλαχίστων, ἐμοὶ ἐποιήσατε.

text_en: Then he shall say to them also that shall be on his left hand: Depart from me, you cursed , into everlasting fire , which was prepared for the devil and his angels .
text_la: Tunc dicet et his qui a sinistris erunt : Discedite a me maledicti in ignem æternum, qui paratus est diabolo, et angelis ejus:
text_pt: Então dirá também aos que estiverem à sua esquerda: Apartai-vos de mim, malditos, para o fogo eterno, preparado para o diabo e seus anjos;
text_el: τότε ἐρεῖ καὶ τοῖς ἐξ εὐωνύμων: πορεύεσθε ἀπ' ἐμοῦ κατηραμένοι εἰς τὸ πῦρ τὸ αἰώνιον τὸ ἡτοιμασμένον τῷ διαβόλῳ καὶ τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ.

text_en: For I was hungry and you gave me not to eat: I was thirsty and you gave me not to drink.
text_la: esurivi enim, et non dedistis mihi manducare : sitivi, et non desistis mihi potum:
text_pt: Porque tive fome, e não me destes de comer; tive sede, e não me destes de beber;
text_el: ἐπείνασα γὰρ καὶ οὐκ ἐδώκατέ μοι φαγεῖν, [καὶ] ἐδίψησα καὶ οὐκ ἐποτίσατέ με,

text_en: I was a stranger and you took me not in: naked and you covered me not: sick and in prison and you did not visit me.
text_la: hospes eram, et non collegistis me : nudus, et non cooperuistis me : infirmus, et in carcere, et non visitastis me.
text_pt: Sendo estrangeiro, não me recolhestes; estando nu, não me vestistes; e enfermo, e na prisão, não me visitastes.
text_el: ξένος ἤμην καὶ οὐ συνηγάγετέ με, γυμνὸς καὶ οὐ περιεβάλετέ με, ἀσθενὴς καὶ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ οὐκ ἐπεσκέψασθέ με.

text_en: Then they also shall answer him, saying: Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison and did not minister to you?
text_la: Tunc respondebunt ei et ipsi, dicentes : Domine, quando te vidimus esurientem, aut sitientem, aut hospitem, aut nudum, aut infirmum, aut in carcere, et non ministravimus tibi?
text_pt: Então eles também lhe responderão, dizendo: Senhor, quando te vimos com fome, ou com sede, ou estrangeiro, ou nu, ou enfermo, ou na prisão, e não te servimos?
text_el: τότε ἀποκριθήσονται καὶ αὐτοὶ λέγοντες: κύριε, πότε σε εἴδομεν πεινῶντα ἢ διψῶντα ἢ ξένον ἢ γυμνὸν ἢ ἀσθενῆ ἢ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ οὐ διηκονήσαμέν σοι;

text_en: Then he shall answer them, saying: Amen : I say to you, as long as you did it not to one of these least, neither did you do it to me.
text_la: Tunc respondebit illis, dicens : Amen dico vobis : Quamdiu non fecistis uni de minoribus his, nec mihi fecistis.
text_pt: Então lhes responderá, dizendo: Em verdade vos digo que, quando a um destes pequeninos o não fizestes, não o fizestes a mim.
text_el: τότε ἀποκριθήσεται αὐτοῖς λέγων: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐφ' ὅσον οὐκ ἐποιήσατε ἑνὶ τούτων τῶν ἐλαχίστων, οὐδὲ ἐμοὶ ἐποιήσατε.

text_en: And these shall go into everlasting punishment : but the just , into life everlasting .
text_la: Et ibunt hi in supplicium æternum: justi autem in vitam æternam.
text_pt: E irão estes para o tormento eterno, mas os justos para a vida eterna.
text_el: καὶ ἀπελεύσονται οὗτοι εἰς κόλασιν αἰώνιον, οἱ δὲ δίκαιοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

text_en: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended all these words, he said to his disciples :
text_la: Et factum est : cum consummasset Jesus sermones hos omnes, dixit discipulis suis:
text_pt: E aconteceu que, quando Jesus concluiu todos estes discursos, disse aos seus discípulos:
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους, εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ:

text_en: You know that after two days shall be the pasch : and the Son of man shall be delivered up to be crucified.
text_la: Scitis quia post biduum Pascha fiet, et Filius hominis tradetur ut crucifigatur.
text_pt: Bem sabeis que daqui a dois dias é a páscoa; e o Filho do homem será entregue para ser crucificado.
text_el: οἴδατε ὅτι μετὰ δύο ἡμέρας τὸ πάσχα γίνεται, καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται εἰς τὸ σταυρωθῆναι.

text_en: Then were gathered together the chief priests and ancients of the people, into the court of the high priest , who was called Caiphas :
text_la: Tunc congregati sunt principes sacerdotum, et seniores populi, in atrium principis sacerdotum, qui dicebatur Caiphas:
text_pt: Depois os príncipes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, e os anciãos do povo reuniram-se na sala do sumo sacerdote, o qual se chamava Caifás.
text_el: Τότε συνήχθησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως τοῦ λεγομένου Καϊάφα,

text_en: And they consulted together that by subtilty they might apprehend Jesus and put him to death.
text_la: et consilium fecerunt ut Jesum dolo tenerent, et occiderent.
text_pt: E consultaram-se mutuamente para prenderem Jesus com dolo e o matarem.
text_el: καὶ συνεβουλεύσαντο ἵνα τὸν Ἰησοῦν δόλῳ κρατήσωσιν καὶ ἀποκτείνωσιν:

text_en: But they said: Not on the festival day , lest perhaps there should be a tumult among the people.
text_la: Dicebant autem : Non in die festo, ne forte tumultus fieret in populo.
text_pt: Mas diziam: Não durante a festa, para que não haja alvoroço entre o povo.
text_el: ἔλεγον δέ: μὴ ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ, ἵνα μὴ θόρυβος γένηται ἐν τῷ λαῷ.

text_en: And when Jesus was in Bethania , in the house of Simon the leper ,
text_la: Cum autem Jesus esset in Bethania in domo Simonis leprosi,
text_pt: E, estando Jesus em Betânia, em casa de Simão, o leproso,
text_el: Τοῦ δὲ Ἰησοῦ γενομένου ἐν Βηθανίᾳ ἐν οἰκίᾳ Σίμωνος τοῦ λεπροῦ,

text_en: there came to him a woman having an alabaster box of precious ointment and poured it on his head as he was at table.
text_la: accessit ad eum mulier habens alabastrum unguenti pretiosi, et effudit super caput ipsius recumbentis.
text_pt: Aproximou-se dele uma mulher com um vaso de alabastro, com ungüento de grande valor, e derramou-lho sobre a cabeça, quando ele estava assentado à mesa.
text_el: προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ γυνὴ ἔχουσα ἀλάβαστρον μύρου βαρυτίμου καὶ κατέχεεν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ ἀνακειμένου.

text_en: And the disciples seeing it had indignation, saying: To what purpose is this waste?
text_la: Videntes autem discipuli, indignati sunt, dicentes : Ut quid perditio hæc?
text_pt: E os seus discípulos, vendo isto, indignaram-se, dizendo: Por que é este desperdício?
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἠγανάκτησαν λέγοντες: εἰς τί ἡ ἀπώλεια αὕτη;

text_en: For this might have been sold for much and given to the poor.
text_la: potuit enim istud venundari multo, et dari pauperibus.
text_pt: Pois este ungüento podia vender-se por grande preço, e dar-se o dinheiro aos pobres.
text_el: ἐδύνατο γὰρ τοῦτο πραθῆναι πολλοῦ καὶ δοθῆναι πτωχοῖς.

text_en: And Jesus knowing it, said to them: Why do you trouble this woman ? For she has wrought a good work upon me.
text_la: Sciens autem Jesus, ait illis : Quid molesti estis huic mulieri? opus enim bonum operata est in me.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, conhecendo isto, disse-lhes: Por que afligis esta mulher? pois praticou uma boa ação para comigo.
text_el: γνοὺς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τί κόπους παρέχετε τῇ γυναικί; ἔργον γὰρ καλὸν ἠργάσατο εἰς ἐμέ.

text_en: For the poor you have always with you: but me you have not always.
text_la: Nam semper pauperes habetis vobiscum : me autem non semper habetis.
text_pt: Porquanto sempre tendes convosco os pobres, mas a mim não me haveis de ter sempre.
text_el: πάντοτε γὰρ τοὺς πτωχοὺς ἔχετε μεθ' ἑαυτῶν, ἐμὲ δὲ οὐ πάντοτε ἔχετε.

text_en: For she in pouring this ointment on my body has done it for my burial.
text_la: Mittens enim hæc unguentum hoc in corpus meum, ad sepeliendum me fecit.
text_pt: Ora, derramando ela este ungüento sobre o meu corpo, fê-lo preparando-me para o meu sepultamento.
text_el: βαλοῦσα γὰρ αὕτη τὸ μύρον τοῦτο ἐπὶ τοῦ σώματός μου πρὸς τὸ ἐνταφιάσαι με ἐποίησεν.

text_en: Amen I say to you, wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, that also which she has done shall be told for a memory of her.
text_la: Amen dico vobis, ubicumque prædicatum fuerit hoc Evangelium in toto mundo, dicetur et quod hæc fecit in memoriam ejus.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que, onde quer que este evangelho for pregado em todo o mundo, também será referido o que ela fez, para memória sua.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅπου ἐὰν κηρυχθῇ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦτο ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ κόσμῳ, λαληθήσεται καὶ ὃ ἐποίησεν αὕτη εἰς μνημόσυνον αὐτῆς.

text_en: Then went one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot , to the chief priests .
text_la: Tunc abiit unus de duodecim, qui dicebatur Judas Iscariotes, ad principes sacerdotum:
text_pt: Então um dos doze, chamado Judas Iscariotes, foi ter com os príncipes dos sacerdotes,
text_el: Τότε πορευθεὶς εἷς τῶν δώδεκα, ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰούδας Ἰσκαριώτης, πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς

text_en: And said to them: What will you give me, and I will deliver him unto you? But they appointed him thirty pieces of silver.
text_la: et ait illis : Quid vultis mihi dare, et ego vobis eum tradam? At illi constituerunt ei triginta argenteos.
text_pt: E disse: Que me quereis dar, e eu vo-lo entregarei? E eles lhe pesaram trinta moedas de prata,
text_el: εἶπεν: τί θέλετέ μοι δοῦναι, κἀγὼ ὑμῖν παραδώσω αὐτόν; οἱ δὲ ἔστησαν αὐτῷ τριάκοντα ἀργύρια.

text_en: And from thenceforth he sought opportunity to betray him.
text_la: Et exinde quærebat opportunitatem ut eum traderet.
text_pt: E desde então buscava oportunidade para o entregar.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τότε ἐζήτει εὐκαιρίαν ἵνα αὐτὸν παραδῷ.

text_en: And on the first day of the Azymes , the disciples came to Jesus , saying: Where will you that we prepare for you to eat the pasch ?
text_la: Prima autem die azymorum accesserunt discipuli ad Jesum, dicentes : Ubi vis paremus tibi comedere Pascha?
text_pt: E, no primeiro dia da festa dos pães ázimos, chegaram os discípulos junto de Jesus, dizendo: Onde queres que façamos os preparativos para comeres a páscoa?
text_el: Τῇ δὲ πρώτῃ τῶν ἀζύμων προσῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες: ποῦ θέλεις ἑτοιμάσωμέν σοι φαγεῖν τὸ πάσχα;

text_en: But Jesus said: Go into the city to a certain man and say to him: The master says, My time is near at hand. With you I make the pasch with my disciples .
text_la: At Jesus dixit : Ite in civitatem ad quemdam, et dicite ei : Magister dicit : Tempus meum prope est, apud te facio Pascha cum discipulis meis.
text_pt: E ele disse: Ide à cidade, a um certo homem, e dizei-lhe: O Mestre diz: O meu tempo está próximo; em tua casa celebrarei a páscoa com os meus discípulos.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν πόλιν πρὸς τὸν δεῖνα καὶ εἴπατε αὐτῷ: ὁ διδάσκαλος λέγει: ὁ καιρός μου ἐγγύς ἐστιν, πρὸς σὲ ποιῶ τὸ πάσχα μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν μου.

text_en: And the disciples did as Jesus appointed to them: and they prepared the pasch .
text_la: Et fecerunt discipuli sicut constituit illis Jesus, et paraverunt Pascha.
text_pt: E os discípulos fizeram como Jesus lhes ordenara, e prepararam a páscoa.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ ὡς συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα.

text_en: But when it was evening, he sat down with his twelve disciples .
text_la: Vespere autem facto, discumbebat cum duodecim discipulis suis.
text_pt: E, chegada a tarde, assentou-se à mesa com os doze.
text_el: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης ἀνέκειτο μετὰ τῶν δώδεκα.[maqhtwn*]

text_en: And whilst they were eating, he said: Amen I say to you that one of you is about to betray me.
text_la: Et edentibus illis, dixit : Amen dico vobis, quia unus vestrum me traditurus est.
text_pt: E, comendo eles, disse: Em verdade vos digo que um de vós me há de trair.
text_el: καὶ ἐσθιόντων αὐτῶν εἶπεν: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με.

text_en: And they being very much troubled began every one to say: Is it I, Lord?
text_la: Et contristati valde, cœperunt singuli dicere : Numquid ego sum Domine?
text_pt: E eles, entristecendo-se muito, começaram cada um a dizer-lhe: Porventura sou eu, Senhor?
text_el: καὶ λυπούμενοι σφόδρα ἤρξαντο λέγειν αὐτῷ εἷς ἕκαστος: μήτι ἐγώ εἰμι, κύριε;

text_en: But he answering said: He that dips his hand with me in the dish, he shall betray me.
text_la: At ipse respondens, ait : Qui intingit mecum manum in paropside, hic me tradet.
text_pt: E ele, respondendo, disse: O que põe comigo a mão no prato, esse me há de trair.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: ὁ ἐμβάψας μετ' ἐμοῦ τὴν χεῖρα ἐν τῷ τρυβλίῳ, οὗτός με παραδώσει.

text_en: The Son of man indeed goes, as it is written of him. But woe to that man by whom the Son of man shall be betrayed. It were better for him, if that man had not been born.
text_la: Filius quidem hominis vadit, sicut scriptum est de illo : væ autem homini illi, per quem Filius hominis tradetur! bonum erat ei, si natus non fuisset homo ille.
text_pt: Em verdade o Filho do homem vai, como acerca dele está escrito, mas ai daquele homem por quem o Filho do homem é traído! Bom seria para esse homem se não houvera nascido.
text_el: ὁ μὲν υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑπάγει καθὼς γέγραπται περὶ αὐτοῦ. οὐαὶ δὲ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ δι' οὗ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται: καλὸν ἦν αὐτῷ εἰ οὐκ ἐγεννήθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος.

text_en: And Judas that betrayed him answering, said: Is it I, Rabbi ? He said to him: You have said it.
text_la: Respondens autem Judas, qui tradidit eum, dixit : Numquid ego sum Rabbi? Ait illi : Tu dixisti.
text_pt: E, respondendo Judas, o que o traía, disse: Porventura sou eu, Rabi? Ele disse: Tu o disseste.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν εἶπεν: μήτι ἐγώ εἰμι, ῥαββί; λέγει αὐτῷ: σὺ εἶπας.

text_en: And whilst they were at supper , Jesus took bread and blessed and broke and gave to his disciples and said: Take and eat. This is my body .
text_la: Cœnantibus autem eis, accepit Jesus panem, et benedixit, ac fregit, deditque discipulis suis, et ait : Accipite, et comedite : hoc est corpus meum.
text_pt: E, quando comiam, Jesus tomou o pão, e abençoando-o, o partiu, e o deu aos discípulos, e disse: Tomai, comei, isto é o meu corpo.
text_el: Ἐσθιόντων δὲ αὐτῶν λαβὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἄρτον καὶ εὐλογήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ δοὺς τοῖς μαθηταῖς εἶπεν: λάβετε φάγετε: τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ σῶμά μου.

text_en: And taking the chalice , he gave thanks and gave to them, saying: Drink all of this.
text_la: Et accipiens calicem, gratias egit : et dedit illis, dicens : Bibite ex hoc omnes.
text_pt: E, tomando o cálice, e dando graças, deu-lho, dizendo: Bebei dele todos;
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν ποτήριον [καὶ] εὐχαριστήσας ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων: πίετε ἐξ αὐτοῦ πάντες:

text_en: For this is my blood of the new testament , which shall be shed for many unto remission of sins .
text_la: Hic est enim sanguis meus novi testamenti, qui pro multis effundetur in remissionem peccatorum.
text_pt: Porque isto é o meu sangue, o sangue do novo testamento, que é derramado por muitos, para remissão dos pecados.
text_el: τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν τὸ αἷμά μου τῆς διαθήκης τὸ περὶ πολλῶν ἐκχυννόμενον εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν.

text_en: And I say to you, I will not drink from henceforth of this fruit of the vine until that day when I shall drink it with you new in the kingdom of my Father .
text_la: Dico autem vobis : non bibam amodo de hoc genimine vitis usque in diem illum, cum illud bibam vobiscum novum in regno Patris mei.
text_pt: E digo-vos que, desde agora, não beberei deste fruto da vide, até aquele dia em que o beba novo convosco no reino de meu Pai.
text_el: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν, οὐ μὴ πίω ἀπ' ἄρτι ἐκ τούτου τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ὅταν αὐτὸ πίνω μεθ' ὑμῶν καινὸν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ πατρός μου.

text_en: And a hymn being said, they went out unto mount Olivet .
text_la: Et hymno dicto, exierunt in montem Oliveti.
text_pt: E, tendo cantado o hino, saíram para o Monte das Oliveiras.
text_el: Καὶ ὑμνήσαντες ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν ἐλαιῶν.

text_en: Then Jesus says to them: All you shall be scandalized in me this night. For it is written: I will strike the shepherd: and the sheep of the flock shall be dispersed.
text_la: Tunc dicit illis Jesus : Omnes vos scandalum patiemini in me in ista nocte. Scriptum est enim : Percutiam pastorem, et dispergentur oves gregis.
text_pt: Então Jesus lhes disse: Todos vós esta noite vos escandalizareis em mim; porque está escrito: Ferirei o pastor, e as ovelhas do rebanho se dispersarão.
text_el: τότε λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: πάντες ὑμεῖς σκανδαλισθήσεσθε ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ταύτῃ, γέγραπται γάρ: πατάξω τὸν ποιμένα, καὶ διασκορπισθήσονται τὰ πρόβατα τῆς ποίμνης.

text_en: But after I shall be risen again , I will go before you into Galilee .
text_la: Postquam autem resurrexero, præcedam vos in Galilæam.
text_pt: Mas, depois de eu ressuscitar, irei adiante de vós para a Galiléia.
text_el: μετὰ δὲ τὸ ἐγερθῆναί με προάξω ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.

text_en: And Peter answering, said to him: Although all shall be scandalized in you, I will never be scandalized .
text_la: Respondens autem Petrus, ait illi : Et si omnes scandalizati fuerint in te, ego numquam scandalizabor.
text_pt: Mas Pedro, respondendo, disse-lhe: Ainda que todos se escandalizem em ti, eu nunca me escandalizarei.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ: εἰ πάντες σκανδαλισθήσονται ἐν σοί, ἐγὼ οὐδέποτε σκανδαλισθήσομαι.

text_en: Jesus said to him: Amen I say to you that in this night before the cock crow, you will deny me thrice.
text_la: Ait illi Jesus : Amen dico tibi, quia in hac nocte, antequam gallus cantet, ter me negabis.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Em verdade te digo que, nesta mesma noite, antes que o galo cante, três vezes me negarás.
text_el: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτι ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ πρὶν ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι τρὶς ἀπαρνήσῃ με.

text_en: Peter said to him: Yea, though I should die with you, I will not deny you. And in like manner said all the disciples .
text_la: Ait illi Petrus : Etiamsi oportuerit me mori tecum, non te negabo. Similiter et omnes discipuli dixerunt.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Pedro: Ainda que me seja mister morrer contigo, não te negarei. E todos os discípulos disseram o mesmo.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος: κἂν δέῃ με σὺν σοὶ ἀποθανεῖν, οὐ μή σε ἀπαρνήσομαι. ὁμοίως καὶ πάντες οἱ μαθηταὶ εἶπαν.

text_en: Then Jesus came with them into a country place which is called Gethsemani . And he said to his disciples : Sit you here, till I go yonder and pray .
text_la: Tunc venit Jesus cum illis in villam, quæ dicitur Gethsemani, et dixit discipulis suis : Sedete hic donec vadam illuc, et orem.
text_pt: Então chegou Jesus com eles a um lugar chamado Getsêmani, e disse a seus discípulos: Assentai-vos aqui, enquanto vou além orar.
text_el: Τότε ἔρχεται μετ' αὐτῶν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς χωρίον λεγόμενον Γεθσημανί, καὶ λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς, καθίσατε αὐτοῦ ἕως οὗ ἀπελθὼν ἐκεῖ προσεύξωμαι.

text_en: And taking with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, he began to grow sorrowful and to be sad.
text_la: Et assumpto Petro, et duobus filiis Zebedæi, cœpit contristari et mœstus esse.
text_pt: E, levando consigo Pedro e os dois filhos de Zebedeu, começou a entristecer-se e a angustiar-se muito.
text_el: καὶ παραλαβὼν τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τοὺς δύο υἱοὺς Ζεβεδαίου ἤρξατο λυπεῖσθαι καὶ ἀδημονεῖν.

text_en: Then he says to them: My soul is sorrowful even unto death. Stay you here and watch with me.
text_la: Tunc ait illis : Tristis est anima mea usque ad mortem : sustinete hic, et vigilate mecum.
text_pt: Então lhes disse: A minha alma está cheia de tristeza até a morte; ficai aqui, e velai comigo.
text_el: τότε λέγει αὐτοῖς: περίλυπός ἐστιν ἡ ψυχή μου ἕως θανάτου: μείνατε ὧδε καὶ γρηγορεῖτε μετ' ἐμοῦ.

text_en: And going a little further, he fell upon his face, praying and saying: My Father , if it be possible, let this chalice pass from me. Nevertheless, not as I will but as you will.
text_la: Et progressus pusillum, procidit in faciem suam, orans, et dicens : Pater mi, si possibile est, transeat a me calix iste : verumtamen non sicut ego volo, sed sicut tu.
text_pt: E, indo um pouco mais para diante, prostrou-se sobre o seu rosto, orando e dizendo: Meu Pai, se é possível, passe de mim este cálice; todavia, não seja como eu quero, mas como tu queres.
text_el: καὶ προελθὼν μικρὸν ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ προσευχόμενος καὶ λέγων: πάτερ, μου εἰ δυνατόν ἐστιν, παρελθάτω ἀπ' ἐμοῦ τὸ ποτήριον τοῦτο: πλὴν οὐχ ὡς ἐγὼ θέλω ἀλλ' ὡς σύ.

text_en: And he comes to his disciples and finds them asleep. And he says to Peter : What? Could you not watch one hour with me?
text_la: Et venit ad discipulos suos, et invenit eos dormientes, et dicit Petro : Sic non potuistis una hora vigilare mecum?
text_pt: E, voltando para os seus discípulos, achou-os adormecidos; e disse a Pedro: Então nem uma hora pudeste velar comigo?
text_el: καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς καὶ εὑρίσκει αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας, καὶ λέγει τῷ Πέτρῳ: οὕτως οὐκ ἰσχύσατε μίαν ὥραν γρηγορῆσαι μετ' ἐμοῦ;

text_en: Watch and pray that you enter not into temptation . The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
text_la: Vigilate, et orate ut non intretis in tentationem. Spiritus quidem promptus est, caro autem infirma.
text_pt: Vigiai e orai, para que não entreis em tentação; na verdade, o espírito está pronto, mas a carne é fraca.
text_el: γρηγορεῖτε καὶ προσεύχεσθε, ἵνα μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν: τὸ μὲν πνεῦμα πρόθυμον, ἡ δὲ σὰρξ ἀσθενής.

text_en: Again the second time, he went and prayed , saying: My Father , if this chalice may not pass away, but I must drink it, your will be done.
text_la: Iterum secundo abiit, et oravit, dicens : Pater mi, si non potest hic calix transire nisi bibam illum, fiat voluntas tua.
text_pt: E, indo segunda vez, orou, dizendo: Pai meu, se este cálice não pode passar de mim sem eu o beber, faça-se a tua vontade.
text_el: πάλιν ἐκ δευτέρου ἀπελθὼν προσηύξατο [λέγων]: πάτερ μου, εἰ οὐ δύναται τοῦτο παρελθεῖν ἐὰν μὴ αὐτὸ πίω, γενηθήτω τὸ θέλημά σου.

text_en: And he comes again and finds them sleeping: for their eyes were heavy.
text_la: Et venit iterum, et invenit eos dormientes : erant enim oculi eorum gravati.
text_pt: E, voltando, achou-os outra vez adormecidos; porque os seus olhos estavam pesados.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν πάλιν εὗρεν αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας: ἦσαν γὰρ αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ βεβαρημένοι.

text_en: And leaving them, he went again: and he prayed the third time, saying the selfsame word.
text_la: Et relictis illis, iterum abiit, et oravit tertio, eumdem sermonem dicens.
text_pt: E, deixando-os de novo, foi orar pela terceira vez, dizendo as mesmas palavras.
text_el: καὶ ἀφεὶς αὐτοὺς πάλιν ἀπελθὼν προσηύξατο ἐκ τρίτου, τὸν αὐτὸν λόγον εἰπὼν πάλιν.

text_en: Then he comes to his disciples and said to them: Sleep now and take your rest. Behold the hour is at hand: and the Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of sinners.
text_la: Tunc venit ad discipulos suos, et dicit illis : Dormite jam, et requiescite : ecce appropinquavit hora, et Filius hominis tradetur in manus peccatorum.
text_pt: Então chegou junto dos seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: Dormi agora, e repousai; eis que é chegada a hora, e o Filho do homem será entregue nas mãos dos pecadores.
text_el: τότε ἔρχεται πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: καθεύδετε λοιπὸν καὶ ἀναπαύεσθε. ἰδοὺ ἤγγικεν ἡ ὥρα καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται εἰς χεῖρας ἁμαρτωλῶν.

text_en: Rise: let us go. Behold he is at hand that will betray me.
text_la: Surgite, eamus : ecce appropinquavit qui me tradet.
text_pt: Levantai-vos, partamos; eis que é chegado o que me trai.
text_el: ἐγείρεσθε, ἄγωμεν: ἰδοὺ ἤγγικεν ὁ παραδιδούς με.

text_en: As he yet spoke, behold Judas , one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and the ancients of the people.
text_la: Adhuc eo loquente, ecce Judas unus de duodecim venit, et cum eo turba multa cum gladiis et fustibus, missi a principibus sacerdotum, et senioribus populi.
text_pt: E, estando ele ainda a falar, eis que chegou Judas, um dos doze, e com ele grande multidão com espadas e varapaus, enviada pelos príncipes dos sacerdotes e pelos anciãos do povo.
text_el: Καὶ ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἰδοὺ Ἰούδας εἷς τῶν δώδεκα ἦλθεν καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ὄχλος πολὺς μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων ἀπὸ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων τοῦ λαοῦ.

text_en: And he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying: Whomsoever I shall kiss , that is he. Hold him fast.
text_la: Qui autem tradidit eum, dedit illis signum, dicens : Quemcumque osculatus fuero, ipse est, tenete eum.
text_pt: E o que o traía tinha-lhes dado um sinal, dizendo: O que eu beijar é esse; prendei-o.
text_el: ὁ δὲ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς σημεῖον λέγων: ὃν ἂν φιλήσω αὐτός ἐστιν: κρατήσατε αὐτόν.

text_en: And forthwith coming to Jesus , he said: Hail, Rabbi . And he kissed him.
text_la: Et confestim accedens ad Jesum, dixit : Ave Rabbi. Et osculatus est eum.
text_pt: E logo, aproximando-se de Jesus, disse: Eu te saúdo, Rabi; e beijou-o.
text_el: καὶ εὐθέως προσελθὼν τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἶπεν: χαῖρε, ῥαββί: καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτόν.

text_en: And Jesus said to him: Friend, whereto are you come? Then they came up and laid hands on Jesus and held him.
text_la: Dixitque illi Jesus : Amice, ad quid venisti? Tunc accesserunt, et manus injecerunt in Jesum, et tenuerunt eum.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, lhe disse: Amigo, a que vieste? Então, aproximando-se eles, lançaram mão de Jesus, e o prenderam.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ, ἑταῖρε, ἐφ' ὃ πάρει. τότε προσελθόντες ἐπέβαλον τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἐκράτησαν αὐτόν.

text_en: And behold one of them that were with Jesus , stretching forth his hand, drew out his sword: and striking the servant of the high priest , cut off his ear.
text_la: Et ecce unus ex his qui erant cum Jesu, extendens manum, exemit gladium suum, et percutiens servum principis sacerdotum amputavit auriculam ejus.
text_pt: E eis que um dos que estavam com Jesus, estendendo a mão, puxou da espada e, ferindo o servo do sumo sacerdote, cortou-lhe uma orelha.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ εἷς τῶν μετὰ Ἰησοῦ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἀπέσπασεν τὴν μάχαιραν αὐτοῦ καὶ πατάξας τὸν δοῦλον τοῦ ἀρχιερέως ἀφεῖλεν αὐτοῦ τὸ ὠτίον.

text_en: Then Jesus said to him: Put up again your sword into its place: for all that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
text_la: Tunc ait illi Jesus : Converte gladium tuum in locum suum : omnes enim, qui acceperint gladium, gladio peribunt.
text_pt: Então Jesus disse-lhe: Embainha a tua espada; porque todos os que lançarem mão da espada, à espada morrerão.
text_el: τότε λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἀπόστρεψον τὴν μάχαιράν σου εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῆς: πάντες γὰρ οἱ λαβόντες μάχαιραν ἐν μαχαίρῃ ἀπολοῦνται.

text_en: Do you think that I cannot ask my Father , and he will give me presently more than twelve legions of angels ?
text_la: An putas, quia non possum rogare patrem meum, et exhibebit mihi modo plusquam duodecim legiones angelorum?
text_pt: Ou pensas tu que eu não poderia agora orar a meu Pai, e que ele não me daria mais de doze legiões de anjos?
text_el: ἢ δοκεῖς ὅτι οὐ δύναμαι παρακαλέσαι τὸν πατέρα μου, καὶ παραστήσει μοι ἄρτι πλείω δώδεκα λεγιῶνας ἀγγέλων;

text_en: How then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that so it must be done?
text_la: Quomodo ergo implebuntur Scripturæ, quia sic oportet fieri?
text_pt: Como, pois, se cumpririam as Escrituras, que dizem que assim convém que aconteça?
text_el: πῶς οὖν πληρωθῶσιν αἱ γραφαὶ, ὅτι οὕτως δεῖ γενέσθαι;

text_en: In that same hour, Jesus said to the multitudes: You have come out, as it were to a robber, with swords and clubs to apprehend me. I sat daily with you, teaching in the temple : and you laid not hands on me.
text_la: In illa hora dixit Jesus turbis : Tamquam ad latronem existis cum gladiis et fustibus comprehendere me : quotidie apud vos sedebam docens in templo, et non me tenuistis.
text_pt: Então disse Jesus à multidão: Saístes, como para um salteador, com espadas e varapaus para me prender? Todos os dias me assentava junto de vós, ensinando no templo, e não me prendestes.
text_el: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς ὄχλοις: ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων συλλαβεῖν με: καθ' ἡμέραν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἐκαθεζόμην διδάσκων καὶ οὐκ ἐκρατήσατέ με.

text_en: Now all this was done that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then the disciples , all leaving him, fled.
text_la: Hoc autem totum factum est, ut adimplerentur Scripturæ prophetarum. Tunc discipuli omnes, relicto eo, fugerunt.
text_pt: Mas tudo isto aconteceu para que se cumpram as escrituras dos profetas. Então, todos os discípulos, deixando-o, fugiram.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ ὅλον γέγονεν ἵνα πληρωθῶσιν αἱ γραφαὶ τῶν προφητῶν. τότε οἱ μαθηταὶ πάντες ἀφέντες αὐτὸν ἔφυγον.

text_en: But they holding Jesus led him to Caiphas the high priest , where the scribes and the ancients were assembled.
text_la: At illi tenentes Jesum, duxerunt ad Caipham principem sacerdotum, ubi scribæ et seniores convenerant.
text_pt: E os que prenderam a Jesus o conduziram à casa do sumo sacerdote Caifás, onde os escribas e os anciãos estavam reunidos.
text_el: Οἱ δὲ κρατήσαντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπήγαγον πρὸς Καϊάφαν τὸν ἀρχιερέα, ὅπου οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι συνήχθησαν.

text_en: And Peter followed him afar off, even to the court of the high priest , And going in, he sat with the servants, that he might see the end.
text_la: Petrus autem sequebatur eum a longe, usque in atrium principis sacerdotum. Et ingressus intro, sedebat cum ministris, ut videret finem.
text_pt: E Pedro o seguiu de longe, até ao pátio do sumo sacerdote e, entrando, assentou-se entre os criados, para ver o fim.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ [ἀπὸ] μακρόθεν ἕως τῆς αὐλῆς τοῦ ἀρχιερέως, καὶ εἰσελθὼν ἔσω ἐκάθητο μετὰ τῶν ὑπηρετῶν ἰδεῖν τὸ τέλος.

text_en: And the chief priests and the whole council sought false witness against Jesus , that they might put him to death .
text_la: Principes autem sacerdotum, et omne concilium, quærebant falsum testimonium contra Jesum, ut eum morti traderent:
text_pt: Ora, os príncipes dos sacerdotes, e os anciãos, e todo o conselho, buscavam falso testemunho contra Jesus, para poderem dar-lhe a morte;
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ τὸ συνέδριον ὅλον ἐζήτουν ψευδομαρτυρίαν κατὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ὅπως αὐτὸν θανατώσωσιν,

text_en: And they found not, whereas many false witnesses had come in. And last of all there came two false witnesses:
text_la: et non invenerunt, cum multi falsi testes accessissent. Novissime autem venerunt duo falsi testes,
text_pt: E não o achavam; apesar de se apresentarem muitas testemunhas falsas, nào o achavam. Mas, por fim chegaram duas testemunhas falsas,
text_el: καὶ οὐχ εὗρον πολλῶν προσελθόντων ψευδομαρτύρων. ὕστερον δὲ προσελθόντες δύο

text_en: And they said: This man said, I am able to destroy the temple of God and after three days to rebuild it.
text_la: et dixerunt : Hic dixit : Possum destruere templum Dei, et post triduum reædificare illud.
text_pt: E disseram: Este disse: Eu posso derrubar o templo de Deus, e reedificá-lo em três dias.
text_el: εἶπαν: οὗτος ἔφη: δύναμαι καταλῦσαι τὸν ναὸν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ διὰ τριῶν ἡμερῶν οἰκοδομῆσαι.

text_en: And the high priest rising up, said to him: Do you answer nothing to the things which these witness against you?
text_la: Et surgens princeps sacerdotum, ait illi : Nihil respondes ad ea, quæ isti adversum te testificantur?
text_pt: E, levantando-se o sumo sacerdote, disse-lhe: Não respondes coisa alguma ao que estes depõem contra ti?
text_el: καὶ ἀναστὰς ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἶπεν αὐτῷ: οὐδὲν ἀποκρίνῃ; τί οὗτοί σου καταμαρτυροῦσιν;

text_en: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest said to him: I adjure you by the living God , that you tell us if you be the Christ the Son of God .
text_la: Jesus autem tacebat. Et princeps sacerdotum ait illi : Adjuro te per Deum vivum, ut dicas nobis si tu es Christus Filius Dei.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, guardava silêncio. E, insistindo o sumo sacerdote, disse-lhe: Conjuro-te pelo Deus vivo que nos digas se tu és o Cristo, o Filho de Deus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐσιώπα. καὶ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἐξορκίζω σε κατὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ζῶντος, ἵνα ἡμῖν εἴπῃς εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: Jesus said to him: You have said it. Nevertheless I say to you, hereafter you shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of the power of God and coming in the clouds of heaven .
text_la: Dicit illi Jesus : Tu dixisti. Verumtamen dico vobis, amodo videbitis Filium hominis sedentem a dextris virtutis Dei, et venientem in nubibus cæli.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Tu o disseste; digo-vos, porém, que vereis em breve o Filho do homem assentado à direita do Poder, e vindo sobre as nuvens do céu.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: σὺ εἶπας: πλὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀπ' ἄρτι ὄψεσθε τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καθήμενον ἐκ δεξιῶν τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ ἐρχόμενον ἐπὶ τῶν νεφελῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.

text_en: Then the high priest rent his garments, saying: He has blasphemed : what further need have we of witnesses? Behold, now you have heard the blasphemy .
text_la: Tunc princeps sacerdotum scidit vestimenta sua, dicens : Blasphemavit : quid adhuc egemus testibus? ecce nunc audistis blasphemiam:
text_pt: Então o sumo sacerdote rasgou as suas vestes, dizendo: Blasfemou; para que precisamos ainda de testemunhas? Eis que bem ouvistes agora a sua blasfêmia.
text_el: τότε ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς διέρρηξεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ λέγων: ἐβλασφήμησεν: τί ἔτι χρείαν ἔχομεν μαρτύρων; ἴδε νῦν ἠκούσατε τὴν βλασφημίαν.

text_en: What think you? But they answering, said: He is guilty of death.
text_la: quid vobis videtur? At illi respondentes dixerunt : Reus est mortis.
text_pt: Que vos parece? E eles, respondendo, disseram: É réu de morte.
text_el: τί ὑμῖν δοκεῖ; οἱ δὲ ἀποκριθέντες εἶπαν: ἔνοχος θανάτου ἐστίν.

text_en: Then did they spit in his face and buffeted him. And others struck his face with the palms of their hands,
text_la: Tunc exspuerunt in faciem ejus, et colaphis eum ceciderunt, alii autem palmas in faciem ejus dederunt,
text_pt: Então cuspiram-lhe no rosto e lhe davam punhadas, e outros o esbofeteavam,
text_el: Τότε ἐνέπτυσαν εἰς τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκολάφισαν αὐτόν, οἱ δὲ ἐράπισαν

text_en: saying: Prophesy unto us, O Christ . Who is he that struck you?
text_la: dicentes : Prophetiza nobis Christe, quis est qui te percussit?
text_pt: Dizendo: Profetiza-nos, Cristo, quem é o que te bateu?
text_el: λέγοντες: προφήτευσον ἡμῖν, Χριστέ, τίς ἐστιν ὁ παίσας σε;

text_en: But Peter sat without in the court . And there came to him a servant maid, saying: You also were with Jesus the Galilean .
text_la: Petrus vero sedebat foris in atrio : et accessit ad eum una ancilla, dicens : Et tu cum Jesu Galilæo eras.
text_pt: Ora, Pedro estava assentado fora, no pátio; e, aproximando-se dele uma criada, disse: Tu também estavas com Jesus, o galileu.
text_el: Ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἐκάθητο ἔξω ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ: καὶ προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ μία παιδίσκη λέγουσα: καὶ σὺ ἦσθα μετὰ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Γαλιλαίου.

text_en: But he denied before them all, saying: I know not what you say.
text_la: At ille negavit coram omnibus, dicens : Nescio quid dicis.
text_pt: Mas ele negou diante de todos, dizendo: Não sei o que dizes.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἠρνήσατο ἔμπροσθεν πάντων λέγων: οὐκ οἶδα τί λέγεις.

text_en: And as he went out of the gate, another maid saw him; and she says to them that were there: This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth .
text_la: Exeunte autem illo januam, vidit eum alia ancilla, et ait his qui erant ibi : Et hic erat cum Jesu Nazareno.
text_pt: E, saindo para o vestíbulo, outra criada o viu, e disse aos que ali estavam: Este também estava com Jesus, o Nazareno.
text_el: ἐξελθόντα δὲ εἰς τὸν πυλῶνα, εἶδεν αὐτὸν ἄλλη καὶ λέγει τοῖς ἐκεῖ: οὗτος ἦν μετὰ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ναζωραίου.

text_en: And again he denied with an oath : I know not the man .
text_la: Et iterum negavit cum juramento : Quia non novi hominem.
text_pt: E ele negou outra vez com juramento: Não conheço tal homem.
text_el: καὶ πάλιν ἠρνήσατο μετὰ ὅρκου ὅτι οὐκ οἶδα τὸν ἄνθρωπον.

text_en: And after a little while, they came that stood by and said to Peter : Surely you also are one of them. For even your speech does discover you.
text_la: Et post pusillum accesserunt qui stabant, et dixerunt Petro : Vere et tu ex illis es : nam et loquela tua manifestum te facit.
text_pt: E, daí a pouco, aproximando-se os que ali estavam, disseram a Pedro: Verdadeiramente também tu és deles, pois a tua fala te denuncia.
text_el: μετὰ μικρὸν δὲ προσελθόντες οἱ ἑστῶτες εἶπον τῷ Πέτρῳ, ἀληθῶς καὶ σὺ ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶ: καὶ γὰρ ἡ λαλιά σου δῆλόν σε ποιεῖ.

text_en: Then he began to curse and to swear that he knew not the man . And immediately the cock crew.
text_la: Tunc cœpit detestari et jurare quia non novisset hominem. Et continuo gallus cantavit.
text_pt: Então começou ele a praguejar e a jurar, dizendo: Não conheço esse homem. E imediatamente o galo cantou.
text_el: τότε ἤρξατο καταθεματίζειν καὶ ὀμνύειν ὅτι οὐκ οἶδα τὸν ἄνθρωπον: καὶ εὐθέως ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν.

text_en: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus which he had said: Before the cock crow, you will deny me thrice. And going forth, he wept bitterly.
text_la: Et recordatus est Petrus verbi Jesu, quod dixerat : Priusquam gallus cantet, ter me negabis. Et egressus foras, flevit amare.
text_pt: E lembrou-se Pedro das palavras de Jesus, que lhe dissera: Antes que o galo cante, três vezes me negarás. E, saindo dali, chorou amargamente.
text_el: καὶ ἐμνήσθη ὁ Πέτρος τοῦ ῥήματος Ἰησοῦ εἰρηκότος ὅτι πρὶν ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι τρὶς ἀπαρνήσῃ με: καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἔξω ἔκλαυσεν πικρῶς.

text_en: And when morning had come, all the chief priests and ancients of the people took counsel against Jesus , that they might put him to death .
text_la: Mane autem facto, consilium inierunt omnes principes sacerdotum et seniores populi adversus Jesum, ut eum morti traderent.
text_pt: E, chegando a manhã, todos os príncipes dos sacerdotes, e os anciãos do povo, formavam juntamente conselho contra Jesus, para o matarem;
text_el: Πρωΐας δὲ γενομένης συμβούλιον ἔλαβον πάντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ κατὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ὥστε θανατῶσαι αὐτόν.

text_en: And they brought him bound and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
text_la: Et vinctum adduxerunt eum, et tradiderunt Pontio Pilato præsidi.
text_pt: E maniatando-o, o levaram e entregaram ao presidente Pôncio Pilatos.
text_el: καὶ δήσαντες αὐτὸν ἀπήγαγον καὶ παρέδωκαν Πιλάτῳ τῷ ἡγεμόνι.

text_en: Then Judas , who betrayed him, seeing that he was condemned, repenting himself, brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and ancients,
text_la: Tunc videns Judas, qui eum tradidit, quod damnatus esset, pœnitentia ductus, retulit triginta argenteos principibus sacerdotum, et senioribus,
text_pt: Então Judas, o que o traíra, vendo que fora condenado, trouxe, arrependido, as trinta moedas de prata aos príncipes dos sacerdotes e aos anciãos,
text_el: Τότε ἰδὼν Ἰούδας ὁ παραδοὺς αὐτὸν ὅτι κατεκρίθη μεταμεληθεὶς ἔστρεψεν τὰ τριάκοντα ἀργύρια τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ πρεσβυτέροις

text_en: saying: I have sinned in betraying innocent blood. But they said: What is that to us? You look to it.
text_la: dicens : Peccavi, tradens sanguinem justum. At illi dixerunt : Quid ad nos? tu videris.
text_pt: Dizendo: Pequei, traindo o sangue inocente. Eles, porém, disseram: Que nos importa? Isso é contigo.
text_el: λέγων: ἥμαρτον παραδοὺς αἷμα δίκαιον. οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: τί πρὸς ἡμᾶς; σὺ ὄψῃ.

text_en: And casting down the pieces of silver in the temple , he departed and went and hanged himself with an halter.
text_la: Et projectis argenteis in templo, recessit : et abiens laqueo se suspendit.
text_pt: E ele, atirando para o templo as moedas de prata, retirou-se e foi-se enforcar.
text_el: καὶ ῥίψας τὰ ἀργύρια εἰς τὸν ναὸν ἀνεχώρησεν, καὶ ἀπελθὼν ἀπήγξατο.

text_en: But the chief priests having taken the pieces of silver, said: It is not lawful to put them into the corbona , because it is the price of blood.
text_la: Principes autem sacerdotum, acceptis argenteis, dixerunt : Non licet eos mittere in corbonam : quia pretium sanguinis est.
text_pt: E os príncipes dos sacerdotes, tomando as moedas de prata, disseram: Não é lícito colocá-las no cofre das ofertas, porque são preço de sangue.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς λαβόντες τὰ ἀργύρια εἶπαν: οὐκ ἔξεστιν βαλεῖν αὐτὰ εἰς τὸν κορβανᾶν, ἐπεὶ τιμὴ αἵματός ἐστιν.

text_en: And after they had consulted together, they bought with them the potter's field, to be a burying place for strangers.
text_la: Consilio autem inito, emerunt ex illis agrum figuli, in sepulturam peregrinorum.
text_pt: E, tendo deliberado em conselho, compraram com elas o campo de um oleiro, para sepultura dos estrangeiros.
text_el: συμβούλιον δὲ λαβόντες ἠγόρασαν ἐξ αὐτῶν τὸν ἀγρὸν τοῦ κεραμέως εἰς ταφὴν τοῖς ξένοις.

text_en: For this cause that field was called Haceldama , that is, the field of blood , even to this day.
text_la: Propter hoc vocatus est ager ille, Haceldama, hoc est, Ager sanguinis, usque in hodiernum diem.
text_pt: Por isso foi chamado aquele campo, até ao dia de hoje, Campo de Sangue.
text_el: διὸ ἐκλήθη ὁ ἀγρὸς ἐκεῖνος ἀγρὸς αἵματος ἕως τῆς σήμερον.

text_en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet , saying: And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was prized, whom they prized of the children of Israel .
text_la: Tunc impletum est quod dictum est per Jeremiam prophetam, dicentem : Et acceperunt triginta argenteos pretium appretiati, quem appretiaverunt a filiis Israël:
text_pt: Então se realizou o que vaticinara o profeta Jeremias: Tomaram as trinta moedas de prata, preço do que foi avaliado, que certos filhos de Israel avaliaram,
text_el: τότε ἐπληρώθη τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἰερεμίου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος: καὶ ἔλαβον τὰ τριάκοντα ἀργύρια, τὴν τιμὴν τοῦ τετιμημένου ὃν ἐτιμήσαντο ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ,

text_en: And they gave them unto the potter's field, as the Lord appointed to me.
text_la: et dederunt eos in agrum figuli, sicut constituit mihi Dominus.
text_pt: E deram-nas pelo campo do oleiro, segundo o que o Senhor me determinou.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτὰ εἰς τὸν ἀγρὸν τοῦ κεραμέως, καθὰ συνέταξέν μοι κύριος.

text_en: And Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, saying: Are you the king of the Jews ? Jesus said to him: You say it.
text_la: Jesus autem stetit ante præsidem, et interrogavit eum præses, dicens : Tu es rex Judæorum? Dicit illi Jesus : Tu dicis.
text_pt: E foi Jesus apresentado ao presidente, e o presidente o interrogou, dizendo: És tu o Rei dos Judeus? E disse-lhe Jesus: Tu o dizes.
text_el: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐστάθη ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ ἡγεμόνος: καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτὸν ὁ ἡγεμὼν λέγων: σὺ εἶ ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων; ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἔφη, σὺ λέγεις.

text_en: And when he was accused by the chief priests and ancients, he answered nothing.
text_la: Et cum accusaretur a principibus sacerdotum et senioribus, nihil respondit.
text_pt: E, sendo acusado pelos príncipes dos sacerdotes e pelos anciãos, nada respondeu.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ κατηγορεῖσθαι αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων οὐδὲν ἀπεκρίνατο.

text_en: Then Pilate said to him: Do you not hear how great testimonies they allege against you?
text_la: Tunc dicit illi Pilatus : Non audis quanta adversum te dicunt testimonia?
text_pt: Disse-lhe então Pilatos: Não ouves quanto testificam contra ti?
text_el: τότε λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πιλᾶτος: οὐκ ἀκούεις πόσα σου καταμαρτυροῦσιν;

text_en: And he answered him to never a word, so that the governor wondered exceedingly.
text_la: Et non respondit ei ad ullum verbum, ita ut miraretur præses vehementer.
text_pt: E nem uma palavra lhe respondeu, de sorte que o presidente estava muito maravilhado.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ πρὸς οὐδὲ ἓν ῥῆμα, ὥστε θαυμάζειν τὸν ἡγεμόνα λίαν.

text_en: Now upon the solemn day the governor was accustomed to release to the people one prisoner, whom they would.
text_la: Per diem autem solemnem consueverat præses populo dimittere unum vinctum, quem voluissent:
text_pt: Ora, por ocasião da festa, costumava o presidente soltar um preso, escolhendo o povo aquele que quisesse.
text_el: Κατὰ δὲ ἑορτὴν εἰώθει ὁ ἡγεμὼν ἀπολύειν ἕνα τῷ ὄχλῳ δέσμιον ὃν ἤθελον.

text_en: And he had then a notorious prisoner that was called Barabbas.
text_la: habebat autem tunc vinctum insignem, qui dicebatur Barrabas.
text_pt: E tinham então um preso bem conhecido, chamado Barrabás.
text_el: εἶχον δὲ τότε δέσμιον ἐπίσημον, λεγόμενον Βαραββᾶν.

text_en: They therefore being gathered together, Pilate said: Whom will you that I release to you: Barabbas, or Jesus that is called Christ ?
text_la: Congregatis ergo illis, dixit Pilatus : Quem vultis dimittam vobis : Barabbam, an Jesum, qui dicitur Christus?
text_pt: Portanto, estando eles reunidos, disse-lhes Pilatos: Qual quereis que vos solte? Barrabás, ou Jesus, chamado Cristo?
text_el: συνηγμένων οὖν αὐτῶν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος: τίνα θέλετε ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν, [τὸν] Βαραββᾶν ἢ Ἰησοῦν τὸν λεγόμενον Χριστόν;

text_en: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
text_la: Sciebat enim quod per invidiam tradidissent eum.
text_pt: Porque sabia que por inveja o haviam entregado.
text_el: ᾔδει γὰρ ὅτι διὰ φθόνον παρέδωκαν αὐτόν.

text_en: And as he was sitting in the place of judgment, his wife sent to him, saying: Have nothing to do with that just man ; for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
text_la: Sedente autem illo pro tribunali, misit ad eum uxor ejus, dicens : Nihil tibi, et justo illi : multa enim passa sum hodie per visum propter eum.
text_pt: E, estando ele assentado no tribunal, sua mulher mandou-lhe dizer: Não entres na questão desse justo, porque num sonho muito sofri por causa dele.
text_el: καθημένου δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ βήματος ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ λέγουσα: μηδὲν σοὶ καὶ τῷ δικαίῳ ἐκείνῳ: πολλὰ γὰρ ἔπαθον σήμερον κατ' ὄναρ δι' αὐτόν.

text_en: But the chief priests and ancients persuaded the people that they should ask Barabbas and make Jesus away.
text_la: Principes autem sacerdotum et seniores persuaserunt populis ut peterent Barabbam, Jesum vero perderent.
text_pt: Mas os príncipes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos persuadiram à multidão que pedisse Barrabás e matasse Jesus.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεισαν τοὺς ὄχλους ἵνα αἰτήσωνται τὸν Βαραββᾶν, τὸν δὲ Ἰησοῦν ἀπολέσωσιν.

text_en: And the governor answering, said to them: Whether will you of the two to be released unto you? But they said: Barabbas.
text_la: Respondens autem præses, ait illis : Quem vultis vobis de duobus dimitti? At illi dixerunt : Barabbam.
text_pt: E, respondendo o presidente, disse-lhes: Qual desses dois quereis vós que eu solte? E eles disseram: Barrabás.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἡγεμὼν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τίνα θέλετε ἀπὸ τῶν δύο ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: τὸν Βαραββᾶν.

text_en: Pilate says to them: What shall I do then with Jesus that is called Christ ? They say all: Let him be crucified.
text_la: Dicit illis Pilatus : Quid igitur faciam de Jesu, qui dicitur Christus?
text_pt: Disse-lhes Pilatos: Que farei então de Jesus, chamado Cristo? Disseram-lhe todos: Seja crucificado.
text_el: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος: τί οὖν ποιήσω Ἰησοῦν τὸν λεγόμενον Χριστόν; λέγουσιν πάντες: σταυρωθήτω.

text_en: The governor said to them: Why, what evil has he done? But they cried out the more, saying: Let him be crucified.
text_la: Dicunt omnes : Crucifigatur. Ait illis præses : Quid enim mali fecit? At illi magis clamabant dicentes : Crucifigatur.
text_pt: O presidente, porém, disse: Mas que mal fez ele? E eles mais clamavam, dizendo: Seja crucificado.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἔφη: τί γὰρ κακὸν ἐποίησεν; οἱ δὲ περισσῶς ἔκραζον λέγοντες: σταυρωθήτω.

text_en: And Pilate seeing that he prevailed nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, taking water washed his hands before the people, saying: I am innocent of the blood of this just man . Look you to it.
text_la: Videns autem Pilatus quia nihil proficeret, sed magis tumultus fieret : accepta aqua, lavit manus coram populo, dicens : Innocens ego sum a sanguine justi hujus : vos videritis.
text_pt: Então Pilatos, vendo que nada aproveitava, antes o tumulto crescia, tomando água, lavou as mãos diante da multidão, dizendo: Estou inocente do sangue deste justo. Considerai isso.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Πιλᾶτος ὅτι οὐδὲν ὠφελεῖ ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον θόρυβος γίνεται, λαβὼν ὕδωρ ἀπενίψατο τὰς χεῖρας κατέναντι τοῦ ὄχλου, λέγων: ἀθῷός εἰμι ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τούτου: ὑμεῖς ὄψεσθε.

text_en: And the whole people answering, said: His blood be upon us and upon our children.
text_la: Et respondens universus populus, dixit : Sanguis ejus super nos, et super filios nostros.
text_pt: E, respondendo todo o povo, disse: O seu sangue caia sobre nós e sobre nossos filhos.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς πᾶς ὁ λαὸς εἶπεν: τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ ἐφ' ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα ἡμῶν.

text_en: Then he released to them Barabbas: and having scourged Jesus , delivered him unto them to be crucified.
text_la: Tunc dimisit illis Barabbam: Jesum autem flagellatum tradidit eis ut crucifigeretur.
text_pt: Então soltou-lhes Barrabás, e, tendo mandado açoitar a Jesus, entregou-o para ser crucificado.
text_el: τότε ἀπέλυσεν αὐτοῖς τὸν Βαραββᾶν, τὸν δὲ Ἰησοῦν φραγελλώσας παρέδωκεν ἵνα σταυρωθῇ.

text_en: Then the soldiers of the governor, taking Jesus into the hall , gathered together unto him the whole band.
text_la: Tunc milites præsidis suscipientes Jesum in prætorium, congregaverunt ad eum universam cohortem:
text_pt: E logo os soldados do presidente, conduzindo Jesus à audiência, reuniram junto dele toda a coorte.
text_el: Τότε οἱ στρατιῶται τοῦ ἡγεμόνος παραλαβόντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον συνήγαγον ἐπ' αὐτὸν ὅλην τὴν σπεῖραν.

text_en: And stripping him, they put a scarlet cloak about him.
text_la: et exuentes eum, chlamydem coccineam circumdederunt ei,
text_pt: E, despindo-o, o cobriram com uma capa de escarlate;
text_el: καὶ ἐκδύσαντες αὐτὸν χλαμύδα κοκκίνην περιέθηκαν αὐτῷ,

text_en: And platting a crown of thorns , they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand. And bowing the knee before him, they mocked him, saying: Hail, King of the Jews .
text_la: et plectentes coronam de spinis, posuerunt super caput ejus, et arundinem in dextera ejus. Et genu flexo ante eum, illudebant ei, dicentes : Ave rex Judæorum.
text_pt: E, tecendo uma coroa de espinhos, puseram-lha na cabeça, e em sua mão direita uma cana; e, ajoelhando diante dele, o escarneciam, dizendo: Salve, Rei dos judeus.
text_el: καὶ πλέξαντες στέφανον ἐξ ἀκανθῶν ἐπέθηκαν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ κάλαμον ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ, καὶ γονυπετήσαντες ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες: χαῖρε βασιλεῦ τῶν Ἰουδαίων,

text_en: And spitting upon him, they took the reed and struck his head.
text_la: Et exspuentes in eum, acceperunt arundinem, et percutiebant caput ejus.
text_pt: E, cuspindo nele, tiraram-lhe a cana, e batiam-lhe com ela na cabeça.
text_el: καὶ ἐμπτύσαντες εἰς αὐτὸν ἔλαβον τὸν κάλαμον καὶ ἔτυπτον εἰς τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And after they had mocked him, they took off the cloak from him and put on him his own garments and led him away to crucify him.
text_la: Et postquam illuserunt ei, exuerunt eum chlamyde, et induerunt eum vestimentis ejus, et duxerunt eum ut crucifigerent.
text_pt: E, depois de o haverem escarnecido, tiraram-lhe a capa, vestiram-lhe as suas vestes e o levaram para ser crucificado.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ, ἐξέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὴν χλαμύδα καὶ ἐνέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ σταυρῶσαι.

text_en: And going out, they found a man of Cyrene, named Simon: him they forced to take up his cross .
text_la: Exeuntes autem invenerunt hominem Cyrenæum, nomine Simonem : hunc angariaverunt ut tolleret crucem ejus.
text_pt: E, quando saíam, encontraram um homem cireneu, chamado Simão, a quem constrangeram a levar a sua cruz.
text_el: Ἐξερχόμενοι δὲ εὗρον ἄνθρωπον Κυρηναῖον, ὀνόματι Σίμωνα: τοῦτον ἠγγάρευσαν ἵνα ἄρῃ τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And they came to the place that is called Golgotha , which is the place of Calvary .
text_la: Et venerunt in locum qui dicitur Golgotha, quod est Calvariæ locus.
text_pt: E, chegando ao lugar chamado Gólgota, que se diz: Lugar da Caveira,
text_el: καὶ ἐλθόντες εἰς τόπον λεγόμενον Γολγοθᾶ, ὅ ἐστιν κρανίου τόπος λεγόμενος,

text_en: And they gave him wine to drink mingled with gall. And when he had tasted, he would not drink.
text_la: Et dederunt ei vinum bibere cum felle mistum. Et cum gustasset, noluit bibere.
text_pt: Deram-lhe a beber vinagre misturado com fel; mas ele, provando-o, não quis beber.
text_el: ἔδωκαν αὐτῷ πιεῖν οἶνον μετὰ χολῆς μεμιγμένον: καὶ γευσάμενος οὐκ ἠθέλησεν πιεῖν.

text_en: And after they had crucified him, they divided his garments, casting lots ; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet , saying: They divided my garments among them; and upon my vesture they cast lots .
text_la: Postquam autem crucifixerunt eum, diviserunt vestimenta ejus, sortem mittentes : ut impleretur quod dictum est per prophetam dicentem : Diviserunt sibi vestimenta mea, et super vestem meam miserunt sortem.
text_pt: E, havendo-o crucificado, repartiram as suas vestes, lançando sortes, para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo profeta: Repartiram entre si as minhas vestes, e sobre a minha túnica lançaram sortes.
text_el: σταυρώσαντες δὲ αὐτὸν διεμερίσαντο τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ βάλλοντες κλῆρον,

text_en: And they sat and watched him.
text_la: Et sedentes servabant eum.
text_pt: E, assentados, o guardavam ali.
text_el: καὶ καθήμενοι ἐτήρουν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ.

text_en: And they put over his head his cause written: THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
text_la: Et imposuerunt super caput ejus causam ipsius scriptam : Hic est Jesus rex Judæorum.
text_pt: E por cima da sua cabeça puseram escrita a sua acusação: este e³ jesus, o rei dos judeus.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπάνω τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ τὴν αἰτίαν αὐτοῦ γεγραμμένην: οὗτός ἐστιν Ἰησοῦς ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων.

text_en: Then were crucified with him two thieves: one on the right hand and one on the left.
text_la: Tunc crucifixi sunt cum eo duo latrones : unus a dextris, et unus a sinistris.
text_pt: E foram crucificados com ele dois salteadores, um à direita, e outro à esquerda.
text_el: Τότε σταυροῦνται σὺν αὐτῷ δύο λῃσταί, εἷς ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ εἷς ἐξ εὐωνύμων.

text_en: And they that passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,
text_la: Prætereuntes autem blasphemabant eum moventes capita sua,
text_pt: E os que passavam blasfemavam dele, meneando as cabeças,
text_el: οἱ δὲ παραπορευόμενοι ἐβλασφήμουν αὐτὸν, κινοῦντες τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: and saying: Vah, you who destroys the temple of God and in three days rebuilds it: save your own self. If you be the Son of God , come down from the cross .
text_la: et dicentes : Vah! qui destruis templum Dei, et in triduo illud reædificas : salva temetipsum : si Filius Dei es, descende de cruce.
text_pt: E dizendo: Tu, que destróis o templo, e em três dias o reedificas, salva-te a ti mesmo. Se és Filho de Deus, desce da cruz.
text_el: καὶ λέγοντες: ὁ καταλύων τὸν ναὸν καὶ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις οἰκοδομῶν, σῶσον σεαυτόν, εἰ υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ θεοῦ, κατάβηθι ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ.

text_en: In like manner also the chief priests , with the scribes and ancients, mocking said:
text_la: Similiter et principes sacerdotum illudentes cum scribis et senioribus dicebant:
text_pt: E da mesma maneira também os príncipes dos sacerdotes, com os escribas, e anciãos, e fariseus, escarnecendo, diziam:
text_el: ὁμοίως [καὶ] οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἐμπαίζοντες μετὰ τῶν γραμματέων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων ἔλεγον:

text_en: He saved others: himself he cannot save. If he be the king of Israel , let him now come down from the cross : and we will believe him.
text_la: Alios salvos fecit, seipsum non potest salvum facere : si rex Israël est, descendat nunc de cruce, et credimus ei:
text_pt: Salvou os outros, e a si mesmo não pode salvar-se. Se é o Rei de Israel, desça agora da cruz, e creremos nele.
text_el: ἄλλους ἔσωσεν, ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται σῶσαι: βασιλεὺς Ἰσραήλ ἐστιν, καταβάτω νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ καὶ πιστεύσομεν ἐπ' αὐτόν:

text_en: He trusted in God : let him now deliver him if he will have him. For he said: I am the Son of God .
text_la: confidit in Deo : liberet nunc, si vult eum : dixit enim : Quia Filius Dei sum.
text_pt: Confiou em Deus; livre-o agora, se o ama; porque disse: Sou Filho de Deus.
text_el: πέποιθεν ἐπὶ τὸν θεόν, ῥυσάσθω νῦν εἰ θέλει αὐτόν: εἶπεν γὰρ ὅτι θεοῦ εἰμι υἱός.

text_en: And the selfsame thing the thieves also that were crucified with him reproached him with.
text_la: Idipsum autem et latrones, qui crucifixi erant cum eo, improperabant ei.
text_pt: E o mesmo lhe lançaram também em rosto os salteadores que com ele estavam crucificados.
text_el: τὸ δ' αὐτὸ καὶ οἱ λῃσταὶ οἱ συσταυρωθέντες σὺν αὐτῷ ὠνείδιζον αὐτόν.

text_en: Now from the sixth hour , there was darkness over the whole earth, until the ninth hour .
text_la: A sexta autem hora tenebræ factæ sunt super universam terram usque ad horam nonam.
text_pt: E desde a hora sexta houve trevas sobre toda a terra, até à hora nona.
text_el: Ἀπὸ δὲ ἕκτης ὥρας σκότος ἐγένετο ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἕως ὥρας ἐνάτης.

text_en: And about the ninth hour , Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying: Eli , Eli , lamma sabacthani? That is, My God , My God , why have you forsaken me?
text_la: Et circa horam nonam clamavit Jesus voce magna, dicens : Eli, Eli, lamma sabacthani? hoc est : Deus meus, Deus meus, ut quid dereliquisti me?
text_pt: E perto da hora nona exclamou Jesus em alta voz, dizendo: Eli, Eli, lamá sabactâni; isto é, Deus meu, Deus meu, por que me desamparaste?
text_el: περὶ δὲ τὴν ἐνάτην ὥραν ἐβόησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγων: ἐλωί ἐλωί λεμα σαβαχθανι; τοῦτ' ἔστιν: θεέ μου θεέ μου, ἱνατί με ἐγκατέλιπες;

text_en: And some that stood there and heard said: This man calls Elias .
text_la: Quidam autem illic stantes, et audientes, dicebant : Eliam vocat iste.
text_pt: E alguns dos que ali estavam, ouvindo isto, diziam: Este chama por Elias,
text_el: τινὲς δὲ τῶν ἐκεῖ ἑστηκότων ἀκούσαντες ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἠλίαν φωνεῖ οὗτος.

text_en: And immediately one of them running took a sponge and filled it with vinegar and put it on a reed and gave him to drink.
text_la: Et continuo currens unus ex eis, acceptam spongiam implevit aceto, et imposuit arundini, et dabat ei bibere.
text_pt: E logo um deles, correndo, tomou uma esponja, e embebeu-a em vinagre, e, pondo-a numa cana, dava-lhe de beber.
text_el: καὶ εὐθέως δραμὼν εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ λαβὼν σπόγγον πλήσας τε ὄξους καὶ περιθεὶς καλάμῳ ἐπότιζεν αὐτόν.

text_en: And the others said: Let be. Let us see whether Elias will come to deliver him.
text_la: Ceteri vero dicebant : Sine, videamus an veniat Elias liberans eum.
text_pt: Os outros, porém, diziam: Deixa, vejamos se Elias vem livrá-lo.
text_el: οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ εἶπαν: ἄφες ἴδωμεν εἰ ἔρχεται Ἠλίας σώσων αὐτόν.

text_en: And Jesus again crying with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost .
text_la: Jesus autem iterum clamans voce magna, emisit spiritum.
text_pt: E Jesus, clamando outra vez com grande voz, rendeu o espírito.
text_el: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς πάλιν κράξας φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἀφῆκεν τὸ πνεῦμα.

text_en: And behold the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top even to the bottom: and the earth quaked and the rocks were rent.
text_la: Et ecce velum templi scissum est in duas partes a summo usque deorsum : et terra mota est, et petræ scissæ sunt,
text_pt: E eis que o véu do templo se rasgou em dois, de alto a baixo; e tremeu a terra, e fenderam-se as pedras;
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ τὸ καταπέτασμα τοῦ ναοῦ ἐσχίσθη [ἀπ]' ἄνωθεν ἕως κάτω εἰς δύο, καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐσείσθη, καὶ αἱ πέτραι ἐσχίσθησαν,

text_en: And the graves were opened: and many bodies of the saints that had slept arose ,
text_la: et monumenta aperta sunt : et multa corpora sanctorum, qui dormierant, surrexerunt.
text_pt: E abriram-se os sepulcros, e muitos corpos de santos que dormiam foram ressuscitados;
text_el: καὶ τὰ μνημεῖα ἀνεῴχθησαν καὶ πολλὰ σώματα τῶν κεκοιμημένων ἁγίων ἠγέρθησαν:

text_en: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection , came into the holy city and appeared to many.
text_la: Et exeuntes de monumentis post resurrectionem ejus, venerunt in sanctam civitatem, et apparuerunt multis.
text_pt: E, saindo dos sepulcros, depois da ressurreição dele, entraram na cidade santa, e apareceram a muitos.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελθόντες ἐκ τῶν μνημείων μετὰ τὴν ἔγερσιν αὐτοῦ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὴν ἁγίαν πόλιν καὶ ἐνεφανίσθησαν πολλοῖς.

text_en: Now the centurion and they that were with him watching Jesus , having seen the earthquake and the things that were done, were sore afraid, saying: Indeed this was the Son of God .
text_la: Centurio autem, et qui cum eo erant, custodientes Jesum, viso terræmotu, et his quæ fiebant, timuerunt valde, dicentes : Vere Filius Dei erat iste.
