text_pt: E o centurião e os que com ele guardavam a Jesus, vendo o terremoto, e as coisas que haviam sucedido, tiveram grande temor, e disseram: Verdadeiramente este era o Filho de Deus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἑκατόνταρχος καὶ οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ τηροῦντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἰδόντες τὸν σεισμὸν καὶ τὰ γινόμενα ἐφοβήθησαν σφόδρα, λέγοντες: ἀληθῶς θεοῦ υἱὸς ἦν οὗτος.

text_en: And there were there many women afar off, who had followed Jesus from Galilee , ministering unto him:
text_la: Erant autem ibi mulieres multæ a longe, quæ secutæ erant Jesum a Galilæa, ministrantes ei:
text_pt: E estavam ali, olhando de longe, muitas mulheres que tinham seguido Jesus desde a Galiléia, para o servir;
text_el: Ἦσαν δὲ ἐκεῖ γυναῖκες πολλαὶ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν θεωροῦσαι, αἵτινες ἠκολούθησαν τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας διακονοῦσαι αὐτῷ:

text_en: Among whom was Mary Magdalen and Mary the mother of James and Joseph and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
text_la: inter quas erat Maria Magdalene, et Maria Jacobi, et Joseph mater, et mater filiorum Zebedæi.
text_pt: Entre as quais estavam Maria Madalena, e Maria, mãe de Tiago e de José, e a mãe dos filhos de Zebedeu.
text_el: ἐν αἷς ἦν Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ἡ τοῦ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωσὴφ μήτηρ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ τῶν υἱῶν Ζεβεδαίου.

text_en: And when it was evening, there came a certain rich man of Arimathea, named Joseph , who also himself was a disciple of Jesus .
text_la: Cum autem sero factum esset, venit quidam homo dives ab Arimathæa, nomine Joseph, qui et ipse discipulus erat Jesu:
text_pt: E, vinda já a tarde, chegou um homem rico, de Arimatéia, por nome José, que também era discípulo de Jesus.
text_el: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης ἦλθεν ἄνθρωπος πλούσιος ἀπὸ Ἁριμαθαίας, τοὔνομα Ἰωσήφ, ὃς καὶ αὐτὸς ἐμαθητεύθη τῷ Ἰησοῦ:

text_en: He went to Pilate and asked the body of Jesus . Then Pilate commanded that the body should be delivered.
text_la: hic accessit ad Pilatum, et petiit corpus Jesu. Tunc Pilatus jussit reddi corpus.
text_pt: Este foi ter com Pilatos, e pediu-lhe o corpo de Jesus. Então Pilatos mandou que o corpo lhe fosse dado.
text_el: οὗτος προσελθὼν τῷ Πιλάτῳ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ. τότε ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἐκέλευσεν ἀποδοθῆναι.

text_en: And Joseph taking the body wrapped it up in a clean linen cloth :
text_la: Et accepto corpore, Joseph involvit illud in sindone munda,
text_pt: E José, tomando o corpo, envolveu-o num fino e limpo lençol,
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν τὸ σῶμα ὁ Ἰωσὴφ ἐνετύλιξεν αὐτὸ ἐν σινδόνι καθαρᾷ,

text_en: And laid it in his own new monument , which he had hewed out in a rock. And he rolled a great stone to the door of the monument and went his way.
text_la: et posuit illud in monumento suo novo, quod exciderat in petra. Et advolvit saxum magnum ad ostium monumenti, et abiit.
text_pt: E o pôs no seu sepulcro novo, que havia aberto em rocha, e, rodando uma grande pedra para a porta do sepulcro, retirou-se.
text_el: καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὸ ἐν τῷ καινῷ αὐτοῦ μνημείῳ ὃ ἐλατόμησεν ἐν τῇ πέτρᾳ, καὶ προσκυλίσας λίθον μέγαν τῇ θύρᾳ τοῦ μνημείου ἀπῆλθεν.

text_en: And there was there Mary Magdalen and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre .
text_la: Erant autem ibi Maria Magdalene, et altera Maria, sedentes contra sepulchrum.
text_pt: E estavam ali Maria Madalena e a outra Maria, assentadas defronte do sepulcro.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ ἡ ἄλλη Μαρία, καθήμεναι ἀπέναντι τοῦ τάφου.

text_en: And the next day, which followed the day of preparation , the chief priests and the Pharisees came together to Pilate ,
text_la: Altera autem die, quæ est post Parasceven, convenerunt principes sacerdotum et pharisæi ad Pilatum,
text_pt: E no dia seguinte, que é o dia depois da Preparação, reuniram-se os príncipes dos sacerdotes e os fariseus em casa de Pilatos,
text_el: Τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον, ἥτις ἐστὶν μετὰ τὴν παρασκευήν, συνήχθησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πρὸς Πιλᾶτον

text_en: saying: Sir, we have remembered, that that seducer said, while he was yet alive: After three days I will rise again .
text_la: dicentes : Domine, recordati sumus, quia seductor ille dixit adhuc vivens : Post tres dies resurgam.
text_pt: Dizendo: Senhor, lembramo-nos de que aquele enganador, vivendo ainda, disse: Depois de três dias ressuscitarei.
text_el: λέγοντες: κύριε, ἐμνήσθημεν ὅτι ἐκεῖνος ὁ πλάνος εἶπεν ἔτι ζῶν, μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἐγείρομαι.

text_en: Command therefore the sepulchre to be guarded until the third day: lest perhaps his disciples come and steal him away and say to the people: He is risen from the dead . And the last error shall be worse than the first.
text_la: Jube ergo custodiri sepulchrum usque in diem tertium : ne forte veniant discipuli ejus, et furentur eum, et dicant plebi : Surrexit a mortuis : et erit novissimus error pejor priore.
text_pt: Manda, pois, que o sepulcro seja guardado com segurança até ao terceiro dia, não se dê o caso que os seus discípulos vão de noite, e o furtem, e digam ao povo: Ressuscitou dentre os mortos; e assim o último erro será pior do que o primeiro.
text_el: κέλευσον οὖν ἀσφαλισθῆναι τὸν τάφον ἕως τῆς τρίτης ἡμέρας, μήποτε ἐλθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ κλέψωσιν αὐτὸν καὶ εἴπωσιν τῷ λαῷ: ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ ἔσται ἡ ἐσχάτη πλάνη χείρων τῆς πρώτης.

text_en: Pilate says to them: You have a guard. Go, guard it as you know .
text_la: Ait illis Pilatus : Habetis custodiam, ite, custodite sicut scitis.
text_pt: E disse-lhes Pilatos: Tendes a guarda; ide, guardai-o como entenderdes.
text_el: ἔφη αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος: ἔχετε κουστωδίαν: ὑπάγετε ἀσφαλίσασθε ὡς οἴδατε.

text_en: And they departing, made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone and setting guards.
text_la: Illi autem abeuntes, munierunt sepulchrum, signantes lapidem, cum custodibus.
text_pt: E, indo eles, seguraram o sepulcro com a guarda, selando a pedra.
text_el: οἱ δὲ πορευθέντες ἠσφαλίσαντο τὸν τάφον, σφραγίσαντες τὸν λίθον μετὰ τῆς κουστωδίας.

text_en: And in the end of the sabbath , when it began to dawn towards the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalen and the other Mary, to see the sepulchre .
text_la: Vespere autem sabbati, quæ lucescit in prima sabbati, venit Maria Magdalene, et altera Maria, videre sepulchrum.
text_pt: E, no fim do sábado, quando já despontava o primeiro dia da semana, Maria Madalena e a outra Maria foram ver o sepulcro.
text_el: Ὀψὲ δὲ σαββάτων, τῇ ἐπιφωσκούσῃ εἰς μίαν σαββάτων, ἦλθεν Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ ἡ ἄλλη Μαρία θεωρῆσαι τὸν τάφον.

text_en: And behold there was a great earthquake. For an angel of the Lord descended from heaven and coming rolled back the stone and sat upon it.
text_la: Et ecce terræmotus factus est magnus. Angelus enim Domini descendit de cælo : et accedens revolvit lapidem, et sedebat super eum:
text_pt: E eis que houvera um grande terremoto, porque um anjo do Senhor, descendo do céu, chegou, removendo a pedra da porta, e sentou-se sobre ela.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ σεισμὸς ἐγένετο μέγας: ἄγγελος γὰρ κυρίου καταβὰς ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καὶ προσελθὼν ἀπεκύλισεν τὸν λίθον καὶ ἐκάθητο ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And his countenance was as lightning and his raiment as snow.
text_la: erat autem aspectus ejus sicut fulgur: et vestimentum ejus sicut nix.
text_pt: E o seu aspecto era como um relâmpago, e as suas vestes brancas como neve.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ἡ εἰδέα αὐτοῦ ὡς ἀστραπὴ, καὶ τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ λευκὸν ὡς χιών.

text_en: And for fear of him, the guards were struck with terror and became as dead men .
text_la: Præ timore autem ejus exterriti sunt custodes, et facti sunt velut mortui.
text_pt: E os guardas, com medo dele, ficaram muito assombrados, e como mortos.
text_el: ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ φόβου αὐτοῦ ἐσείσθησαν οἱ τηροῦντες καὶ ἐγενήθησαν ὡς νεκροί.

text_en: And the angel answering, said to the women : Fear not you: for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified.
text_la: Respondens autem angelus dixit mulieribus : Nolite timere vos : scio enim, quod Jesum, qui crucifixus est, quæritis.
text_pt: Mas o anjo, respondendo, disse às mulheres: Não tenhais medo; pois eu sei que buscais a Jesus, que foi crucificado.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν ταῖς γυναιξίν: μὴ φοβεῖσθε ὑμεῖς: οἶδα γὰρ ὅτι Ἰησοῦν τὸν ἐσταυρωμένον ζητεῖτε.

text_en: He is not here. For he is risen , as he said. Come, and see the place where the Lord was laid.
text_la: Non est hic : surrexit enim, sicut dixit : venite, et videte locum ubi positus erat Dominus.
text_pt: Ele não está aqui, porque já ressuscitou, como havia dito. Vinde, vede o lugar onde o Senhor jazia.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε: ἠγέρθη γὰρ, καθὼς εἶπεν: δεῦτε ἴδετε τὸν τόπον ὅπου ἔκειτο.

text_en: And going quickly, tell his disciples that he is risen . And behold he will go before you into Galilee . There you shall see him. Lo, I have foretold it to you.
text_la: Et cito euntes, dicite discipulis ejus quia surrexit : et ecce præcedit vos in Galilæam : ibi eum videbitis : ecce prædixi vobis.
text_pt: Ide pois, imediatamente, e dizei aos seus discípulos que já ressuscitou dentre os mortos. E eis que ele vai adiante de vós para a Galiléia; ali o vereis. Eis que eu vo-lo tenho dito.
text_el: καὶ ταχὺ πορευθεῖσαι εἴπατε τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ ἰδοὺ προάγει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, ἐκεῖ αὐτὸν ὄψεσθε. ἰδοὺ εἶπον ὑμῖν.

text_en: And they went out quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy , running to tell his disciples .
text_la: Et exierunt cito de monumento cum timore et gaudio magno, currentes nuntiare discipulis ejus.
text_pt: E, saindo elas pressurosamente do sepulcro, com temor e grande alegria, correram a anunciá-lo aos seus discípulos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπελθοῦσαι ταχὺ ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου μετὰ φόβου καὶ χαρᾶς μεγάλης ἔδραμον ἀπαγγεῖλαι τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And behold, Jesus met them, saying: All hail. But they came up and took hold of his feet and adored him.
text_la: Et ecce Jesus occurrit illis, dicens : Avete. Illæ autem accesserunt, et tenuerunt pedes ejus, et adoraverunt eum.
text_pt: E, indo elas a dar as novas aos seus discípulos, eis que Jesus lhes sai ao encontro, dizendo: Eu vos saúdo. E elas, chegando, abraçaram os seus pés, e o adoraram.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἰησοῦς ὑπήντησεν αὐταῖς λέγων: χαίρετε. αἱ δὲ προσελθοῦσαι ἐκράτησαν αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ.

text_en: Then Jesus said to them: Fear not. Go, tell my brethren that they go into Galilee . There they shall see me.
text_la: Tunc ait illis Jesus : Nolite timere : ite, nuntiare fratribus meis ut eant in Galilæam; ibi me videbunt.
text_pt: Então Jesus disse-lhes: Não temais; ide dizer a meus irmãos que vão à Galiléia, e lá me verão.
text_el: τότε λέγει αὐταῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: μὴ φοβεῖσθε: ὑπάγετε ἀπαγγείλατε τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου ἵνα ἀπέλθωσιν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, κἀκεῖ με ὄψονται.

text_en: Who when they were departed, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all things that had been done.
text_la: Quæ cum abiissent, ecce quidam de custodibus venerunt in civitatem, et nuntiaverunt principibus sacerdotum omnia quæ facta fuerant.
text_pt: E, quando iam, eis que alguns da guarda, chegando à cidade, anunciaram aos príncipes dos sacerdotes todas as coisas que haviam acontecido.
text_el: Πορευομένων δὲ αὐτῶν, ἰδού τινες τῆς κουστωδίας ἐλθόντες εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἀπήγγειλαν τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν ἅπαντα τὰ γενόμενα.

text_en: And they being assembled together with the ancients, taking counsel, gave a great sum of money to the soldiers,
text_la: Et congregati cum senioribus consilio accepto, pecuniam copiosam dederunt militibus,
text_pt: E, congregados eles com os anciãos, e tomando conselho entre si, deram muito dinheiro aos soldados,
text_el: καὶ συναχθέντες μετὰ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων συμβούλιόν τε λαβόντες ἀργύρια ἱκανὰ ἔδωκαν τοῖς στρατιώταις,

text_en: saying: Say you, His disciples came by night and stole him away when we were asleep.
text_la: dicentes : Dicite quia discipuli ejus nocte venerunt, et furati sunt eum, nobis dormientibus.
text_pt: Dizendo: Dizei: Vieram de noite os seus discípulos e, dormindo nós, o furtaram.
text_el: λέγοντες: εἴπατε ὅτι οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς ἐλθόντες ἔκλεψαν αὐτὸν ἡμῶν κοιμωμένων.

text_en: And if the governor shall hear of this, we will persuade him and secure you.
text_la: Et si hoc auditum fuerit a præside, nos suadebimus ei, et securos vos faciemus.
text_pt: E, se isto chegar a ser ouvido pelo presidente, nós o persuadiremos, e vos poremos em segurança.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ἀκουσθῇ τοῦτο ἐπὶ τοῦ ἡγεμόνος, ἡμεῖς πείσομεν καὶ ὑμᾶς ἀμερίμνους ποιήσομεν.

text_en: So they taking the money , did as they were taught: and this word was spread abroad among the Jews even unto this day.
text_la: At illi, accepta pecunia, fecerunt sicut erant edocti. Et divulgatum est verbum istud apud Judæos, usque in hodiernum diem.
text_pt: E eles, recebendo o dinheiro, fizeram como estavam instruídos. E foi divulgado este dito entre os judeus, até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: οἱ δὲ λαβόντες ἀργύρια ἐποίησαν ὡς ἐδιδάχθησαν: καὶ διεφημίσθη ὁ λόγος οὗτος παρὰ Ἰουδαίοις μέχρι τῆς σήμερον. [ἡμέρας]

text_en: And the eleven disciples went into Galilee , unto the mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
text_la: Undecim autem discipuli abierunt in Galilæam in montem ubi constituerat illis Jesus.
text_pt: E os onze discípulos partiram para a Galiléia, para o monte que Jesus lhes tinha designado.
text_el: Οἱ δὲ ἕνδεκα μαθηταὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν εἰς τὸ ὄρος οὗ ἐτάξατο αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς,

text_en: And seeing him they adored : but some doubted .
text_la: Et videntes eum adoraverunt : quidam autem dubitaverunt.
text_pt: E, quando o viram, o adoraram; mas alguns duvidaram.
text_el: καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν προσεκύνησαν, οἱ δὲ ἐδίστασαν.

text_en: And Jesus coming, spoke to them, saying: All power is given to me in heaven and in earth.
text_la: Et accedens Jesus locutus est eis, dicens : Data est mihi omnis potestas in cælo et in terra:
text_pt: E, chegando-se Jesus, falou-lhes, dizendo: É-me dado todo o poder no céu e na terra.
text_el: καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς λέγων: ἐδόθη μοι πᾶσα ἐξουσία ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

text_en: Going therefore, teach all nations : baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Ghost .
text_la: euntes ergo docete omnes gentes : baptizantes eos in nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti:
text_pt: Portanto ide, fazei discípulos de todas as nações, batizando-os em nome do Pai, e do Filho, e do Espírito Santo;
text_el: πορευθέντες οὖν μαθητεύσατε πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, βαπτίζοντες αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ τοῦ υἱοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος,

text_en: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you. And behold I am with you all days, even to the consummation of the world .
text_la: docentes eos servare omnia quæcumque mandavi vobis : et ecce ego vobiscum sum omnibus diebus, usque ad consummationem sæculi.
text_pt: Ensinando-os a guardar todas as coisas que eu vos tenho mandado; e eis que eu estou convosco todos os dias, até a consumação dos séculos. Amém.
text_el: διδάσκοντες αὐτοὺς τηρεῖν πάντα ὅσα ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν. καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ μεθ' ὑμῶν εἰμι πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἕως τῆς συντελείας τοῦ αἰῶνος.
